ds: A mysterious cloud has appeared off the Mist Coast, hovering over the ocean waves: immobile, slowly expanding, and impenetrable to the eye. No wind moves it, and fishermen dare not approach. Several fishing boats have gone missing, and the fishing town of Darnby lives in fear. Local authorities call for the assistance of adventurers to suss out the mysterious cloud and dispel it. As you enter these mists, strange shapes loom before you. Enter the world of veiled foes and threats that remain unseen - until it’s too late! While this is a stand-alone adventure, it is also the first of three sequential and interconnected Mist Coast adventures planned for Gen Con 2026. If you like, you can sign up for multiple Mist Coast adventure events to get the feel of a mini campaign. We will be following the Original Dungeons and Dragons rules published in 1974. Join us for an old-school D&D adventure!
sd: A great, expanding cloud hovers over the ocean waters just off the Mist Coast, disrupting the local fishing industry. A group of intrepid adventurers assembles to probe the ominous mists. Are you in?

In the Major League Dungeon expect interviews, fan interaction, sponsorship opportunities, and a dungeon built for spectacle as much as survival.
 
 This adventure features four teams of 4–6 players, each at their own table, running the same dungeon under the same rules. Teams earn points through combat performance, puzzle-solving, style, crowd engagement, and creative problem-solving. When the dust settles, scores are tallied and the top team claims bragging rights as the best delvers in the league.

ds: This adventure continues the story of a series of related adventures from past Gen Con Conventions. Your group of railroaders first encountered Phineas Bartleby's gang as you tried to put a tunnel through a mountain where the bandits were illegally mining a rich gold vein. You then disrupted his gold smelting operation, stopped his train hijacking, and tracked him down to his mountaintop hideout, where he was wounded and taken into custody. Now, after a few months of recovery, you are summoned as witnesses at Phineas' trial at the Cedar Bluff courthouse. Riding the trail late in the day, you reach the top of a ridge and see the town of Cedar Bluff in the valley below. The trial starts tomorrow. In the gathering darkness, you wonder: Is all as it seems? We will be following the original Boot Hill Basic Rules published in 1975 for this event. Join us for a classic wild west adventure!
sd: After effecting his capture and neutralizing his operation, your group is called as witnesses in the trial of notorious gangster Phineas Bartleby. Courthouse. High noon. What could possibly go wrong?

t: A Hero Arises: A Tarot-Driven Adventure
gm: Danielle Marshall, Alejandro Tey, Rob Schehr
ds: Tarot informs every element of this game; it has defined the entire magical universe in which the game exists, is used to create characters and shape narrative, and drives outcomes through rich and exciting game mechanics that are just as satisfying as rolling dice in other RPGs. Players share control of a single Hero, each playing an internal Aspect of that Hero based on archetypal figures from the tarot. Roleplay includes Aspects interacting with each other to give voice to the Hero's inner conflicts and decisions, as well as trading off the control of their shared Hero in the world. The Diviner (GM) reads cards, using the number, suit, and interpretation of a drawn card to drive scenes and resolve encounters. This one-shot will be equally enjoyable to those with no tarot experience or advanced practitioners. Participants will split into groups, four players per Diviner for gameplay.
sd: Successfully Kickstarted in 2024! A magical, urban fantasy adventure driven by tarot cards in place of dice. Each player controls one inner Aspect of a shared Hero (think Pixar's Inside Out).

t: A Taste of Div: Tarot-Driven Character Creation
gm: Shannon Desmond, Jerica Hucke, Tam Cecala, Jackson (Grover) Hollway
ds: Want to check out the game but don't have time for a full four-hour play-through? This abridged session is exactly what you need! Players share control of a single Hero, each playing an internal Aspect of that Hero based on archetypal figures from the tarot. The character creation process is a tarot-guided series of story prompts that takes your group through building together the Hero you share as well as each of your individual Aspects within that Hero. This demo will show you how tarot informs every element of the game—defining the entire magical universe in which the game exists, creating characters and shaping narrative, and driving outcomes through rich and exciting game mechanics that are just as satisfying as rolling dice in other RPGs. Participants will split into groups, four players per Diviner, for this experience.
sd: Experience a shortened look at the game - our full unique character creation process (which many call their favorite part of the game!), plus a short demo of core mechanics.

t: Starred For Life - Tarot RPG Learn to Play
ds:
No dice are required at this learn-to-play event for the tarot-based TTRPG Starred for Life. A copy of the game rulebook is included with each ticket!
 
 Starred for Life is a game about cute witches in an uncute world. The stories you will tell in this game can range from cozy slice-of-life romances to soul-sucking trials of the heart.
 
 Embrace being a Virgo Sun, Leo Moon, and Gemini Rising as you strive to reach your goals and manage your burdens. 
 
 Most players play a witch who has dreams that they want to accomplish and duties they have to manage. One player is the Master of Ceremonies whose goal is to fill in the rest of the world and give you tough choices to make.
 
 Powered by the Apocalypse. A standard-sized Tarot Deck is required for play.
sd: A game for cute witches in an uncute world. This is an astrology and tarot-based TTRPG that's powered by the apocalypse. This includes a copy of the game!

ds: A new developer, Bayou Phoenix, has bought the remains of Six Flags Jazzland in New Orleans and have begun tearing down some of the 65 structures. Unfortunately, strange accidents have been plaguing the demolition, from simple equipment failure to catastrophic building collapses. Many blame the ghosts of those that drowned when Hurricane Katrina struck back in 2005. Others believe that the land itself is cursed. McCall International is sending your team in to find out what is happening before these hazards become fatalities.

ds: The city of Kirtland, Ohio just had one of the worst Halloween nights in its history. 4 people were savagely murdered, in different parts of the town, and by different methods. This place was the site of several paranormal sightings several years ago, but there were never any attacks, let alone homicides. Are the two incidents connected in some way, or has something new come into the area to spread death and mayhem, especially on a night known for its chaos. McCall International is sending your team in to try to solve these bizarre cases before anyone else dies.

Return to the roots of the Alien universe in the latest cinematic scenario for the new Evolved Edition of the Alien RPG. You are a member of the crew of a decaying old Bison-class transport starship, the USCSS Fidanza, making a simple run to the mining facility of Jeremiah VI to deliver equipment and collect a refinery tower. However, upon arriving at the facility, things are not what you expected. 
 
 *This is a 4 part game of the cinematic scenario Rapture Protocol. Purchase of a ticket for part 1 gives you access to all 4 parts throughout the con. All parts run at the same time on each day of the con. Only purchase a ticket if you plan on playing in all 4 parts.
sd: The crew of a small starfreighter on a resupply run to the remote Jeremiah VI industrial colony, soon find themselves embroiled in a deadly conflict.

ds:
Welcome to Barovia, where you must face your nightmares and conquer your fears. It's dangerous, deadly, and brimming with tension. This is a reimagining of the popular Curse of Strahd introduction known as Death House. Durst Manor offers a riveting story, immersive handouts you can take home, and fun roleplaying opportunities. Environmental descriptions have been revamped to amplify suspense and bring the beauty and horror of this grim realm to life. Your choices will shape the unfolding narrative as you explore, interact with the world, and uncover the harrowing secrets buried within Durst Manor.
 
 I am a professional dungeon master specializing in Curse of Strahd. I have run Durst Manor countless times for over a dozen groups. I’ve also run one-shots for Kobold Press events. Will you conquer the nightmare and cement your name in legend, or join the cursed souls of those who failed?
sd: Unravel chilling secrets, face unspeakable horrors, and survive the nightmare, lest you join the cursed spirits of those who came before you. Do you dare to step inside?

gm: Thomas Marshall, Patrick Jascot, Aaron Wilcoxon, Teagan Rose
ds:
Welcome to a world dominated by anthropomorphic animals (Djura) in a fantasy/sci-fi setting. Inspired by many stories of animal people, their struggles, victories, and how they mirror our own, the game is designed to be a comprehensive role-playing experience that enables dramatic storytelling of all kinds. Players will take on the roles of a Djura, becoming part of the story involving fragments, powerful remnants of their lost civilization, with the power to change the very fabric of reality. 
 
 *At the event, you'll choose a pre-generated character based on their preferences between 32 different animals and 8 different careers.
 
 **Attendees will receive an official set of Djura Dice and a unique code for a Djura quick-play PDF guide, which includes a starter scenario and pre-generated character sheets.
sd: Your crew regains consciousness, chained down and in complete darkness, after a hazily remembered heist. Where are you, how did you get here, how can you escape, & what is that scraping sound?

ds: Cosplay Deviants is back again with their eighth year of naughty adventures! Your GMs will guide you (and a special guest Deviant!) into the depths of Erotic Fantasy as your characters attempt to solve a sexy mystery that each player helps to craft! Players will answer questions and roleplay their way into their own unique character. It will be rude, gross, sexy, and hilarious so please come prepared with an open mind. This is a unique system designed just for this adventure and we're sure you're going to love it! This arousing adventure is Powered by the Apocalypse and should be completed in less than two hours.
sd: Is the eighth anniversary time for a dungeon date?! Play through a rousing quest with dirty jokes & unique storytelling gameplay that you help create! Each game is different!

t: The Blighted Ones. A WakeSong Campaign Introduction
lo: ICC Hall B : Pine Box Entertainment HQ
ds: The Bukana islands are inspired by the rich cultures of pre-colonial Philippines & Indonesia. Meaning “gateway,” Bukana is a prosperous, magical archipelago. It is the commercial hub of our blossoming world where a visitor can see travelers inspired by cultures throughout Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and even Meso- and South America. Bukana is part of WakeSong, a magical land of daring adventures, terrifying beasts and, of course, heroes. Players will encounter monsters from the Bukana Bestiary release by PBE.
sd: Investigate mysterious disappearances of townsfolk in a world that takes inspiration from the darker tales and folklore of the Philippines.

t: Dungeons and Doggies: Raining Cats and Dogs!
ds: Now that the humans of Haven know just what their furry friends have been up to, things have been...well...different, to say the least! Being able to explain everything may have helped, but once the Clawed One, god of felines, sets his eye on the Great Mother's followers, the courageous canines must go on the run to protect their humans from harm. It's dogs versus cats to decide who is worthy of their gods' blessings!
sd: The humans of Haven now know just what their furry friends have been up to, and things have changed a bit. New adventures await as our courageous canines become targets of the Clawed One, god of cats!

ds:
This event is part of a series of one-shot Vampire the Masquerade RPG Chronicles reimagining what what the Video Game Bloodlines 2 could have been, each session will be unique.
 
 In this version, we explore what the originally planned Troika Games Bloodlines sequel set in Las Vegas during the year 2008 could have been like. 
 
 The players may choose from 1 of 7 pre-generated characters to play, who all belong to the same coterie. 
 
 "The Neonate", the player character of the first Bloodlines game, killed each of your Sires, the Vampires who created you and became your mentors. 
 
 You are now on a quest of vengeance to navigate Kindred Politics, uncover the mystery of why the Neonate slew your Sires, and survive the encroaching doom of Gehenna.
sd: An RPG Chronicle Reimagining of the originally planned sequel to Troika games' Cult Classic Vampire the Masquerade - Bloodlines. Join a Coterie of Vampires to uncover mysterious events in Las Vegas.

ds:
This event is part of a series of one-shot Vampire the Masquerade RPG Chronicles reimagining what what the Video Game Bloodlines 2 could have been, each session will be unique.
 
 In this version, we explore what the canceled Hardsuit Labs version of Bloodlines 2 set in Seattle during the year 2020 could have been like. 
 
 The players may choose from 1 of 7 pre-generated characters to play, who all belong to the same Thin-Blood Vampire Coterie. 
 
 The Coterie will awake hungry, pulling themselves out of a mass grave. Together, you will discover your unusual power, survive being Hunted by Vampires and Mortals alike, and learn of the practice of consuming another Vampire's Soul for Power: Diablerie. 
 
 Will you succumb to this forbidden ritual? Or will you try to keep your Humanity intact? Whatever you choose surviving Seattle, a city besieged by the Sabbat, will not be simple.
sd: An RPG Chronicle Reimagining of the Hardsuit Labs' canceled version of Vampire the Masquerade - Bloodlines 2. Join a Coterie of Thin-Blood Vampires and learn the joys of Diablerie!

ds: You’ve been unexpectedly recalled from your current assignment to a classified mission briefing at Naval Station Roosevelt Roads. Deep within the Navy's inner workings an enigmatic benefactor recognized your unique skills/experience and secured your spot on this top-secret task. The clandestine assignment code named Hot Game carries an official mission: observe & report scientific research in the expanse of Antarctica. However rumors of unexplained phenomena in the Antarctic Convergence, unexplored dangers below the ice, & unspoken tensions among the crew point to a mission far beyond the boundaries of scientific inquiry. What secrets lie hidden at the frozen edge of the world? What forces have drawn the Navy to this desolate frontier? As icy winds and shadowed waters of the Southern Ocean close around you, one thing becomes certain: Not all missions return with answers - or survivors.
sd: 1958 - the US Navy formed Task Force 88 to conduct Operation Hot Gate, a mission officially considered to be scientific research. Beneath the facade however, lay secrets no one could fully comprehend.

ds: 22-APR-1986: You are an agent within the United States government. You have been recalled from your current assignment for a secretive meeting at Frederick Sherman Field (Naval Auxiliary Landing Field) in San Clemente, California. Because of your particular knowledge, skills set, and previous experiences in life someone higher up in the inner workings of government has taken an interest in you. They have managed to get you on a tour of the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant in Pripyat, Ukraine, U.S.S.R. in the name of the Interacademy Scientific Exchange. Your stated mission is to observe the construction of the new #5 reactor scheduled to come online soon. However, all is not as it seems in the Red Empire.
sd: The Interacademy Scientific Exchange is an agreement between the U.S. and U.S.S.R. enabling scientists to visit & work with each other. The U.S. has interest in reactor #5 opening soon at Chernobyl.

ds: On LV-637, planet Thames, the Mining Underground Technique Control Organization has gone on strike and seized control of the lithium Clipperton Fracture mine and the Deepstar Nine refining facility. But three weeks ago the strikers went silent, production ceased completely, and this has put the United Americas and Colonial Marine Corps in an unacceptable situation.
sd: On LV-637 the Mining Underground Technique Control Organization is on strike and seized control of the Clipperton Fracture mine. Three weeks ago the strikers went silent.

ds: 1974 - You've been selected for a mission that does not exist. Under extraordinary secrecy the United States authorizes Apollo 19, a classified lunar mission hidden under Cold War bureaucracy and National Security concerns. Recalled from your duties, you're briefed by NASA officials who speak carefully, omit details, and make clear this mission will never be acknowledged. Apollo 19 exists to investigate anomalous telemetry & inconsistencies recovered from earlier missions. However, concerns persist the Soviet Union has conducted undisclosed lunar operations, forcing NASA & U.S. intelligence to confirm what, if anything, was left behind on the Moon. As you sail further from Earth, radio delays turn to silence, and it becomes clear your mission is not about discovery, but verification. What was found on Luna’s surface was buried for a reason. Some truths were never meant to return home.
sd: Officially, the Apollo Program ended in 1972. Unofficially, Apollo 19 was a classified lunar mission, launched amongst fears of Soviet activity. What waits on the Moon was never meant to be found.

ds: You recently went beneath the evil city of Bilkarfin, and performed a ritual to return the artifact, Hands of Odin, to Odin himself. You had to get past Melchime, a Mind Flayer Mage, and his mechanics, to get to the burried Temple of Odin. You succeeded, and escaped, but Melchime learned of the Temple. You met, and he destroyed, Derdrumin. He was the ghost of a Dwarven priest, protecting the sunken temple. It's been 10 days, and Derdrumin has reformed. He appears to you... "Melchime is in the temple. He and his minions are raiding its treasures. The temple has them trapped for now, but I need you to stop them before they escape."
sd: You've returned the Hand of Odin to the Gods! You deserve a rest. That's exactly what you're doing, when the Ghost of the Dwarven Priest, Derdrumin, appears. Melchime is raiding the fallen temple!

ds: The town of Pleasantville, Indiana, is a quintessentially midwestern town. The Great Depression brought a boom in this town through the increased sales of soy. Lately, strange events have caused the residents to question the stability of this thriving town. As you delve into the town's history and present events, the future will become even more uncertain.
sd: Strange occurrences in your hometown have brought you back to investigate. As you dig deeper into the unusual event, you may learn that some secrets are best left hidden.

gm: Randal Cox, David Mitchard, Doug Moore, Buster Pishkur, Phil Sorensen, Eris Beamer
ds: Think NASCRAG is all about role-playing and funny voices? SKIP that! Nascrag: Survivor returns for our 47th year at Gen Con with all new puzzles and challenges. That’s right, we’re giving you what you really want—puzzles! NASCRAG Survivor pits 10 teams of 5-7 players against each other in a fierce 2-hour puzzle bowl. Each time a team solves a puzzle, they rack up points: 3 for being first, 2 for second, and 1 for third. The team with the highest score wins and takes home commemorative NASCRAG Survivor hats. Expect fierce competition, team taunting, and fast-paced fun. Whether you're a puzzle master or a casual player, join us for bragging rights and a shot at becoming the ultimate puzzle champs. Remember, when it’s time for story... SKIP to the fun!
sd: All new puzzles for 2026. A fast-paced puzzle bowl where teams battle to solve puzzles for glory and bragging! Now you can SKIP the story - start the puzzles!

ds: You will join your team of researchers to try & find the answers to why the lights went out in this game of tragic storytelling. Hope may be the only thing left as your team faces off against an unknowable force which wishes to blanket the world in an eternal darkness. You are all experts in your respective fields and are employed at the same university. Your characters will be created and fleshed out over the course of the start of the game.
sd: As an academic, you thought you could rationalize the lights going out. No sun, no moon, no stars. Your training has given you some theories, but in the dark, it all fades away.

gm: Randal Cox, Tyler DeVries, David Mitchard, Doug Moore, Buster Pishkur, Eris Beamer, Conner White
ds:
Questia was built for adventure — until GARCSAN took over. They promised safety, branding, and risk management, but the rise of the mysterious Black Wind made every quest more dangerous. Customers fled. Profits fell. The image must be protected.
 Your children didn’t listen. They ran off adventuring anyway, chasing danger, purpose, and a found family that didn't include you. Now they’re captured - and this time, the responsibility is yours. You are flawed, guilty parents forced back into a world you don’t understand to rescue the kids you pushed away.
 Expect madcap role-playing, sharp corporate satire, and a strong emphasis on clever puzzles over brute force. Come for the puzzles. Stay for the guilt. Proceeds to charity. PG-13. D&D 5E for 5–7 players. Pre-generated characters provided.
sd: Your kids ran off to become heroes. They screwed up. Now you have to fix it. Estranged parents, zany role-play, clever puzzles, corporate satire, and a very dangerous adventure planet.

ds:
Questia was built for adventure — until GARCSAN took over. They promised safety, branding, and risk management, but the rise of the mysterious Black Wind made every quest more dangerous. Customers fled. Profits fell. The image must be protected.
 Your children didn’t listen. They ran off adventuring anyway, chasing danger, purpose, and a found family that didn't include you. Now they’re captured - and this time, the responsibility is yours. You are flawed, guilty parents forced back into a world you don’t understand to rescue the kids you pushed away.
 Expect madcap role-playing, sharp corporate satire, and a strong emphasis on clever puzzles over brute force. Come for the puzzles. Stay for the guilt. Proceeds to charity. PG-13. D&D 5E for 5–7 players. Pre-generated characters provided.
sd: Your kids ran off to become heroes. They screwed up. Now you have to fix it. Estranged parents, zany role-play, clever puzzles, corporate satire, and a very dangerous adventure planet.

gm: Sammi Burch, David Mitchard, Doug Moore, Buster Pishkur, Phil Sorensen, Heather Ashcraft, Grayson Post, Elisa Ford, David Chase
ds:
The league finals are right around the corner and the Arkham Investigators have just concluded the penultimate bout. As the league leaders the honor of hosting the championships falls on them. But, hold on, why is the head ref missing? Where is the Trophy? Not to mention, all the games where things at the Arkham Roller Rink have mysteriously gone wrong. Surely this isn’t some kind of conspiracy orchestrated by the Innsmouth Ancients. But there’s no time to think about that, the Arkham Investigators have a bout to prepare for.
 Join us for a Nascrag Pulp Cthluhu roller derby adventure, with big hits, torn fishnets, weird voices, missing refs, puzzles, mysteries, and…fish?
 Most importantly, where are we going to get the beer for the after party?
sd: The Arkham Investigators are about to host the league championships against the Innsmouth Ancients. Can you host one bout without the mysterious "accidents" that have plagued your team all season?

t: Indianapolis by Night: The Circle City; Night 1: Foundations
ds: With the disappearance of Melvin Ramses, the beloved leader of Indianapolis, rumors of the shadow of the Sabbat, the encroaching presence of the Camarilla and the Anarchs insistence of the Circle City officially joining the Anarch Free States, the local Kindred force through into the future. Night one is a social night, centering on getting to know the options given in this new, dangerous political climate.
sd: Since the 1960s Indianapolis has been in the clutches of the Followers of Set. In modern nights the serpents have rebranded as the Ministry and thrown their lot in with the Anarch Movement.

t: Doffin Grimstone's Monster Hunts - City Sewer Sleuths (One Shot)
ds: When it comes to hunting monsters, there's one name that stands out above the rest: Doffin Grimstone. His book, Doffin Grimstone's Manual of Monsters, chronicles such beasts as the Spicy Butterfly, Misplacing Beast, Froggermorphs, and others. Something has been kidnapping the good people of Canbridge, and Doffin has hired your crew to assist him in solving the mystery. Find out who or what is behind the kidnappings and help Doffin discover an entirely new monster! Characters provided or create your own. Free gift for every player!
sd: Join a famous monster hunter as he investigates missing person cases! The clues will lead the party on a wild adventure through a sewer system. Homebrew monsters and traps await the brave. Level 5.

t: Indianapolis by Night: The Circle City; Night 2: Your Vote Counts
ds: A new path with new leadership will shape the future, not only in this game but other Our Worlds of Darkness presentations at Gen Con.
sd: You have met the options. Now it is time to establish dominance of the Domain. Show your Support and Opposition and be part of the future of Indianapolis by Night.

t: Indianapolis by Night: The Circle City; Night 3: In Conclusion
ds: The results of this night's session will decide the Future of Indianapolis by Night: the Circle City. Our Worlds of Darkness has grand ambitions to return to future Gen Cons, to continue this story in a continuing Chronicle, telling the stories of the Kindred of the Domain. We hope to have returning player characters and continuing plotlines that will establish Indianapolis by Night: the Circle City as a yearly event that players anticipate returning to year after year. Come make your mark.
sd: The votes are in. The decision has been made. Indianapolis has a new path and a new leadership to guide them. Who will be satisfied with the outcome, who will not be and what will be the consequences?

t: Indianapolis by Night: In the Shadow of Ramses
ds: The shepherds of the city have tasked you and a coterie of neonates to investigate a series of mysterious attacks that have left several victims drained of blood and left where humans have found them. Mystery, Investigation and intrigue awaits.
sd: The Pharaoh is missing. The city is beset by enemies from the outside and something dark stalks the streets of Indianapolis by Night.

ds: Step into a richly illustrated fantasy garden where every leaf, root, and petal matters. In Garden Fall, players take on the role of tiny heroes drawn together by a mysterious call as the heart of the garden begins to fail. Explore strange paths, encounter memorable NPCs, face dangerous foes, and uncover fragments of a larger truth hidden beneath the soil. Combat is tense but accessible, choices carry lasting consequences, and even fallen characters continue to influence the story from beyond. This is a complete one-shot experience focused on narrative, teamwork, and meaningful decisions—no prior knowledge required, just a willingness to shape the fate of a living world.
sd: Play as garden gnomes exploring a dying magical garden, face impossible choices, and decide whether the Bloom lives or dies.

t: In Time, Lost - Rivers of Return
ds: This one-shot session uses a custom built system to tell stories inspired by the Destiny video game series. Players will take on the role of a risen Lightborn to defend humanity against hostile aliens and ruinous warlords. This session will introduce players to the rules and showcase the system’s high energy, fast paced combat and set the players against the growing horde summoned by Vilziks, the Plinian Chieftain.
sd: In the lawless Dark Ages, a fireteam must brave the impossible heat of a shattered Vesuvius and stop the Scorn from building an unspeakable army.

A team is sent to discover evidence as to his true motives and the source of his apparent knowledge.
sd: A team of Laundry agents are sent to investigate a politician who may be seeking access to dangerous occult powers.

ds: When the game has to be good, Paladin Hill Games returns for our 6th Geneva Convention. Carlos Hill's unique scenerio has you running a hero as well as three 0-level hirelings. The Necessities will be supplied to play the game. Plus each player will be taking home a swag package containing the following: your character sheets, 4 "Skinny Minis" brand miniatures, 10 custom luck tokens, and a custom satin bag to keep it all in. Do you dare take the Last Voyage over R’lyeh?
sd:
Paladin Hill Games brings an epic Boss fight!
 The ship lies splintered, and from the wreckage rises the Sleeper. Players will command brave heroes and hirelings in a desperate stand against Cthulhu!

t: Chivalrous Arts: The Raging Infernos of Tarzarus
ds:
They're back & this time the infernos are going to rage hotter than ever. The 2025 smash hit returns all new for 2026, with comments ranging from “best RPG I have played at GC to best game I have played in years” we have a blockbuster story, amazing setup, & elite DM’s, all players will have their choice of 1 of 2 gifts bags packed with cool stuff a $55 value. 6th level, characters provided.
 —Exiting the portal is a very strange being, the creature is in incredible pain and speaks of a captured civilization, & an inferno realm, it begs for your help, as your party debate what to do, you determine there is nothing to debate, it’s a time for Legends to be born, you draw your sword & say “Lets go!” Confident, powerful, & determined you like your chances, but can you or anyone or anything even survive? The Raging Infernos of Tarzarus. Based on the graphic novel series: Chivalrous Arts.
sd: Dining with fellow adventurers, a portal opens & the adventure of a lifetime begins— Travel to an inferno realm, battle a Dragon King & save a lost civilization. Amazing gift bags for all!

ds: With winter beginning to fade and the rays of spring growing warmer, the rabbits emerge in search of the Crane of Wisdom and to receive their annual blessing of plenty. But above ground, a world of tumult and unseen predators awaits them. This session is an introduction to the rabbit realm and the system, featuring a brand new mini-quest for our fuzzy friends.
sd: Play as rabbits on a harrowing adventure through a strange and apocalyptic world!

ds: You've seen something like this before. Strange attacks. Bodies drained of blood. Hastily managed cover ups. This is why you became a Hunter. You know that even if the mortal authorities are trying to keep the outlandishness of the occurrences from causing a panic, other things might just be pulling their strings. Whatever is responsible for the recent attacks is sloppy and needs to be put down.
sd: Something stalks the streets and alleyways of Indianapolis by Night. It's up to you and a small group of like minded people to discover what it might be.

t: Indianapolis by Night: The Wild in the Weaver's Domain
ds: Ghastly reports of grizzly killings flood the Red News Network. The city continues on as if nothing is wrong. Gaia in her death throws. The local Sept has partnered you up with a few local Garou with a simple directive; find whatever it is and kill it. Whatever the thing is it feeds like a leech, but it's not as careful. A new one perhaps? A vampire gone mad? Whatever it is, the Alpha was clear; it does not see another night.
sd: Werewolves hunting down the stench of the Worm on the streets of Indianapolis by Night. A killer stalks the streets and so do you.

ds:
A wealthy noble of Dominium city hires harbingers to find out why no one has heard from Blackwood Keep in many months. He gives the harbingers a sealed message for Cynrik Blackwood, its lord, and instructs them to assist with any troubles at the keep. Players will face several challenges and important decisions: 
 
 Travel across a land haunted by erratic nightfall and terrors it brings.
 Face the oppressive mystery befalling the keep and its people.
 Explore the keep and its surroundings.
sd: No word has been heard from Blackwood Keep since before winter, and harbingers (PCs) are sent to investigate.

gm: John Mosey, Ryan Reyes, Alex Kammer
ds:
Welcome to Wardens of the Eastern Marches, a new 5th edition organized play program that features physical magic item certs, character Alliances, and unmatched player and DM rewards. Each character joins one of six Alliances which is central to this setting, The Eastern Marches. Enjoy top quality adventures run by the best DMs and run by a team of admins that put the player and DM experience above all else. 
 
 For this adventure, the action begins in the trade route outpost known as Kebbles Bend, located on the Great South Road between Robertshire and Fallmarch.
 
 Create a Wardens 5th edition character or play a pregenerated one. Join an Alliance and help us figure out what happened on Midsummer's eve. 
 
 Bright Stars and Misery is a levels 1-3 adventure. For complete information on Wardens character creation guidelines, visit www.gameholepublishing.com.
sd: Explore a swamp to find a mysterious object in this player-focused new organized play program. Make a character or use our pre-gens, join an alliance to and enjoy this level 1-3 game.

ds: Players will be Tier 1 adventurers who work together to discover the darkness behind the quaint little gnomish town of Timbers! Prepare to name some NPCs, talk to strangers, explore some forests, and foist some evil plans. There will be a mix of roleplay, exploration, and combat, but emphasis for the one shot will be on the roleplay. Players should bring a set of dice, paper, and pencil, but those can be borrowed during the session. Pre-gen level 1 characters will be provided if needed. All experiences welcome! A short primer of the rules will be given at the start for those who haven't played before. We will also do a quick session 0 for everyone to communicate anything they don't want to see in their game.
sd: Join the GM of the Dodoborne podcast as we unravel the insidious secrets that plague the tiny gnomish town of Timbers. Mystery and Nonsense is guaranteed!

ds:
A wealthy noble of Dominium city hires harbingers to find out why no one has heard from Blackwood Keep in many months. He gives the harbingers a sealed message for Cynrik Blackwood, its lord, and instructs them to assist with any troubles at the keep. Players will face several challenges and important decisions: 
 
 Travel across a land haunted by erratic nightfall and terrors it brings.
 Face the oppressive mystery befalling the keep and its people.
 Explore the keep and its surroundings.

t: The Last Light of the Boglands
ds: Rumors spread of an undead horde rising from the Boglands, led by a necromantic force that grows stronger each night. Only one artifact can halt the tide: a massive swamp grown crystal known as the Heart of Stillwater, hidden deep within the bog. The crystal has awakened — and if the Nighthawks (locally famous adventurers) don’t retrieve it and deliver it to the ritual site before the horde reaches civilization, the entire region will fall. A local druid circle begs the adventurers for help. The relenless horde of undead are already on the move. This adventure uses 5th level pre-generated characters.
sd: An undead horde rises from the Boglands. Only one artifact can halt the tide: a massive crystal known as the Heart of Stillwater, hidden deep within the bog.

t: Tales of Aerysia: The Deeps of Mount Craeg III - The Eastern Forge
ds: The third chapter of our Mount Craeg-themed live game series requires characters to be Level 7. It is also intended for our two species of dwarves...the mountain dwarves (called gruhlar) and the furnace dwarves (called slaghar, a homebrew species). Certain classes will not be permitted, nor will multiclasses or evil-aligned characters be allowed. D&D Beyond will also be a requirement, as I would like to have your characters entered in advance of the game.
sd: With the northern and the western valves opened, it's time for the gruhlar and slaghar dwarves to penetrate the eastern valve and discover if the documentation about an ancient forge is true!

ds:
Condensed rules, pre-generated characters, and a tournament-style adventure. The adventure offers difficult challenges for even the bravest and most skilled adventurers. 
 
 Dragonbane is a classic fantasy tabletop role-playing game full of magic, mystery, and adventure. It is designed from the ground up to facilitate fast, furious play, with minimal prep time and adventures that are a breeze to run. Dragonbane is a game with room for laughs at the table, while still offering brutal challenges for the adventurers.
sd: A one-shot that the players will need to work together to solve puzzles, win battles, and find valuable treasure - all in just two hours!

t: Tales of Aerysia: Warlords of Ippon - The Cave of Mists
ds: Using material which adapts mythical japanese legends to 5e, the setting is the Shogunate land of Ippon where samurai, ninja, and geisha...among other classes and species...are plentiful! If you're a fan of anime and films set in the japanese feudal era, this will be right up your alley! You will be required to have a D&D Beyond account, multiclasses and evil-aligned characters are prohibited, and characters must be 5th Level. At least one character must be a samurai!
sd: Far beyond the commerce district of Hofuna Shokuryo in the province of Shikanotorizu, a cave mouth has been found shrouded in mists at the base of a large and massive mountain. What lies within?

ds:
Haven't been able to get your favorite character to level 20? Are you a DM that has some crazy build you have never been able to play? Well, this is your game! Bring me your min/max builds to face off in this epic one shot for experienced players.
 
 Check out my website to give you an idea of what you are in for!
 
 Your character can be any published class, race, and background (Sorry no Homebrew or UA). Use the “standard array” for your Attribute Scores generation method. When you select equipment, use either method (Starting Equipment or Gold), You may also spend up to 5000 gold on other non-magical equipment. You may take up to 20 points in magical items using the following rules: 1 point Common, 3 points Uncommon, 5 points Rare, 7 Points Very Rare, and 10 Points legendary. Again published magic items only.
sd: Players, bring me your level 20 crazy characters for this epic one-shot. What's the adventure? I’m not telling you, at this level, you should be able to handle a few surprises!

ds:
The world's deity of fire, death, & destruction is dead. You serve one of the world's other demigods, all who seek to replace him and ascend to godhood. You're not the only group that serves an ambitious demigod, however. It's a race to see who can consecrate enough of the temple to bestow immortality on their chosen demigod.
 
 This is an interactive adventure where four tables will simultaneously play the same adventure and have the opportunity to interact with one another.
sd: The god of fire, death, & destruction is dead, and his domains are empty. Can you consecrate the dead god's temple in time for your chosen demigod to ascend to divinity?

ds:
Long ago, the monks of Twistwarden Abbey hid away a foul god’s flesh from society. Recently, the abbot returned to civilization with warped flesh, warning of the foul god’s imminent return. The high priest of the light god and the dean of the Ars Arcana have tasked you with infiltrating the abbey and recovering the god flesh before the monks end existence as you know it. 
 
 This is an interactive adventure where four tables will simultaneously play the same adventure and have the opportunity to interact with one another.
sd: Can you and your crack team of specialists infiltrate Twistwarden Abbey and recover bits of a foul god’s flesh before corrupted monks can end existence as you know it?

ds:
After your village is attacked by a goblin horde, you begin to recover memories of your past life. As you right wrongs, you recover more of your memories—unlocking both new injustices and greater inner strength to defeat your forgotten foes.
 
 This is an interactive adventure where four tables will simultaneously play the same adventure and have the opportunity to interact with one another.
sd: After your village is attacked by a goblin horde, you begin recovering memories of your past life that leads you into direct conflict with the Fell Queen of Dieraen.

ds: This adventure is set in the world of Aerysia, a homebrew medieval fantasy realm featured on our Twitch livestream. D&D Beyond is a requirement for this game and the campaign link will be provided privately to those interested in joining. Characters should be 5th Level and are restricted to permitted Barbarian subclasses. Multiclasses and evil-aligned characters are forbidden, and some species choices are similarly not possible.
sd: The barbarians of the Proudfeet Tribe seek to destroy a female barbarian who has become a powerful vampire. To do so, they must negotiate a cavernous lair within the icy Silver Peaks region!

ds:
This is a narrative driven horror tabletop RPG focused on atmosphere, tension, and collaborative storytelling. The goal is to create a compelling horror story together through difficult choices and rising suspense.
 
 We use the Dread system, where actions require pulling blocks from a shared Jenga tower. A collapse triggers serious story consequences and often the removal of a character from play.
 
 Players sit at tables of six and choose one self contained horror one shot from two or three available scenarios. Each story is an anthology style experience built around moral pressure, escalating risk, and horror themes.
 
 Not every story ends in death, but many do. Survival is uncertain and not the focus. What matters most is the story that unfolds, the choices made under pressure, and the shared horror experience created at the table by everyone.
sd: A narrative focused horror tabletop RPG using the Dread system and a Jenga tower. Choose from list of one shot stories and shape a tense horror experience where choices matter more than winning.

ds: Can your crew of original companions of the Doctor help the crash survivors and uncover the deadly secret of the Planet of Terror? Can you find the Doctor, who seems to be missing?
sd: A spacecraft has crashed on a remote planet. Conditions are harsh and deadly. The survivors need help as something on the planet seems to be watching them. A blue box might be the only help.

t: The Chronicles of Naboria: Thieves of Time
ds: This D&D 5e playtest from Accidental Cyclops thrusts heroes snatched from the brink of death into a desperate race against time. Reality is unraveling, and only by confronting temporal anomalies and cosmic horrors can they restore balance. Players will explore fractured timelines, uncover sinister plots, and perform high-stakes rituals to prevent the collapse of existence itself. Along the way, you’ll playtest bold new content—innovative subclasses, unique races, and mechanics designed to push the boundaries of 5e. Every choice matters, every failure echoes across eternity. Will you defy fate and save time itself, or watch reality dissolve into chaos?
sd: Heroes snatched from death must unravel time-warped anomalies, confront cult plots and cosmic horrors, and perform rituals to save reality itself.

ds:
You and your fellow hunters have been traveling the country solving mysteries and decide to take a well-deserved break in a small, quiet little town. But this town is anything but peaceful. 
 We'll spend some time building your characters and setting the tone before jumping into the adventure. Feel free to come with ideas!
sd: While having a meal in a local diner after a long day of travel, a strange mist envelopes the town. Can you and your fellow hunters solve the mystery and escape before you are hunted down?

ds: Kill things. Get Achievements. Earn Fan Boxes. Level up a lot, you're gonna need it to survive the lower levels! Begin at Level 1. With each kill you grow stronger and gain more loot! Can you fight your way to Level 20 and survive to the bottom of HackMaster Wurld? This is not your typical adventure. The pace of leveling could be up to 80x faster than your typical campaign! You will get to experience the game across several levels of play. You will be showered with loot! But before you think this will be easy, the monsters and challenges will be scaling along with you as you delve ever deeper into the dungeon! Pregen characters will be provided because, quite frankly, you'll be so busy hacking you won't have time for the several level-ups you can expect!
sd: Inspired by Dungeon Crawler Carl. In HackMaster Wurld, the Gawds have put forth a challenge, and only the strongest will survive! You must delve deep into the dungeon, facing ever increasing dangers!

ds: I know what you're thinking, you think rats are a problem in many cities. So why should we be different? Well, you're right and wrong. The city has normal rats, but something is agitating them. And not only the rats but the beggars too. I think it's all connected. Every darn night I kill them and they keep coming up. The guards say it's nothing but I would ask around. If not maybe you'd take a look at the sewers for me? I will make it worth your while! What do you say? Level 3 adventurers will be provided.
sd: Rats! I tell you the city is cursed with them! If you ask me I think something is afoot. The city guard say it's nothing but I bet my rabbit foot it goes deeper.

ds: For nearly a week you've been most fortunate not having encountered a band of goblins or worse in this land. Trekking up this unnamed river valley north of the Tanara you are approaching the location of the pass you've been searching for. And there off in the distance you think you spot a splash of color against the dun rockface. Is that the passageway marking ornamentation the hermit related? There's only one way to tell! L4 pregens provided.
sd: The Earl of Reyifor has reason to suspect the humanoid tribes have found a secret pass through the mountains and has hired you to scour the vales looking for this pass.

ds: The party has been hired by the Sheriff in Waymeet to deal with a complaint/ call for assistance from the tiny village of Marron, up in the hilly portion of the region. It’s a three-day travel to there and it’s at the boundary of what the Sheriff covers. They don’t want to do the job, as they don’t want to leave the comforts of Waymeet, so it falls on you brave adventurers to face this challenge. This is an introductory adventure. 1st level pre-gens will be provided.
sd: Danger! Sheep! And more Danger! Are you the sheep? Or the Danger? Crawl your way through the hillsides and find out!

ds: The Baron Wrincol has hired you all to deal with the attacks of a group of bandits near a forested area. He wants you to deal with them and has offeded payment of 300 silver for your time. Also you are allowed to keep whatever loot you can find. He above all wants you to find their lair and make sure none of them remain. With no information concerning their lair the party will have to deal with these unknowns to stop the bandits. This adventure is for characters level 5-7. Pre-gens will be provided but home characters can be allowed.
sd: A group of bandits are plaguing the region. Is there something more to their depredations than just robbery? And why do they always seem to roll dice before they attack?

ds: An old school dungeon crawl using mechanics based on tarot cards. Your guild was recently tipped off to an entrance to a megadungeon beneath the comically macabre city of Hex. Now to get rich.
sd: An old school dungeon crawl using mechanics based on tarot cards. Your guild was recently tipped off to an entrance to a megadungeon beneath the comically macabre city of Hex. Now to get rich.

t: Sunken Bath of Mislaid Souls and Silver
ds: An old school adventure for 2nd-3rd level characters. You have chased a member of the deposed oligarchy to this remote provence. Please enjoy the not-haunted baths while you're here.
sd: An old school adventure for 2nd-3rd level characters. You have chased a member of the deposed oligarchy to this remote provence. Please enjoy the not-haunted baths while you're here.

ds: A brief hexcrawl and dungeoncrawl for 5th level characters through a land and dungeon inspired by the Three Kingdoms era of China. An adventure of vendettas and a kingdom on the precipice.
sd: A brief hexcrawl and dungeoncrawl for 5th level characters through a land and dungeon inspired by the Three Kingdoms era of China. An adventure of vendettas and a kingdom on the precipice.

ds: The Society has caught wind of a secret project involving a wealthy patron has contacted the Automata of London, The Doll Maker. Your organization is tasked with keeping an eye on this eccentric inventor as they are an informant. Find out what this project is and bring an end to it if it would disturb our polite society.
sd: It is 1899, you belong to a group known only as The Society. You walk a doomed path as an Investigator of the Occult. This investigation will test your body, mind, and soul.

t: The Shredder: Loma Park's Last Stand
ds: Powered by the brand new TraitCraft engine, Totally Rad is a lightning fast game about team up with your fellow BMX'ers, Skaters, Surfers, and whoever else you can round up! This event is led by the Designer.
sd: School starts in two weeks. Your favorite hangout is about to become a corporate chain. The prize purse is exactly enough to save it. Time to shred.

ds:
A mashup of Warhammer 40,000 and My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic. 
 On a planet-sized museum, the immortal collector of historic events, Trazyn, displays unwilling living exhibits in stasis fields. When a glitch damages Trazyn's systems, exhibits of Space Mareines, Zebrar, Yorks, Changelings, and more come to life, providing an opportunity to escape from the labyrinth dimensions. However, the cause of the glitch is only the first of many mysteries.
sd: Players must escape from Trazyn's museum after a glitch causes them and other exhibits to come to life.

ds: You brave and undeniably disposable troubleshooters are assigned to hunt traitors while handing out morale-boosting frozen treats during a brain-melting heatwave. Your team is then diverted on an Ultraviolet double-plus-high-priority mission to deliver an experimental sensor array to a data collection site. Unfortunately, that mission is so secret, even Friend Computer will deny its existence. Can you Troubleshooters complete a mission that doesn't exist? AI generated pictures will be used to help set the scenes.
sd: Troubleshooters distributing Cold Fun Food during a heatwave are diverted onto an ultra-super-duper-secret R&D mission so hush-hush that even Friend Computer denies its existence.

ds: Eight meta-beings from throughout the stars have formed the mighty team known as the Galactic Defenders. But though as superheroes they present a united front, not all is smooth sailing behind the scenes. There’s the love triangle that led to a divorce, and the daughter who picked mom’s side. Oh yeah, and the two men in this mess? They were business partners with a third team member, but a massive lab explosion bankrupted their company. Sure, two of them got their powers from that explosion, but was it really an accident? Meanwhile, the twins don’t know why their powers are so different, but with the help of the professor who is on the team, one of them hopes to figure out why. And don’t forget, there’s a meta-killer on the loose and the Defenders are trying to catch the being responsible. Roleplaying stressed!
sd: The amazing alien heroes of the Galactic Defenders find themselves on the trail of a murderer. Who killed Backwater Eddy? And why? Roleplaying stressed.

t: Rio Dorado - Action in the Weird Old West
ds: Small cattle rancher is being bullied by a larger spread for its water rights. You arrive in the town of Rio Dorado at the wrong time or is the just the right time to do some good. What is that foul stench? It smells like death.
sd: Cattle ranch wars with a small dose of undead thrown in to spice things up.

t: Off to the Wizard, I Want to Go Home
ds: You gathered at the tavern as usual; you look over the map you found, and the trail leads through the Shallows Swamp. You gather your gear, have one last drink of ale and the party heads to the swamps. The flash of light and the weirdness come later, such is the adventurers' lot.
sd: A map, a swamp witch and a strange new land, business as usual for Tig Tog's Titans

t: A Broken Ship - Need Work, No Job Too Small
ds: A broken ship, no credits to fix it and stuck in a backwater system, you'll take any job you're offered. Your ship was finally all paid for and you were on your way to the Gaven system to pick up a cargo. You ended up at K873 on a mining base with a busted ship. Broke, needing a job to pay for repairs.
sd: Create a character, if you survive character creation send them on a mission.

ds: Blackwater Rush is occupied by a Dragon. Our heroes are not yet strong enough to face the captor of their chosen home by themselves. They travel to the far away city state of Haven seeking help from family and old acquaintances. That help, however, comes at a high price. What are our heroes willing to do to obtain what they need to free their chosen home? Mature role-playing stressed.
sd: Our heroes travel to Haven seeking the help they need to free their chosen home from occupation. What price are they willing to pay for the assistance they need? Mature role-playing stressed.

t: The Twilight Trading Company: Founding Fathers
ds: It is 1345 and the Mogols have ruled China since the Rise of Kublai Khan to the throne in 1271. Now though the Yuan dynasty is in peril the land has been beset by disasters and plagues. There are voices of dissent amongst the people but also a healthy dose of fear. Whispers on the wind say China has been cursed, and the question now is can that curse be broken before China crumbles? The Twilight Trading company is a Role-Playing stressed event using the pathfinder game system, with a healthy dose of rule bending for story telling purposes.
sd: It is 1345 and the Mogols have ruled China since 1271. The Yuan dynasty is in peril, beset by ill luck. Dissent grows amongst the people but also fear. The land has been cursed, will China fall?

t: The Betrayer is Known - Vengeance Awaits
ds: Each of you received an unusual envelope this morning. The envelope contained a card with the words: “The Betrayer is known – Vengeance Awaits.” With no clue other than this, you quickly agree to meet. We will teach anything you need or want to know. Role playing, problem solving and story telling are encouraged!

ds: Barrett Development Company has been going from strength to strength in the biotech field for a number of years now, largely on the shoulders of its brilliant Nova founder and her equally talented inner circle. They’ve had as much a reputation as an incubator of geniuses as of their own technologies, and now an OpNet streaming series has been following their latest batch of interns. After one intern disappears, a board member calls in a favor with a Nova investigative agency because a single disappearance may be the tip of the iceberg. Is the seemingly unstoppable company’s string of successes finally ending? This is a game of corporate espionage, investigation, celebrities, and cultural commentary in the Trinity Continuum: Aberrant world of 2028. Roleplaying emphasized.
sd: What's going on at Barrett Development Company? Investigators are called in when a Nova-backed biotech firm "misplaces" an intern, but it looks like the company has potentially bigger problems.

ds: 10 years ago, the town of Sheffield Lake became host to the legendary Centurions, who surprisingly went into semi-retirement. In the years since, the elder heroes have done a lot to improve their small part of the world, including training the next generation of heroes. Although one would think such titans would be able to handle anything that could afflict a town of 14,346 souls, this has turned out not to be the case. Until recently, locals were not overly bothered by living in a peaceful, but weird, town, but now strange events are piling on top of each other. Something has to be done, though the younger heroes may be unready and their mentors often seem distracted. This is superhero gaming with elements of the Justice Society, Infinity Inc., Welcome to Nightvale, and Twin Peaks. Roleplaying emphasized.
sd: Years ago, the Centurions moved from saving the world to live in a tiny midwestern town. Why? And why does their seemingly idyllic adopted home get weirder as time goes on?

t: Chivalrous Arts: The Raging Infernos of Tarzarus
ds:
They're back & this time the infernos are going to rage hotter than ever. The 2025 smash hit returns all new for 2026, with comments ranging from “best RPG I have played at GC to best game I have played in years” we have a blockbuster story, amazing setup, & elite DM’s, all players will have their choice of 1 of 2 gifts bags packed with cool stuff a $55 value. 6th level, characters provided.
 —Exiting the portal is a very strange being, the creature is in incredible pain and speaks of a captured civilization, & an inferno realm, it begs for your help, as your party debate what to do, you determine there is nothing to debate, it’s a time for Legends to be born, you draw your sword & say “Lets go!” Confident, powerful, & determined you like your chances, but can you or anyone or anything even survive? The Raging Infernos of Tarzarus. Based on the graphic novel series: Chivalrous Arts.
sd: Dining with fellow adventurers, a portal opens, & the adventure of a lifetime begins— Travel to an inferno realm, battle a Dragon King & save a lost civilization. Amazing gift bags for all!

ds:
5th Ed rules run like D&D from the 70's. Characters on index cards. Fast play. And if you die A new hero shows up.
 
 A group of 4th level heroes have entered a modular tile dungeon. You don’t have a lot of power but neither do the monsters. You will explore, map, and fight. I am using my dungeon in a box tools. All home made and low tech.
sd: A simple dungeon crawl using modern rules but played in an old school style. Low level fun with a DM who has played the game for 50 years. We will use home made dungeon tiles and wooden counters.

ds: While browsing the Gen Con vendor hall, an exhibit malfunctions, sucking the players into a new interactive VR tabletop game called Jumanji. sd: This will be a new Jumanji-style adventure written for Gen Con. Players will be able to play as the original four characters, plus one of multiple characters created specifically for this adventure.

ds: When the game has to be good, Paladin Hill Games returns for our 6th Geneva Convention. GM Mike Hawkins original Masters of the Universe themed adventure has you running four Eternian villagers. The Necessities needed will be supplied to play the game. Plus each player will be taking home a swag package containing the following: your character sheets, 4 "Skinny Minis" brand miniatures, 10 custom luck tokens, and a custom satin bag to keep it all in. Do you dare fight Skeletor's forces for freedom?
sd: The crops have failed, the waters smell of something just not right, something stirs in the forests of Eternia. Will you be able to discover the cause for this malady or will the cause find you first.

ds:
Xanthous: The Tormented King has been a best selling sci-fi novel since it was written, and studios have been clamoring to do a movie almost as long. The author was always staunchly against it, but now that she has passed, her grandchild has no such qualms. The film is in production and everything is going well, even if the cast is high maintenance, the writers are annoyed with everyone, and everyone is annoyed with the executives that just won't stay out of the creative process. Everyone has settled in for a long day of filming, but no one has anticipated the grim pall settling over the set.
 
 A lovecraftian delight with heavy character focus and moderate puzzle solving.
sd: Quiet on the set! The cast and crew of Xanthous: The Tormented King have gathered for a long day of filming. The production is going well, but tensions are brewing, as THINGS begin to happen.

t: Downtown Militarized Zone 2.0:  Shadowrun Combat Grinder
ds: You enter the urban combat arena as a ganger, with only basic equipment. Succeed in a mission or successfully terminate an enemy and move up in skill and gear. If you’re taken out, you’ll re-enter as a progressively better equipped runner. Run and gun for the entire four hour event block, or, if you’re ready, jump over to the RPG table to experience the full breadth of what Shadowrun has to offer.
sd: Welcome to the mean streets of the Sixth World, chummer!

t: The Mystery at Hidden Valley Ranch
ds:
Giddy-up cowpoke, this is a Wild West-themed D&D one-shot set in the cattle town of Mascow, which unfolds in three acts, full of exploration, combat, and gabdern NPC interactions. 
 
 The town is experiencing mysterious cattle disappearances! Cows are vanishing and later found completely drained of blood. The locals are in a panic, with some suspecting the clothier Buck A. Rue, especially since he's suddenly started making leather goods when he previously only used donkey hides. Renowned cattle rancher Salvador "Sal" Edward Dressing seeks the help of your party to solve the mystery and keep his cows safe! 
 
 Great for groups but can also sign up as an individual. If you are unfamiliar with Dumbest DnD, we focus on the non-serious side of DnD encounters and one-shots, so this will be a silly, but appropriate adventure.
sd: This is a Wild West-themed D&D one-shot set in a strange cattle town. For up to 5 Level 5 Characters. Players that send character sheets ahead of time will get a custom mini.

ds: For the fifth time, you are sent into the worlds of song, sent to bring balance to the newer stories that have strayed from their path. Memories long-forgotten have resurfaced to challenge your friend Melodia and break the worlds she tries so hard to protect. Can you discover what even Melodia has forgotten, and bring balance back to the rocky worlds of story? No prior experience with characters is required. 5th Level characters provided. Roleplaying: encouraged. Puzzles: likely. Combat: inevitable.
sd: Again, you are sent into the worlds of song. You are asked to bring balance to a new set of stories that are breaking without reason. Can you fix the stories gone awry before they break your own?

t: One for All and All for Explosions
ds: As the Musketeers for His Majesty, the King of France, it is your solemn duty to protect the crown and all of her interests. Those interests extend to protecting assets abroad, so when the King charges you with a journey to Germany, honor demands that you carry out his wishes. Will you embody the Musketeers on a journey to acquire a new type of gunpowder, before the British get it first? 4th Level characters provided. Roleplaying: encouraged. Puzzles: likely. Combat: inevitable.
sd: Step into the boots of His Majesty’s Musketeers and adventure forth to protect France’s assets before the dreaded British steal a newly discovered form of gunpowder. All for One and One for All!

ds: Coming along with you mentor, Rosa Mercado, you have arrived to hear the Will of Hubert Peletir, the famous musician. Instead of leaving his Golden Fiddle to one of his prodigies in the Will, he has set up a battle of wits to find the Fiddle on his property. Can you beat out the other prodigies and find the magical Golden Fiddle? 4th Level characters provided. Roleplaying: encouraged. Puzzles: likely. Combat: inevitable.
sd: A famous musician has died, and you are here to learn if Rosa Mercado will get the magical Golden Fiddle. When it is left up to those invited to find the Fiddle instead, can you get to it first?

ds:
Captain’s log: The Federation has ordered the Enterprise to Devron II. This is an old colony placed strategically near the Neutral Zone, but the colonists are embroiled in a Civil War. The inhabitants cling to outdated ideas of freedom and competing ideologies. Two ambassadors, that I know well, have been assigned. They are from Harry Mudd’s new “League of the Oppressed” group. Vanna of Ardana and Shahna of Triskelion will find it a difficult task to keep these two warring parties from destroying each other.
 
 Personal log: the Shahna and Vanna that I remember would be ill-equipped to resolve this conflict and I believe having learned the art of diplomacy from Harry Mudd… well I have my concerns.
sd: Statdate 6818.4: We have been ordered to Devron II near the Neutral Zone. The Enterprise must assist two unlikely ambassadors to end the Colony’s Civil War.

t: Where the Lava Meets the Sea: The Danger Disinterred
ds: The first of 3 linked adventures in an original world based on the history and culture of Sicily. The island is rich, both in farmland plowed by domesticated miniature woolly mammoths and in legends of fallen civilizations and their untold treasures. Classic fantasy races have mixed freely because waves of various cultures have landed on its shores and made their homes here. This is the perfect place to make a name for yourself, unearth enough gold to live out your days in luxury, and discover ancient magic to make you powerful beyond your wildest dreams. Sure, most adventurers meet a grisly end or decide after their first delve that they’d rather plow a field than ever try that again, but you’re different – right? Drop into one session or all three for the continuation of the story; sessions 1 and 3 will use D&D 5E and session 2 will use Shadowdark. Low-level pregens will be provided.
sd: An earthquake uncovers more than broken stone. A hooded stranger appears, ancient forces stir, and something long buried is brought back into the light. And you're in the middle of all of it.

t: Rescue on Aurore: The Montagne d'Or Nouveau Mine Disaster
ds: An explosion has trapped 200 miners inside Sainte-Pauline Shaft No. X. The miners' oxygen is running low, and their time is running out. As members of the Tanstafl Free Legion, the PCs must travel to the Montagne d'Or Noveau Mine to assist with the miners' rescue. Unfortunately, Kaefer guerrilla bands roam the wilderness between the mine and Tanstaafl City. So getting there will be half the fun.
sd: Two hundred miners are trapped 1000 meters down at the Montagne d'Or Noveau--Aurore's largest mine. Dispatched from Tanstaafl, your team will join the rescue efforts. But watch out for the Kaefers!

ds: An introductory adventure for level 1 heroes. Premade character sheets available.
sd: The town’s water supply is put under threat when a horrible THING emerges from the well. Can you slay the thing and put an end to the threat?

ds: An introductory adventure for level 1 heroes. Premade character sheets available.
sd: Everyone knows that the moose is the avatar of the storm god. So when a majestic moose appears outside your city, it only makes sense to follow.

sd: An eclectic musician has been causing a disturbance; rumor has it that he plays haunting melodies every night, but he has no memory of it. Can you untangle the puzzle and restore peace and quiet?

sd: Off the coast of Cliffsbay, monsters and storms lay waste to ships. Their lost crews are laid to rest deep in the silt... or are they? Can you stop hordes of undead pirates from wreaking havoc?

ds: An introductory adventure for level 2 heroes. Premade character sheets available.
sd: Strange creatures keep popping up in the city of Cliffsbay, and a detective has linked their appearances to a troupe of unhinged minstrels whose music might be warping reality.

ds: An introductory adventure for level 3 heroes. Premade character sheets available.

t: The Good, the Bad, and the Bugly: The Rubbleshade Bank
ds:
Based on the high fantasy insect RPG Stingers & Spores, in which insects have inherited the earth. Revolutions in technology have brought steel, steam, and gunpowder to the Insect Nations, and now pioneers travel across the Frontier, searching for opportunities in a hostile land.
 In this adventure, what begins as an ambush on the road turns into a bank heist in the Frontier town of Rubbleshade. Join the Mesa Roja Marauders, the most notorious gang of insect outlaws in the West, as they bluff, blast, and blunder their way into a vault laden with treasure, or die trying.
sd: A gang of wacky insect outlaws in the Old West decides to rob a bank.

t: The Good, the Bad, and the Bugly: The Midnight Squeak
ds:
Based on the high fantasy insect RPG Stingers & Spores, in which insects have inherited the earth. Revolutions in technology have brought steel, steam, and gunpowder to the Insect Nations, and now pioneers travel across the Frontier, searching for opportunities in a hostile land.
 This adventure brings the posse, a notorious gang of outlaws, South of the Border on a rustling job. When a mysterious shrieking creature begins devouring livestock and then people at night, the Marauders are roped into protecting a helpless village by a friendly criminal syndicate.
sd: Insect outlaws in the Wild West protect an impoverished town from a terrifying nocturnal menace.

t: The Good, the Bad, and the Bugly: No More than Fishfood
ds:
Based on the high fantasy insect RPG Stingers & Spores, in which insects have inherited the earth. Revolutions in technology have brought steel, steam, and gunpowder to the Insect Nations, and now pioneers travel across the Frontier, searching for opportunities in a hostile land.
 A riverboat journey is not as simple as it seems. To get to their destination with a barge full of contraband guns, the Mesa Roja Marauders must contend with blockades, pirates, river monsters, and much more. If they play their cards right, a fortune in wasp treasure awaits them at their destination. But play their hand wrong, and they are sure to be nothing but fish food.
sd: A notorious gang of insect outlaws in the Old West smuggles a barge full of dangerous cargo down a perilous river.

t: Savage Secret World: The Occam's Razor
ds: You are one of Gaia's Chosen (a Bee), imbued with mystic powers and virtual immortality. The end times approach, hastened by the forces of the Dreaming Ones and their "Flilthy" minions. The Rippers were supposed to be a relic—Victorian monster hunters who vanished into myth after their brutal experiments crossed too many lines. But when a series of disappearances in upstate New York point to a private “wellness academy” with an unusually high security budget, the Secret World’s factions take notice. Can you and your friends pass your first field test? Find out in this Savage Worlds Adventure! Six Pregenerated characters provided. No experience needed.
sd: When a series of disappearances point to a private "wellness academy," the Secret World's factions take notice. An agent's sister goes missing, you must infiltrate the academy and get her back.

t: Doom Guard: From Atlantis with Love
ds: When alien warships dominate the skies, when mad gods wake from their slumber, when the world is on the brink of an apocalypse—the world relies on the might of the Doom Guard. Unfortunately, the powers that be have determined that you are not quite ready for the "big time." As a member of the Doomlings, a Covert Response Team, you and your teammates represent the sidekicks, the novices, and the second stringers, who can operate in the shadows and play by their own rules. When an extradimensional entity known as Lady Seraphyne offers you purpose, power, and a chance to change the fate of countless worlds, how can you refuse? Think "Young Justice" meets "Guardians of the Galaxy" in this Savage Supers Adventure!.
sd: You're a collection of sidekicks and novice level heroes who have yet to earn membership into DoomGuard. An extradimensional entity offers you purpose and power, how can you refuse?

ds: The Eberron of 1099 YK is a world filled with magic, monsters, and host of threats to Khorvaire and beyond. While pushing out their products and services to the masses, the Houses wage a shadow war of corporate espionage. You are a Runner, a master of subterfuge, close combat, and aggressive negotiation. When a professor from Morgrave University goes missing in the Lhazar Principalities, only heroes can rise to the challenge of finding her and returning with her research. Will you prevail? Find out in this Savage Worlds adventure! Six pregenerated characters provided. No experience needed! This Savage Worlds adventure combines the Dark Fantasy world of Eberron with the Sprawrunners setting for Savage Worlds and is inspired by the Neon Knights adventure written by Christian Eichhorn.
sd: A Morgrave University professor goes missing, you are hired to find her and return her research! Hope you survive the blood cults, mutants, and the rival factions who want her for themselves!

t: Obojima, Tales from the Tall Grass
ds:
The island of Obojima, a land of whimsical wonder and vibrant spirits, is under threat. The Corruption is creeping deeper into the island, warping creatures and throwing the island's once-harmonious spirits into chaos. As brave adventurers, you are called to cleanse these corrupted spirits and protect the charming communities of Obojima.
 Your journey begins in the tranquil Okiri Village, now overshadowed by fear. Frenzied spirits haunt the area, and corrupted creatures disrupt the peace of this once-cozy farming community. The villagers are desperate for help, afraid to venture beyond their homes. Each day, the chaos worsens, threatening to consume the village entirely.
 Can you uncover the source of The Corruption and drive it back before it spreads?`
 An Anime inspired world of adventure and wonder.
sd: Corruption is creeping deeper into Obojima, warping creatures and creating chaos. A mystic's wisdom is the only hope. Traverse the dangers of the temple and cleanse your home before it's too late!

t: In the Belly of the Beast
ds:
Long ago, great heroes slew the most evil and vile of beasts, the world consuming Tarrasque! The lords of the land formed a special council of mages whose sole job was to study and learn about the creature. Now, eons later, the mages have discovered that the creature's body is regenerating and if not stopped will rise again to terrorize the whole planet!
 The greatest heroes are called to enter the gigantic form and destroy the regenerating heart of the vile beast!
 A classic dungeon crawl set in the regenerating carcass of the Tarrasque.
sd: The Mage Council has called you for a secret mission. The Slain form of the Tarrasque is reviving and only your team can save the world. Venture with the beast to slay its heart before it rises again.

ds:
On a routine scouting mission, the Ophelia begins receiving distress signals of an unknown origin. Messages appear from the current time, the past and the future all simultaneously. The crew hear the messages in their native languages, but all with the same message; "The light summons us all". Dropping out of the drift, the crew spot an ancient war vessel of unknown design slowly spiraling into a neutron star. Radiation readings are like nothing anyone has ever seen before. 
 Investigate this vessel before it is lost forever in the gravity of the star.
sd: Strange signals pull the crew of the Ophelia out of the Drift to investigate the ancient husk of a forgotten warship spiraling toward a neutron star. This enticing mystery hides a much darker secret.

ds:
As part of the Order of the Veil, you and your team must keep the secrets of the supernatural world from the prying eyes of humans. While difficult, the veil has maintained its secrecy for generations and allowed the supernaturals to move about free of persecution. 
 Recently, members of the Order have been found dead through magical means. The curiosity of local reporters has revealed more than the Order ever expected. Take your team and find the killer and solve the mystery of the Veil being pierced before its too late
sd: The veil between worlds must be kept up at any cost. Recently, the murder of a prominent member of the city's elite has threatened that balance. Even darker secrets will unfold on a winter's stroll.
