t: Lori's Midnight Game: Halloween Party Horror
gm: Lori Pecchia, Jonathan Van Luik, Jason Roe, Peter Pecchia
ds: Play as groups of college students in a party vibe, rules light, role play heavy, hack and slash RPG. Bring all your friends or come as a single and make instant new friends. Costumes encouraged but not required (although you may get a game bonus for doing so), let's slay some zombies...or better yet, become the zombies!!! Animal House meets Slaughterhouse Rulez meets Zombieland.
sd: It's Halloween 1986, a huge party on fraternity row goes bad when a pledge accidentally mispronounces a chant in Latin. Bonfires and togas and zombies, oh my! Try to survive a toga party gone undead!

t: Lori's Midnight Game: Post Apocalyptic Thunderdome
gm: Lori Pecchia, Jonathan Van Luik, Jason Roe, Peter Pecchia
ds: Play as groups of marauders trying to capture the "Running GMs" and get them to Circle Center Monimnet in a party vibe, rules light, role play heavy, hack & slash RPG. Teams battle to win the-100% Fictional prize of a fully stocked, and connected by skywalk -oooohhhh, ahhhhhh- presidential suite at the next Gen Con. We’ve all lived through the insanity of the housing lottery, let’s make jokes about it while fantasizing that our character’s marauding actions would win us the most coveted of all rooms. Bring all your friends or come as a single and make instant new friends. Costumes encouraged but not required (although you may get a game bonus for doing so), let's capture a running GM and slay some zombies...or better yet, become the zombies!!! Who will survive and who will become the undead? Running Man meets Thunderdome meets Zombieland meets Shaun of the Dead.
sd: Maybe gameshows in the future have taken it a bit too far, or maybe it just makes for a super fun PvP battle royale. Work in teams to survive undead hordes, sabotage your opponents, and win the game.

ds:
The war is over, and the 1950s feels like the future—except for places like this. Deep in creek valleys covered by kudzu, in the shadow of mountains older than anything else in the world. 
 
 Nestled in the Great Smokey Mountains is Happy Valley, TN. You are here at the invitation of John Pardo, a wealthy and mysterious man who is willing to pay a premium for strong backs and sharp minds that can help repair his theme park before the season starts. 
 
 You're not just here for the pay — you need answers. A friend or loved one disappeared after visiting the theme park, and you hardly doubt that they just abandoned you. This job is an excuse to explore the park and learn of their fate. 
 
 This is an interactive adventure where four tables will simultaneously play the same adventure and have the opportunity to interact with one another.
sd: Almost heaven, where life is older than the trees. Your new job is working to repair an Appalachian theme park before the season opens — can you find your loved ones who disappeared in Happy Valley?

ds:
You wake in darkness, strung up in silk. Something massive stirs below. On the night of her betrothal, the Eight-Legged Queen hunts—and you’re the offering. No maps. No light. No help. Rip free, regroup, and escape her hive before you're devoured—or worse.
 
 Bring your wits and help each other survive in this brutal interactive new game mode: Prey!
 
 This is an interactive adventure, where up to 8 tables of players play the same adventure. What happens at one table impacts all the other tables.
sd: You wake in darkness, strung up in silk. Something massive stirs below. On the night of her betrothal, the Eight-Legged Queen hunts—and you’re the offering.

ds:
Your crew is hired to quietly recover an incriminating ledger from a mine with suspected ties to the regional thieves' guild. What starts as a tense investigation among nervous workers and sealed records quickly becomes dangerous as pressure mounts. The deeper they delve, the more the mine itself feels wrong. 
 
 When every decision carries risk, can you succeed where others will fail? 
 
 This is an interactive adventure, where up to 8 tables of players play the same adventure. What happens at one table impacts all the other tables.
sd: Your patron has hired your crew to recover an incriminating ledger filled with valuable secrets worth killing for. An interactive Shadowdark adventure for 4th-level crawlers.

t: Doom Tolls at the Seventh Sunset
ds:
Long ago, an alliance of humans, dwarves, and goblins defeated an invasive foe. Their inscrutable leaders, the Foremost, have broken their bindings and are have promised to destroy Meridia, the City of Masks. The magic items that once banished them are lost in the Itzalca Jungle—can you recover them before the Foremost enact vengeance upon the Western Reaches? 
 
 This is an interactive adventure, where up to 8 tables of players play the same adventure. What happens at one table impacts all the other tables.
sd: An ancient evil has broken free of their gaols. Can you recover the rods that banished them before they can conquer the Western Reaches? An interactive Shadowdark adventure for 4th-level crawlers.

t: How Much Extra Credit is this Worth?
ds: Something is not right in the township of Shelford Hills. Unexplained attacks keep occurring, but the culprits elude capture. Worse, the culprits appear to be monsters! Eyewitnesses at the stables, the local inn and even the World Famous Corn Maze speak of horrendous creatures terrorizing the townsfolk. However, the creatures they describe resemble nothing native to the area. Dr. Bruce Bruceson, professor of multiversal ecology at Wottsamatta University has enlisted your band of adventures, the best he could afford with department funds, to solve these mysteries. This D&D one-shot involves unusual creatures based in real-world biology, run by a biology professor, although no prior scientific knowledge is required to play. The adventure is tuned for level 5 characters using 2024 rules. Pre-generated characters will be available.
sd: You are a rag-tag group of adventurers, the best the local University could afford, tasked with investigating unusual attacks in a nearby town; if you don’t get lost in the corn maze first.

ds: Rules Light game. We will have two extra characters available, generics accepted while space is available.
sd: The storm came out of nowhere. This storm isn't letting up. How long are we gonna be stuck here? What is that out in the snow? Oh god. It's coming for us. There's no escape. Oh go-

ds:
Legend has it that the dreaded Bigat (“the giant worm”) living along the Fossa River accumulated a vast treasure over the centuries. This is probably the usual folklore on hidden monsters and lost treasures heard all over the Kingdom. Still, since you’ve been hanging around the Den for weeks with nothing to do, and eating for free without doing a minute’s honest work, your band leader, Roughger of Punchrabbit, has given you a kick in the butt and ordered you to find out whether this rumor is true, just to get you out of his hair.
 
 Before you come to blows, you decide to accept this great mission. Cracking jokes and playing pranks, you head off for the given area to look for a certain Biondello of Pera, a rapscallion said to have an extremely valuable long-lost map of this treasure.
sd: Legend has it that the dreaded Bigat (“the giant worm”) living along the Fossa River accumulated a vast treasure over the centuries. You've been ordered to find out whether the legend is true...

ds: A team of Delta Green agents have been sent to investigate a strange disturbance in the town of Woodstock, NY in 1974. Why was the music festival six years ago really moved out of the town?
sd: A team of Delta Green agents have been sent to investigate a strange disturbance in the town of Woodstock, NY in 1974. Why was the music festival six years ago really moved out of the town?

ds: You are ordered to head into the interior and as far as the Blue Mountains to recover whatever remnants still exist from the crash of the “falling star” and return them to Governor Hunter in Sydney. Gathered before the Freemason’s Arms Public House, the assembled PCs are soon joined by Lt. Alastair Morrant, the expedition leader.
sd: 1799: Authorities in convict-era Australia noticed a falling star crashing to the ground far away from Sydney. You are now part of a hastily assembled expedition sent to recover the meteorite.

t: Adventure of the Lost Polonaise Macabre
ds: The war has left you behind enemy lines, with the Soviets hunting down survivors of your unit. Time is running out unless you can find assistance. A local Polish contact has assured you that there is way out, and as a part of the resistance they are offering you and your companions a chance to escape...if you can find Chopin's missing "Polonaise Macabre."
sd: The war has left you behind enemy lines. A local Polish resistance contact has assured you that there is way out, a chance to escape...if you can find Chopin's missing "Polonaise Macabre."

ds: Play as goblins stealing items from a local town. Each item recovered will be met with real world prizes. Prizes include snacks, candy, and drinks. Miniatures will also be provided as gifts. Rules light.
sd: Your goblin Chief has charged you with an important mission. Grab items from those greedy humans!

t: Old Gods of Appalachia LARP - Unofficial
ds:
Folks, welcome aboard the North Star Express with service from Newport Tennessee to Cincinnati, Ohio. It’s not the fanciest of passenger trains, but she does the job just fine. Along with our passengers, we are hauling four cargo cars with us, so the ride may be a little slow, but we’re sure you’ll enjoy the ride through the beautiful Smoky Mountains. 
 
 Ride the rails as we roll into the 1930s somewhere between Newport and Knoxville Tennessee. As the modern era and the past collide in this unofficial LARP inspired by the popular podcast and tabletop game Old Gods of Appalachia by DeepNerd Media and Monte Cook Games. Will you get to your final destination, or will your story go off the rails? The woods and valleys hide secrets, but so does this northbound train as we try to make it out of the shadows and mist of the mountains.
sd: All aboard the North Star Express with service to Cincinnati: this train carries more than passengers during the prohibition. Will you make it to your desired final destination?

t: Conquer Castle Transylvania: Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
ds:
Welcome, my friends, to a Daggerheart adventure where each table embodies a ’70s college club invited to the opulent Castle Transylvanian Hotel for the ultimate role-playing game. What begins as a charming weekend of nostalgia quickly unravels as a hidden secret awakens. 
 A fun addition to our game will be “words of the game.” If you remember Pee Wee’s Playhouse, there’s a word of the day, every time we say Critical or Roll, we’ll add a poker chip to the jar (each worth a dollar) We’ll add it up at the end and make a donation to charities close to our hearts. We will make a donation to the Critical Roll Foundation. To help them “leave the world better than we found it.” We will match that donation to Camp Kesem a non-profit that provides free summer camps to children of parents with cancer, in memory of our dear friend Shelly.
sd: Welcome to a rules-light cooperative adventure where each table plays as a 70s college club invited to the Castle Transylvanian Hotel for an ultimate roleplaying game. What could possibly go wrong?

gm: Erik Norris, Steven Collins, Dannielle Hasty
ds:
Julian Cross noted Malkavian spymaster has disappeared. His secrets are up for grabs. Petty rivalries and unforgivable crimes are both contained in his caches. It is a simple three step process. Step one, solve the puzzles of a Malkavian. Step two, do it before the others. Last but not least, Step three, survive.
 
 Content Warning. This is a Vampire the Masquerade LARP featuring Horror themes as well as those of betrayal, gaslighting and possible violence.
sd: Julian Cross, Malkavian Spymaster and occasional Prince-Maker, has vanished. Now long dormant safeguards have begun to activate, His collections of secrets are now bleeding into the city.

ds:
Cinder Flats is home to Ashfall Crossing, a small settlement built inside the remains of a pre-War geothermal research station. The station’s heat vents provide warmth, power, and clean water—making it a rare oasis in an otherwise dead region.
 
 Once every few years, a brutal raider army known as The Black Ash Horde descends from the badlands, stripping settlements of supplies, tech, and people. Ashfall Crossing has survived by staying hidden—but this year, they’ve been discovered.
 
 The settlement cannot flee. Instead, they hire wandering wastelanders—the PCs—to train them, fortify the town, and help them survive the coming assault.
sd: Hidden in a ruined geothermal station, Ashfall Crossing thrives—until the Black Ash Horde finds it. Unable to flee, they hire wastelanders to train, fortify, & survive the coming siege.

lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds: Within Massachusetts lies supernatural communities, secrets, and conflicts which normal mortal have been unaware of for centuries. The Camarilla once held a death grip over the society of Boston, until being uprooted by the Sabbat in an immense underground operation, which saw a still to this day uneasy truce with the Garou and other shifters. While in Salem, an ages old Cabal of mages has begun reaping the seeds of plans made long ago. Those of the Fae Folk mourn the loss of their beloved, though obtuse, King Meilge who met his end in New Orleans. And as all of these conflicts turn, boil, and move to their conclusions, it all goes monitored, perhaps even manipulated, by the agents of the Technocratic Union.
sd: A multi-splat World of Darkness LARP, featuring the ability to play as vampires, werewolves, mages, or changeling. Join us for our Fourth Chronicle Finale.

t: No More Ale? NO MORE ALE!
ds: The Jets helped rid New Verona City of Robbins the Robber Baron. A month later, their favorite haunts are out of ale. Their noble allies, the Montagues, are just as thirsty. In fact, the whole city is going dry. Can they get the ale back? Must they work with the Sharks? Will they have to leave New Verona City for a pint? 4th level characters provided. Roleplaying encouraged, Combat inevitable.
sd: Working class New Verona City is a town of industry, magic, and taverns. Poor dwarves are only content in taverns after their shifts end. What if the ale loses its kick? The Jets must fix this now!

sd: For new players looking to participate in any night, this gaming session is to assist in understanding their character, sheets, and system.

ds:
After the uneasy peace following the Dominion War, the USS Valiant, a Starfleet science vessel, receives orders to investigate the disappearance of Starbase Orion Reach 
 
 Once a cutting-edge mobile r research station specializing in advanced warp development, the station was on route to a new assignment when it simply vanished.
sd: The crew of the Valiant must determine what happened to the missing station and its personnel.

ds: You’ve each had detailed dreams of plays never written. That heavyset elf must have been Ramona, the Voice of Cinth on Albion. Could a visit with the great Marlowe help you discover more of the plays? Should you visit the clerics of the Goddess of Art & Song? Maybe you should ask Merlin. The reclusive wizard has a great store of esoteric knowledge. Maybe he can help you discover what is wrong. 6th level characters provided. Roleplaying encouraged, Combat inevitable.
sd: You awake remembering very specific dreams of the stage. But, the plays were new to you. Sharing your dream with your friends doesn't help. Was that Ramona? Something is wrong. Can you figure it out?

ds:
You are low-level Cobra operatives, hand-picked (volun-told) by the ambitious Lt. Livid to carry out a dangerous infiltration mission against a lightly guarded G.I. Joe Mobile Command Center. The goal is simple: steal a classified data core, cause some mayhem, and escape before the Joes realize what’s happening.
 
 Whether you succeed or fail, one thing is certain: Lt. Livid intends to take all the credit. What you do about that… is entirely up to you.
 
 Remember: if this mission fails, Cobra will deny all knowledge of you.
 
 COBRAAAA!
sd: Welcome to a high-chaos G.I. Joe–inspired one-shot where you don’t play the heroes—you play Cobra. Whether you succeed or fail, one thing is certain Cobra will deny all knowledge of you.

t: Reverse the Curse, a Dungeon Delve
ds: Visiting Rugby to meet with Lord Wren's old companions Brianna Seedsower and Killian Stoutfoot, the party discovers Killian is cursed. Brianna's prayers have revealed that notorious dungeon-delver Bart the Glorious possesses an artifact that can reverse the curse. Will the party retrieve it in time? Will this turn into an old school dungeon crawl? 6th level characters provided. Roleplaying encouraged, Combat inevitable.
sd: Visiting Rugby, the party discovers Killian Stoutfoot is cursed. Bart the Glorious has an artifact that can reverse it. Can the party retrieve it? Will this turn into an old school dungeon crawl?

ds: No experience required, character sheets, and dice will be provided. The rules will be taught at say it but if you have prior experience, then that is fine.
sd: A role playing game where the players play as superheroes, trying to save the day against dastardly villains, dangerous environments, and endless twists.

t: American Auto Duel – Big John & Mini-Me!
ds:
The American Autoduel Association, in conjunction with CBS, is bringing back the Number 1 reality show, American Autoduel, for a new decade!! Watch each week as eight contestants battle it out for supremacy behind the wheel and a chance to win a life of luxury! Yes, the winning contestant will receive one million dollars per year, for the rest of their life!
 
 America has always had a love-hate relationship with the classic Custom Van! We decided to bring that into the arena for you – no more messing around with dune buggies and compact cars, enter the big boys, the giants of the midway! With all that space, imagine the big weapons in store for you, and still have room for that nasty mattress in the back! But wait, there’s more! In a nod back to every teenagers ‘van plan’ wait until you see the surprise that shoots out of these babies!
sd: America has a love-hate relationship with the classic Van! We're bringing that into the arena for you – no more messing around with dune buggies and compact cars, enter the big boys with big guns!

t: Once Upon a Time - Order of the Red Hood
ds:
The Order of the Red Hood are Ix's elite personal guard, that investigate and police the more dangerous elements of this fairytale land. So come and join us as you start out as a brand new Chapter House in the Order in an all new adventure.
 
 This is a Narrative system that is built on a foundation of Traits and descriptors to help you immerse yourself easily into game play. Recommended for newcomers and veteran players alike.
sd: Welcome to the World of Elsewhere and the Land of Ix. This twisted fables world is ruled by the Grand Imperator Ix and in this game you will play a member of the Order of the Red Hood.

t: Wind in the Ruins - A World Outside
ds:
The setting for Peachtree is similar to the Wind in the Willows, but is imagined after mankind has disappeared from the earth. In the game, you will be assisting the town of Peachtree by scouting out beyond the wall and into the great forest beyond.
 10x10 is a Narrative system that is built on a foundation of Traits and descriptors to help you immerse yourself easily into game play. Recommended for newcomers and veteran players alike or anyone looking for a cozy style game.
sd: Welcome to the small town of Peachtree. In this cozy style setting, you play animals, who are also a circle of friends, who must venture out beyond the wall for the first time.

t: Friday Night Lights - A Cyberpunk ERT
ds:
The setting for Friday Night Lights is a dark cyberpunk 2079, where the MK Network has turned emergency response into prime-time entertainment. In this game, you will respond to live emergency calls, make impossible choices between saving lives and boosting ratings, and navigate the razor's edge between authentic heroism and manufactured drama. Each team member was hand-picked not just for their skills, but for their vulnerabilities—the corporation owns a piece of everyone, and the cameras never stop rolling.
 
 10x10 is a narrative system built on a foundation of Traits and descriptors to help you immerse yourself easily into gameplay. Recommended for newcomers and veteran players alike.
sd: Welcome to Friday Night Lights. You are cyberpunk Emergency Response Team - corporate assets descending into hell every Friday while 40 million viewers watch you bleed for ratings in the Sprawl.

ds:
This is a modern day scenario with mature themes for experienced players. 1. This is not a beginner friendly scenario. You will enjoy it more if you have RPG experience and are familiar with Call of Cthulhu. 2. This scenario contains mature themes including mass murder, human torture and experimentation (on all ages and genders), and domination. 3. Pregenerated characters are mandatory and will be provided. Each character has a specific role and secret, so characters will be chosen based on brief descriptions.
 
 This scenario will be run in 2 slots (Thursday morning from 0800 - 1300 and Friday morning from 0900-1300). By signing up for this slot, you are automatically signed up for BOTH slots. You cannot sign up for slot 2 separately. Of note, the system will not block slot 2 on your schedule, so please do not sign up for another event at the same time.
sd: You are the Spektral Krew, ghost hunters traveling the world and livestreaming your investigations. Next destination - Isola di Malamente, an island with a long, dark history. What will you find?

ds:

 Pre-gens will be provided. Please bring dice.

ds: At Del’s Delicious Diner, it’s the same every week. Same Meatloaf Mondays. Same faces. Same small town, petty gossip. But when everyone’s favorite regular, Obie—who’s always in at 9 for a slice of chocolate pie and a cup of black coffee—hasn’t been seen in four days, something feels wrong. Maybe a little visit, just to put everyone’s mind at ease, is in order. This Call of Cthulhu 7th Edition adventure stresses roleplay. Possible content includes child abuse, elder abuse/ neglect, violence, gore, and mental illness. This game is not appropriate for minors.
sd: Seven diner denizens look for their missing regular, who has a strange past and an even stranger family.

ds: Your Cell has been recruited by a mysterious benefactor to investigate the disappearance of several members of the Kriticos family. Your investigation has led you to their recently inherited mansion that your team finds itself trapped inside. Unlucky for you, you are also trapped with thirteen bloodthirsty ghosts eager to tear the living limb from limb. Their cells have malfunctioned and are set to open at random intervals and thanks to the mansion's failsafe procedure, you cannot escape until sunrise when the ghosts become inert. You have only hours to solve the mystery of the Kriticos family or disable the automated prison before something terrible happens that will spell your Cell's doom.
sd: Your Cell was investigating the disappearance of the Kriticos family. Now you are locked inside their mansion with thirteen imprisoned ghosts with only hours to spare before they're all free.

ds: The Hollows have a reputation for danger, natural wonder, and the primeval. Many have tried to mine for gemstones and silver, but the tectonics and occult machinations have prevented large-scale operations. No one claims ownership of former mines, but the rangers of the Fen have successfully warded off treasure hunters, sure to find an early grave. You and your fellow Outcasts have been tasked to reopen the mines with the promise of release from the service of Lord Goldrich. Characters will be generated at the table. Safety Tools will be used. Content Warning: Gore, Body Horror, Player Death.
sd: A classic dungeon delve in the medieval occult OSR style. Your band of Outcasts has been sent into danger of men, beasts, and the world itself. Will you see them through to reopen the mines?

t: Coronation at the Court of Stars: VIP table with Amy Vorpahl
ds:
DMed by TTRPG veteran Amy Vorpahl and played on a dazzling 2×3 ft miniature set by NPC Charles.
 The Feywild runs on contracts, symbolism, and loopholes, and this court is no exception. Whispers of scandalous bloodlines and archaic fey contracts puncture every conversation, as this coronation might have more at stake than meets the eye. Will the stars align to see this coronation through before time runs out?
 This adventure blends social intrigue, mystery, and cinematic action, culminating in a very public reckoning where the outcome—and even the crown itself—rests in the players’ hands.
sd: A diplomatic visit to the fey Court of Stars on the eve of a coronation reveals layers of rumor, ritual, and political tension—especially when it becomes clear not everyone wants the truth known.

ds: Players will be divided equally into three teams who are playing against each other in real time to reach the final prize. You will be building characters who, as a team, may have to solve puzzles, fight, or finesse their way to the prize. We'll help you build your character and then we'll dive right in. If you have a large party, be advised you may be split amongst the three teams. Once the scavenger hunt begins, pretty much anything goes! PVP is a possibility, but don't worry, your characters won't be able to die until the very end, so you'll be able to play the whole time. We encourage players of all skill levels to join us; this is a community where we're playing for fun, and we would love to share that fun with both those new to the game, and veterans to the RPG world. We look forward to seeing you at Gen Con. Happy gaming!

ds:
"The Minotaur's Fortress" is a full campaign about a walled complex in a cold, wind swept valley and an owner, who is desperately protecting the greatest treasure in the world. Through tricks and traps, the master has kept adventurers and treasure seekers from reaching the center of their lair. Who will be the first to enter the chamber and find the hidden treasure. And, who will be lost forever in the bowels of the fortress? 
 "Enter In" brings us to the front door. This session will give you just a taste of the adventure that lies ahead. You will be given a pre-generated character, time to make them your own and the freedom to explore.
sd: The ancient Ballad of the Five Brothers tells of a keep in the mountains that holds vast treasures. But, it also holds unconquered traps, mazes and monsters. Welcome to it's gates.

ds:
Using custom classes, weapons, and rules, players will form a ragtag group of heroes to defend Okutama village. The group will be hopelessly outnumbered, and will need to enlist the help of the villagers, carefully strategize, and use the terrain to full advantage if they want to succeed. 
 
 	This adventure is suitable for players of all experience levels. Prefabricated character sheets with the custom subclasses for samurai and gunslingers will be provide. The story offers plenty of opportunity for immersive roleplay and lends itself well to complicated characters with strong arcs, but, as in the films, expect a few graves to be filled by the time the end credits roll - the villagers of Okumura need heroes who aren’t afraid to lay down their lives for a good cause.
sd: An homage to classic films Seven Samurai (1954) and Magnificent Seven (1960), this challenging but accessible game sees samurai and cowboys work together to defend a village from bandits.

ds:
Using custom classes, weapons, and rules, players will form a ragtag group of heroes to defend Okutama village. The group will be hopelessly outnumbered, and will need to enlist the help of the villagers, carefully strategize, and use the terrain to full advantage if they want to succeed. 
 
 	This adventure is suitable for players of all experience levels. You can bring your own character (DnD 5th Ed 2014 or 2024 - levels 3 - 4), or use one of the prefabricated character sheets provide with our original samurai and gunslingers classes. The story offers plenty of opportunity for immersive roleplay and lends itself well to complicated characters with strong arcs, but, as in the films, expect a few graves to be filled by the time the end credits roll - the villagers of Okumura need heroes who aren’t afraid to lay down their lives for a good cause.
sd: An homage to classic films Seven Samurai (1954) and Magnificent Seven (1960), this challenging but accessible game sees samurai and cowboys work together to defend a village from bandits.

ds: No pencils and paper needed - only your imagination! We’ll get you roleplaying faster. Learn to play as you explore the Thornwood Forest - meeting some real characters, solving puzzles, and maybe fighting an enemy or two! You’ll embark on an important training mission that might just be critical to the survival of the forest and the world, where the loose alliance of the Woven Nations is protecting knowledge and nature against the dreaded Collectors. How will you work together to complete the mission? Sessions will be GM’d by our team.
sd: Adventures await in Wildenir! As animal kin, you must work together to protect the magical world. Join us for an introductory session to our new role-playing system for all ages & experience levels.

ds: While spending the night in a small town on your search for fame and riches, the locals have informed you of a problem and asked for your help. What should be a simple rescue turns into anything but. A 3rd level scenario. No experience necessary, all rules taught! A 2024 event replay.
sd: The village of Ironton ekes out a living mining in the nearby hills, but the miners haven't been heard from in a few days. Can you solve the mystery (and perhaps make a bit of coin in the process)?

t: Team Icarus vs. The Black Dawn
ds: Team Icarus is just a couple of years into their tenure as one of the more powerful Omega-level Quasar teams in the world. When the Team is called to a hostage negotiation, things quickly turn topsy-turvy as they learn that the evil Dr. Symantro has engineered a devious trap for the heroes. Where can one of the most powerful Quasar teams turn to for help when they are the ones in need of assistance?
sd: Team Icarus, one of the premiere superhero teams, find themselves in an alarming situation after Dr. Symantro, once believed deceased, appeared during a bank robbery in downtown Seattle.

t: There's Gold in Them Thar Hills!
ds:
Driven by the chance to make a fortune, you have come to the Black Hills in the Dakota Territory. There had been rumors for many years, but Custer's Army Expedtion of 1874 has found gold! The Sioux and Cheyenne are not happy to have their sacred grounds invaded by thousands of white folk.
 The spirits of Paha Sapa are also unhappy to be disturbed. The natives have stories of strange creatures who roam the hills. Miners claim to hear strange cries in the night.
 Are you willing to risk more than your life for the chance to become one of the wealthy ones?
 An original Call of Cthulhu adventure using parts of the Down Darker Trails setting. Characters will be provided, rules will be taught.
 Trigger Warnings: Cosmic Horror, Body Horror, Historical Accuracy
sd: Gold has been discovered in the Black Hills. The Natives consider the mountains sacred. And the Spirits of Paha Sapa are not happy to be disturbed.

ds:
Champions of the Magistrate is a week-long festival and arena spectacle that draws crowds, contenders, and political intrigue to the city of Everstar. While champions clash for public glory in the arena, the real battle unfolds beyond the cheers and banners.
 
 The party is tasked with exploring a long-forgotten ruined temple on the city’s outskirts, seeking a powerful magical artifact tied to the festival’s outcome. This relic could either secure victory for the Magistrate’s favored champion—or tip the balance against them, weakening the government’s grip on power.
 
 As the festival rages on above, the party delves into ancient halls, hidden dangers, and forgotten secrets, knowing their choices will ripple back to Everstar. What they recover—and who they choose to aid—may decide not only the champion’s fate, but the future of the city itself.
sd: Champions of the Magistrate is a week-long festival arena event. Will the party help overthrow—or defend the city of Everstar? Expect high-stakes choices, exploration, and a mini-dungeon adventure.

ds: Return with us to those gullible days of 1964, when 3-day storms and uncharted desert islands appearing out of nowhere seemed totally normal! Life as a castaway isn't really too bad. You live on a tropical island with clean water and plenty of food. You and your companions have built shelters and settled into a comfortable, albeit boring, life. You miss home, but you're doing okay. But the idyllic tropical scene is shattered on the morning that Gilligan goes missing. Will the castaways find him? Will they learn the truth of why they are here, and uncover the dark, dark secret of Gilligan's Island? Quantum Black is a cinematic, story-driven RPG powered by the lightning fast rules of the Ubiquity Roleplaying System. Characters will be provided, rules will be taught. Bring dice, pencil and sense of fun! Trigger warnings: Cosmic horror, body horror.
sd: Screams drown out the laugh track when cosmic horrors descend upon Gilligan's Island. Can the castaways learn the terrible truth of the Island and stop Gilligan's zany plan Before It's Too Late(TM)?

ds:
The arena battles begin in earnest. With the magical item now in play, the balance of power shifts, and every faction moves to secure the outcome they desire.
 
 Depending on the party’s choices, they may be drawn directly into the arena—fighting before roaring crowds—or pulled into the shadows of the undercity, where deals, betrayals, and secret struggles unfold alongside the public spectacle. As champions rise and fall, the influence of the artifact becomes clear.
 
 By the festival’s end, the fate of the arena, the champion, and the city itself hangs in the balance. The party’s actions will determine who claims victory—and whether the seat of the Magistrates stands, falls, or changes hands entirely.
sd: In Part Two, the party returns to Everstar as the festival reaches its climax. They may be drawn directly into the fighting before roaring crowds—or pulled into the shadows of the undercity.

t: Assault on the Mad Druid's Maze
ds: Legend has it, a great and evil druid by the name of Bothangar left his belongings after death in a hedge maze. Ever shifting and ever adapting, the maze repels or consumes all who dare collect its treasure. an icrpg adventure roguelike experience.
sd: Five adventurers brave the maze of twisted nature to plunder the mad druid.

The battle will take up most of the event but expect a few twists along the way. There will be different BBE endings based on the decisions during the lizardfolk attack. Adventure inspired by the movie "Zulu Dawn."
sd: Your party reaches a ruined swamp keep under dwarven repair. At dawn, a lizardfolk war band advances. The defenses are weak. Can you survive the assault and its aftermath?

ds:
In Quantum Black, you play a member of a secret corporate team that investigates the supernatural. In this mission, the investigation may spiral into a mix of ancient magic, questionable science, and discoveries perhaps best left undiscovered. And will it lead to a glorious new age for humanity, or the end of the world? Join us for fast-paced action and horror as Quantum Black is Unleashed!

t: The Lost Sceptre of the Scarab Queen
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Wanted: brave adventurers. Pursue lost treasures in the land of sand, scorpions, mummies and pyramids. Seek the fabled sceptre of the Scarab Queen. Adventurers will discover hidden sites, solve hieroglyphic puzzles and battle fearsome guardians of ancient wonders. Only the hardiest souls need apply. The Lost Sceptre of the Scarab Queen is a Fifth Edition (2014) adventure for up to 6 4th level characters using terrain and miniatures. Handouts, materials and pregen characters will be provided.
sd: Your party has set out to find an ancient artifact of reputed power. Contend with the elements, curses and fearsome foes. 4th level.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Its been over 3 months since someone onboard the ORI IV investigating Morpheus-3 for neuracite, sent the last message Omni Robotics, Inc. received from its exploration vessel. The connection was terrible - but Omni Robotics was able to make out a bloody face in the grainy video signal. The comms team cleaned it up enough to pull a robotic, reverberating voice, cracking and buzzing through theinterference: “Dr. Brennan’s team has made an amazing discovery. This changes everything. Details to follow.” Details never followed. While everyone wants to hold out hope, the crew is presumed dead. You’ve been hired to locate, recover and secure Dr. Brennan's discovery before Omni Robotics’ competitors. Characters provided. PCs may have hidden, competing agendas and conflicts may occur. Safety Tools will be used. Content Warning: Gore, Body Horror, Betrayal, Domination/Loss of Agency.
sd: Your crew has been hired to locate, recover, and secure a science team's discovery aboard a ship that stopped communicating after announcing said discovery. See Content Warnings in long description.

ds: We've got some of what we need but not enough and stuff keeps breaking. The Dead are never far behind and there are other groups in the area; we've defended the camp from them a few times...and one of them just showed up on our doorstep. This was supposed to be our Haven. Situation's Normal: All Fouled Up. Safety Tools will be used. Content Warnings: Gore, Violence, Betrayal (Players may have competing agendas). Let's wrap-up Gen Con 2026 with some lighter-weight, tropey mayhem!
sd: They call it The Haven; I call it a refugee camp. The only thing we are not lacking is The Dead and people who want to take what we have. And things just got worse. Situation's Normal: All Fouled Up!

ds: Are any brave adventurers daring enough to test their mettle here? This is a violent fantasy combat game, with a few dark fantasy elements, so it’s best for teens and above. Play style leans towards roleplay encounters and a few good combats.
sd: In the Shattered Sea, civilization floats on sky islands far above the roiling clouds of the demonic Abyssal Domaine. On the island of Darkfathom, great secrets and dangers lie in waiting.

ds: Division K's first rule is Do Not Engage. We leave that sort of thing to the Quantum Black Wolf Spiders. Your job is to assess, consider, and report. A QB Low-Orbit Reconnaissance Drone (LORD) has discovered a facility in the Adirondacks. After several days of recon, it seems abandoned. So, in the spirit of Finders Keepers, you are being dispatched to check the place out. It should be perfectly safe (we think). Good luck!
sd: Division K Rule 1: Do Not Engage - leave that to Quantum Black. We’ve discovered an abandoned facility. Finders keepers! You've been dispatched to the Adirondacks. Check it out, Be Safe. Don’t die!

ds: The Offspring of Poseidon & Atlantica have come together at the 10,000th anniversary of the founding of the Covenant of Atlantis as has been decreed by Poseidon & Zeus. The celebration rages across all of Atlantis but none compare to the 10th Millennial celebration here in The Capital city of atlantis. As Stewards of the Realm Players will be tasked with developing problems as well as implement improvements across the 7 Kingdoms in 1. All while upholding the Covenant!
sd: The 2025 CMT Final round - The Kings of Atlantis unite for the 10th Millennial Holiday. Grand portents, political maneuvers to rival the days of foundation. The Covenant Forever is Atlantis forever!

ds: In the North of Bastion sits the Synoba Plaza. It features a curious attraction. The Synobian Colossus sat overlooking the site of the last interdimensional incursion. Most modern scholars don't remember what it did, who made it, or why it should be left alone. BUT, within the last 2 days, rumors have circulated that the Colossus is missing! These rumors have made their way to the August Body of the Delver's Collective! Tremors have rocked Bastion and have been felt as far away as South Bastion. You've been dispatched to see what jiggery-pokery has led to this. Discover why the Colossus has left its post and if there is a way to correct this. Also: there must be some Arcana behind this! We do love Arcana.
sd: On the North side of Bastion sits a Colossus. No one remembers why it is there. But yesterday, it disappeared. Now tremors rock the city! Go forth, Delvers! Find what Arcanum is causing this!

ds: The job was routine, the money fair. Then the damn company diverted you to answer a distress call from a ship that disappeared almost 80 years ago — a derelict carrying something bizarre, twisted, and alien. What the ship's frozen crew brought back with them was bad enough — what they themselves were turning into was a bloody nightmare. Add to that an annoying sensor ghost shadowing you in the void, and your stress level is shot.—- It’s all a bit much.—-You don't get paid enough to deal with monsters. But hold your breath, count to three, and play your cards right with this one and you just might walk away very rich. Oh, who am I kidding? You're all going to die.
sd: Had to finish our last delivery, then finally we can get paid. Big paycheck this trip,definitely overdue for some cash. Then the company diverted us for one last stop en route back to base.

ds: Hadley’s Hope, jointly funded by Weyland-Yutani and the United Americas, has a “them and us” feel to it, with any visiting corporate folk looking down their noses at the colony’s laborers. Despite this, the colony has been developing well. There’s opportunity aplenty—and risk aplenty, too.Four days ago, a miner named Russ Jorden was brought back, collapsed with some sort of illness. Very quickly, some Weyland Yutani suits and their guns for hire were dispatched to the colony.
sd: Play the story of the final hours of Hadley's Hope, all through the eyes of five colonist workers.

ds: The Grand United Order of Oddfellows has a rich and storied history. For centuries the Friendly Society has helped people in need, but sometimes they have to deal with threats many ignore. This adventure takes place in 1930 in Long Lake, Minnesota and involves a legendary Ojibwe creature, Mythos horror, and the storied Dayton family.
sd: When children start disappearing and a mysterious island appears on Long Lake during the Ricing Moon, your group of Oddfellows is assigned to figure out what is happening.

t: Novus Ordo Seclorum Tournament Round One
ds: A two round tournament. All of the first rounds will be written by and feature the talents of veteran GMs Alex Elder, Jim Beecher, and Dr. Michael Furlong. Everyone at the table will vote to advance their favorite roleplayers, and those who advance will be welcomed to play in the final round on Sunday to determine who is the 2026 Novus Ordo Seclorum Champion. Call of Cthulhu is easy to learn and everyone is welcome. This tournament contains horror elements that may be disturbing.
sd: Reality is a lie. Pierce the veil and embrace the truth. The Novus Ordo Seclorum tournament is a series of immersive Call of Cthulhu adventures focused on roleplaying. Join us!

t: Trouble in Space TAKE HOME GAME
ds: It’s a long trip to a far-away planet, but the spaceship is self-driving. Opik the Powerful wants you to keep Zow, a young alien, safe on the journey. It should be easy, because the spaceship is stealthy and nobody else is on board. What could go wrong? No Thank You, Evil! is the critically acclaimed RPG for families with creative kids as young as five. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, who can sign up to join the game or just watch!
sd: Opik the Powerful wants the PCs to keep Zow, a young alien, safe on a long journey. We hope there won't be Trouble in Space! (Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.)

t: A Fetching Tale of Dandy Dogs
ds:
Who’s a good dog? You are—even though you’re a creature made of the Devil's very shadow, tasked with collecting souls! But if there’s one thing the Devil loves even more, it’s a great story. So, you’ll spin a rousing tale of your exploits, and the myriad people, places, creatures, experiences, and conundrums—not to mention temptations—you faced as you carried out your most recent mission.
 In The Devil’s Dandy Dogs you’ll collaborate with the rest of your pack and the Diviner to create the conflict, characters, and resolutions to your tale. Special dice and a beautiful tarot-style deck generate interesting twists and turns. This no-prep, rules-light narrative roleplaying game is filled with mystery, magic, and the unforeseen.
 And a pack of supernatural dogs trying their best to be oh-so-good.
sd: Who's a good dog? You are - even though you're a creature made of the Devil's very shadow, tasked with collecting souls! Spin a rousing tale of your exploits in your most recent mission.

 In The Devil’s Dandy Dogs you’ll collaborate with the rest of your pack and the Diviner to create the conflict, characters, and resolutions to your tale. Special dice and a beautiful tarot-style deck generate interesting twists and turns. This no-prep, rules-light narrative roleplaying game is filled with mystery, magic, and the unforeseen.
 And a pack of supernatural dogs trying their best to be oh-so-good.

ds: Welcome to the swashbuckling world of Freeport! Cut-Throat’s Gold uses the Fantasy AGE 2nd Edition rules for this pirate adventure.
sd: Has the character’s luck changed? Finding what appears to be an old treasure map hidden in Freeport, they set out to find the location shown on the map.

ds: "	The Expanse Roleplaying Game brings James S.A. Corey’s award-winning series of science fiction novels to the tabletop. Using the Adventure Game Engine (AGE) rules that power Green Ronin’s Fantasy AGE, Blue Rose, and Modern AGE RPGs, The Expanse takes players to a far-future solar system where humanity is divided: Martians, Belters, and the people of old Earth struggle for political power and resources, but older, alien, forces are stirring in the universe, and human history is about to take an unexpected new turn."
sd: You and the crew of the Miriam Makeba have a job to do, drop off your supplies at Tycho Station, get paid and pick up your return cargo.

t: Where the Lava Meets the Sea: The Pyroductian Wardens
ds: The second of 3 linked adventures in an original world based on the history and culture of Sicily. The island is rich, both in farmland plowed by domesticated miniature woolly mammoths and in legends of fallen civilizations and their untold treasures. Classic fantasy races have mixed freely because waves of various cultures have landed on its shores and made their homes here. This is the perfect place to make a name for yourself, unearth enough gold to live out your days in luxury, and discover ancient magic to make you powerful beyond your wildest dreams. Sure, most adventurers meet a grisly end or decide after their first delve that they’d rather plow a field than ever try that again, but you’re different – right? Drop into one session or all three for the continuation of the story; sessions 1 and 3 will use D&D 5E and session 2 will use Shadowdark. Low-level pregens will be provided.
sd: Beneath the island, the past still stands watch. In the lava tubes, once-dormant guardians test your worth as you attempt to retrieve an artifact never meant to surface again.

ds: On your way back from the city of Latik, where you traveled to procure rare dusk moss, you receive news that you are needed for an urgent task in the City of Aldis. A separatist group called the Coral Tide seems to be targeting seafolk. Players completely new to Blue Rose are welcome - everything you need to know will be taught, and pre-generated characters are provided! If you prefer to use your own dice, please bring 3d6, with 1 die a different color than the other two.
sd: As freshly-graduated members of the Sovereign's Finest, you are returning from the small city of Latik to news of an attack against another member of the Finest.

ds: Dreams in Digital is a modern day eldritch horror adventure using the AGE (Adventure Game Engine) system.
sd: The Carter-West Agency has sent your team to San Diego to investigate a rash of unexplainable coma cases.

sd: When the Hellions contact the New Mutants asking for rescue from a dangerous situation without letting Magneto or the White Queen know, they need to sneak out to counter a dangerous threat.

ds: This adventure will use the sub setting of Earth Prime, and focus mostly upon the lower level happenings within the American Elite Government Intervention Service (AEGIS). Discover what it's like handling the more mundane threats underpinning a world full of superheroes. Espionage, street level combat, and crazy spy gadgets are the name of the game here. Of course, it'll take more than fancy technology to outwit the villainous SHADOW. Pre-generated characters will be provided.
sd: Players will take on the roles of a rag tag group of newly minted, fresh faced AEGIS agents on your first mission together. Together they'll come face to face with the villainous SHADOW organization.

ds: This adventure will use the sub setting of Earth Prime, and take place within it's Golden Age. Strange German super-technology and dark magic underpin this classic tale of good versus evil! Come ready to punch out some Nazis! Pre-generated characters will be provided.
sd: A step back in time to the Golden Age of comic books. Two fisted pulp action as our heroes fight gangsters and Germans in this WWII Earth Prime adventure!

ds: This adventure will use the sub setting of Earth Prime, and focus on the Europan city of Starhaven. Formed by alien refugees fleeing a myriad of cosmic threats, Starhaven is fractious at the best of times. When strange technologies and hostile alien life forms are just a way of life, your band of oddballs and misfits are right at home! But when circumstances align that force these characters to work together, you just know things are going to get even uglier than usual. Pre-generated characters will be provided.
sd: Odd things are happening in the alien city of Starhaven! Step into the shoes of a band of alien misfits and see just how weird life on Europa can get!

t: Titan City Chronicles: The Dragon of Parkhurst Manor
ds: This event will showcase the upcoming Mutants & Masterminds 4th Edition rule set.
sd: Titan City, 1936. The students of the Silverthorne Academy must help a baby dragon return to its mother when they rescue it from monster smugglers outside Titan City.

t: Freedom League: All in the Family
ds: This event will showcase the upcoming Mutants & Masterminds 4th Edition rule set.
sd: All isn't as it seems when Zeus requests the Freedom League's assistance in foiling his brother's latest scheme to take over Earth-Prime.

t: Titan City Chronicles: Trouble in Paradise
ds: This event will showcase the upcoming Mutants & Masterminds 4th Edition rule set.
sd: Titan City, 1927 Agents from the Department of Monster Affairs infiltrate a couple's counseling camp when a strange dead body washes up nearby.

ds: While spending the night in a small town on your search for fame and riches, the locals have informed you of a problem and asked for your help. What should be a simple rescue turns into anything but. A 3rd level scenario. No experience necessary, all rules taught! A 2024 event replay.
sd: The village of Ironton ekes out a living mining in the nearby hills, but the miners haven't been heard from in a few days. Can you solve the mystery (and perhaps make a bit of coin in the process)?

ds: Greetings operatives. The security overseer in the svirfneblin town of Little Lockford has turned traitor. The mayor has asked for our help in taking the town back. Travel to the Underdark, find the refugees, and take back Little Lockford before there is nothing left to take back.
sd: The Golden Vault, an organization with a mixed reputation. Sometimes you have to break the law to do some good.

ds: A stand alone one shot. Players will take on the roles of tiny humanoids known as littlings, adventuring inside an abandoned home. Pre-made characters and dice will be provided but you are welcome to bring your own. In this adventure our littlings come across a child begging for help in retrieving her beloved rat from the Ratador arena before he gets injured or worse. They will have to find a way to get the creature, twice their size, out of one of the most popular locations in all of Umbral. (This game may not be for players with Arachnophobia or other discomfort with bugs)
sd: A young girl found her rat taken from her in broad daylight and cries for help. A group of littlings find themselves braving the Ratador arena to bring the furry "friend" home.

ds: A stand alone one shot. Players will take on the roles of tiny humanoids known as littlings, adventuring inside an abandoned home. Pre-made characters and dice will be provided but you are welcome to bring your own. In this adventure our littlings are braving the space between the House's walls, colloquially known as the Inbetweens. While navigating, they come across a strange letter addressed to a town none of them have heard of, the Town of Hollow. Shortly thereafter they easily stumble they're way into it. Leaving, however is a appears to be a different matter. (This game may not be for players with Arachnophobia or other discomfort with bugs)
sd: While venturing the treacherous Inbetweens of the House's walls our littlings find a letter addressed to an unknown town. Entering the Town of Hollow is simple, but leaving is a different story.

ds: Every player will receive a FREE 5th Edition ALternate Cover Book for playing! At the heart of Thay lies Szass Tamm's compound, The Citadel. Do you dare enter & brave its halls?

ds: You are a member of the Gallop: seasoned monster-hunters that ordinary townsfolk would best keep away from. However, when missing sheep escalate into a torn apart villager, it becomes clear that those townsfolk are way out of their league. With a provided investigation journal brimming with notes on local 'fauna,' and an assortment of weapons and potions ready to slay them, saving this town is another grueling day on the job for you. You may bring a 7th level character made using the 2024 character rules, but pregens will also be provided. Dice and pencils provided if needed. Magic items will be provided during the game.
sd: A monster-focused murder mystery for level 7 characters. Interrogate witnesses, consult your monster-hunter guide, and avenge death in a not-so-sleepy town.

ds: “What kind of hero will you be (insert cinematic trailer voice)?” No, seriously, what kind? There are 16 starter classes for you to choose from! Each one has its own special sauce. Like the Xiolin, who combos with up, down, left, and right basic attacks to activate unique bonus moves, just like your favorite old school fighting game. There are a variety of fun races to choose from, such as slimefolk or an awakened pot of stew, and, of course, there are the classics, including orcs, gnomes, and more. No backstory, no problem, act like yourself, and if you want to roleplay, that’s great too! You’ll be tracking down Gubba and his goblin gang. Along the way, there's a lush grassy plain to explore, full of sidequests, monsters, hidden dungeons, crafting, and minigames! You’ll definitely get distracted along the way in this lighthearted and goof-prone adventure! This is a 2 day event.
sd: A dynamic board game-esque TTRPG with engaging combat, mini games, and vibrant exploration. It's lighter on the improv but still perfect for YOU to play out your ideal fantasy adventure.

ds: Your Hunter Cell wakes after being ambushed by an unknown assailant. Each of you has been drugged and transported to a mysterious hotel that seems rigged to guarantee your demise. Your possessions have been replaced with limited tools intended to help you defend yourself. A note left in the room confirms your worst fears. You and your team are unwilling participants in some sort of sick survival game presented by some supernatural entity. The odds are heavily out of your favor. But if you choose to play along, then your team will be released so long as a single member of your team succeeds. If instead you choose not to play, or you break the rules... then all bets are off, and each of you may become dinner at any time. Choose wisely.
sd: You and your Cell wake in a booby-trapped hotel. Something has kidnapped your team and left you with limited tools to defend yourself. Now you must fight to escape or become dinner.

ds:
This is a level 3 folk horror and mystery one-shot for Pathfinder 2e based on a real-world folktale I grew up with in the Southern Appalachians. It features overland travel, environmental conditions, and investigation components. CW: pet death 
 You may bring your own character or use a provided pre-gen.
sd: There's a mountain you ought not set foot on in winter. Whether the harsh reality of nature or haunted by spooks, that place has bad juju. Your party is sent to find a fool who ignored the warnings.

gm: Jeff Wilson, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
Something sinister has arrived in Nordvorn. Animals have been mutilated, citizens whisper of missing pets, a young merchant’s daughter fades with each passing day, and whispers of a shadowy presence have spread through the city. Only the cleverest and bravest will uncover the truth behind the city’s mysterious terror before something truly unspeakable occurs.
 
 An original fantasy adventure using the Dungeon Fantasy GURPS rules is part of the Nick and Nose World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) 
 
 We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Nordvorn is gripped by strange deaths and unexplained disappearances. Animals mutilated, a young woman with an unknown malady, and whispers of a shadowy presence have spread through the city.

gm: Jeff Wilson, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
A violent storm strands strangers on a lonely road. Power flickers, visibility drops, and the night feels… wrong. Something unseen stalks the darkness, testing nerves and resolve. Every choice matters—do you act or hide, help others or save yourself?
 
 In this tense adventure, you are not heroes. You survive by managing fear, protecting each other, and deciding when to push your luck—and when to stay hidden. Expect claustrophobic suspense, moral dilemmas, and escalating dread in a single session designed to keep hearts racing and hands trembling.
 
 This rules-light modern survival horror GURPS game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) 
 
 We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Alone on a lonely road, the lights fail and fear rises. Something watches. Can you last the night? A rules-light modern survival horror game.

ds:
The archmage Malacar Veyne, once an advisor to kings, disappeared into his tower many years past. A few weeks ago, magic eruptions (portals, gravity changes, illusions, etc.) started occurring in and around the tower. These occurrences are getting more frequent and spreading farther, threatening to engulf the town of Tower’s Edge. The mayor has hired your team of adventurers to investigate!
 
 This adventure is an Introduction to GURPS (the Generic Universal Role Playing System). The rules will be taught to you in stages, no experience necessary.
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: An archmage's tower has erupted in wild magic surges after a botched spell experiment and the resultant chaos threatens to engulf the nearby town. Can you protect them?

ds: The realm of Baela's Love is watched over by a goddess of peace and protection named Baela (of course) as well as her chosen Four Paladins. Her capital city, Baela's Splendor, hosts a spring festival where people from all over the country celebrate and provide tribute to Baela in thanks for her protection. You are an experienced team of adventurers who have arrived in the city during the time of the spring festival. Once in the city, you notice something amiss beneath the air of joy and merrymaking. Do you pull the thread and possibly unravel this perfect city?
sd: A level 12 one shot adventure in the high-fantasy home-brew realm of Baela's Love. This is a classic style game consisting of exploration, social intrigue and combat.

 Oil up, get in the ring, and kayfabe to glory!

ds: Captain Henry Avery, known as the Arch Pirate and the King of Pirates, led a daring raid on a Grand Mughal treasure convoy bound for Mecca. He escaped with more than 600,000 pounds of treasure, becoming the most wanted man on the seas and triggering the first recorded worldwide manhunt. By 1696, Avery and the treasure vanished from all records, the pursuit officially abandoned and Avery presumed dead. Rumors persist that among the stolen riches was the relic Nizeh Seh Shakheh Poseidon, Poseidon’s Trident, an artifact said to grant power over the oceans themselves. You are the crew of the Iron Grackle. Avery’s name has faded into legend, but you know the truth. The East India Company is still searching, and you are racing them to Avery’s last known hideaway. This is a multi-table event with cross-table interaction shaping a larger shared story.
sd: 7 September 1695. Pirate captain Henry Avery vanished after stealing a vast Mughal treasure, sparking the first global manhunt. You are the crew racing the East India Company to his final hideaway.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: You and a random group of "heroes" are working together to figure out who stole some Pym technology. Pym himself can't deal with it personally, as it might raise too much alarm about the shipment theft. Your group is to work together (yes play nice... ugh) to find out who stole the Pym tech, retrieve the material, and stop whoever stole it to shut them down.
sd: Nanotech was safe they said. Nothing could go wrong they said. They will help the world they said. Well, things just got a little crazy when in the wrong hands.

t: How to Create a World with Friends
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: This is a collaborative illustration game where you define the struggles of a community living after the collapse of civilization, and attempt to build something good within the ruins of the world. Maybe uncover mysteries of the past? How about discover what caused it all to happen? Start some projects to be rebuild. But be warned, some of your co survivors will need to make some tough choices that might conflict with your objectives. The goal of the game isn't to win or lose. It's to make the most of what is left as you manage your resources, and build society anew. Paper, and writing tools are all we will need, which will be supplied. Be prepared to work as a team, and to respect the choices your fellow team members make while being willing to make sacrifices.
sd: Learn how to build a world with friends. Its helpful when you want to make a world for your next RPG adventure, or just mess around with some creative ideas.

Careful planning and cooperation will be more critical than a sharp sword. Players will be provided pre-generated Level 1 Characters for this game and no experience is required. All materials provided.
sd: Heroes take on the role of robbers to protect the Sword Coast from lurking evil. Can you survive this night at the museum?

ds: Created as a companion to the A24 film, The Green Knight is a game about honor and its consequences. Players will venture out to meet their fates at the Green Chapel and encounter strange adventures along the path. Characters need not fear death — the ultimate punishment is Dishonor. Players will be provided with pre-generated character options and no experience is required. All materials provided.
sd: O Greatest of Players, indulge me in this friendly Christmas game. Journey to the Green Chapel to meet your fate.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: A collaborative map-based RPG where players define the struggles, celebrations, and inevitable end of a shared community. Whether the final year is one of triumph, despair, progress, or destruction, the players will decide through their decisions and responses to events that play out for their community. They will shape the world and space they have found themselves in to make a home they hope will remember them.
sd: As a member of a dying community, you must respond to events that spell out your final year. Each card drawn represents another week gone in our march towards the end.

t: Brewer's District Down by the Docks
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Your agency has been contacted by a mysterious figure with a request. Meet him at the lighthouse on the edge of town, ensuring no one follows you. There he promises to provide you with the details of his request and all the information you should need in order to ferret out the rodents that are infecting this city with their latest concoction. You will work with other investigators to uncover their whereabouts, disrupt their operations, and do all you can to return home without becoming another corpse floating in the river.
sd: A strange transmission flashed across your monitor. You know two things. 1. A powerful figure has wormed his way into your network. 2. He needs your help to dig up the supplier of a new drug.

Play with Mazes Architect Patrick Lynn Clapp! 
 
 The Witch Kings destroyed the world with their war. Now, we live in the last city, on the edge of the seas of sand, salvaging treasures to keep the great City of Skull from falling to the Darkness.
 
 City of Skull is the first expansion to Mazes Fantasy Role playing game. Explore with wastes around the last city, standing in external eclipse at the edge of an ocean of sand. Discover new hazards, classes, west marching, hex crawling, find old gods and new, make kings and kill gods. 
 
 Mazes is a return to the classic sword and sorcery dungeon crawler with award-winning, yet delightfully simple modern rules. The first TTRPG to use the polymorph system, Mazes is easy to learn and teach, and ready to play without a lot of prep.

t: Kobold Midnight(ish) Massacre: Torg's Rancid Rumble
ds:
Back again for the Midnight* Massacre returns Kobolds Ate My Baby! to the ring in an all-holds-chewed event for the ages. Team up and throw down for King Torg! (All Hail King Torg!) Get ready to heel turn hard, because every baby face gets eaten. 
 
 Now Powered by Polymorph! Kobolds Ate my Baby! is even easier! Crash and burn this cult classic while you and your hangry brood of Kobolds tear through town looking for snacks, start fires, and eat tasty tasty babies. 
 
 With simple fast rules and faster deaths polymorph games are great for beginner and seasoned Kobold alike. 
 
 ALL HAIL KING TORG!!!!
 
 *Kobolds can't tell time
sd: In this all out wrassling extravaganza go paw-to-paw with Kobold tag teams. Climb the turn buckle and fight for glory with elbows, chops, fire and foreign objects! Win the belt for King Torg! AHKT!

ds:
This is a 1950s-set Call of Cthulhu one-shot about family, conformity, and the horrors buried beneath small-town tradition.
 You don’t play investigators. You play the family.
 
 Summoned to an isolated ancestral home for the reading of a will, you’ll uncover unsettling truths about your bloodline, a town that smiles too much, and a legacy that demands something in return.
 
 This game focuses on atmosphere, investigation, and psychological horror, with a non-traditional sanity system that warps beliefs instead of simply draining points.
 
 Expect slow dread, moral pressure, and bad choices.
sd:
This is not a typical Cthulhu game.
 
 You will not “solve” the horror.
 
 You will decide what survives.

ds:
This is an open-world, player-driven horror scenario set firmly in the late 1920s: an era of medical cruelty, institutional power, and unchecked experimentation. The asylum is fully explorable. Clues exist in many places. There is no single correct path only consequences. Time moves forward whether you are ready or not.
 
 You may plan carefully.
 You may act rashly.
 You may save her.
 You may unleash something far worse.
 
 This is not about heroism.
 It is about loyalty, desperation, and how far you will go when the system itself is the monster.
sd:
You are patients.
 
 You have no weapons worth naming.
 
 You have no authority, no protection, no guarantee of survival.

t: The Love Boat, We're Expecting You!
ds: Love Boat Season 7 E-99. [NOT FOR AIR ** COPY 1 of 5 **]. All Rights Reserved American Broadcasting Co, 1983. [PEND ON-AIR APPROVAL]. Segments: Parents in Love/ A Midsummer Night's Dream/ Down on his Luck. Outside authorship project, Post Production COMPLETE, Air Date TBD, Spelling must sign off before air. [ABC CIRC ONLY NO MEDIA DIST]
sd: A test audience gets a sneak preview of a new episode of ABC's star-studded mega-hit show! This episode is a little... strange, but some people really dig it! Come aboard!

t: Bi Planes, Zeppelins, and Jet Packs OH MY!
ds: It’s 1932—an age of roaring engines, brass goggles, and impossible science. In blazing Rio, whispers of vanished passengers and forbidden tech ignite a skybound mystery that could change the world. Enter the scrappy Harold’s Midnight Marauders: a daring pilot, a renowned relic hunter, a cunning femme fatale, a towering circus strongman, a grizzled Spanish-American War veteran, a brilliant mad scientist, and a mysterious occultist. Strap in—adventure lives above the clouds.
sd: The airship Samuel Clemens docks in Rio on time—engines warm, lights on, no souls aboard. Harold’s Midnight Marauders came to vacation. Instead, they’re chasing a mystery in the sky.

gm: Chris Normand, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
The former preacher turned outlaw, Ezekiel Crowe, robbed and murdered a local shaman, believing he had magic that would grant him riches. Ezekiel took over the local mine, in the hopes of gaining untold wealth, but in doing so he unleashed a force that has been trapped for centuries. Ever since then, weird and deadly events have been occurring around the mine. The mine owner has hired your posse to go in and remove Mr Crowe and hopefully lift the curse.
 This adventure is an Introduction to GURPS (the Generic Universal Role Playing System). The rules will be taught to you in stages, no experience necessary.
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: The 1880s Wild West frontier town of Shade Gulch is plagued by a cursed gold mine unleashing magic. Can you lift the curse before the town is destroyed?

gm: Chris Normand, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
The CEO of Veilbreak promised the first instantaneous transport before the end of the year. It was aggressive; some corners had to be cut, but on Dec 30th, 2035, the first inanimate object transfer was made. There were some glitches (the test cargo arrived mangled) and unfortunately, the target portal didn’t close, and all living beings within the building were sucked into the portal, presumed dead. DCOps (Dimension Control Operations) has dispatched your team to investigate the portal and close it ASAP.
 
 This adventure is an Introduction to GURPS (the Generic Universal Role Playing System). The rules will be taught to you in stages, no experience necessary.
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: In 2035, the hi-tech company Veilbreak attempted their first zero-time transport. The experiment wasn't a complete success, and the rip in space-time is causing problems.

gm: Jason Woollard, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
A strange, fragmented signal crackles through an ancient radio, drawing a small band of survivors into the untamed wilds of a world that has long since moved on without them. In this GURPS post-apocalyptic adventure, players confront warped remnants of human technology, treacherous terrain reclaimed by nature, and hostile forces shaped by decay and neglect. As clues accumulate, the group uncovers a hidden, escalating threat whose consequences reach far beyond the ruins ahead. What begins as a simple investigation becomes a race against time to protect everything they call home.
 
 An original GURPS adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world of danger and wonder.
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: A distant signal is detected, sending a group of survivors into the wilds of a world moved on. This post-apoc adventure pits them against forgotten tech, dangerous terrain, and a looming threat.

t: Bitter Song of the Black Mangroves
gm: Jason Woollard, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
In a remote village perched on the edge of a dark mangrove swamp, a haunting song has begun luring villagers to their doom, spreading fear and desperation. A group of travelers band together to uncover the source of the eerie melody, navigating treacherous waterways, natural hazards, and an unraveling mystery tied to the swamp’s ancient secrets. With the village on edge and time running out, the heroes must act quickly to end the growing curse and stop The Bitter Song of the Black Mangroves. 
 
 An original GURPS adventure set in a strange and beautiful land inspired by southeast Asian folklore. Originally run at GenCon 2025. 
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: A haunting melody lures villagers to the nearby swamp. The adventurers must uncover its source, face hidden dangers, and break the curse before all is lost to The Bitter Song of the Black Mangroves.

gm: Jason Woollard, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
A run at 600 kph. MegaMeridian Rail is a sealed city in motion, layers of passengers, commerce, and corporate security hurtling across borders without slowing. Corridors are monitored, doors lock remotely, and electric eyes never blink. Every car has a purpose, every system a failsafe, and every mistake rumbles down the line. You’re inside a moving machine that responds to disruption with precision force. Plans will fracture, alarms will blare, and exits will vanish just when you need them most. Stay ahead of the systems, outpace security, and adapt fast: or ride the rail to the end of the line.
 
 An original GURPS adventure set in a neon and chrome dystopian future.
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Complete the job and secure the asset at 600 kph. MegaMeridian Rail is a sealed city in motion; monitored corridors, electronic eyes, no exits. It doesn't stop, slow down, or forgive. Time to move.
