t: Sleeper in the Tomb of Dreams
gm: Ben Lipe, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
Pilgrims transport sacred bones to perform a ritual meant to seal away a Far Realm entity for another century. When cultists ambush them and steal the relics, the heroes must give chase to the dark heart of the forest to the Tomb of Dreams, where a ritual is underway to awaken the Sleeper, an ancient being trapped between worlds. The tomb is a nightmare realm of cultists, deadly traps, and fears made real. Recover the bones, stop the ritual, and prevent madness from being unleashed upon the world.
 
 Part 1 of a 3-part campaign. Each session stands alone—join for one or play the full saga. Adapted for GURPS from Sleeper in the Tomb of Dreams by Matthew Sernett.
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: When cultists steal sacred bones, heroes must brave the nightmare-haunted Tomb of Dreams to stop the Sleeper-an entity from beyond the stars. Face cultists, traps, and your own fears made real.

gm: Ben Lipe, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
A dark fantasy sword-and-sorcery adventure with a chilling twist on the classic dungeon crawl. After a cataclysm shatters a great city, desperate survivors are trapped deep underground, cut off from the world above. In the ruins of a fallen civilization, they must navigate deadly tunnels, evade traps, and confront alien horrors lurking in the dark. As resources dwindle and sanity frays, the survivors must work together to survive, make hard choices, and find a way out before the darkness claims them.
 
 Part 2 of a 3-part campaign. Each session stands alone—join for one or play the entire saga. Based on 'Nightcrawlers' by Gildor Games, adapted for GURPS.
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Survivors, trapped underground after a cataclysm, must navigate dangerous tunnels, face alien creatures, and escape before light runs out and the depths consume them in this dark fantasy adventure.

gm: Ben Lipe, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
After narrowly escaping an earlier calamity, heroes learn the cult’s ritual succeeded, opening a conduit to the nightmare realm where the Sleeper is imprisoned. As the entity nears awakening, a mysterious messenger reveals the only hope: enter the Sleeper’s prison and destroy the ritual anchor sustaining the breach. The heroes must brave a surreal underworld of impossible geometry, living landscapes, and nightmares made real, facing twisted cult remnants and deadly manifestations of their deepest fears before time runs out and reality is unmade.
 
 Part 3 of a 3-part campaign. Each session stands alone—join for one or play the entire saga. Adapted to GURPS.
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Heroes must venture into a nightmare realm to destroy the ritual anchor before the Sleeper awakens. Face twisted cultists, living nightmares, and your deepest fears made real in a surreal underworld.

ds:
A GURPS Space/Powers Adventure
 
 An eclectic group of folk have been invited to join Professor Stoneking for dinner and a most exciting discovery! What could the old archaeologist be doing in an exclusive base on the moon?
 
 Learn the basics of GURPS - what you can do, how to do it, and how well you can do it. Be an artist, a professor, a jet jockey, or an aspiring actress. What could these folk have in common? And will they be able to work together to unravel the mysteries of Tranquility Base?
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Dear Professor Stoneking has exciting news, and he wants to share it with you in person. Take your exclusive invitation to a mysterious facility on Luna. What could be so important?

gm: Arne Jamtgaard, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
A GURPS Space/Powers Adventure
 
 An eclectic group of folk have been invited to join Professor Stoneking for dinner and a most exciting discovery! What could the old archaeologist be doing in an exclusive base on the moon?
 
 Learn the basics of GURPS - what you can do, how to do it, and how well you can do it. Be an artist, a professor, a jet jockey, or an aspiring actress. What could these folk have in common? And will they be able to work together to unravel the mysteries of Tranquility Base?
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Dear Professor Stoneking has exciting news, and he wants to share it with you in person. Take your exclusive invitation to a mysterious facility on Luna. What could be so important?

gm: Arne Jamtgaard, Nick & Nose World Tour
ds:
A GURPS Youths on Wheeled Devices adventure
 
 Mr Robert's, your favorite teacher, has gone missing, and no one seems to care. Even worse, the new substitute, Mrs Crabbridge, is the worst! It's up to you and your gang of misfit school kids to figure out what's going on and fix it!
 
 This game is part of the Nick and Nose (and friends!) World Tour which brings fast, welcoming GURPS games to the table wherever we roll (3d6!) We’re dedicated to great play and may accept 1–2 walk-ups if space allows.
sd: Something is wrong in Greenville. Your favorite teacher, Mister Roberts, is not in school. The new substitute, Mrs Crabbridge, is really mean. What can you and your friends do about it?

ds: The humans of the town of Purity and the Witches of nearby Black Branch have lived in an uneasy truce for generations. Sure, violence erupts every once in a while, but both sides work hard to keep a full-on war from erupting. Which is why when a human teen is found murdered on the outskirts of Black Branch with all signs pointing to a Witch being the culprit, the leaders of the town quickly asked the one coven they know could not possibly have done it to investigate. You need to uncover the truth and bring the murderer to justice before the good people of Purity show up on your doorstep.
sd: A horrific crime is committed and a coven of unlikely heroes must find the truth before the mundane folks show up with torches and pitchforks. Experience a dark, folk-horror adventure like no other!

ds:
Lvl 9 Premade Characters. What should have been a minor offense becomes a life-altering sentence. Without warning or proper trial, the party is arrested, shackled, and transported across treacherous waters to a remote island prison "The Last Lock" - an infamous place whispered about in taverns. The punishment is excessive. The charges are vague. And no one seems interested in hearing the truth. 
 
 The island is a fortress of steel, surrounded by jagged reefs, cold seas, and watchful eyes. Guards rule through fear, inmates are worked to exhaustion, and hope is treated as contraband. Magic is restricted, violence is common, and survival depends on who you trust - or betray.
 
 But adventurers are not meant to rot in cells. So, rally yourselves adventures and prepare for a PRISON BREAK!
 
 All players will receive a custom mini, owlbear cub mini, set of dice, and character sheet to keep!
sd: A minor offense leads to an extreme punishment. Transported to a heavily guarded island prison. Surrounded by ruthless wardens and desperate inmates, the party's only objective is clear... ESCAPE!

t: Where Are You? We Are Here
ds: A group of old friends are pulled back to a small, New Mexico town to help their former classmate prevent a catastrophe. Play as everyday adults, thrown in way over their heads, as they navigate the dynamics of a small town. Work with your team to infiltrate the VLA, and uncover the mystery hidden by the US government for the last generation. Join 6 players and 2 GMs for a long format, RP-focused game, using a ruleset derived from Kids on Bikes with dashes of Blades in the Dark! Character sheets will be provided. The story will involve elements of science fiction, engineering, espionage, and adventure. Most of all, have fun!
sd: 20 years after graduation and going your separate ways, you are drawn back to their hometown to help your friend to unveil the secrets of the VLA and prevent a catastrophe.

ds: Rising sophomores are invited to a manor on the edge of campus to complete the initiation into a prestigious historic fraternity. Initiates must defend an abandoned manor on the edge of campus, using only their ingenuity and the magic they have learned. This sounds more than a little dorky, but the upperclassmen say that the post-initiation after party is when they made their first real friends, and you can only go to the afterparty if you go through the dorky initiation. You have been told that you will make traps, you suspect the large costume you saw being loaded into a cart is involved, and there are rumors of something disturbing at the manor, but you're not completely sure what to expect. Join 6 players and 2 GMs for a long format game! Character sheets will be provided. The story will involve elements of horror and gore, and RP is encouraged. Most of all, have fun!
sd: At the end of their first year at a magical trade school, a bunch of students step out for a frat initiation that takes an unexpected and dangerous turn.

ds: An adventure into the First Age of Middle Earth, before Beleriand fell beneath the waves. Knowledge of the Silmarillion is not essential but probably helpful. Roleplaying stressed over mechanics.
sd: It is the end of the First Age. A small group from the free peoples of Middle Earth ventures into the land of the Enemy to ensure that the valor of those who opposed him is not forgotten.

t: World Builder 3: The Chill of the Sea, Part 1
ds: Tabletop RPG, 4X strategy, and wargaming tactics all combine in the legacy conclusion to the World Builder series! A chill wind rolls off the ocean and those attuned to the ebbs of magic are certain that ill tidings will soon come ashore. Use your dwindling resources, exploit strategic positions, and band together with your allies to weather the coming storm. This will be the first adventure in a three-part series. Participation in all three parts is not required but is encouraged. Characters will be provided and all rules will be taught as you go.
sd: During the last conflict, a whisper of an ancient power was released. Can you leverage the bounty you've amassed to outlast the storm? D&D, 4X, and Wargaming themes combine in this climactic finale!

t: “Hoards & Hazards” The Lair Safety Compliance Codex
ds:
This game will feature dangerous low-level play and pre-built characters!
 
 *I'm a Bombastic, Lore-Master GM Focused on Player-Driven Games and Improvisation*
 
 •	 “He has a very special talent of navigating player decisions while keeping the group on track to their goals. His focus on individual character growth is something unrivaled...” – Autumn. 
 •	 “He's got a great sense of humor, treats everyone fairly, and is always respectful. He's also incredibly patient with beginners, always willing to kindly explain rules and the finer points of the game.” – Dextronomous. 
 •	 “…Sam makes it easy to understand. The gameplay is always fun and interesting! – Grace.
 
 Safety: We will establish interests, tone, settings, and expectations, including lines and veils.
sd: Kobolds chosen by the Dragon "Red Death" are anointed as Kobold Union Dragon Auditors! Review other Dragon Lairs & Rob the Ugly Human Cities! For fans of “The Hobbit,” "Gremlins," & "The Labyrinth.”

t: The Case of the Missing Bumblebee
ds: A stand alone one shot. Players will take on the roles of tiny humanoids known as littlings, adventuring inside an abandoned home. Pre-made characters and dice will be provided but you are welcome to bring your own. In this adventure our littlings find themselves the morning after a rambunctious soirée to celebrate the Sluagh holiday, Samhain. And a beloved pet bee, Joya, belonging to an influential figure from the basement has gone missing! Some are military officers, sent to resolve the situation quickly by the Tsarina herself, others are those in attendance of the party and looking to stick their nose where it may or may not belong. Regardless, they all share the same mission, Find that Bee! (This game may not be for players with discomfort with bugs)
sd: The morning after a soirée, it is discovered that a pet bumble bee has gone missing. But this is no ordinary bumble bee, Joya, may end up throwing the whole house into trouble if not found soon.

t: A Night of Home and Horror
ds: While playing this game, everyone is a player and everyone is a game master, creating a story collaboratively from the elements we design at beginning of play. The table can chose to be as haunting or hilarious as we would like to be. All expansions are available to choose from and rules will be taught at table. Players do not need to bring anything to play. (Safety tools and comfort levels will be discussed before play)
sd: An at table generated horror RPG where cards and players collective imaginations weave the adventure of exploring a haunted house through a dry erase board map.

ds: It’s the 60’s. Everyone is trying not to think about nuclear devastation, women are liberated and wearing leather catsuits, and a small Caribbean island has acquired two nuclear bombs! Your characters are members of a super secret organization for agents with “special” talents. The X-Men meet the Avengers (not those Avengers!) in this role playing game of espionage and superpowers.
sd: It’s the ‘60s! In a world of spies, leather catsuits and master villains, you are an agent with “special” talents trying to prevent nuclear proliferation.

ds: A Leopard Woman of Venus, Spy Racer, Hobomancer, Sailor, Sorceress, and two Rasslin’ brothers walk into a tavern. It may sound like the start of a problematic joke, but it’s actually the beginning of a murder mystery and epic adventure in a multiversal setting.
sd: A Leopard Woman of Venus, Spy Racer, Hobomancer, Sailor, Sorceress, and two Rasslin’ brothers walk into a tavern. It’s not a joke, but a game of epic multiversal adventure.

ds: If heroes are outlaws, then outlaws will become heroes. 30 years ago, the Peacekeepers saved the world from the renegade AIs. After external protests and internal bickering, the Skyper Act disbanded them 3 years ago. Some former Peacekeepers have refused to follow that law and continue to operate, being joined by new Peacekeepers as they face a growing threat to the entire world. This is an Overwatch-styled superhero game set in the near future
sd: Just 3 years ago, the Skyper Act disbanded the Peacekeepers. Recent events have caused both past and new members to rise up again in this Overwatch-styled superhero game.

ds: In the style of the D&D Open tournament that used to run at Origins and GenCon in the 1990’s, we present the D&D Challenge: Talon's Test 2026. Talon the great Wizard died years ago. Each year, on the anniversary of his death, a contest is held for the title 'Defenders of the Realm'. Your party of 6 is competing. Fighting and puzzles await. 5th level characters provided.
sd: Your party of 6 is competing in a contest for the title of 'Defenders of the Realm'. 5th level characters provided.

t: Sinners Prequel: The Hunt for Remmick
ds: Players will assume the roles of three Choctaw characters using the Spirit of 77 archetypes: Matthew Mingo, Thomas Tushka, and Charles Chitto, who learn the true nature of Remmick and seek to end his evil before it can spread. Characters will be provided, and rules will be taught. Play the game and take the adventure home. Players will be offered free copies of the character sheets and scenario notes. (https://sinnersmovie.fandom.com/wiki/)
sd: In Sinners, the vampire Remmick is on the run, pursued by three members of the Choctaw Native American tribe, a tribe with connections to both the Irish and the supernatural. This is their story.

t: King of the Hill:  Pain and Pro Pain Accessories
ds: Players will assume the roles of Hank Hill and his wife, the award-winning substitute Spanish teacher & Boggle champion, Peggy Hill (Yes!), Dale Gribble (with bonus second identity Rusty Shackleford), Bill Dauterive, & Boomhauer. Always an extra character for any player with a dream (in this case, Bobby Hill (The boy ain't right!)). Play the game & take the adventure home. Players will be offered free electronic copies of the character sheets & game notes. (https://www.reddit.com/.../i_like_propain_and_propain.../)
sd: The cast members of "The King of the Hill" must defend their beloved Arlen, TX, from supernatural beings summoned by a strangely familiar relic. Angels to some, Demons to others. I tell you what!

t: Batman and the Outsiders: To Live Outside the Law, You Have to Be Honest
ds: Batman founded the Outsiders when the Justice League became too restricted by rules, regulations, and public relations to focus on Justice. Players will assume the roles of Geoforce, Katana, Halo, and Black Lightning. Always an extra character for any player with a dream (in this case, Looker). Play the game and take the adventure home. Players will be offered free electronic copies of the character sheets and game notes.
sd: Batman and the Outsiders sought to defend a society that did not really accept them for acting in many ways outside the law. But what will they do when their most powerful members go missing?

t: Justice Society: Flash! A-Ah! He Will Save Everyone of Us!
ds:
Players will assume the roles of the Flash, Dr. Mid-Nite, Mister Terrific, and Hawkman, Always an extra character for any player with a dream (in this case, Black Canary). Play the game and take the adventure home. Players will be offered free electronic copies of the character sheets and game notes.
 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hYTYqs-ytSk)
sd: Mordru the Merciless has targeted Earth for destruction, and only the returned heroes of the Justice Society can stop his evil plans of global destruction!

t: Marvel Tales Presents Freedom Force: The Trial of Magneto
ds: Players will assume the roles of the Blob, Avalanche, Pyro, and Super Saber, led by Crimson Commando. Always an extra character for any player with a fist full of generics and a dream (in this case, Stonewall). Characters will be provided, and rules will be taught. Play the game and take the adventure home. Players will be offered free copies of the character sheets and scenario notes. (https://www.pinterest.com/pin/33073378506952974/)
sd: Having captured & temporarily depowered the Mutant Master of Magnetism, Freedom Force must deliver him to his trial while his enemies look to assassinate him & his followers look to create a martyr.

ds:
When a small group of families built a community on the banks of the Blackbrook River, they made a deal with the legendary Blackbrook beast … but that was ages ago and, as the town grew and thrived, they forgot about that promise. Every few generations, the beast gathers the strength to rise and exact its revenge on those who betrayed it and corrupted its home. Every time, the successors of those founding families have bound the beast back to the river. At least, every time so far.
 
 Now a new generation has begun to dream of the Blackbrook beast—haunted dreams that draw them to the Blackbrook River, where the beast is more powerful than it’s ever been.
sd: Descendants of a town's founding families must perform a ritual to bind the Blackbrook beast, a creature their ancestors made a bargain with - and betrayed.

Every time, the successors of those founding families have bound the beast back to the river. At least, every time so far.
 
 Now a new generation has begun to dream of the Blackbrook beast—haunted dreams that draw them to the Blackbrook River, where the beast is more powerful than it’s ever been.
sd: Descendants of a town's founding families must perform a ritual to bind the Blackbrook beast, a creature their ancestors made a bargain with - and betrayed.

ds:
A Play with the Author event!
 
 Gaufridus Goblinmist, a wizard billionaire and Xcrawl DJ, has run out of ideas for new dungeons. To keep his billions safe and untaxable, he has made a pact with an eldritch AI system, UR1-3L. UR1-3L’s dungeons are dangerous, strange, and uncanny. Many crawlers have lost their lives fighting their menagerie of seven fingered monsters and brain rotting riddles. But a few heroes can stop this entity! You are part of a rebel faction of crawlers who refused to bow to these AI overlords. Armed with a thumb drive that holds a curse so powerful that it can destroy UR1-3L forever. If you fail, UR1-3L will control dungeons with AI for the rest of time.
sd: A lazy DJ made a deal with an AI entity to make new dangerous dungeons. It is up to you to destroy the entity in the latest dungeon it designed or all crawls will be controlled by AI slop forever.

ds: The promise of good pay and all you can eat wins over. You listen to the rumble in your tummy and decide to go check it out. You play as the monsters.
sd: Adventurers in the wilds have been slim pickings of late and you see an interesting advertisement looking for monsters to staff a game show. This is a Play with the Author event!

ds: Eight meta-beings from throughout the stars have formed the mighty team known as the Galactic Defenders. But though as superheroes they present a united front, not all is smooth sailing behind the scenes. There’s the love triangle that led to a divorce, and the daughter who picked mom’s side. Oh yeah, and the two men in this mess? They were business partners with a third team member, but a massive lab explosion bankrupted their company. Sure, two of them got their powers from that explosion, but was it really an accident? Meanwhile, the twins don’t know why their powers are so different, but with the help of the professor who is on the team, one of them hopes to figure out why. And don’t forget, there’s a meta-killer on the loose and the Defenders are trying to catch the being responsible. Roleplaying stressed!
sd: The amazing alien heroes of the Galactic Defenders find themselves on the trail of a murderer. Who killed Backwater Eddy? And why? Roleplaying stressed.

ds:
Fortunately for all involved, Zaraides the Sage happened to be rummaging for baubles at a nearby stall when a fluxial disgorgemental rejection in space-time spilled an aspect of Uthaw into the party's docked worming vessel. Owed a debt as recompense for his generosity in sealing the space-time rift and thereby saving the party's ship, Zaraides has tasked the crew to sail from Saskervoy to the fabled ancient city of Ampridatvir. 
 
 His request is simple: evade the various dangers (no doubt to be expected) and retrieve the Compendium of Universal Knowledge as Zaraides' rightful property. Surely an easy task for such seemingly capable adventurers as yourselves!
 
 A 4th level treasure hunt inspired by Jack Vance's early stories.
sd: Owing an exactitude to a powerful benefactor, the party explores the ancient city of Ampridatvir on a quest for a singular tome that allegedly contains all knowledge. A Play with the Author event!

t: The Museum at the End of Time
ds:
With each new generation of younglings, the Tribe of Cog tests their youths fitness to serve their neolithic society as adults by sending them out on The Rite of Passage. The purpose of the Rite is two-fold.
 First and foremost, the younglings are tasked with going out into the untamed wilderness, surviving on their own for over one week, and with bringing back to the tribe one functioning artifact of the ancients per participant. Secondly, it is to be hoped that the stresses of the Rite will trigger the "Metagenesis." For mutants, manimals, and plantients, the Metagenesis is the sudden full-flowering of their mutated genetic code and its attendant mutations.
sd: A great disaster has ravaged the world, it's up to you and your mutant tribesmen to go out into the hothouse jungles and radioactive deserts and collect artifacts of the Ancient Ones.

t: Ash and Iron Chapter 1: The Gates Remember
ds:
You are a dwarf of the old blood, descended from clans that once ruled a mountain kingdom of stone, fire, and unmatched craft. Karak Zul was not merely a home, but the heart of your people’s identity, carved by generations of labor, oath, and tradition. Its fall came not by conquest, but by catastrophe, when a reckless act deep within the mines tore open a gate to something dark and hostile. The kingdom was shattered, and its survivors were dragged into slavery in the Plane of Fire.
 
 You have escaped that fate. Now, standing once more upon the Material Plane, you return to the Zul Mountains to face whatever has claimed your ancestral halls. Ruin, ancient defenses, and lingering corruption await, but the mountain still bears your clan’s marks. Level 10 pregenerated characters are provided, using the 2014 5e rules, as you decide whether Karak Zul can truly be reclaimed.
sd: A dwarven expedition enters a ruined mountain realm, confronting ancient dangers and hard truths while attempting to reclaim a long-lost homeland.

t: The Best of Times: Wicked City
gm: Thomas Javoroski, Ed Allen, Beth Allen
ds: Not everyone in a pirate city is a pirate. And some people are plotting more than piracy. There are smugglers, thieves, practitioners of dark magic, the whole gamut. And of course lots of people without "dark" in front of their occupation, folks just trying to get by. And then there are visitors from far off lands - very far off. What do any of these people want? Just to survive the day. That, sad to say, may not be easy. Costumes enjoyed but not required. All people are celebrated here - we have no tolerance for intolerance.
sd: Pirate cities are all wicked. That’s because pirates are wicked—this is common knowledge. But not everyone in a pirate city is a pirate. And some people are plotting more than piracy. Which are you?

gm: Thomas Javoroski, Kristina Moseley, Beth Allen
ds: Raiding, let’s face it, is a warm weather activity. Try scaring the locals into submission when you jump out of your boat and fall face-first on the ice. Better just to stay home until the Spring thaw. But Vikings at home get bored. So what harm could come from an invitation to some friendly winter competition? A feared and fearsome Jarl, his soldiers legendary for their bravery and prowess, has issued just such an invitation. There’s no way you can decline and keep your reputation as "pretty fearsome yourself," so…pack your spear and your best mead. Grab a skald to tell everyone of your victory when it’s done. And maybe find some quiet way to cheat. Because you’re also widely known to be "surprisingly clever, considering." Costumes appreciated but not required. All people are celebrated here, we have no tolerance for intolerance.
sd: Raiding is a summer gig. No one wants to go sailing on frozen fjords. But what happens when a snowed-in Jarl invites his neighbors for "friendly competition"? That won’t get out of hand, not at all.

Every crawl squad worthy of the name shall face DJ Creature Feature’s nightmare dungeon. Will your team survive . . . a slaydate with destiny? This is a single-session tournament event for trophies and bragging rights.
sd: It is back! Will your team survive the greatest challenge the World’s Funnest Death Sport has to offer? Trophies + bragging rights are on the line, so bring your hot dice!

ds: Saturday night in Paris, 1923. Gertrude Stein’s salon sparkles with jazz, perfume, and danger. The Lost Generation drinks, argues, and seduces beneath Picasso’s gaze while the new Russian ballet captures headlines and hearts. Whispers of scandal and murder drift through the smoke. Genius and jealousy dance too closely, and inspiration may come at a fatal cost.

ds: The last acolyte of a blood-mad god lays his curse upon his fellow travelers in a caravan crossing the plains. Death and ruin follow, but can the survivors find hope in a ruined keep? This is a zero-level adventure designed to teach the system to new players.
sd: The Funnel Experience is designed to launch you into the world of old-school gaming thrills! Can you survive the wrath of the Owl god? A full game introduction to epic adventure!

ds: This labyrinthine crypt is filled with terrible traps, strange and ferocious monsters, rich and magical treasures, and somewhere within rests the evil Demi-Lich. He's about to have his worst day ever... because Toons have discovered his Tomb. Expect wacky traps, cursed items, hijinks, chaos, and a lot of silly cartoon violence.
sd: The true horror is what the Toons will do to this poor dungeon! A Toon spin on the classic old-school module.

ds: Cocaine Owlbear is an (adult), lighthearted RPG about With your newfound intelligence, you plunder the belongings of the courier you killed. You find that he or she had a complicated heist plan written on parchment and hidden in their satchel bag. But it’s not just any heist. It is a complicated heist that involves stealing more of the enchanted cocaine that has granted you sentience and made you really jittery.
sd: You're a woodland creature who has recently gained sentience when you ingested magical cocaine from the satchel of an unlucky traveler in your forest.

ds: Within the world sphere of Skyhelm, flying ships journey through the vast open skies of the Blue, from the glorious heights of the Seven Skyholds to the savage depths of the Gloom. You will take on the role of a beginning hero hoping to make a name for yourself in this fantasy setting of floating islands & high adventure. 1st level characters will be provided.
sd: You are hired to help retrieve an abandoned skyship floating above Triton's Girdle. Will this be easy salvage or will the discovery of a long forgotten horror mark your final voyage through the Blue?

ds: This adventure takes place before the events of the Serenity movie and all of the 9 major characters (Mal, Zoe, Wash, Jayne, Kaylee, Inara, River, Simon, Book) will be playable.
sd: The crew of Serenity are hired to "rescue" an ape from Cherub's Cosmic Circus. Gawk & guffaw as goslings are juggled & shock sticks generously applied.

ds: This adventure takes place in the wild frontier of the Verge in the Stardrive campaign setting. The player character choices will consist of the five main alien species (Weren, Fraal, Mechalus, Sesheyen, T'sa) and a mutant human.
sd: You were facing life imprisonment on an isolated moon in the Verge, but the Concord is offering you a second chance with a dangerous covert mission. And they don't care whether you live or die.

ds:
You were just passing through, but now the horses are gone, the general store is a pile of toothpicks, and the ground is vibrating in a way that suggests you’ve moved from "tourist" to "entree."
 
 This isn’t your standard dungeon crawl. Forget the dark hallways; you’re trapped on a tin roof in the blistering sun. Forget the goblins; you’re up against prehistoric creatures that hunt by sound. If you walk on the sand, you’re a snack. If you scream, you’re a target. If you have a plan involving homemade pipe bombs and a pogo stick? Well, now you’re talking.
 
 Pre made characters will be provided for this loving homage to the American cinema classic "Tremors". It will be RULES LIGHT and built for both brand new and experienced players. All that is required is to have a sense of humor, quick thinking, and a daggum plan!
sd: Welcome to Adequate Canyon, a desert outpost where the rent is cheap and the neighbors are... thirty feet long, subterranean, and exceptionally hungry.

ds: On a raw world of violent volcanoes and bubbling tar pits, tribal warlords fight for supremacy. Roaming herds of colossal dinosaurs are stalked by pack-hunting predators across wind-blasted plains. After a catastrophic time jump, the party awakens in a crashed ship. Their only hope of getting home lies with a group of stegosaurian refugees who need help repairing their time machine. But the kentrosaurus-riding barbarian, Baird is hellbent on claiming it for himself. Time is running out in this one-shot adventure from A Time Traveler's Guide to Dinosaur Hunting. Perfect for fans of the Jurassic Park franchise, video games like ARK and Turok, and Lovecraftian sci-fi like Event Horizon. 5th-level characters will be provided. Learn more at: https://dinosaurs.splatteredink.com
sd: In a land of tribal warlords and savage beasts, the party must face pack-hunting dinosaurs and a kentrosaurus-riding barbarian. Fangs and tusks come calling in this fast-paced, cinematic adventure!

t: In the Jungle, No One Cares if You Scream
ds:
The Carbonide facility is a slaughterhouse with hidden dangers around every corner. The deeper you go into the ancient ruins beneath, the worse it gets. Crystalline mutations. Eggs ready to hatch. One survivor remains, hiding in the walls, traumatized and wounded. The data you need to escape is down there, surrounded by dozens of predators that have turned this place into their killing ground.
 This is a one-shot adventure from A Time Traveler's Guide to Dinosaur Hunting. It's Aliens meets Jurassic Park, perfect for fans of ARK, Turok, and Lovecraftian sci-fi like Event Horizon. Face colossal dinosaurs, mutated monsters, and alien horrors in an adventure collection featuring the largest dinosaur and prehistoric monster bestiary ever released for 5e! 5th-level characters will be provided. Learn more at: https://dinosaurs.splatteredink.com
sd: Lock 'N' Load! Delve the bowels of an abandoned mining facility and face roaming packs of mutated austroraptors that hunt like tacticians. Can you survive this fast-paced, cinematic adventure?

ds:
In the shadow of the Gorgwin Mountains, the village of Cloven Rock depends on the Ironspire Mine for its survival. But the mine has gone silent. An ancient ice lizard—one of the oldest the north has ever seen—has made it her lair, sealing it and trapping miners inside. The village is desperate. Workers are starving in the darkness, if they haven't already become something worse. A goblin named Trin discovered something deep in the mine, but in doing so, has disturbed the souls of every creature that ever died in those tunnels.
 The party must navigate frozen passages, survive undead, rescue trapped workers, confront the ice lizard, and more in this standalone one-shot adventure set in the Seeds of Decay world. Perfect for fans of The Dark Crystal, The NeverEnding Story, and Lord of the Rings. 5th-level characters will be provided. Learn more at: https://seedsofdecay.com
sd: Undead horrors patrol frozen halls of the Ironspire Mine. An ancient ice lizard guards deep where ambition has awakened that should have stayed buried. Brave the cold in this Seeds of Decay quest!

ds:
For thirty years, Bishonia's magical walls have protected its citizens, allowing only those of pure intent to pass. But this protection comes at a price: the city is effectively imprisoned by its own defenses.
 Those walls have never been breached... until tonight. When a desperate father carrying a special child seeks sanctuary, the players must make a choice that will test the city's defenses and their own moral resolve. No dice. No mercy. Framework is a diceless RPG where strategy and resource management are the only things between survival and the grave. A fantasy-horror one-shot for: Framework RPG. Learn more at http://framework.splatteredink.com
sd: Unmade corpses stitched into feral horrors, chase a father & child toward the last beacon of hope in the land. He begs entry. Open the gates and risk the city or keep them closed and watch them die?

ds:
Every sailor knows the Singing Rocks. When the tide rushes through, they howl, and at the full moon, something howls back. A wolf made of fog with eyes like molten gold walks on waves and its song makes sailors step off decks without a word.
 But the full moon passed three days ago. The wolf should be gone. It isn't.
 Drowned sailors drag themselves onto the docks, barnacle-crusted and silent. They search for that which was taken. An iron-forged doom that should have stayed at the bottom of the sea. Find what was stolen before the next full moon, or the whole town walks into the waves and never comes back. No dice. No mercy. Framework is a diceless RPG where strategy and resource management are the only things between survival and the grave. The howling won't stop in this nautical, pirate one-shot for: Framework RPG. Learn more at http://framework.splatteredink.com
sd: Where the tide-walker hunts, ships dare not sail. Now it’s come ashore. A mist-born horror with eyes of molten gold. Return an iron-forged doom before the next full moon drowns everyone in madness!

ds:
Everyone's on the Lattice. It's modern life. Better jobs, faster reflexes, access to everything. Being synced is normal. Being analog is for outcasts and the left behind.
 NeuroSync 7.0 hijacks consciousness, jumping from body to body. If you kill the host, it instantly possesses the next synced person. Your ally, your friend, or a stranger, anyone could be next. As the only analog humans left, you must protect Professor Kennedy and cut the signal before there is no one left to save.
 Tonight, there is no resistance. Just a handful of strangers who happened to be offline and a choice: go analog or die synced. Tomorrow the resistance begins.
 No dice. No mercy. Framework is a diceless RPG where strategy and resource management are the only things between survival and the grave. Trust no one in this cyberpunk one-shot for: Framework RPG. Learn more at http://framework.splatteredink.com
sd: 2078. NeuroSync 7 went live. Minds started snapping. Everyone synced is compromised by a virus that hijacks thoughts. You can only trust those who were analog when it hit. Cut Node Zero or die trying.

ds: In this event, players both old and new will visit a town plagued by mysterious evil forces. This campaign is aimed at kids approximately 11-14 years old.
sd: In this event, players both old and new will visit a town plagued by mysterious evil forces. This campaign is aimed at kids approximately 11-14 years old.

ds: You are a member of the Gallop: seasoned monster-hunters that ordinary townsfolk would best keep away from. However, when missing sheep escalate into a torn apart villager, it becomes clear that those townsfolk are way out of their league. With a provided investigation journal brimming with notes on local 'fauna,' and an assortment of weapons and potions ready to slay them, saving this town is another grueling day on the job for you. You may bring a 7th level character made using the 2024 character rules, but pregens will also be provided. Dice and pencils provided if needed. Magic items will be provided during the game.
sd: A monster-focused murder mystery for level 7 characters. Interrogate witnesses, consult your monster-hunter guide, and avenge death in a not-so-sleepy town.

sd: Seek and destroy! That's your mission, even as you're training a newly bonded skydrake. Can you find the enemy base of operations, and deal with them once and for all?

ds: The sport of dungeon crawling comes to live TV. Now it's going international with the first competition to measure athletic, global prowess.
sd: This is a Play with the Author event! Whether it's combat surfing, ostrich jousting, or deadly water ballet with hippos, these varied events will put the Xcrawlers to the test as they go for the gold.

ds: This is a Play with the Author event! Dungeon Judge Klaus von Klaus takes the team on a trip through the empire's history.
sd: It's gladiatorial arena combat on live TV! The XCrawlers will have to defend a giant keg from the Beer-serker and defend themselves from cannons that shoot live goblins.

ds:
This is a Play with the Author event! 
 
 Play in an alternate reality Earth where dungeon crawling is a live, televised blood sport. For over two thousand years, gladiatorial combat has thrilled viewers around the globe. Much has changed in later times, with the merging of technology and magic, but in some places, a sense of tradition in this sport remains strong. One such place is the city where it all began - the Eternal City - Rome.
sd: It's gladiatorial arena combat on live TV. Your team is fighting in Anfiteatro Vittoria in Rome. The hazards will be greater than you've faced before, but so also will be the glory.

ds: From a dire wolf dogsled race in Alaska to defending a Florida sand castle from sea monsters, Xcrawlers will partake in deadly challenges themed to various locales, bringing glory to the Empire!
sd: This is a Play with the Author event! In honor of the NAE's 250th birthday, the empire is organizing a series of events across the country.

ds: Indianapolis's own superhero team finds themselves on the front line when science goes awry. Comic Crawl Classics is a super-hero adaptation of DCC.
sd: This is a Play with the Author event! Nightmare Engineers Restoring the Dominance of Science (N.E.R.D.S.) is a secretive guild trying to create a ruling class of geniuses to govern the world.

ds: A wealthy Roman merchant family has reported the theft of magically sensitive supplies. You must find them before they are used for sinister purposes. Time is of the essence!
sd: You are members of the imperial special forces group, Manus Legis in this exciting 3rd level adventure. This is a Play with the Author event!

ds: I'll be in touch with the parents of the players before the event, offering to make a pregen character out of one of their own toys. Parents are welcome to attend and spectate.
sd: Kids get to play as their favorite plush toys! Come dive into this world where plush heroes go on an adventure to help one of their fuzzy friends. This is a Play with the Author event!

ds: Can you infiltrate the construct workshop and thwart this threat of emotionless killing golems, or will you become its first victims?
sd: A Roman special forces team discovers a plan to invade the empire with an army of magical constructs. A level 4 adventure. This is a Play with the Author event!

ds: Since the time of the Elders, the local tribes have shunned the crawling glacier and whatever secrets lie beneath the Ghost Ice. But, now the ice has shattered, revealing its secrets; strange machines and wonderful horrors entombed below.
sd: A Level 1 adventure in the Frozen North. Forget about the frigid temperatures, can you survive the unknown from a forgotten time!

ds: Horrible champions of the Unseelie Court come by shadow to slaughter the people of Eng. Mighty adventurers are needed to cross into the Faerie and overcome the machinations of the merciless Queen for good.
sd: A Level 1 adventure in the capitol of fae country. The power of Elfland has returned, seeping across the borders into the mortal world.

ds: A 0-level funnel adventure.
sd: Tales of emptied graves and disappearances in the night have reached your small village. The clues have led you to a forgotten jungle temple where an ancient hunger has awoken to feast on the living.

gm: Kristina Moseley, Alice Crawford, Beth Allen
ds: Fifty years ago, magic was torn from the world in a single moment—leaving spells to rot on the tongues of witches and power to fade into myth. Then, ten years ago, it came back wrong. Magic returned without mercy or pattern. Humans woke to fire in their veins, lifelong magic users were left hollow, their gifts stripped away. Witch hunters rose again, wearing old symbols with new authority, hunting the newly gifted in the name of “balance.” Those who lost everything - turned feral and desperate, killing humans to steal the magic they believe was stolen from them first. Now power is a crime and no one knows whether magic is a blessing, a punishment, or a test the world is failing. The most powerful leaders of each faction have called a summit to see what can be done to reset the balance in our world. Costumes welcome but not required.
sd: 50 years ago magic was erased, 10 years ago it came back but wrong. Leaders of the different factions, humans, witches, demons etc, have called a summit to create a plan forward. Who will prevail?

t: The Shattered Sanctum of the Moontide Queen
ds:
Deep beneath the waves, the Moontide Queen has waited centuries for what was stolen from her. Now her crown sits locked in a monastery vault, and her curse twists everything it touches. Monks transform into creatures of the deep, hallways shift like the tide, and the sea itself hungers for revenge.
 Your party must navigate this warped sanctuary, uncovering the truth behind the theft while the monastery collapses around you. Will you return the crown and honor an ancient wrong? Destroy it and break the curse forever? Or find a third path that requires cleverness, courage, and sacrifice?
 This adventure showcases Daggerheart's unique Hope and Fear mechanics, where your choices directly influence the story's direction. Expect dynamic combat with environmental hazards, meaningful roleplay moments, and a climactic decision with no single right answer.
sd: A stolen crown has cursed a coastal monastery. Navigate shifting halls, confront transformed monks, and decide the fate of an ancient queen's wrath. Your choices shape the story in this complete

sd: When strange disappearances and unknown forces are at work, the people still call upon heroes for help. Play a virtuous kung fu hero as the fictional world of wuxia meets Cthulhu.

ds: The invitation has gone out for wannabe superstars from all over the Empire! This is a chance for ordinary folk to rise above their origins and grab some of the glory and the gold for themselves! Can you survive this mountain playground full of beer-drinking Yetis, angry post-cryptids, ice grommits, and more? The answers are hidden on the mountain, and only the brave stand a chance!
sd: Come one, come all! DJ Hard Knoxx has a Crawl that'll put you on the map - if you survive! Test your mettle and climb the mountain!

lo: Stadium Field : Fight in the Skies HQ
ds: Daggerheart is a ground-breaking narrative-heavy RPG, with a unique combat system where every roll matters, and the line between hope and fear is perilously thin. This adventure takes place in the "Four Queens, Aces High" campaign frame, which is currently under third-party development for potential future release. It centers around the daring exploits of sky pilots using magitech engines and flying beasts to fight the tyranny of warring fae nobles who have broken the world with their arrogance and pettiness. It adds a bit of moderate complexity in the form of aerial dogfighting rules, where exact movement and location is less important than strategy and adaptation to swiftly-changing situations.
sd: Welcome to world war fae, flying aces! In this mission, you must pull a heist, and fight your way out... in the skies!

This is a Play with the Author event! 
 
 sci-fi time-travel RPG where humanity survives in Subterra D.C., a vast underground city beneath the ruins of Washington. The fractured organization Tempus sends agents into the past while its rival factions clash over whether history should be changed or protected.
 
 Your mission leads to ancient Egypt at the Great Pyramid’s completion, amid festivals, dark omens, and the whispered Hand of God prophecy. Tasked with uncovering the truth, the party must navigate Tempus intrigue, hostile time operatives, and warring ancient powers. Infiltrating the pyramid through guarded gates and secret passages, they face deadly traps, undead pharaohs, divine trials, and reality-shaping rituals. At the center lie Pharaoh Khufu’s ascension plan, the fate of Queen Sobekneferu, and a choice that could reshape history—and open the universe itself.
sd: It's 2177 CE. The world is broken - but there's hope. Tempus, a high-tech group beneath Washington, D.C., recruits you for time travel missions to rewrite history and save humanity.

ds: A level 3 adventure on a quest to meet with the famous archmage Arcadianus Bring back any information on the archmage and his reasearch to the temple of Vosmera, the Goddess of the Sea and Travel, the same temple who Arcandianus has dedicated his tower to. You have been hired by priestess Wyriana, the local head of the church of Vosmera, to investigate the reason that Arcandianus has not been replying to any of her messages in the past few weeks, a very uncommon thing from him. This leads you to the sea tower, a wizard tower that has been carved into one of the 7 pillars that have served as monuments to Vosmara for centuries. Once there you will navigate deadly traps, solve intricate puzzles, and battle with fierce protectors in the hope of finding out the secret to the disappearance of Arcadianus and in the process gain wealth and fame.
sd: Based on the adventure Pillars of Pelagia. Venture into the sea tower created by a powerful archmage to uncover the secrets he has been researching in seclusion.

ds: A simple stopover in San Antonio becomes a life or death struggle. Welcome to the Weird West!
sd: A simple stopover in San Antonio becomes a life or death struggle. Welcome to the Weird West!

ds: Welcome to Innoviware Labs. Global leader in artificial intelligence based automation systems. You are a Managed Automation Maintenance Specialist. In reality, you and your team act as first responders to automation failure events. Recently, these events have become more frequent and severe. Something doesn’t seem quite right. On top of your normal case load of failure events, figuring out what changed may keep more than just your employment from being terminated.
sd: You work for an AI automation company and your team acts as first responders to automation failure events. Something has changed in the job recently and you should probably figure out what.

ds:
You and your estranged siblings finally accepted your father's dark legacy: the only inheritance he left you. In doing so, you destroyed the mysterious altar under Thorne Manor, temporarily preventing That Which Lives Below from entering our reality.
 Now, however, you discover the Thorne Mining Company, led by the enigmatic Silas Barrow, has aggressively claimed the Blackwood family's ancestral land. They even drilled directly on your property before suddenly vanishing. Driven by the fierce desire to reclaim your inheritance, the estranged family must again grudgingly put aside their feuds to unravel a corporate mystery that conceals a terrifying occult truth.
 And worse, That Which Lives Below is now pushing to be released, not from the earth, but through one of your own siblings.
sd: After destroying the altar to protect your family, you must now face the terrifying possibility that The Essence Within is pushing to be released through the betrayal of one of your own siblings.

ds: This is a Play with the Author event! A horror 0-level funnel adventure.
sd: You are invited to Ives Manor for a will reading - what can go wrong? Note that this is not your standard funnel, only 2 PCs per player and the game heavily focuses on puzzles and deduction.

ds: When a decades-old journal and a brittle map are recovered from a wrecked ship in the North Sea, the Society is called to investigate the ill-fated Gresham Expedition of 1832. Your journey will take you through the treacherous "Ghost Belt" and onto the shores of De Solskydas Skärgård, a prehistoric sanctuary where ancient Vaesen have become the apex predators and the air hums with the frequency of a twisted amber relic. The players must navigate a world where 19th-century logic crashes against the raw, untamed power of the De Solskydas Skärgård.
sd: When a decades-old journal and a brittle map are recovered from a wrecked ship in the North Sea, the Society is called to investigate the ill-fated Gresham Expedition of 1832.

t: Indiana Jones and No Time For Love
ds: If adventure has a name, it must be Indiana Jones. It is 1937 and the storm clouds of war are brewing in Europe. Travel to exotic locales in the pursuit of priceless artifacts, some rumored to have strange powers. Rules will be taught. You will not have to play the characters from the films. Instead, the attribute blocks will be available for drafting (and Indiana Jones's block will not be available). The game is played with five six-sided dice. Pencils will be needed and available.

ds:
This is a Play with the Author event!
 
 Victors will receive the accolades of their kith and kin, while those that fall will be devoured by the ferocious predators that stalk the fell wastes! Each racing team is composed of two members: the charioteer and the war-master, tasked with defending the skiff. Together they will race five other teams across the desolate plateau, evading the wreckage of a thousand-year war, rogue war bands, and the machinations of rival teams. Only one team will survive to ascend the podium! Join the creator for the latest of the Purple Planet adventures! Each player controls two PCs and their chariot. All Hail the Champions!
sd: Race your gleaming skiff for the glory of your House and the undying Overlord of the Purple Planet! Only one champion will live to carry the day, celebrated as the new master of the Purple Planet!

ds: Social media posts and internet advertisements shouldn't be linked to real supernatural events, but isn't it just your luck that is exactly what is currently happening to you and your team. Out of the town of Shady Brooks Kentucky a string of disappearances has been linked to a strange advertisement and presence that seems to be reaching out to the populous at large to come and try a new kind of challenge; staying the night at a haunted house in the murky woods on the outskirts of town to win $50,000 per participant! But something seems hauntingly real surrounding the disappearances in the area. Enjoy finding out in a game using the Monster of the Week rules playset.
sd: How does a haunted mansion advertise itself online? You and your team will find out as they head into the backwoods of Kentucky to look into the disappearances plaguing the town of Shady Brooks.

ds: Overcome the restless spirits of the deceased, surviving legacies of failed experiments, and the Ectoplasmic Cotillion—an everlasting dance macabre that threatens the very souls of the living. Will you be able to find the artifact of eternal life and escape the perils that threaten to keep it?
sd: Rumors of a ring that can overcome death itself spur the adventurers into entering the subterranean lair of long-dead magicians.

ds: The Emperor's daughter has been kidnapped, and it falls to you and your unusual band of heroes to rescue her from the villainous northern Ursine tribe. Do you have what it takes?
sd: The Emperor's daughter has been kidnapped, and it falls to you and your unusual band of heroes to rescue her from the villainous northern Ursine tribe. Do you have what it takes?

ds: Rumors spread of the strange disappearance of magicians and the reappearance of a magical palace thought long destroyed. Upon venturing within the palace, the adventurers discover that everything is not as it seems.
sd: Travel to the lands north of the Falling Wall to a mysterious place where time itself has fractured!

ds: The great city of Tara is gripped by fear. Many dangers have appeared around the capital and so thus; the assessors guild has been reinstated. Hidden dungeons, dilapidated towers, perfectly square hallways, all are against code and liable to draw monsters! Search the city as ex-adventurers and find what has gone wrong in the city of kings. Gamestyle- light mechanics, more for fun and creativity. You will pick from a set of lowish level characters with some backstory for your inspiration, and be invited to add to the scenario you’ll be playing through. Main prompt: What kind of room or thing could someone build or have that would be perfect for a monster or some kind of magical mishap?
sd: The city of Tara is violating safe building code. You as adventurers turned Assessors must sniff out these problems and keep the public safe! Welcome to fantasy OSHA, find the true dangers of fantasy.

sd: The city of Tara is violating safe building code. You as adventurers turned Assessors must sniff out these problems and keep the public safe! Welcome to fantasy OSHA, find the true dangers of fantasy.

t: Chateau in the Crimson Fen: an intro to Draw Steel
ds: As a member of Morkoth’s Revenants you are used to weird or dangerous situations. Rarely do you have to deal with something dangerous and weird. Your captain knows that two of your fellows have been trapped under a country estate, but he has also mentioned that you need to go during a huge party there? You’ve got some time to prepare, create your own entrance, and find the tools you need; but how will you manage when you enter this crimson parade? Gameplay info: The goal is to introduce you to as amany of the mechanics of Draw Steel as possible, except for character creation and leveling. Time and fun are a factor, so it is likely that not everything will make it into the version you actually get to play. but we’ll try.
sd: 2 of your number are missing, they're trapped in an old manse. Complications: there's a party going on and you're not invited. Take your time, strategize, find your entrance, enjoy the party?

ds: Verannar is the great orbital stronghold of the elven Xaryxis Empire in your home sphere. While not popular with the local worlds, the Imperial Navy does protect against threats from the Far Realm, or at least they do when they are not under eldritch influences. 12th level characters provided.
sd: Your spelljammer crew returned to your regular home port just as a strange eclipse passed. Now familiar faces are acting in a sinister manner, and you're beginning to wonder if you can escape alive.

ds: Appearing seemingly from nowhere, it crashed through three ships before hurtling deeper into the system. It was almost impossibly large, and of no known configuration. Is it a prize to be won, or a force of destruction to be stopped. 12th level characters provided.
sd: An eldritch derelict space hulk from the Far Realms is drifting toward a populated world. Your spelljammer crew is sailing to investigate whether this ship is a treasure trove or existential threat.

ds: The city of Eversink is a bustling, cosmopolitan, and prosperous metropolis where intrigue, mystery, and danger are around every corner. Commerce is sacred (not a metaphor), and the city is slowly, inexorably sinking into the river delta. Slinkers are freelance investigators and problem solvers, and your team are good enough to handle any problem, but also desperate enough to take any job.
sd: You are freelance problems solvers and investigators known as slinkers. Rival guilds have hired your group to look into an old noble's house about to disappear beneath the water line.

The urgent email you got overnight was full of initials and buzzwords, and that is never a good thing, especially when it means a team meeting first thing in the morning.
sd: When a field team fails to meet standard practices, Quality Assurance sends your team to facilitate corrective and preventative action. Hopefully the Anomaly cooperates.

t: Arcane Knights - The Master Is Dead: To Begin With
ds: In a world where creatures of the night prowl and gloom creeps into the corners of life and mind, the normal human is prey. For there are other worlds that impinge on our light and safety. It is only by the will and fight of a few brave, worthy souls that 'normal' is an option at all. The modern protectors exist in both places, with car keys, flashlights and cell phones in one hand when those work, but with swords and wands in the other for the times and places they do not. These people fight the long battle, while finding, educating and training their own replacements, for who else will if they do not? These modern knights are needed most in the broken edges of the landscape, where the cell towers don't reach, where cops shouldn't go, only steel and aspen and knowledge of the weird can prevail. Modern day in a world of capes, battling the mystical threats. Today, the Master is dead.
sd: Magic fades as tech grows, but some wylde intrudes, you have to stop it. Few can use magic, you must find and train each replacement. Now the Master is dead. Cellphone one hand, magic from the other.

lo: Stadium Field : Fight in the Skies HQ
ds: This game is a playthrough of the Eat the Reich RPG, with a couple of small customizations. The rules are light and easily taught. The characters are vampires, recruited by the allies in a world war that never was, coffin-dropped into occupied Paris for one final mission. Come prepared to roll plenty of D6s and narrate just how assume your character looks while mowing down boatloads of Nazis action movie style.
sd: Listen up maggot farms, this is our final mission! Infiltrate Paris end World War II, by killing the worst man in the world! DRINK ALL HIS BLOOD!

t: Demon Hunters: A Comedy of Terrors
ds: Using the Fate Accelerated system of play, the DHRPG is a fast and funny RPG experience you don't want to miss. In a world where everything and anything is real (Demons, the Tooth Fairy, Sentient Manbuns - you name it, we've defeated it), the Brotherhood of the Celestial Torch fights for truth, justice, and their next coffee break.
sd: You & your misfit crew of Demon Hunters must save the world from the forces of Evil. Yeah, we're screwed...

t: Demon Hunters: A Comedy of Terrors  - Premium Play with ZOE Cast
ds:
Come and join us for this special one-off event! Nearly 30 years ago the original horror-comedy film "Demon Hunters (1999)" introduced the world to what would eventually become Dead Gentlemen Productions and Zombie Orpheus Entertainment - this is your chance to be a part of that history. You'll get 4 hours of RPG play led by ZOE's own James "GM Jams" Durham with fan favorites Christian Doyle and - making his Gen Con debut - Steve Payne (Wolf from Demon Hunters and "The one who gets his pants stolen" from the original The Gamers).
 
 Using the Fate Accelerated system of play, the DHRPG is a fast and funny RPG experience you don't want to miss. In a world where everything and anything is real (Demons, the Tooth Fairy, Sentient Manbuns - you name it, we've defeated it), the Brotherhood of the Celestial Torch fights for truth, justice, and their next coffee break.
sd: You & your misfit crew of Demon Hunters must save the world from the forces of Evil. But this time, you get to bring along some of the cast from the movies. Yeah, we're screwed...

ds: It’s been six months since the villagers of Cahli last saw the wizard, Tizun Thane. Shortly after, the Night Things appeared, coming up from the south – the same direction as the magic-user’s grand halls, rumored to be filled with wondrous treasure. This old school adventure will include pre-generated, level 3 characters featuring some classes from Swords & Wizardry’s Book of Options, like the Barbarian, the Demon Hunter, and the Necromancer, alongside the classic classes of original D&D.
sd: The classic White Dwarf adventure by Albie Fiore, exploring the halls of a magic-user whose recent disappearance precedes nightly visits from dark creatures who now haunt a local village.

t: The Curious Conundrum of the Conflagrated Condottiero
ds: Germany, 1630. Five mercenaries went off to war, only four returned. Now something is burning the survivors to death. The PCs are sent to the town of Schwarzfuss, home to the targeted soldiers and recently experiencing an outbreak of dysentery. There, they can attempt to find what stalks these soldiers, decide whether to help protect those that remain, or follow up on rumors of a treasure brought back from the war. This Kelvin Green adventure will include pre-generated, level 4 characters.
sd: Investigate the strange death of a mercenary soldier in 17th century Germany and discover what stalks his remaining comrades from beyond.

t: Knights of the Dragon #14 "Across the Inner Sea"
ds:
"Calvaria’s army is depleted from repelling the invasion; King Josef Calvarion I requires reinforcements. The Knights are dispatched to cross the Inner Sea and recruit mercenaries from the Caliphate of El-Azatlan. You will need to bring an existing 4th-6th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 4th-level character built using our online character creation rules.
 Emphasis: diplomacy, combat, ocean navigation"
sd:
"Calvaria’s army requires reinforcements; the Knights are dispatched to recruit and escort them to the kingdom from across the Inner Sea. 
 For KotD PCs levels 4-6. "

ds:
"The City of Calvaria is poisoned, and the heroes must find the source & the cure. You will need to bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 1st-level character built using our online character creation rules. 
 Emphasis: investigation."
sd: The City of Calvaria is poisoned, and the heroes must find the source & the cure. For KotD PCs levels 1-3.

t: Knights of the Dragon #27 “Tournoi de Sang: Faveur Retourne”
ds:
"""Tournament of Blood. A Favor Returned."" Count Massimo Silvano of Le Royaume des Morts has called in his favor. He needs new champions in the once-every-500 years Tournament of Blood to compete for Prizes, Honor, Glory, and their lives. 5th of the Stronghold modules. You will need to bring an existing 8th-10th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 8th-level character built using our online character creation rules. 
 Emphasis: combat, diplomacy"
sd: A favor is called in, & the Knights are substituted into a grueling tournament to compete. For KotD PCs levels 8-10.

t: Knights of the Dragon #3 “Orcs in the Mines”
ds: "King Tarvan Silveraxe of Karaz-a-tan Undermountain has requested the Kingdom of Calvaria's assistance in evicting an invading swarm of orcs, goblins, and kobolds from his realm. You will need to bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 1st-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: trapfinding, combat."
sd: "The Dwarven allies of King Josef Calvarion I need help repelling an invasion. For KotD PCs levels 1-3."

t: Knights of the Dragon #28 “The Return of the Cudgel”
ds:
"It has been several years since Cardinal Dalin's passing. After visiting his gravesite to pay respects, the Knights discover that the tomb has been disturbed and Dalin's Cudgel is missing. It's a chase to find the thief who would dare defile the grave and safely return the Cudgel to the proper resting place. You will need to bring an existing 8th-10th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 8th-level character built using our online character creation rules. 
 Emphasis: investigation, combat, trapfinding"
sd:
Cardinal Dalin's grave has been disturbed & Dalin's Cudgel is missing. It's a chase to return the Cudgel to the proper resting place. 
 For KotD PCs levels 8-10.

t: Knights of the Dragon #4 “The Changing of Colors"
ds:
"Bandits are disrupting trade with the Seven Dales on the main trade route from Calvaria to the East; the Knights are sent to remedy the situation by any means necessary. You will need to bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 1st-level character built using our online character creation rules. 
 Emphasis: combat."
sd: Bandits attack the new trade route from Calvaria to the East; the Knights are dispatched in force to eliminate the problem. For KotD PCs levels 1-3.

t: Knights of the Dragon #5 “The Stars Align"
ds:
"Nemesis has taunted the king; portents and legends: what do they mean? An ancient shall rise, does it bring terror or joy? 1st of the Acid modules. You will need to bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 1st-level character built using our online character creation rules. 
 Emphasis: investigation, research."
sd:
Old legends come true, as an ancient returns to the realm. 
 For KotD PCs levels 1-3.

t: Knights of the Dragon #43 “Showdown at the Stronghold part 1: Silenced Citizens”
ds: "King Rolland of Minilous has requested the Knights’ aid in locating missing workers. When they arrive at the capital, things have gotten far worse. What was originally a few missing work parties has become hundreds of citizens. How can so many citizens have disappeared so quickly? 8th of the Stronghold modules. You will need to bring an existing 13th-15th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 14th-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: Investigation, Diplomacy, Combat "
sd: The Knights return to Minilous to locate missing citizens. First dozens, now hundreds! For KotD PCs levels 13-15.

t: Knights of the Dragon #6 "The Lair of the Liche"
ds: "Cardinal Dalin has destroyed the physical body of a Liche whose minions have been terrorizing the countryside. The Knights must recover its phylactery for destruction before it creates a new host body. Time is of the essence; if it revives before they complete their quest, they will be the newest additions to its array of undead minions. You will need to bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 1st-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: puzzle solving, trapfinding, combat."
sd: Cardinal Dalin has disrupted a Liche, now the Knights must find its phylactery before it revives. For KotD PCs levels 1-3.

ds: King Josef Calvarion I dedicates the new Hope Bridge across the river Knox, heralding increased trade and cooperation with the surrounding realms. Tragedy strikes and the kingdom needs new heroes. You will need to make a new character, or bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character. Not playable for PCs that have previously played in KotD #1.1. Emphasis: campaign introduction, character creation.
sd:
King Josef Calvarion I opens the new Hope Bridge across the river Knox; when the realm faces a crisis & needs new heroes. 
 For KotD PCs levels 1-3.

t: Knights of the Dragon #44 “Showdown at the Stronghold part 2: Metal Mayhem"
ds: The Crimson Blades of Minilous are hard-pressed to hold back a rampaging opponent. The Knights will need to join their allies in the thick of battle, as well as determine the origin of this sudden assault. 9th of the Stronghold modules. You will need to bring an existing 13th-15th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 14th-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: Combat
sd: A massive host assaults the Kingdom of Minilous. Help the Crimson Blades turn the tide! For KotD PCs levels 13-15.

ds: Bartering, jousting, spell casting, what more could a tired hero want? Intrigue, of course! Enjoy the Vernal Equinox festival. You will need to bring an existing 2nd-4th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 2nd-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: player-driven.
sd:
The Vernal Equinox festival: everything a tired could hero want. 
 For KotD PCs levels 2-4.

t: Knights of the Dragon “Annual High Summer Festival – Richfest”
ds: This is the annual GenCon KotD special event. In addition to a diverse choice of directives presented to them by King Josef Calvarion I, our Knights will have opportunities to undertake advanced training, equipment procurement, and admission to some of the more esoteric professions. All players MUST have a pre-existing KotD character of ANY level that has played in a minimum of one module prior to this event.
sd: After choosing a mission from their King, Knights will have opportunities to retrain feats and classes, commission magical equipment, and enter prestige classes. For KotD PCs of any level.

t: Knights of the Dragon #3 “Orcs in the Mines”
ds: "King Tarvan Silveraxe of Karaz-a-tan Undermountain has requested the Kingdom of Calvaria's assistance in evicting an invading swarm of orcs, goblins, and kobolds from his realm. You will need to bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 1st-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: trapfinding, combat."
sd: "The Dwarven allies of King Josef Calvarion I need help repelling an invasion. For KotD PCs levels 1-3."

t: Knights of the Dragon #16 “The Rescue part 1: Strange Bedfellows”
ds:
"The rogue Kingdom of Minilous has allied itself with Nemesis. A refugee has come to Calvaria begging assistance, the Knights are dispatched to liberate the enslaved populace. 1st of the Stronghold modules. You will need to bring an existing 5th-7th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 5th-level character built using our online character creation rules. 
 Emphasis: combat, diplomacy. "
sd: "An emissary from a rogue Kingdom comes to Calvaria seeking assistance against Nemesis. Gain an ally, depose a prince? Part 1 of 2. For KotD PCs levels 5-7. "

t: Knights of the Dragon #17 “The Rescue part 2: Revenge of the Blades”
ds: "Nemesis has sprung his trap, can the Knights liberate Minilous? Can any of the locals be trusted? Has Nemesis finally captured the Knights of the Dragon? 2nd of the Stronghold modules. You will need to bring an existing 5th-7th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 5th-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: combat, diplomacy, investigation.
sd:
"Now that the trap is sprung, can the Knights win the allegiance of the rogue kingdom? Or is Nemesis’ grip inescapable? Part 2 of 2. 
 For KotD PCs levels 5-7. "

t: Knights of the Dragon #54 "The Sky City"
ds:
"The desert Caliphate of El-Azatlan has long been a staunch ally of Calvaria, but a series of disturbing events has cast a shadow over the city of Akhetaten. From the mysterious disappearance of a prominent official to a sudden, violent bout of madness from a local merchant, the ""Sky City"" is a powder keg waiting to ignite. King Josef Calvarion has dispatched the Knights to assist the local Inquisitors in restoring order and uncovering the truth behind these disturbances. In a city built on ancient traditions and strict laws, the party must tread carefully; in Akhetaten, the sun reveals much, but the shadows hide even more.
 You will need to bring an existing 17th-19th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 17th-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: Diplomacy, Investigation"
sd: The Knights are dispatched to assist the local inquisitors in the the city of Akhetaten in the nation of El-Azatlan. Paft 1 of 2. For KotD PCs levels 17-19.

t: Knights of the Dragon #55 "The Dark Lady"
ds:
"The investigation into the reaching shadows of El-Azatlan takes a harrowing turn as the Knights are drawn deeper into a web of ancient secrets and betrayal. With the stability of the region hanging in the balance, the party must venture where the light of Ra cannot reach. Mettle will be tested and steel will be drawn as the Knights of the Dragon face their most enigmatic foe yet. The desert hides many secrets, but some are better left buried.
 You will need to bring an existing 17th-19th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 17th-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: Combat, Trap finding"
sd: The Knights continue their investigation in the Caliphate of El-Azatlan. Part 2 of 2. For KotD PCs levels 17-19.

t: Knights of the Dragon #56 "Staff of Legend Part 1: Her be Dongeouns"
ds: "Acid is a looming threat for the whole of the world, but particularly for Calvaria. Diligent research has been conducted for any way to stop him. Finally after years, Xynn has revealed that his latest apprentice has found information about a staff of legend in the archives. Prior to the events of Dragon's Bluff in the ancient past, Acid saw this as a threat. Too powerful to be completely destroyed, it was broken into pieces and scattered across the world. It is necessary to gather the pieces soon, as the energy from the upcoming true eclipse of the red moon is required to restore the staff. Retrieval will be quite the undertaking. 6th of the Acid modules. You will need to bring an existing 17th-19th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 17th-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: Trap finding, Combat, Puzzle Solving"
sd: The Knights scour the entire planet to recover the fragments of an artifact to thwart the terror known as "Acid". Part 1 of 2. For KotD PCs levels 17-19.

t: Knights of the Dragon #57 "Staff of Legend Part 2: Power Overwhelming"
ds:
"The quest has been undertaken to escort Xynn's assistant to recover the pieces of the staff of legend. Two tasks remain. The first is facing the last dungeon and gathering the final piece of the staff. The second is locating the pylons that will channel the moonlight and recombine the pieces. Danger lurks as agents of Nemesis have learned of the quest. Can you face the many dangers and come out with the completed staff unscathed. 7th of the Acid modules. 
 You will need to bring an existing 17th-19th level KotD character, use a pre-generated character, or bring a 17th-level character built using our online character creation rules. Emphasis: Combat, Trap finding, Exploration"
sd: The Knights rush to reassemble the artifact during the lunar eclipse. Part 2 of 2. For KotD PCs levels 17-19.

And what about the civilians caught in the middle? The choice is yours. Welcome to the world of MajiTeck.
