t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 1: The Gnome
ds: Russia, 1874, and famous artist and architect Victor Hartmann has died very suddenly. To commemorate his life, an exhibition of his works is being displayed in St. Petersburg. While viewing the gallery, a painting of a spindly legged gnome starts to move, thrusting a group of Patrons into a new world of magic and mythology, with Baba Yaga hot on their heels. For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A leisurely walk through an art exhibition becomes a desperate race to escape another world.

ds: "Won't you take that ride on heavy metal?" Plunge into the far out worlds of Heavy Metal. Become Taarna, Den, Barbarella and Harry Canyon, to name a few. Seek out the source of the Loc-Nar and end its evil for all time. Adventure across space and time, battle the forces of Uhluhtc as you soar the skies of Neverwhere. With all the feel of a midnight movie we dive into the pages of the magazine. This adventure is not for the timid. Rated R for Violence, Horror, Sexual Situations and Humor.
sd: Plunge into the far out worlds of Heavy Metal magazine. Seek out the source of the Loc-Nar and ends its evil for all time. Den, Tarrna, and many more. Not for the timid, Rated R. Wanna take a ride?

t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 2: The Old Castle
ds: The Hartmann exhibition continues with the display of a painting of an old European castle and troubadour. When the troubadour’s music begins to play, the Patrons find themselves in the Italian countryside. There they must contend with the castle’s dark history, and its connection to Baba Yaga. For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A European castle with a troubadour in the foreground. Paintings aren’t supposed to have audible music, though.

t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 3: Tuileries
ds: Hartmann’s painting of the Tuileries garden in Paris shows a tableau of children playing a game in an idyllic field. As the Patrons of the exhibition view the painting, they hear the laughter of the children and find themselves standing in the sunshine. However, when Baba Yaga is involved, nothing is ever as it seems. For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A charming scene of children playing in a city park. If you listen hard, you can hear the children laughing as they play.

t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 4: Bydlo
ds: Baba Yaga continues to haunt the Patrons, barring them from the safety of their own world. Fortunately, a nearby village contains an unlikely ally. Getting to the village may be a challenge, however, as the sun begins to set. A passing Bull and Cart may be nice enough to help! For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A painting of a bull pulling a cart. Wait, a painting of a wagon shouldn’t have moving wheels, should it?

t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 5: Ballad of the Unhatched Chicks/Samuel and Schmuyle
ds: Somebody is responsible for Baba Yaga’s cruelty, but who? Perhaps a trip to Hell can shed light on her madness. But first, the Patrons have to bring down the house as they find themselves in the very costumes they had been examining as the curtain begins to rise. For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A blueprint sketch of an egg costume for a ballet. The eggs hatching on the sketch look so real!

t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 6: Limoges, the Market
ds: With the manipulator behind Baba Yaga's corruption revealed, the Patrons must find the materials to reverse her madness, before Baba Yaga or Koschei can find them. The first few reagents of the spell are found in a particular market, and it just so happens Hartmann painted a tableau of a particular market. For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A French market square. You can almost hear the vendors hawking their wares.

t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 7: Catacombs/With the Dead
ds: The Patrons descend into the Catacombs of another painting in pursuit of the second reagent, pursued by Koschei's minions. While there they find themselves being guided through the labyrinthine caverns by a familiar figure. It seems there was more to Victor Hartmann than appeared back home in Russia. For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A painting of the Catacombs below the streets of Paris, with Hartmann himself holding the lantern. The painting is so well done, the lantern looks as if it's really glowing.

t: Pictures at an Exhibition, Level 8: Hut on Fowl’s Legs/The Bogatyr Gate
ds: The conclusion of the Patrons’ painting hopping adventure to foil the schemes of Baba Yaga and Koschei the Deathless! The final component of the spell to reverse Baba Yaga's insanity will be the most dangerous to obtain: her own Flying Mortar, which is kept on her Hut. The Patrons must race both the Hut and the clock to find the Mortar and undo Koschei's curse before the Hut bears them to its Mistress…and their doom. For fans of: Classical Music, European history, Slavic Mythology
sd: A sketch of a clock, shaped like a very familiar hut. And that clock is definitely ticking.

ds: New players are welcome and we will spend a short time go over the rules. Pregen characters will be available or create your character with the free rules from our website.
sd: Test yourself in the harsh arenas of Fujira. Face monsters from far flung planes for fame and riches. How much will you risk in the arena?

t: New America, New Frontiers, New Terror
gm: Jake Ivey, Michael Hart, Stephen Ford
ds: The West is a dream. It is a place for families, pioneers, and lost souls to find themselves in the promises of a new American frontier. It is a long journey, slow and dangerous along the wagon trails to this land of plenty on the Pacific. But all of this pain and suffering will be worth it, as long as you and the other wagons stick together, you will overcome any obstacle. That storm on the horizon, however, means you cannot tarry here. Pioneers, O pioneers, do you hear the brunt of danger? Can you make it through the next pass? Or will the terrors of this haunted land consume you all?
sd: A wagon train makes its way West, with pioneers seeking the hope of a new frontier. You cannot tarry here and terror can be found behind every mountain pass.

ds: Our group of MPD detectives return for another episode of Miami ‘80s action. After a mysterious death at Fire Station No. 1 in Downtown Miami, the police are baffled at how one of Miami’s finest could fall victim to such a terrible crime in the shadow of Freedom Tower. Plunge into a world of big hair, cocaine, and rad mythos mysteries all set to the soundtrack of the 1980s! A Call of Cthulhu adventure of 1980s horror and another episode of the wildly successful 80s police drama from Gen Con 2024 and 2025.
sd: A group of Miami PD detectives plunge into a world of big hair, cocaine, and rad mythos mysteries all set to the soundtrack of the 1980s.

ds: King Josef Calvarion I dedicates the new Hope Bridge across the river Knox, heralding increased trade and cooperation with the surrounding realms. Tragedy strikes and the kingdom needs new heroes. You will need to make a new character, or bring an existing 1st-3rd level KotD character. Not playable for PCs that have previously played in KotD #1.1. Emphasis: campaign introduction, character creation.
sd:
King Josef Calvarion I opens the new Hope Bridge across the river Knox; when the realm faces a crisis & needs new heroes. 
 For KotD PCs levels 1-3.

t: Boogie-Woogie Bugles in America’s Black Mecca
ds: It’s 1925 and Charlie Johnson's Paradise Orchestra has just begun a set at the grand opening of Small’s Paradise nightclub in Harlem. A renaissance of music, poetry, and art is in full swing in this Black Mecca of America. But there is something strange in the air on 133rd Street. News of missing dancers and staff across Jungle Alley has everyone on edge. But obviously it’s baloney! Especially when the juice is flowing, and the jelly is plentiful in the greatest city in the world!
sd: Jazz Age action in 1920s Harlem as Charlie Johnson's Paradise Orchestra must survive the night during the grand opening of Small’s Paradise nightclub.

ds: Super science has run amok at Krimtech. All manner of experimentation is underway, hidden from the government's prying eyes deep underground. Like many great discoveries before, Dr. Krim has accidentally stumbled onto a super serum that grants those who drink it amazing psychic powers while making himself a more potent energy drink that's easier on his gut. Drunk on serum, their minds expanded, the bats realize they're powerful enough to break free from their captivity! Our heroes must pull a psychic bat prison escape and navigate the super science laboratory, of Krimtech. Dodge & parry gun toting body guards and robot defense droids on their way to freedom in the outside world!
sd: Several tiny bats, dosed up on super serum, must use their newfound psychic powers to escape their cage, slip past security, and free themselves from the lab of Dr. Krim!

ds: Planets owned whole cloth by space corpos are at constant war with each other. To keep from obliterating the land and resources they're so hungry to claim, many corpos are excited to unleash giant alien monsters on their enemies! Our heroes, an overpowered cyborg mercenary outfit, are tasked with capturing an alien for this very purpose. They'll need to hunt them in the tall grass, weaken them, then shrink and bottle them for delivery to OaCorp. If our heroes can pull this off they'll be set for a long, luxurious vacation!
sd: In a grimdark space faring future, cyborg mercenaries take on a career defining job to hunt down and capture alien monsters for the Federation, lurking in the tall grass of Mars Two!

ds: On an Earth overwhelmed by alien real-estate ventures and wasteful space tourists, the last of humanity scrapes by on cruise ships casually sailing the seven seas. The waters are clogged with alien garbage and bizarre sea monsters grown to large for the casino aquariums came from. Skullduggery is rampant on the open seas. Crews of humans and aliens alike raid the cruise ships at every opportunity. Each cruise has their own strategy for fending off the horrors of the open sea. Our ship, the Sailor's Boon, has a rather unique ace in the hole, the Boon Patrol! Using alien technology dredged from the sea, mild mannered crewmates transform into multi-chromatic super heroes to defend the cruise ship from danger!
sd: Earth's land has been conquered by aliens! Sailing oceans overrun by pirates and sea monsters, the passengers of the Sailor's Boon sleep easy thanks to their local heroes the Boon Patrol!

ds: You’ll play Imperial agents dispatched to a remote moon where vital adamantium mines have fallen silent. Sabotage, heresy, or something far worse lurks in the depths. Investigate the threat, survive the mines, and secure the Emperor’s interests. Pregenerated characters are provided, and all rules are taught at the table—no experience necessary.
sd: Dispatched on a dangerous mission, you’ll investigate mysterious trouble deep within adamantium mines on a distant moon.

t: The Beverly Killbillies: Raiders of the Black Ark
ds: Now members of a super-secret, worldwide organization, the members of The Beverly Killbillies Extermination Service find themselves high in the forbidden Himalayas, perhaps to uncover the long-hidden origin of all cryptids on Earth! But first they must face the granddaddy of all cryptids: the abominable snowman. Roleplaying, redneckery, and hillbilly accents stressed in this final episode of the Killbillies story!

ds:
Your lord is dead. Slain not in battle, but betrayed in silence. Poisoned at a banquet by the Daimyō who once called him brother.
 Now his killers sit behind lacquered walls, protected by hired blades and political silence. No court will hear your case. No allies will march at your side. The world has already moved on.
 
 But you have your blades. You have each other. And as Ronin, you have nothing left to lose.

t: Indiana Jones and No Time For Love
ds: If adventure has a name, it must be Indiana Jones. It is 1937 and the storm clouds of war are brewing in Europe. Travel to exotic locales in the pursuit of priceless artifacts, some rumored to have strange powers. Rules will be taught. You will not have to play the characters from the films. The game is played with two ten-sided dice. Pencils will be needed and available.
sd: It is 1937 and the storm clouds of war are brewing in Europe. Travel to exotic locales in the pursuit of priceless artifacts, some rumored to have strange powers. Fedora optional.

ds: You're an adult stuck in Fairyland, a pastel-drenched hellscape where toys whisper secrets, tea parties never end, and the fae want to peel you apart, one memory at a time. Rumor says there’s a way out of Fairyland hidden at the heart of the Queen’s abandoned Labyrinth. You must plunge into its twisting passages, outwit cruel fae tricks, and survive nightmarish creatures. Solve the maze, face what waits at its center, and maybe, just maybe, you'll finally escape Fairyland.
sd: You're an adult stuck in Fairyland. Rumor says there’s a way out of Fairyland hidden at the heart of the Queen’s abandoned Labyrinth. If you solve the maze, maybe, you'll finally escape Fairyland.

ds: You have been in online group counseling for the last year with others like you, teens who swear to see things, hear things no one else can. Impossible things. But now you're ready to move on, to start college. But first, your therapist wants to meet in person and tie up any loose ends and make sure you’re ready for college. She has booked a long weekend at Martic Manor, an old, peaceful Manor house in Massachusetts.
sd: A therapeutic retreat at a manor house in Massachusetts turns into a nightmare you need to solve if you're going to survive.

ds: For nearly a century, a pattern of violence has haunted one sorority at Syracuse University. Every twenty-five years, the past resurfaces, leaving bodies in its wake. When a close friend is found dead just days before the anniversary of the first murders, the truth refuses to stay buried. A final message points to secrets hidden beneath the campus and a history that may not be finished yet.

The clothes may finish spinning but the connection remains.

ds:
High above the blackened coast, the ancient lighthouse of Gloamspire burns once more. Its light guides no ships, yet something stirs within its walls. Once a powerful beacon to hold the darkness at bay, but what has come of it since the fall of magic?
 
 Players must climb the haunted lighthouse, confront drowned spirits and warped guardians, and decide the fate of the flame. Will you extinguish it and plunge the coast into night, or claim its power and draw the gaze of the Fell?
sd: High above the blackened coast, the ancient lighthouse of Gloamspire burns once more. Its light guides no ships, yet something stirs within its walls.

ds:
A PbtA game about knightly quests and coming of age, inspired by Arthurian legends, fairy tales, Tamora Pierce's Tortall books, and Magic: The Gathering's plane of Eldraine. The game is in-development from Cloven Pine Games. It uses modular playbooks where each character is created by combining two playbooks that form two halves of a heraldic shield, e.g. The Stag and The Anvil, or The Fox and The Oak.
 
 In this scenario, the Knight-Aspirants are called upon to ensure all goes well with a wedding meant to unite two formerly feuding families. As you discover dark secrets and fend off the restless dead, will you still want the wedding to go forward?
sd: You are aspiring knights, venturing into the wild reaches of the realm on a quest to prove yourselves worthy. What wrongs will you right and lessons will you learn along the way?

ds: A 5th-level adventure. The Orb of Night is stolen by Three-Fingers; if not recovered, it will herald a war no one has seen in over seven hundred winters. A war of sorcerers, magic, violence, terror, and death. He has fled to the Trade town of Agot. Can you stop him and retrieve the Orb before the Wild Tide on the horizon engulfs you and everyone in madness and flames?
sd: Can you stop the thief, Three-Fingers, in time & retrieve the Orb of Night?

ds: An 8th-level adventure. Agot is in shambles after the brutal attack from the Wilders. Now, an unknown entity is using the chaos to move criminal organizations and people who want power to control the Trade Town. Can you find out who or stop what may even destroy the Order of the Sacred Fist before it is too late?
sd: A new threat has emerged a week later after the brutal attack on the Trade Town of Agot. One that may even be a menace to the Order of the Sacred Fist.

t: Real House Spouses of Bravo Bay
ds:
You’re a cast member on a reality TV show about the “real lives” of spouses and partners of the powerful in Bravo Bay—a glossy city built on influence, ambition, and image. After a weak season, ratings are down and cancellation rumors are everywhere.
 
 Producers are pushing harder: deeper conversations, old conflicts revisited, and bigger moments to pull viewers back in. Some cast members want bold drama, others want honesty and growth, and a few are just trying to protect what they’ve built if the show ends.
 
 Play a fun, chaotic game of Daggerheart where your alignment is shady and you have to walk the line of playing a team where sabotage is king.
sd: You’re on a reality show about the “real lives” of spouses of the powerful in Bravo Bay. After a weak season, cancellation rumors swirl, what do you do to save the show?

ds:
Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils rides again in a blaze of magipunk mayhem! A dying frontier town hides an ancient relic humming with forbidden power—and every monster with ambition can smell it. Cinder, a fire-blooded dragon, wants it to rule the wastes. Lord Ashcroft, a silver-tongued tyrant, plans to crack it open and ascend as an archfiend. And your band of reckless kobolds? You’re here to steal it first.
 
 Roam dusty streets, spin rumors into leverage, duel rival gangs, rig contraptions, and cut deals that will absolutely backfire. Side with dragonfire or deviltry… or play them both. The cards drive the chaos, the story bends to your choices, and the clock is ticking. In Dust & Devils, loyalty is optional, explosions are inevitable, and tiny scaly legends are born in smoke and fire.
sd: Chaotic kobolds race a dragon and a devil-bound tyrant to steal an ancient relic. Cut deals, spark mayhem, and betray everyone before the town burns to ash.

t: Loan Foreclosure - Knowing is Half the Battle
ds: Your target is in the vicinity of Al Shirqat. Oddly, there have been a lot of snake like motifs and symbols in the area. Intelligence suggests a high powered production facility is there, perhaps manufacturing chemical weapons. Weird?!?!
sd: It is 1988. The war between Iraq and Iran has drug on for five long years. Your special team is being sent in to help stop the conflict or at least de-escalate.

ds: This is a continuation of last year's Planet of the Apes sessions. Our intrepid APPEs were given a large amount of money by the authorities for keeping quiet about what happened last year. They invested the money into a paranormal investigation agency. Who you gonna call?
sd: Ghosts and slimes have invaded Ape City. Your Ghostbuster team stands between Ape-vilization and chaos. Who you gonna call?

ds: The Underdwellers have caused psychic manifestations in Ape City. Your team needs to stop them from disrupting Ape-vilization.

ds: This is a parent-kid event where the players (accompanied by a parent) take on the roles of magical kitties who will solve a series of challenges to keep their kids safe.

ds: 1st-4th level adventure. Morgan Rechis has found the missing codex of the Aphotic. Except things don’t go as one might hope. Others have learned of his impressive discovery and seek to benefit from what the codex can provide. When Rechis returns to his home in Somnolence, the codex thrums to life after centuries of dormancy. In doing so, it calls forth something evil. The tiny village is about to face an invasion from something that is beyond their comprehension. Can a group of adventurers who just happen to be in Somnolence when the mists of fate roll in stand between the Aphotic and their ability to plunge the very nation into war?
sd: In the sleepy village of Somnolence, evil begins to awaken. After excavating an ancient battle site, Manceologist Morgan Rechis has made the discovery of a lifetime.

gm: Celeste Tenchavez, Andrea Santoyo, Deidra King, Erika Martin, Anastasia Benavides, Melissa Keck, Jasmine Diaz, Briana Lam, Cameron Felt
ds:
Calling all lady knights, wizard women, and femme fighters! Join us for a one-shot game where every table is led by experienced DMs running bespoke adventures written by the talented women of our community. Expect scenarios that are fun, interactive, and women-centered, highlighting all the best parts of the game with moments for roleplaying, combat, and skill encounters. 
 
 Never picked up a d20 before? We've got a learn to play module just for you! We'll walk you through everything you need to know, so all you have to bring is your sense of adventure.
sd: Come play with the Ladies of D&D San Diego! All games are written and run by the members of LDDSD, a volunteer-led nerdy girl community group.

gm: Ron Gores, Francisco Rodriguez, Eli Ninnemann, Bryan Clark, Stefan Perich, Heather O'Malley
ds: This is it. The time has come. Decades of maneuverings out of sight of the great wyrm. Lifetimes of research and plotting and planning. Hundreds of lives lost in the pursuit of knowledge that will hopefully provide the edge needed to defeat the most magnificent of evils. This is it. The day we move on the Beast of Caerbannog. Rot Gut the Decaying. The Tempest of Thybaj. Smrt. This is it. The final push. We must move quickly, for the beast is sure to know we are coming. There is no time to rest. No time to delay. This is it. This is the day To Hunt a Dragon. This is a multi-table event. Level 20 pre-gens will be provided.
sd: You've learned its weakness. You've discovered its location. You've divined its true name. You've recovered an ancient weapon to level the battle in your favor, you hope. It is time To Hunt A Dragon!

ds: Ankh-Morpork! A shining city by a river! Well, not so much shining as moistly glistening due to the amount of sweat its populace can exude on a typical summer day. Sweat that still smells better than the river that is the city's namesake. But one place in this fair city is still cool (for various values of "cool") - the hallowed halls of Unseen University, which educates the best wizards on Disc World, if they do say so themselves. There's just a little problem that the professors can't figure out that they'd like the City Watch to take a look at. That shouldn't be a problem for The Versy Special Unit, should it?
sd: Congratulations - you've survived your first month with the Ankh-Morpork Watch, The Very Special Unit. But can you face what lurks underneath Unseen University (besides one very angry librarian)?

ds: You are a torchbearer: judge and jury of the chosen people of the guiding light. Strangers in a strange land, the health, wealth, purity, and the sanity of the people depend on the Torchbearers’ good judgment in times of crises. Your decisions will guide the fate of your people, for good or ill, and your decisions are final. A D&D (2024) fantasy interpretation of frontier community and justice, inspired by Dogs in the Vineyard. Focus on relationships, story and hard moral decisions. RP stressed.
sd: You are judge and jury of the chosen people, who depend on your good judgment in times of crises. Justice and community on a frontier.

ds: A 3rd-level Dungeon Crawl game of survival. Ludrik and Tudrik Alanssen are natives of the trade town of Agot. They are known as hard laborers, but not too bright. When they return after a recent excavation, screaming that the walls "ate their excavation team", most people believe they were just scammed by the excavators for free labor. But still, the bulletin has gone up, and someone should look into it, just in case.
sd: Laborers from a recent excavation near the Trade Town of Agot screamed that the walls "ate their excavation team." Do you have what it takes to find out what actually happened?

ds: Pisgah University is a remote haven of thought, prosperity and promise. Tucked into the Appalchian wilderness, Pisgah has roots dating back to the first European settlers. Its alumni include many CEOs, Nobel prize winners, world leaders, and tech giants. Generous grants offer students from modest means a small taste of privilege, and in return they owe service to the university. Something sinister is rising, and a small, diverse group will find themselves channeling ancient powers to shape the university’s future. This is a game of secrets, opinions, and choice with a supernatural metaphor not a game of supernatural special abilities. This is a story of class and privilege and the price of ambition and of conscience. A social interaction game with a taste of politics and a healthy dose of drama.
sd: A supernatural struggle breaks down a university’s social barriers, if only briefly. A story focusing on social interactions, politics and a healthy dose of drama.

ds: 1st-4th level adventure. Morgan Rechis has found the missing codex of the Aphotic. Except things don’t go as one might hope. Others have learned of his impressive discovery and seek to benefit from what the codex can provide. When Rechis returns to his home in Somnolence, the codex thrums to life after centuries of dormancy. In doing so, it calls forth something evil. The tiny village is about to face an invasion from something that is beyond their comprehension. Can a group of adventurers who just happen to be in Somnolence when the mists of fate roll in stand between the Aphotic and their ability to plunge the very nation into war?
sd: In the sleepy village of Somnolence, evil begins to awaken. After excavating an ancient battle site, Manceologist Morgan Rechis has made the discovery of a lifetime.

t: The Case of the Missing McGuffin
s: Terry Pratchett's Discworld: Adventures in Ankh-Morpork
ds:
"A heinous crime - a theft which the Thieves’ Guild did not sanction. During an evening of adequate entertainment at the home of Lord and Lady Manner, an original piece by the renowned artist McGuffin was stolen. The Patrician is keen to resolve this quickly, so it’s off to Manner Manor and pull back the curtain on the perpetrators so they can face the judgement of the Watch, or the justice-adjacent punishment that the Thieves’ Guild reserves for unapproved theft.
 A Whodunit in the Big Wahoonie, complete with the parlor room reveal. Discworld itself operates like a story, and players are going to have to contend with it if they want to forge their own story in a world bursting at the seams with stories. Players will use their character and dice to see if they have what it takes to beat the narrative into the shape they want. Be careful, however - sometimes it beats back.
sd: A heinous crime, theft which the Thieves’ Guild did not sanction - that of an original piece by renowned artist McGuffin. A Whodunit at Manner Manor in the Big Wahoonie, with the parlor room reveal.

s: Terry Pratchett's Discworld: Adventures in Ankh-Morpork
ds:
"Tired of the endless one-upmanship of many of their members, those in power at the Assassins’ Guild have arranged for a ‘team-building’ exercise upon a ship known as The Morporkian Muddler. The exercise is to spend the day on board, eat, drink, talk - and plot the theoretical murder of the ship’s captain. Upon arrival back, the assassin with the best theoretical plot wins a theoretical prize. What could go wrong?
 Ankh-Morpork is set In a distant and secondhand set of dimensions, in an astral plane that was never meant to fly. Discworld itself operates like a story, and players are going to have to contend with it if they want to forge their own story in a world bursting at the seams with stories. Players will use their character and dice to see if they have what it takes to beat the narrative into the shape they want. Be careful, however - sometimes it beats back. Rules taught!"
sd: Assassins’ Guild elders arrange a team-building exercise. While aboard ship, you plot a theoretical murder of the captain. One with the best plot wins a theoretical prize. What could go wrong?

s: Terry Pratchett's Discworld: Adventures in Ankh-Morpork
ds:
"The wizards of Unseen University are very concerned by a recent spate of minor magical inconveniences. Things have been exploding, people have turned slightly purple, bells have started speaking, and nobody knows why. Their concern is that the incidents appear to be caused by somebody other than UU wizards - which of course is against the natural order of things. Being practical, rather than investigate this for themselves, the wizards are outsourcing - to you. Discworld itself operates like a story, and players are going to have to contend with it if they want to forge their own story in a world bursting at the seams with stories. Players will use their characters, dice, and bad puns to see if they have what it takes to beat the narrative into the shape they want. Be careful, however - sometimes it beats back. 
 Rules taught!"
sd: Wizards of Unseen University are concerned by a spate of magical incidents. People are turning slightly purple, and bells are speaking. They are outsourcing the investigation to you.

t: \Are You There, Bel-Shamharoth? It's Me, Cultist #44
s: Terry Pratchett's Discworld: Adventures in Ankh-Morpork
ds:
"Since Bel-Shamharoth was banished to the deeper chthonic planes, worshippers of the Soul-Eater practicing in the sewers beneath Sator Square have found themselves searching for meaning in the absence of their abominable master. The cult leader has decided to truly gain dominion requires removing potential obstacles for amassing power in the future. Other cultists have decided they’d rather be devoured by a Nameless Things than do community outreach; you as the last members standing and on the hook for everything that is planned.
 Discworld itself operates like a story, and players are going to have to contend with it if they want to forge their own story in a world bursting at the seams with stories. Players will use their character and dice to see if they have what it takes to beat the narrative into the shape they want. Be careful, however - sometimes it beats back. Rules taught!"
sd: Most worshippers of the Soul-Eater decided they’d rather be devoured by Nameless Things than do community outreach. You’re the last members left and on the hook for the cult leader’s plans.

ds:
Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils rides again in a blaze of magipunk mayhem! A dying frontier town hides an ancient relic humming with forbidden power—and every monster with ambition can smell it. Cinder, a fire-blooded dragon, wants it to rule the wastes. Lord Ashcroft, a silver-tongued tyrant, plans to crack it open and ascend as an archfiend. And your band of reckless kobolds? You’re here to steal it first.
 
 Roam dusty streets, spin rumors into leverage, duel rival gangs, rig contraptions, and cut deals that will absolutely backfire. Side with dragonfire or deviltry… or play them both. The cards drive the chaos, the story bends to your choices, and the clock is ticking. In Dust & Devils, loyalty is optional, explosions are inevitable, and tiny scaly legends are born in smoke and fire.
sd: Chaotic kobolds race a dragon and a devil-bound tyrant to steal an ancient relic. Cut deals, spark mayhem, and betray everyone before the town burns to ash.

ds: This event is an introductory adventure for Daggerheart. In it, the party will travel deep into the tropical jungle of Cuijara to find out what is keeping a much-anticipated group of tamed riding raptors from being delivered. These raptors can navigate the jungle terrain with ease, but that doesn't matter much until you can find out what's taking so darn long! sd: Join the Battle Royale game show produced by the media conglomerate U-VIEW!

ds: Anomalous solar radiation has triggered a momentary glitch in electronic devices across the glowing metropolis. Extract the Phantom Brain hacker before the coming Solar Storm. Infiltrate the Operations center in ashes!
sd: Extract the Phantom Brain hacker before the coming Solar Storm!

ds: Rising seas pushed Venice to the brink, forcing drastic intervention. The Aqua Alta Conglomerate built MOSE 2.0, a massive and controversial dam born from a failed project. For years, MOSE 2.0 has held back the sea, allowing billions of tourists to flood the city safely. Now someone plans to destroy it, risking catastrophe and countless lives!
sd: Rising seas pushed Venice to the brink! Will you destroy the dam or save it?!

ds: Under another name, it ran Project 71 in the Phlegrean Fields, evacuating residents and violently reshaping the land for the mega-rich. That project reactivated Vesuvius and wiped Torre del Greco off the map! Now every Neapolitan is born indebted to Partenopower and will be forced to serve the corporation sooner or later…
sd: Partenopower began as a reclamation company, long before Naples understood the scale of its power. Rise up!

ds: Privileges of Diamond Membership in the X Syndicate, include protection from the other top-notch criminals using The Hotel Crescent. The RUNNERS have received the notification that a Parallax Sanitation has been ordered: a window of 60 minutes where anyone can attempt to claim the bounty before the Crescent staff are allowed full salvage rights! Inspired by John Wick, Smokin’ Aces, and The Raid.
sd: Up until 60 seconds from now, VIP Kenji Sanderson has enjoyed the privileges of Diamond Membership in the X Syndicate. Inspired by John Wick

ds: What are their plans for the dreaded OMEGA Program? Delve the depths of Akuma’s digital mindscape. And discover the truth!
sd: ENTER THE MIND OF AKUMA. The legendary Runner has been captured and imprisoned by the sinister ALPHA Corp.

ds: W0ND3R experience. The tribes gather under neon bass and mass waste. A hundred thousand dancing in the hot sweat of anonymity. A place to escape. Or run a job…!
sd: W0ND3R experience. The tribes gather under neon bass and mass waste. A hundred thousand dancing in the hot sweat of anonymity. A place to escape. Or run a job…!

ds: Anonymously jack into a dangerous digital network known as the Grid. Inside the Scape, users manipulate real-world tech, battle viruses and virtuals, and break into encrypted zones to steal protected data. The longer they stay connected, the more they fail, the weaker their grip on reality becomes, risking permanent loss in the code. Even with VPN protection, the network watches everything, and once anonymity breaks, the Scape turns lethal…!
sd: Inside the Scape, manipulate real-world tech, battle viruses and virtuals, and break into encrypted zones to steal protected data!

t: Dungeons & Deadlines - Part 2: Teamwork Makes the Screams Work
ds:
Q3 was a success—against all odds, the Dungeon hit its numbers. Now Corporate wants more. The Dungeon has been flagged for a merger under a new Synergy Initiative, and integration is already underway.
 
 Immediately, things begin to break. Reports disappear. Systems conflict. Someone inside the Dungeon doesn’t want this merger—and they’re willing to do anything to stop it.
 
 This one-shot blends investigation, roleplay, dark humor, and tactical combat in a corporate-fantasy dungeon setting. Success or Failure of the merger relies upon you and your choices—and how well you handle synergy under pressure!
 
 Attendees will receive: 
 - Dungeons & Deadlines T-Shirt
 - Custom Character Mini
 - Commorative Employee ID
 - Custom Character Sheet
sd: Join a corporate-fantasy RPG where monsters have jobs, dungeons run on KPIs, and adventuring is a workplace hazard. Solve problems, hit metrics, and survive office politics.

ds: The Eternal Ruins are a vast and endless collection of corridors, chasms, towers, and gardens; they are explored by Wanderers, stone statues hatched to life as children, now seeking solace and hope in the bright places of the ruins, safe from the despair that the darker, more hostile corners may hold. Inspired by ICO, Zelda, and Hollowknight! Based on the Wild Words engine.
sd: Behind the thick tangle of fruiting trees and twisting vines lie ancient ruins. Carnivorous plants, spirits, and more inhabit this land as the ruins are alive here, with spore, shadow, and hope.

ds:
At a top-secret black site in the Atlantic,corporate scientists have developed a world-altering PROTOTYPE: a self-replicating nanobot capable of bonding to any form of organic matter and imbuing it with intelligence.
 Guess what? You're going to steal it.
 This /RUN takes place within the Trident Majesty, a luxury deep-sea aqualiner on its way to view the sunken corpse of the Titanic.

t: Shorefall: Trygg Hafn, Into the Future
ds:
This is a continuation of the Shorefall setting, a setting created by people just like you. Join the story. Low spell magic but high fantasy, play the early years of great heroes defining this new age of cultural growth. Strive to support a new city. You will search a hostile environment and find riches, not for gold and silver but for iron and land suitable for farming.
 
 This is a game focusing on the role play of the characters as they take on a hostile environment under heroic conditions. Recently revived after Ragnarök, Baldur needs heroes to secure the region and find resources to make his city beautiful.
sd: Adventurers come of age in the new city of Trygg Hafn, a town dedicated to Baldur. Offspring of Scandinavians explore the world in hopes of finding beauty. Rules tweaked for a more heroic CE 921 feel.

t: Institute of Logistics and Licensing: Orientation Day
ds: Characters can be provided, but feel free to ‘make up’ a backstory for your own normal 18-year-old who has just graduated high school. At the event, a random power will be given, and the character will end up being sent to the Institute of Logistics and Licensing, an academy for people of unusual power located in Kansas. Knowledge of the rules is not needed and will be taught. If you like using your own dice, feel free to bring 3d6, but plenty will be available. I plan to run the second installment of the setting following this session. Players are welcome to join that session if they enjoy the first one.
sd: The emergence of powers has caused the government to come up with a way to rein things in. Join the problem kids, err, young adults at the new school. Why would they place the school in Kansas?

ds:
When a small group of families built a community on the banks of the Blackbrook River, they made a deal with the legendary Blackbrook beast … but that was ages ago and, as the town grew and thrived, they forgot about that promise. Every few generations, the beast gathers the strength to rise and exact its revenge on those who betrayed it and corrupted its home. Every time, the successors of those founding families have bound the beast back to the river. At least, every time so far.
 
 Now a new generation has begun to dream of the Blackbrook beast—haunted dreams that draw them to the Blackbrook River, where the beast is more powerful than it’s ever been.
sd: Descendants of a town's founding families must perform a ritual to bind the Blackbrook beast, a creature their ancestors made a bargain with - and betrayed.

Every time, the successors of those founding families have bound the beast back to the river. At least, every time so far.
 
 Now a new generation has begun to dream of the Blackbrook beast—haunted dreams that draw them to the Blackbrook River, where the beast is more powerful than it’s ever been.
sd: Descendants of a town's founding families must perform a ritual to bind the Blackbrook beast, a creature their ancestors made a bargain with - and betrayed.

s: For the Good of the Hive
ds:
The hive is in danger! A strange disease has stricken your fellow bees, and you are tasked with finding the cure. Play this new game by acting as a group of Super Sisters, bees with a strong genetic bond, as you work with other players' bees for the good of the hive. This game is designed to get you to think as a bee, not an individual, so be prepared to explore role-playing games with a new buzz.
 
 This game takes inspiration from titles such as Bunnies & Burrows where players interact with the world as naturalistic versions of animals. In this case, honey bees! Bee lives are complex, and life is cheap. In this game you will see what it is like to put your collective first, and do whatever it takes to make sure that your Queen and your sisters survive. Even if it means your own life. Can you successfully cure the disease that has been spreading in the hive, or will you all perish?
sd: A strange disease has stricken your fellow bees and you are tasked with finding the cure. Play as groups of Super Sisters, bees with a strong genetic bond, for the good of the hive.

s: For the Good of the Hive
ds:
The bees of Hive Willowbottom are no stranger to wasps and hornets, but this season something is different. Larger bugs with a thicker, seemingly impenetrable, carapace have begun are in area. Neighboring Hive Coneflower has recently gone silent and all the buzz is that these new interlopers are responsible. What will you do to ensure your hive can survive if these giants attack?
 
 This game takes inspiration from titles like Bunnies & Burrows, where players interact with the world as naturalistic versions of animals. In this case, honey bees! Bee lives are complex, and life is cheap. In this game you will put your collective first, and do whatever it takes to make sure that your Queen and your sisters survive. Even if it means your own life. Can you successfully unlock the secrets of the Murder Hornets in time, or will you all perish?
sd: You are used to wasps and hornets, but these bugs are different. They've been terrorizing the neighborhood and your queen is worried your hive is next. How will you deal with this emerging threat?

ds: With the inauguration of Nixon and the beginning of the Khmer Rouge insurgency, agents are tasked with locating a cache of artifacts and tomes owned by a French occultist, Severin Hamon. The agents begin in Sihanoukville and race against the clock to find his and the assets’ whereabouts. Not knowing whether he’s dead or alive, the agents must find him before the political situation spirals out of control or the assets are collected by someone else. Drop out and tune in to horror on the frontiers of the Cold War in the late sixties.
sd: February 1968: Delta Green is dispatched to Cambodia to track down a French occultist’s cache of artifacts. The agents are to secure the assets and eliminate the occultist, with extreme prejudice.

ds: Answering Hon-eel’s call, you head south to build a new life in the land of Tarsh. A wild land, populated by barbarians who revere the god Orlanth. Some of you hope to tame and civilize it, while others seek their own destinies. Rumors persist, though, of some current resistance to this wave of settlement. You set out on the road for Furthest, but as you travel, a storm appears to be on the horizon.
sd: Thousands have answered Hon-eel the Artess’ call to settle Tarsh. As settlers from the Heartlands, will you find a new home or learn all too well why your people call it the Land of War?

ds: Learn the heart of the Through the Breach role-playing game system's character creation and try out your new creation in an introductory adventure! Through the Breach is a role-playing game set in the weird west world of Malifaux. This event will walk players through an in-depth look at the core character creation systems in the Crossroads Tarot. Will you accept what Fate has in store for you or Cheat your way to your own goals?
sd: Flip cards and determine who your Fated is and where their talents lie and jump into a short adventure, showcasing the unique mechanics of the system.

His shattered keep has since become an accursed place of ill omen! What secrets and treasures lie buried in the ruins of this abandoned forest redoubt? 1st Level - Western Reaches Mini Adventures

ds:
Streets echo with footsteps that aren't there. The night air carries the scent of blooming roses... dare you venture into a place where beauty twists into nightmare and every path demands a price?
 
 The Society of Paranormal Investigators (SPI) knows better than to ignore the signs. With people in danger and the supernatural risking exposure, The Society has put out a call to come to the rescue. But they are not the only ones.
 
 Claim your place in the story:
 SPI agent — armed with occult insight, strange powers and curiosity
 Innocent bystander — ordinary life interrupted by the supernatural, clawing for survival in a world that wants to keep you.
 Supernatural interloper — eager to exploit the situation... or desperate to seal the wound...
 
 Mature themes (psychological horror, trauma, identity erosion) with safety tools, content warnings, and debriefs.
sd: People are going missing and strange creatures are appearing on the edge of Indianapolis as rifts are forming in the Hedge. A call has gone out to investigate--and brave the thorns in rescue.

t: Tales of the Valiant: Progeny of Blood
ds: Become a Night Hunter and unravel the mystery that haunts the village of Thrushdale. What you learn will determine the fate of a young boy and blur the lines between monster and man. Will you overcome the darkness, or be consumed by it? This adventure is for 3rd-level Tales of the Valiant characters, and features horror and dark fantasy content. Pre-generated characters will be provided. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: A troubled teenage boy vanishes from an isolated village. When the party investigates, they uncover a web of occult secrets, forbidden magic, vampirism, and a shadow war between two factions.

t: Institute of Logistics and Licensing: Orientation Day
ds: Characters can be provided, but feel free to ‘make up’ a backstory for your own normal 18-year-old who has just graduated high school. At the event, a random power will be given, and the character will end up being sent to the Institute of Logistics and Licensing, an academy for people of unusual power located in Kansas. Knowledge of the rules is not needed and will be taught. If you like using your own dice, feel free to bring 3d6, but plenty will be available. I plan to run the second installment of the setting following this session. Players are welcome to join that session if they enjoy the first one.
sd: The emergence of powers has caused the government to come up with a way to rein things in. Join the problem kids, err, young adults at the new school. Why would they place the school in Kansas?

t: Institute of Logistics and Licensing: Day of 1000 Cuts
ds:
A continuation of the ILL: Orientation Day, no prior experience is needed with the setting, as basic information will be provided in the setting to allow you to spend 4 hours reliving the horrors of being a teenager, but with terribly dangerous powers.
 
 If you want to create a character prior to the convention, feel free to email me! As your characters' exact power will be 'random', stick to thinking about your character's life pre-having the power manifest.
sd: Students survived the Day of 1000 Cuts. Now recovering from wounds earned in your first three weeks of school, the promised "carrot" is here: a weekend away from campus! Is that a string attached?

ds: For new players or long-time fans to enjoy the extreme flexibility and endless possibilities of Rolemaster. Where a player can let their imagination soar because even minute details can make a difference and nearly anything is conceivable. Any character can learn and use any skill, and criticals actually have tactical meaning. The Channel Cities are comprised of five separate cities, each with its own system of government, its own economy, varied social beliefs and morals, and the behind-the-scenes intrigue and espionage that accompanies such a vast and varied fantasy metropolis of more than 570,000 people, within approximately 13 square miles of land in an area of about 23 square miles (the remainder of the area is water). So, whether it is on land or by sea, if you can dream it you can be it or do it in the world of Rolemaster because we have plenty of room to play.
sd: Players choose from lots of pre-gens & from a variety of plot-lines within the World of Ærnth setting, a large medieval metropolitan area ripe with economic, political & social intrigue.

gm: Christina Noel, Kevin Noel, Lisa Purdin, Daniel Zeiger
ds:
The heirs to the Naismith Manor have just tragically died. The sprawling Naismith family has always been full of eccentric geniuses, inventors, and mystics. Which of them will now claim the fantastic rambling house with its twisting corridors, hidden rooms, and decades-old secrets?
 Ages 16+ are welcome.
sd: After a tragic death, a family of eccentric geniuses meet to pay their respects, and to determine who shall inherit the mysterious Naismith Manor.

gm: Christina Noel, Kevin Noel, Lisa Purdin, Daniel Zeiger
ds: Untold aeons ago, the world shattered, leaving behind fragments of reality in a sea of nothingness. Those creatures who are left, draw upon the power of Anima, the essence of being itself, to overcome the forces of Aether, its destroying opposite. It is this Aether, in the form of a continent-sized colossus, that has swallowed the once-great kingdom of Tirtha. The death of humankind’s greatest ruler, King Tarama, has spurred his people to find this terrible beast and free their ancestral home so that it may be part of the world once more. Only once Tirtha is again the realm of humanity can the dead king be laid to rest, and the struggle of existence continue.
sd: The shade of King Tarama cannot rest until he is buried in his ancestral home. The kingdom’s greatest heroes will be needed to brave the void and conquer the colossus that the land itself has become.

ds:
Centuries ago, a massive cataclysm changed every aspect of our world. Join the ranks of the survivors of the fall who battle the constantly changing adversities of the plane.
 Discover structures and relics left behind by the Kitarya Dynasty - the beings that once ruled Harrow and who were ultimately responsible for its fall. Within the ethereal architecture that marks their sites, there are powerful devices waiting to be discovered.
 Be a Blightborn Crysallis Rover who Moves Like a Dune Ghast, an Iceian Human Blightslinger who Blazes With Radiance or aStrong-Willed Hisk Shriker who Howls in the Wastes!
 Choose from a wide selection of descriptors, species, and foci to create your ideal character!
sd: You wake up in a dream weaver's lair, its carcass lying in pieces nearby - next to the precious dream crystal from its head. Fight your way back to your ship and return home with your treasure!

ds:
Explore the dark corners of the docks, while working for a criminal gang -- all while you learn to play "Harrow: The Blighted Plane", a new TTRPG from Underground Oracle Publishing. Harrow is compatible with Monte Cook Game's Cypher System; if you know how to play Cypher, you know how to play Harrow!
 
 Centuries ago, a massive cataclysm changed every aspect of our world. Join the ranks of the survivors of the fall who battle the constantly changing adversities of the plane.
 
 Discover structures and relics left behind by the Kitarya Dynasty—the beings that once ruled Harrow and who caused its fall. There are powerful devices waiting to be discovered in the ruins...
 
 Choose from a wide selection of unique and original descriptors, species, and foci to create your ideal character!
sd: Everyone knows the Wharf Ghasts control the illicit trade at The Docks, but recently a captain isn't paying his "dues". This can't be allowed, so the Ghasts turn to the PCs to make things right.

ds: You must hunt down Finulf One-hand and retrieve Uror's Shears. If you succeed, you save the world and become epic heroes! If you fail, Ragnarok starts early and the world is doomed. No pressure. You'll need all your wits to handle the puzzles and traps of the barrow, and all your battle skills to defeat the cultists bent on kicking off Ragnarok. Will you answer the call? This adventure is for 1st-level 5E 2024 characters. Pre-generated characters using new Northlands subclasses and features will be provided. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: Loki has given you a path to become a hero of legend: retrieve a magical artifact and capture a thief. Sounds simple, right? Nothing's ever simple when the god of mischief is involved.

ds: Throwing a party at the last minute is not easy, especially if it is critical that it go well! You've just received word that Madame Anthemia, the locally famous spiritualist is visiting town, and you need to throw her a welcoming party. What are your plans? How will the spooky bat respond? What could go wrong? Grab your tea and get cozy as we settle in for a 4-hour RiverBank event! Pre-generated characters will be provided. An Adult must accompany all minors. Please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page that is linked within the event for more general information.

t: Tales of the Valiant: Runes of the World Tree
ds: Yggdrasil, the World-Tree. Within its sacred boughs are nestled entire planes of existence, making it a rare fixed-point within the twists and turns of the Labyrinth. Held especially sacred by the people of the Northlands, an unthinkable act of destruction against the World-Tree will send your party on the trail of a brutal mercenary band in search of the Hexrage Axe, crafted from Yggdrasil itself. This adventure is for 3rd-level pre-generated characters using new ToV Player's Guide 2 classes and features. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: Travel the Labyrinth to the farthest reaches of the Northlands, find the Ironsworn company, and resist the fury within the Hexrage Axe or fall victim to its curse. Let the skalds sing of your victory!

Held especially sacred by the people of the Northlands, an unthinkable act of destruction against the World-Tree will send your party on the trail of a brutal mercenary band in search of the Hexrage Axe, crafted from Yggdrasil itself. This adventure is for 3rd-level pre-generated characters using new ToV Player's Guide 2 classes and features. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: Travel the Labyrinth to the farthest reaches of the Northlands, find the Ironsworn company, and resist the fury within the Hexrage Axe or fall victim to its curse. Let the skalds sing of your victory!

t: Raid on Castle Raisinloaf - Midnight Sun
ds:
Special Horror Edition!
 
 In Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils, a narrative-driven, wild west, steampunk magipunk adventure bursting with chaos, light rules, and ridiculous fun, your homeless, hungry kobold clan is one bad torch away from extinction—and desperate times call for reckless real estate acquisition. The plan? Seize Castle Raisinloaf and make it yours.
 
 Unfortunately, it’s occupied by the brooding (and extremely bitey) Vampire Lord C'hahd and a buffet of monsters, mercenaries, and things that skitter in the dark. Rumor whispers his still-beating Heart lies hidden deep within the castle’s cursed halls. Capture it, and the pale tyrant must kneel. Fail, and you’re appetizers. Grab your six-shooters, your posse, and your questionable courage—tonight, the kobolds raid.
sd: Homeless kobolds raid Castle Raisinloaf to seize Vampire Lord C'hahd's hidden Heart. Win a new home. Fail and become dinner. Chaos, guns, and magipunk mayhem!

ds:
Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils rides again in a blaze of magipunk mayhem! A dying frontier town hides an ancient relic humming with forbidden power—and every monster with ambition can smell it. Cinder, a fire-blooded dragon, wants it to rule the wastes. Lord Ashcroft, a silver-tongued tyrant, plans to crack it open and ascend as an archfiend. And your band of reckless kobolds? You’re here to steal it first.
 
 Roam dusty streets, spin rumors into leverage, duel rival gangs, rig contraptions, and cut deals that will absolutely backfire. Side with dragonfire or deviltry… or play them both. The cards drive the chaos, the story bends to your choices, and the clock is ticking. In Dust & Devils, loyalty is optional, explosions are inevitable, and tiny scaly legends are born in smoke and fire.
sd: Chaotic kobolds race a dragon and a devil-bound tyrant to steal an ancient relic. Cut deals, spark mayhem, and betray everyone before the town burns to ash.

ds:
Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils is a high-octane, improv-driven, rules-light, card-powered narrative heist set in a lawless western steampunk magipunk frontier. Devil’s Gulch has gone dark. Travelers vanish. The wildlife has fled. Vultures circle above an empty town that should not be empty.
 
 Gather up to six other kobolds and venture into the silent streets to uncover the truth, seize the mysterious Mind Shard, and escape… “alive.” This two-hour, loosely cooperative chaos-fest rewards bold creativity, reckless teamwork, and increasingly catastrophic decisions as you break in, grab the prize, and get out — preferably before everything (and everyone) explodes.
 
 What is the Mind Shard? Why do you need it? How many kobolds can you fit in a trench coat? Only time will tell.
 
 Presented by Kobold Game Labs — please use your Kobold Posse Responsibly.
 Adventure Track 2 (2026)
sd: Devil’s Gulch is silent. Team up with 6 kobolds to uncover the mystery, grab the Mind Shard, and escape “alive” in this high-octane magipunk heist.

 Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils is a high-octane, improv-driven, rules-light, card-powered narrative adventure set in a lawless western steampunk magipunk frontier. Trapped in a deadly time loop, you and up to six other kobolds must explore the town, unravel the mystery of the Time Shard, and break the cycle before the world ends - again.
 
 This two-hour, loosely cooperative chaos-fest rewards bold creativity, reckless teamwork, and increasingly catastrophic decisions as you experiment, adapt, and desperately try to escape… “alive.”
 
 What is the Time Shard? Why is it bound to you? How many kobolds can you fit in a trench coat?
 
 Only time will tell.

t: The Battle of the Dungeon Bands with DM Timm Woods
ds: Join DM Timm Woods (Pardon My Take podcast, A24 Green Knight Box Set, & Chuthulu in a Castle) for an unforgettably unique D&D experience! Do not miss this opportunity to meet and game with an absolutely celestial dungeon master as you enter the Battle of the Bands! DM Timm will work with players beforehand to create a custom game experience to their liking! Pick DM Timm's brain and rock out during this game session!
sd: Sigil draws outrageous groups from across the multiverse. With a Wish Spell as the ultimate prize, the winning act can change the fabric of reality itself!

t: Doom Raiders Must Die with DM Timm Woods
ds: Unfortunately, one group of unscrupulous “heroes”, the infamous Doom Raiders, has begun to win honor, fame, and even great rewards by claiming credit for certain exploits— namely yours!
sd: In Waterdeep adventurers are a silver-piece-a-dozen. You and the other TRUE champions must band together to stop the imposter Doom Raiders, get your vengeance, and reclaim your rightful glory!

t: Blood on the Spellbooks with DM Timm Woods
ds: The Doom Raiders are dead, but their master lives on! Manshoon, the leader of the ruthless Zhentarim crime syndicate, has a vendetta to settle against your heroes. Before the dread wizard can execute his twisted plans, your party must infiltrate his private tower to undermine and eliminate Manshoon and his wicked protectors. But an arch wizard's tower should not be taken lightly for around every corner of this lair are tricks, traps, and magical secrets awaiting our would-be assassins. The spiritual sequel to "Doom Raiders Must Die" but playable as a self contained one-shot.
sd: Manshoon, the leader of the ruthless Zhentarim crime syndicate, has a vendetta to settle against you. To save your party of heroes, infiltrate the arch wizard's private tower!

t: The Sepulcher of Ash and Teeth
ds:
The world is ending and you are already too late.
 In The Sepulcher of Ash and Teeth, the dying lead you into a cursed ruin choked with soot, bones, and bad prophecy. Something inside refuses to stay buried, and every step closer makes the air thicker, the omens worse, and the choices more final.
 
 This is a fast, brutal one-session descent into rot and desperation. Characters are fragile, violence is sudden, and mercy is rare. Expect collapsing stone, blasphemous relics, malformed dead, and a creeping sense that the dungeon itself wants you gone. There are no heroes here—only scavengers, sinners, and fools trying to survive long enough to see what kills them.
 
 The tone is bleak, violent, and darkly funny. The rules are simple, the danger is constant, and the end is always near. Bring dice, make bad choices, and see how long you last before the world closes in.
sd: A doomed expedition into a blighted ruin where something ancient refuses to stay buried. Expect rot, prophecy, sudden violence, and a short, brutal struggle against the end of the world.

t: The Crooked Moon: The Crooked House
ds:
An exciting haunted house adventure designed for four Level 3 
 characters for The Crooked Moon. This abridged 2.5 hour version of the adventure will 
 provide you have a first hand look into the mechanics, new subclasses, and the terrifying 
 world of The Crooked Moon campaign setting. 
 
 Teeming with horrors from its bloody past, Druskenvald Manor - the home of Phillip and Adela Druskenvald - readies its horrors for the unlucky pair that now call this place home. The manor bends and contorts into its true, twisted, ruined, and haunted form - the Crooked House - with the helpless Druskenvalds trapped inside. You and your party must explore the Crooked House and save its benefactors!

ds: Dog Eat Dog is a role-playing game of colonialism and its consequences. As a group, players work together to describe the conquest of one of the hundreds of small islands in the Pacific Ocean, defining the customs of the native people and the mores of the outsiders arriving to claim it. One player then assumes the role of the Occupation force, playing their capable military, their collaborationist government, and whatever jaded tourists and shrewd businessmen are interested in this not-quite-pacified territory. All the others play individual Natives, each trying in their own ways to come to terms with the new regime.
sd: Come play Dog Eat Dog: A Game of Imperialism and Assimilation on the Pacific Islands.

ds: Keep the Faith is a storytelling game of belief, tension, and transformation, designed to create compelling narratives and spark discussions between players. Players become members of a fictional Faith in transition, shaping its rituals, symbols, and stories as beliefs evolve and fracture under pressure. Through cards and shared narration, they explore how conviction, community, and power shape a religion’s future.
sd: Build a religion and watch it fracture in this storytelling game about faith in transition.

ds: The Mountain Witch is a self-contained role-playing game in which players take on the role of ronin in mythical, feudal Japan. Outcast and unemployed, these samurai accept a deal that no one else would take—to assault and kill the dreaded O-Yanma, the Mountain Witch of Mt Fuji. But haunted by the past and by dark fortune, these characters very quickly find themselves trapped in desperate circumstances.
sd: Play as one of a group of secretive ronin hired to seek out and kill the dreaded Mountain Witch of Mt. Fuji.

ds: Keep the Faith is a storytelling game of belief, tension, and transformation, designed to create compelling narratives and spark discussions between players. Players become members of a fictional Faith in transition, shaping its rituals, symbols, and stories as beliefs evolve and fracture under pressure. Through cards and shared narration, they explore how conviction, community, and power shape a religion’s future.
sd: Build a religion and then watch it schism in this storytelling game about faith in transition.

ds: The Mountain Witch is a self-contained role-playing game in which players take on the role of ronin in mythical, feudal Japan. Outcast and unemployed, these samurai accept a deal that no one else would take—to assault and kill the dreaded O-Yanma, the Mountain Witch of Mt Fuji. But haunted by the past and by dark fortune, these characters very quickly find themselves trapped in desperate circumstances.
sd: Play as one of a group of secretive ronin hired to seek out and kill the dreaded Mountain Witch of Mt. Fuji.

ds: Dog Eat Dog is a role-playing game of colonialism and its consequences. As a group, players work together to describe the conquest of one of the hundreds of small islands in the Pacific Ocean, defining the customs of the native people and the mores of the outsiders arriving to claim it. One player then assumes the role of the Occupation force, playing their capable military, their collaborationist government, and whatever jaded tourists and shrewd businessmen are interested in the not-quite-pacified territory. All the others play individual Natives, each trying in their own ways to come to terms with the new regime.
sd: Players are placed in the midst of a struggle between a colonizing Occupation force and a targeted Native force.

ds: In this game inspired by the real world migration of sea turtle hatchlings, you will be playing as a group of adventures who after being lost at see make a deal with a dragon turtle to check up on her babies in exchange for safe passage. Protect the dragon turtle babies by any means necessary including navigating traps, fighting animals, talking people down, and many many more things that would stop the hatchlings from returning to sea.
sd: You must protect a group of newly hatched dragon turtles on there way to the ocean while there mother is away in this LVL 1 one-shot adventure. You're their only hope for a life!

ds:
A ranger party has gone missing in the Nightwood, and they're not the only ones. Will you brave the dangers in the dark to help bring them back to town? Payment is guaranteed, but only if you survive.
 Embark on a fast-paced and dangerous one-shot where the forest is twisted, your adversaries are out for blood and just about anything can happen.
sd: The Mayor's son has gone missing. Will you enter the supposedly cursed forest to find him?

ds: Whispers run rampant across the city about 'Cherry Moon', a strange and potent new offering that makes Kindred feel more alive than they have in decades (or centuries...). Everyone wants a taste, but few know how to get it. Will your coterie be able to figure what all the buzz is about?
sd: Everyone is clamoring about an addictive and intoxicating new type of blood, but few know where to get it.

t: One Night in the Sinister Citadel
ds:
Shirf Crylla the youngest daughter of the Crylla house has recently purchased an old run down citadel with the intention of turning it into an auction house. Her first auction is going to be held soon and while the building is "mostly" ready, she still needs help with added security. You have been tasked with keeping the citadel safe overnight in preparation for the auction in the morning, however the citadel has it's own secrets!
 
 Explore the haunted citadel while trying to protect the auction goods from any attempts to steal them from the vault. Will you learn all of the secrets of the Sinister Citadel.
sd: A simple job. Protect the merchandise that will be up for auction the following day. Nevermind that they say the citadel where the auction will be held is haunted. A LVL 2 adventure.

ds:
During one of the city’s biggest events of the year, two Barons play a sick game. Two different groups of Kindred are sent out to solve the same problem. What’s at stake? Only your reputations among the local Kindred population among other things.  
 The team who solves the mystery first will be crowned champions and receive special prizes. Join us in this battle of wits, wills, and Vitae where every decision can turn the tides.
sd: Two groups go head-to-head in a mysterious challenge. Will your coterie come out on top?

ds: Styk. 3135. The HPG network is down. BattleMechs are rare. And the Republic of the Sphere, which seemed to be the best hope the Inner Sphere had for peace...has failed. The Capellan Confederation has now taken control of the planet Skyk, resulting in a presence of security forces. Those forces are looking for something or someone which is causing many on world to feel uneasy, especially those that have shown interest in BattleMech warfare. The characters feel as if their every move is being closely watched until a chance encounter may save them...or condemn them.
sd: There is more to Battletech than 'Mechs. Take on the role of a Mechwarrior during the Dark Age. Failure means it's just another one-shot. Success lets you walk away with the spoils.

ds:
Your group of adventurers has been hired to explore the ruins of a ancient temple that has been thought impossible to open, but recent weather has caused a opportunity to explore. Ixleem, a member of a local tribe, has offered to help guide you to the temple and provide sleds to get there, in exchange for letting him accompany you inside.
 
 Journey through the inhospitable cold and survive encounters with dangerous beasts so that you can discover the secrets of the lost temple, all while trying not to freeze to death.
sd: You've been hired to explore the rumors of a long lost temple in freezing northern mountains. Just survive the cold and the savage creature hunting you! A LVL 10 adventure.

ds:
The sun never sets on the British Empire. Truly there has not been a grander empire since the likes of Julius Caesar and Genghis Khan. Under the mourning eyes of Queen Victoria in the wake of the death of her beloved Prince Albert, the city of London is vibrating for release from this prolonged grief.
 You, on the other hand, have been experiencing a different kind of grief. The kind one feels when mourning not the loss of someone else but rather, the loss of your own life. Grieving, however, gets old.
 Now is the time to party.
sd: Sad vampires try to forget that they're sad by going on a big night out in Victorian London.

ds: There are places in the world that are still left unexplored, but sometimes that’s for good reason. When Rylus Durham (he/she/they/any) looks at the map the section that has always stood out was the ancient forest. True people have always lived along its fringes, but the interior is the place of myth and legend. So Rylus got a grant and some family money to hire a group to help explore the forest and map it. What you all discover on the journey will change everything.
sd: A cartographer requests some adventurers to help them map an ancient forest, but the journey reveals more than any of them could have expected.

ds: To swim the English Channel is regarded as an astounding feat of endurance -- and no woman has yet managed it. The renowned American swimmer Gertie Eberhard plans to attempt the crossing in August 1926. She and her team are acutely aware that, of the two women known to have tried the journey before, one was never seen again and the other has mysteriously faded from public view. Eberhard has had Smythe's Discreet Investigations, London's first -- indeed, only -- all-female detective agency recommended to her, and has engaged the team to manage her security before and during the swim.
sd: An unusual project for the team from Smythe's Discreet Investigations -- a swimmer attempting a Channel crossing seems to be concerned about more than weather, currents and tides.

t: Echoes of the Sea: Quick Delve Adventure
ds:
Be among the first to explore a world in the making during this exclusive indie premiere. In this Deep Dive session, you play a pre-generated fantasy hero sent to investigate a ruined seaside temple of a moon goddess. Within, you will face dangers, uncover hidden paths, and navigate a forgotten sanctum shaped by time and tide.
 This session showcases a skill-based system where every choice matters. Learn through direct play with a streamlined format focused on exploration, problem-solving, and tactical encounters. All materials are provided, including characters and dice.
 Each session features randomized threats, paths, and outcomes, ensuring a fresh experience every time. Help refine the system with your feedback and shape its future. Participants receive tokens and mementos as a thank you. Learn more at our website.

t: Dead in Thay : Multi-Table Persistent Epic - Track A
gm: Gilles Provenzano, John Sanchez, David Claros, Marco Carrion, Diego Garcia
ds:
To play the full campaign, please purchase tickets for the same time slot on Thursday, Friday, Saturday, & Sunday Track A Part 1 of 4.
 
 The Lich Lord Szass Tam has built a nightmare—The Doomvault—& it will take more than one party to bring it down. In this "Round Table Games" exclusive, four adventuring parties will operate in the same dungeon simultaneously, sharing a common goal: the Bloodgate Nexus.
 
 While each table explores independently, your successes (& failures) affect the overall war effort. We are using the D&D 5.5e Rules for a fresh, tactical experience.
 
 This is a persistent event. We highly encourage you to book the same time slot for Thursday, Friday, Saturday, & Sunday. You will play the same character, retain your level-ups, and see the campaign through to the final epic conclusion. High-quality physical props, professional GMs, and a unified war-map included!
sd: ​4 parties, 1 mission: Conquer a 100+ room dungeon! Successes affect all tables in this D&D 5.5e multi-table epic. Persistent play: return daily to finish the siege. Join the strike on Thay!

ds:
For new players or long-time fans to enjoy the extreme flexibility and endless possibilities of Rolemaster. Where a player can let their imagination soar because even minute details can make a difference and nearly anything is conceivable. Any character can learn and use any skill, and criticals actually have tactical meaning. 
 
 Deep within the Dark Woods of the kingdom of Archendurn is a ruined fortress, Dún Crú. Rumors say that it has become the lair of bandits or evil goblins. Legends say that it is haunted by the spirits of its garrison. Are you brave enough to seek answers to the mysteries of Dún Crú?
sd: Traveling through the wilderness of the Archendurn Kingdom, between the city of Archendurn and the town of Libintat, things go afoul. What will you do...

t: Tower of Gygarn - POKEMON! Battle Arena
lo: ICC Hall B : No Rails Adventure Team HQ
ds: BE THE VERY BEST - Choose the Pokemon you want and enter the arena to fight and become champion in unique match-ups in a large arena format. Move between arena's with each re-spawn as you pursue victory. Boast and brag as you seek to take the prize as event champion. Being knocked out is not the end in this event as you return as a new Pokemon! This is a play-tested solo mash-up of D&D that you won't soon forget. Maximize your resistances, eat from a variety of 20 different Pokeberries, EVOLVE and grow more powerful! Booster pack prize based on knock outs. Randon events from GM's are possible during battles including boosts, berries, and even bonus prize possibilities.
sd: Do you want to be THE VERY BEST? Choose your favorite Pokemon and battle others in this arena mash-up. Booster pack for winners! We choose you to join us in this unique event!

t: Tower of Gygarn - WANDERING MONSTER Arena Royale
lo: ICC Hall B : No Rails Adventure Team HQ
ds: Enter the arena as a randomly selected monster and fight to the death again and again as unique match-ups in a large arena format are pushed to the limit. Move between arena's with each re-spawn as you pursue victory and pre-set goals. Boast and brag as you seek to take the crown as event champion. Death is not the end in this event as dying reincarnates you as a new entity, perhaps weaker or perhaps unstoppable! This is a play-tested solo mash-up of D&D that you won't soon forget. Play as many rounds as your fellow players wish and that time allows in the two hour block chance for prizes depending on performance. Miniature Prize for Most Kills and for Most Times Killed!
sd: Enter the Battle Arena again and again as a random monster from D&D Lore. When you die, re-spawn again and again as a different monster contestant in a a fast & furious mash-up.

ds: Enter the arena as a randomly selected monster and fight to the death again and again as unique match-ups in a large arena format are pushed to the limit. Move between arena's with each re-spawn as you pursue victory and pre-set goals. Boast and brag as you seek to take the crown as event champion. Death is not the end in this event as dying reincarnates you as a new entity, perhaps weaker or perhaps unstoppable! This is a play-tested solo mash-up of D&D that you won't soon forget. Play as many rounds as your fellow players wish and that time allows in the two hour block chance for prizes depending on performance. Miniature Prize for Most Kills and for Most Times Killed!
sd: Enter the Battle Arena again and again as a random monster from D&D Lore. When you die, re-spawn again and again as a different monster contestant in a a fast & furious mash-up.

ds: You have 3 stats: Sexy, Battle, and Wizard. There are a ton of problems that you are definitely not qualified to solve. Will that stop you? Absolutely not. Come sit at GM Sarah Moore's table and show the world why you've been banned from most areas of the map for "helping."
sd: It's field trip time with your class from The College Errant - a floating university that produces "heroes." Will you defeat the elemental danger without destroying the entire town...again?

ds: Everyone knows that the funniest crime – objectively – is smuggling rare birds across borders. In this game you will play a down-on-your-luck poacher who’s been roped into illegally importing seven rare breed parrots (who are also criminals) aboard a redeye passenger jet from JFK to Heathrow, and the birds keep escaping, and at one point they get hold of a weapon and it’s really downhill from there on in.
sd: Smuggle illegal bird criminals across the ocean. Don't get caught...and don't let them take over the plane.

t: Sarah's Table - Sweet as honey, sharp as a sting
ds: The Queen is in peril and not even her hive of dire bees has been able to rescue her. Are you hero enough to enter this home brew world by GM Sarah Moore and save the day? Or will the Queendom stay stuck in peril?
sd: This real honey of an adventure takes you into a homebrew world where Dire Bees are in a sticky situation.
