t: Sarah's Table - A Murder of Crows
ds: You are a god of a small slice of reality. Will you use your powers to help humanity or for your own gain? When one minor god goes rampaging through a portion of the city, only other gods can stop them...or save them? Come find out who the real villain is.
sd: The god of crows is acting out of character - find out who is pulling the strings and stop them before part of the city is completely decimated.

t: Tower of Gygarn - KILL IT, KEEP IT - Adult Emerald Dragon
lo: ICC Hall B : No Rails Adventure Team HQ
ds: Join endless ranks of hero fodder (er...) adventurers! March to face the monster in its lair. No loss of life is too much for the Grieving Emperor who wants vengeance. Adventures fight and quickly die, to be reincarnated until the evil creature is slain. Improve your character each death in Roguelike fashion with permanent benefits. Play as multiple classes and work together or in competition to kill the creature and land the killing blow (which awards your own collectible as trophy of your victory! Endless player lives and someone WILL eventually walk away with this valuable figure. GM Decisions final. Winning Player from each table with compete in Critical Hit Roll-off to take home this Premium "miniature"
sd: Reincarnate and power up your character in battle after battle until monster dies. Final critical hit keeps the miniature from Icons of the Realms ($99 MSRP)!

ds:
An astrophysicist needs the Magnus Institute’s help. Her boss, the abrasive Dr. Fisher, has long obsessed over the cold and empty darkness of space—and after some sort of mental breakdown, Fisher’s obsession resulted in dangerous and unnatural events. The observatory’s main telescope is leaking viscous, liquid darkness that has flooded the building and consumed most of its personnel. 
 
 After hearing the lone survivor’s statement, investigators must find a way to staunch the flood. If they fail, the liquid void won’t stop at just the observatory.
sd: A telescope has formed a direct portal to the blackness of space, flooding a local observatory with liquid void. The spill remains unchecked, and only millimeters are enough to drag someone under.

ds: Play as adventurers and treasure seekers who have journeyed to the Island of Drairmare to get an artifact deep inside a volcano that is said to grant you your heart's desires.
sd: A volcanic dungeon crawl and quest for the crown of wishes.

ds: Play as people at a birthday party who get sucked into a racing video game filled with high speed danger at every turn. Will you survive this deadly race and get out of the game?
sd: Speed Racer meets Hot Wheels in this whacky and high octane race.

ds: While embroiled in their regular scheming and backstabbing, the oil magnates of the Ewing family discover their land is also home to an interdimensional portal connecting them to parallel universes. If there is one thing a true Ewing knows, it’s that where there are deals to be made, there is money and power to follow. Players take on the role of characters from Dallas split across many worlds. To start, you will be divided into groups in separate universes where your characters have a tangled web of power, relationships, and goals. Each universe will have a sci-fi tongue-in-cheek quirk that layers an outlandish sci-fi quirk onto the usual Dallas melodrama. Then a portal will open, allowing characters to hop between worlds, causing chaos and making their goals possible in new ways. We’re using the basic Dallas system with a few original mechanics to accommodate this strange premise.
sd: A session of the baffling 1979 officially licensed RPG based on the 1978 soap opera “Dallas” with a bizarre sci-fi twist. You don’t need to know anything about Dallas to play.

ds: The mercenaries belong to a new company in Gloomhaven. The company’s first mission resulted in an ooze machine gone haywire and curing a member of Needle-Eye’s Freebooters, the Prawn, of a terrible curse that made him always smell of dead fish. Now, the Prawn has hired the company to help him collect oozes that escaped from the incident into Gloomhaven’s sewers for study. Unfortunately, the Prawn’s ex has other plans for the oozes, catching the mercenaries in the middle of their complicated relationship.
sd: The mercenary company has been hired to help a shady inventor capture oozes for study, but they get caught up in their client’s complicated relationship when his ex shows up to take his research.

ds: The planet Ayohusdi is a dangerous place. With skies colored crimson from its red supergiant star, the planet is hot and moist and covered in a number of highly deadly viruses and novel diseases. But it’s also a place where you can make a clean break and get out of the watchful eyes of prying governments. A place where people don’t ask where you came from and instead only care that you share in the burdens. This adventure for the ALIEN RPG Evolved Edition is written by Connor Alexander (Coyote & Crow)
sd: Sooner or later, most of us need a fresh start. Some more than others. The mining planet Ayohusdi in the Far Reach might just be that fresh start for you.

But it’s also a place where you can make a clean break and get out of the watchful eyes of prying governments. A place where people don’t ask where you came from and instead only care that you share in the burdens. This adventure for the ALIEN RPG Evolved Edition is written by Connor Alexander (Coyote & Crow)
sd: Sooner or later, most of us need a fresh start. Some more than others. The mining planet Ayohusdi in the Far Reach might just be that fresh start for you.

ds: The mercenaries belong to a new company in Gloomhaven. The company’s first mission resulted in an ooze machine gone haywire and curing a member of Needle-Eye’s Freebooters, the Prawn, of a terrible curse that made him always smell of dead fish. Now, the Prawn has hired the company to help him collect oozes that escaped from the incident into Gloomhaven’s sewers for study. Unfortunately, the Prawn’s ex has other plans for the oozes, catching the mercenaries in the middle of their complicated relationship.

ds:
Human supremacist influencer and Kill Magazine publisher Jelle Schyler is many things but most relevant here is his nose for a
 story. Jelle knows the city, he knows his readership, and he knows how to chase down leads. If he was not so prone to embellishing
 the facts to fuel his readers’ predilections, Jelle might be considered a true investigative journalist. It was one of these leads that led to
 the shooting.

t: The Crypt of the Golden Star
ds: Osera sneaks you into the palace and leads you through the empty corridors of the servants' quarters to the governor's bedroom. Kaelohr Gyldenstierna's breathing is weak and slow. She then opens a secret door behind his bed and says: “Here is the staircase that leads down to the crypts. But please, hurry! Not only do I fear that the governor does not have much time left, but there are also only two hours left until midnight. I am afraid that if you do not find the elixir before midnight, you will have to flee the catacombs if you want to get out alive...
sd: Explore the catacombs of the city of Foamsvale in an attempt to find an elixir that can save the dying governor Kaelohr Gyldenstierna.

ds: On the one-year anniversary of the brutal battle between Omni-Man and his son Invincible that caused large-scale destruction in several locations worldwide, the city prepares a memorial event to honor those who were lost. Machine Head, the notorious criminal kingpin, sees the gathering as the perfect chance to strike at the unusually large number of superheroes who will be present – proclaiming he will pay a substantial bounty for every superhero successfully taken out. The offer draws out every kind of low-life, assassin, and supervillain eager to cash in on the opportunity. Can you survive open season on superheroes?
sd: This short adventure throws heroes into a deadly predicament as a massive bounty is placed on their heads - one lucrative enough to send every supervillain in the area scrambling to collect.

ds: In this Tarantino-esqe, ultra-violent, pulp adventure there are 6 unique vampires that are tasked with fighting their way though the streets of Paris to get to the Eiffel tower where a War Zeppelin is parked. In between where the squad emerges from their drop-coffins and their target Hitler, lie occult and paranormal threats.
sd: You, a unit of crack vampire commandos are coffin dropped into occupied Paris. You have one goal, drink all of Hitlers blood -in this rules light, narrative driven, d6 system.

ds: Danger and exploration in an impossibly verdant weird fantasy world! Some three hundred years ago a wave of fast-growing greenery, a tide of rampant growth over took the world, a titanic expanse of rustling waves and sturdy boughs known as the Wildsea. Now chainsaw-driven ships cut their way across dense treetop waves piloted by the new mutated peoples of the world. Game play is gives a lot of narrative power to the players. Decisions are made through the conversation, a collaborative process that keeps all players at the table involved in the outcome of an event (not just the GM/dice). Only when things are dramatic, dangerous, or difficult will players create their dice pools to find out the result of their actions -triumph, conflict, or disaster (the the binary success/fail). There will be premade characters for this adventure but we will create a ship together!
sd: This is the one where you get to sail across the mile high tree tops on chainsaw ships!!! This is a narrative first, d6 pool system, that's in a overgrown techno/weird setting.

t: D&D Adventurers League: The Sage of Cormanthor
ds: The grain has rotted in the town of Elmwood, which means people might starve, businesses and banks might fail, and endanger the town’s already-precarious existence. Brave adventurers are needed to travel through the wild forest to seek the advice of the Sage of Cormanthor. D&D Adventurers League. New to Adventurers League? We will have some level 5 pregen characters available, or you are also welcome to create your own level 5 character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website (https://atxal.com/GenCon). Message the GM if you need assistance. CCC-BMG-16 The Sage of Cormanthor. A four-hour Adventurers League adventure for Tier 2 Characters (levels 5-10).
sd: As the grain rots, the town of Elmwood hires you to seek out the Sage of Cormanthor's wisdom. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 5-10.

ds:
It is a truth universally acknowledged that there is a dark, beating heart in the center of every big box store which can only be killed by stabbing it with a crystal sword. 
 
 Dark Hearts is an anti-capitalist, Powered by the Apocalypse Tabletop RPG. Players will use premade playbooks to create characters at the beginning of the session, and then be thrust into the dark world of Retail where they'll be forced to confront the horror in the mundane, everyday world of capital around them. The tone will very much be horror comedy (perhaps with a slight emphasis on horror). Rules will be taught at the table and are very easy to pick up. Please bring a few d6s and a pencil if you'd like, otherwise you'll be provided with them at the table. This game is still in production, and players will be asked to provide feedback at the end of the session.
sd: Players will create Bargain Hunters and take down the demonic forces of Retail in this horror comedy inspired by They Live and Devil May Cry.

t: D&D Adventurers League: A Martyred Heart
ds: As Thentia’s lighthouse grows dim, so too does the faith within the city, as various powers wage a quiet struggle in the wake of an assassination. In the midst of this, a priest of Ilmater has been accused of a heinous crime. Is this all really the truth of the matter, or are we all just Agents of Fate? New to D&D or Adventurers League? Level 1 pregen characters will be available, or you are welcome to create your own character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website. Have your own Tier 1 AL character already? Great! This module is fun for all levels of D&D and AL experience. CCC-TAROT-01-03 A Martyred Heart. A beginner-friendly Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.
sd: In the wake of an assassination, a priest of Ilmater stands trial. But is this really the truth of the matter, or is it fate? A beginner-friendly D&D AL adventure for levels 1-4.

t: The Magistrate's Gambit: A Timed Fantasy Tournament
gm: Mel Georgiou, Jonah White, Brian Moody, David Mika
ds:
Step into a competitive roleplaying experience tailored for speed and social excitement. The teams of players, each supported by a dedicated Game Master, will match wits against the same hazardous scenario within an identical time frame. Strategic thinking, risk management, and cooperation become increasingly crucial as the environment grows more perilous, the clock ticking down.
 
 This event mingles the drama or roleplay with the energy of a tournament. Clear scoring, a dramatic finale, and a celebratory wrap-up come together in this exciting experience. New and experienced players welcome; pregenerated characters and a guided introduction get you playing in no time.
sd: A competitive tournament where teams face the same timed scenario. Work together, manage risks, and score points before the clock runs out.

t: WHPA-13: Live on Location at Lake Nessy
ds: Fairhaven is home to the weird, the eccentric, and the best public access programming in the region. As one their many television hosts, you have been invited to the WHPA-TV13’s annual summer party featuring BBQ, kayaking, and cornhole tournament. All seems the regular amount of odd and fun until unexpected party crashers arise from the lake.

ds: The Council of Mages has recently sent a young apprentice out to investigate the strange disturbances that have beset Thentia. It has been several weeks and he has not yet reported back. Pregen characters will be available, or you are also welcome to create your own character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website (https://atxal.com/GenCon). Have your own AL character? Great! This module is fun for all levels of D&D and AL experience. CCC-TAROT-01-05 The Lost Apprentice. A beginner-friendly Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.

t: A Summer Weekend at Lake Waukesha
ds:
Its Summer Vacation and Lake Waukesha is bustling in the Northwoods of Wisconsin. Are you visiting for the weekend with family? Are you a local town kid? Maybe this is your first time to this great Lake Town. Whoever you are, you know that Lake Waukesha is beautiful and serene. Maybe too serene? 
 
 In this session, we will explore the town of Lake Waukesha and work to discover why there is a higher prevelance of Missing Person reports from this town. Let's have fun this Summer Vacation and solve a mystery while we are at it!
 
 Starting from a quick Character creation, we will jump right into the action as we discover the secrets Lake Waukesha is hiding. 
 
 So, take a break from your summer reading list and jump on your bike with some friends. Who knows maybe you will go down as a legend yourself on the walls of Lake Waukesha's Boathouse.
sd: Lake Waukesha has been a Summer Vacation Retreat for Generations, but also not everyone makes it back home by the end of the Summer.

t: D&D Adventurers League: To Be the Very Best
ds: Festival bells cut loud through the air! Adventurers are gathering to celebrate the Wild Monster Capture Festival. Tame wild monsters, team up with them in honorable combat, and you could win not only gold, but fame and renown! The spirit of the festival is about to get disrupted, however, and you must prepare for trouble… New to D&D or Adventurers League? No problem! Pregen characters will be available, or you are also welcome to create your own character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website (https://atxal.com/GenCon). Have your own AL character? Great! This module is fun for all levels of D&D and AL experience. CCC-KUMORI-02-04 To Be the Very Best. A beginner-friendly Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.
sd: Have you ever wanted to play Pokemo- I mean, catch wild monsters in a legally distinct D&D game? Now you can, in this beginner-friendly D&D AL adventure for levels 1-4!

ds:
Join a crew of cutthroats and thieves to steal the Jeweled Crescent. In this session, you and your crew will set a quick plan to steal a beautiful Tiara from the Silver Stag Casino, and then we jump right into the action.
 
 Will you be cunning and stealthy, or violent and destructive? Maybe you will just convince Helene to hand over the Crown. Maybe a little bit of all of the above. The only way to find out is by joining and seeing how well you can execute on your mischievous desires.
sd: Have you ever wanted to be part of Ocean's Eleven? Now you can in the noir setting of Duskvol.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Undermountain: The Musical!
ds: DDAL00-09 Undermountain: The Musical! is a lighthearted, satirical adventure that takes place in Waterdeep and later a lost level of the famed dungeon: Undermountain. Dancing, singing, improv, joking around, & meme-ing are all encouraged! Be mentally prepared - the faint of heart may cringe or become embarrassed. This module offers special silly subclass options! On signup, you'll receive a message listing these subclasses. Message the DM if you would like to use one of these - they're silly, so try them out! Some time will also be allocated at the beginning of the session for anyone building a character with a special subclass. You may bring an existing D&D AL character, and have the option to temporarily rebuild into one of this adventure's special subclasses! You can also create your own level 5 character using the AL guidelines, or use a provided pregen character.
sd: Discard your shame for a silly romp through the MUSICAL level of Undermountain! Dancing and singing encouraged! You can be a Garbage Druid or Flat-Realmer! (YES, all D&D AL legal!) Levels 5-10.

ds: SEER has learned of an attempt to intimidate Gralm, an ettin, and his followers into joining Bad Fruul's army. Hsing comes forth to communicate that she wants you to see if you can find some way to either ensure Gralm remains neutral, or to encourage the creature to challenge Bad Fruul to single combat in the hopes that he might wrest control of the hill giant's forces and turn them back from Parnast. New to D&D or Adventurers League? No problem! Pregen characters will be available, or you are also welcome to create your own character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website (https://atxal.com/Gencon). Have your own AL character already? Great! This module is fun for all levels of D&D and AL experience. DDAL05-10 Giant Diplomacy. A beginner-friendly Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.
sd: How would you convince a giant to join your side in a war? Diplomacy is a contest, and you're going to WIN! A beginner-friendly D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Vault of the Devourer
ds: Amid the gales and snowy Earthspur Mountains, the tumbling ruins of the ancient Tempest Mage’s Tower brood over the village of Windy Valley. When a kidnapper flees into the ruins, it’s up to a group of adventurers to apprehend the rogue and save his victim from the vault below. New to Adventurers League? We will have some level 1 pregen characters available, or you are also welcome to create your own level 1 character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website (https://atxal.com/GenCon). Message the GM if you need assistance. CONTENT WARNING: Kidnapping, Ritual Sacrifice, Animal Harm. CCC-IC-01 Vault of the Devourer. A four-hour Adventurers League adventure for Tier 1 Characters (levels 1-4).
sd: A kidnapper has struck the Windy Valley and made for the Tempest Mage's Tower. Can you save his hostage from the Vault of the Devourer? A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.

gm: Mel Georgiou, Jaren Zacher, Susan Haarman
ds:
Agents are assigned the same operation across multiple tables, each overseen by a General Manager (GM). As teams investigate, negotiate, and contain anomalies, their decisions are tracked and evaluated using shared criteria.
 
 This event blends narrative roleplay with competitive structure, encouraging creative problem-solving, teamwork, and smart risk assessment. All rules are taught at the table, characters are provided, and the session concludes with a comparative debrief and ranking of outcomes.
sd: A competitive, corporate horror multi-table mission where teams handle the same operation under time pressure. Decisions, efficiency, and outcomes are evaluated and ranked.

ds: *Author-run adventure* The dark of the ocean’s depths has risen in Port Llast! Will the heroes be able to restore the light and intercede in the ancient war that brought this gloom? New to Adventurers League? We will have some level 1 pregen characters available, or you are also welcome to create your own level 1 character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website (https://atxal.com/GenCon). Message the GM if you need assistance. CONTENT WARNING: Darkness, Drowning, Invasion, Sharks. FR-DC-DARK-01 Dark Harbor. A four-hour Adventurers League adventure for Tier 1 Characters (levels 1-4). Optimized for APL 3.
sd: *Author-run adventure* Port Llast has gone dark, and murderous monsters stalk the city. Brave the fog, clear the streets, and save the city! A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Pillars of Peril
ds: *Author-run adventure* In the bountiful city of Sustenance in the Outlands, mysterious tremors threaten its stability. The city's leaders urgently enlist help to recover crucial artifacts stolen by a radical group, which are used to maintain the city’s stability and prevent a total collapse. Can you track down these stolen artifacts before there’s a catastrophic event and perhaps discover the true motives of this radical group? This game is not for beginners or anyone who doesn't already have a Tier 4 character for Adventurers League. CONTENT WARNING: Animal abuse, city destruction, references to recreational drugs. PS-DC-POP-01 Pillars of Peril. A four-hour Adventurers League adventure for Tier 4 Characters (levels 17-20). Please bring an AL-legal Tier 4 character.
sd: *Author-run adventure* A city in the outlands, Sustenance, needs your help as radical cultists have stolen the relics that keep the local geography stable. A D&D AL adventure for levels 17-20.

ds: At her birth no sun shone bright, no bird broke into song. A figure stood beside her crib in shadows deep and long. So sing my song, O twilight child, with heart so full of pain, as shadows whisper out your name within this dark domain.

t: D&D Adventurers League EPIC! Infernal Pursuits
gm: Daniel Mawhirter, Erin Pennington, Hunter Sinclair, Jacqueline Kuenstler, Jarrett Marrero, Leif Olson, Thomas Day, Jeremy Marrero, Sam Mars, Justin Nierman
ds: A horse race in Baldur’s Gate becomes a hellish battle on infernal war machines in Avernus when the characters get caught between two evil merchants… and must hang on for dear life. A D&D Epic™ is a multi-table event where all tables work together to accomplish a goal! This will be fast-paced, there will be interactive elements, and you will be forced to make decisions and choices that have the chance to affect everyone - for better or worse! DDEP09-01 Infernal Pursuits. A four-hour D&D Epic™ Adventurers League adventure for Tier 1 (levels 1-4) and Tier 2 (levels 5-10) characters.
sd: A horse race in Baldur’s Gate becomes a hellish war machine battle, as the characters are caught between two evil merchants...and must hang on for dear life. A D&D AL Epic™ for Tiers 1 and 2.

ds: The Event of the Season is a silly Regency-themed social game at the messy intersection of love and wealth. Over the course of the game, players will gain Assets to accumulate their wealth, and then brag about that wealth at three Balls, during which players will leave the table and move around the surrounding areas to talk about their prospects and court their fellow players. At the end of the game, each player will write a letter of proposal to another player, and any matched pairs become married. The married couple (or individual) with the most wealth at the end of the game wins. The assets are silly, the Balls are riddled with goofy roleplay, and on the whole the game provides the experience of a season of Bridgerton written by Weird Al. A must-play for Regency enthusiasts, roleplay lovers, and anybody who likes to laugh.
sd: A Regency game of love & wealth. Over the course of 3 Balls, players will mill and court one another, discussing financial and romantic interests. But will they find love? Or more importantly, riches?

ds:
An astrophysicist needs the Magnus Institute’s help. Her boss, the abrasive Dr. Fisher, has long obsessed over the cold and empty darkness of space—and after some sort of mental breakdown, Fisher’s obsession resulted in dangerous and unnatural events. The observatory’s main telescope is leaking viscous, liquid darkness that has flooded the building and consumed most of its personnel. 
 
 After hearing the lone survivor’s statement, investigators must find a way to staunch the flood. If they fail, the liquid void won’t stop at just the observatory.
sd: A telescope has formed a direct portal to the blackness of space, flooding a local observatory with liquid void. The spill remains unchecked, and only millimeters are enough to drag someone under.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Giants of the Star Forge
ds: The Star Forge is a furnace built by giants eons ago at the spot where a star fell to the earth. A talented enough smith could use the Star Forge to craft a legendary weapon or suit of armor. Word has it that one such smith has recently been forcibly put to work on the forge to construct a war-machine of unimaginable destruction. To participate in this adventure, you must already have an Adventurer's League legal character in Tier 3 (levels 11-16). For more information, visit https://atxal.com/GenCon, or email us with any questions. DDHC-GOG-01 Giants of the Star Forge. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for Tier 3 Characters (levels 11-16).
sd: You are tasked to rescue a legendary smith, kidnapped by Fire Giants and forced to labor at the legendary Star Forge to construct an apocalyptic war machine. A D&D AL adventure for levels 11-16.

ds: On the moon Asherot lies an enigmatic structure known as Nazlut-Katar, according to its entry in the Explorers Guild archives. When a high-ranking member of the Navigators Guild is reported missing in the vicinity of the remote ruin, the worst is feared. A team of ruin delvers is sent to the site to find out what happened. This is a delve through an ancient ruin will showcase exploration, intrigue and mystery.
sd: "This is the shuttle Aramis declaring an emergency. In the name of the Archimandrite, help us!" - Last message from the Aramis, registered to the Navigators Guild.

t: D&D Adventurers League: White Plume Mountain - Mega Dungeon Crawl!
ds: Three famous weapons: Wave, Trident of the Sea Lords; Whelm, Foehammer of the Dwarfs; and dread Blackrazor, Stealer of Souls, are missing from well-protected collections of powerful and influential collectors, and the same cryptic note has been left in their place each time. You have been gathered by your faction, the lure of rich rewards, or your own personal interest in these weapons, and tasked with their recovery. Your quest takes you into the shadow of the roiling fumes of White Plume Mountain. Can you survive the perils you will find and retrieve Wave, Whelm, and Blackrazor? New to AL? Level 5 pregen characters will be available, or you are welcome to create your own level 5 character using the AL guidelines, which can be found on our website. DDHC-TYP-4 White Plume Mountain. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for Tier 2 Characters (levels 5-10). Optimized for APL 8.
sd: Three weapons of legend have dissapeared, and all signs point to the ever-roiling fumes of White Plume Mountain. Can you survive the perils and retrieve them? A D&D AL adventure for levels 5-10.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Tomb of Horrors - Mega Dungeon Crawl!
ds: Before there was much else in the world of D&D, there was the Tomb of Horrors! The first version of the adventure was crafted for Gary Gygax’s personal campaign in the early '70s and went on to be featured as the official D&D event at the original Origins gaming convention in 1975. The first publication of Tomb of Horrors, as a part of the Advanced D&D game, came in 1978. As a proving ground for characters and players alike, fabricated by the devious mind of the game’s co-creator, Tomb of Horrors has no equal in the annals of D&D’s greatest adventures. Only high-level characters stand a chance of coming back alive, but every player who braves the Tomb will have the experience of a lifetime. To participate in this module, you must have an existing AL character in Tier 3 (levels 11-16). DDHC-TYP-7 Tomb of Horrors. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 11-16.
sd: The sinister Tomb of Horrors is a labyrinthine crypt, with terrible traps, ferocious monsters, and magical treasures...all under the eye of evil lich Acererak. A D&D AL adventure for levels 11-16.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Claws of Fury
ds: The frontier city of Hawksroost has seen a lot in the past few weeks, but the claims that the people have seen a skeleton dragon flying overhead at dusk are unsubstantiated. The hunt for the rumored creature is on, but is the creature what the people claim it is? Or is something else getting the people of Hawksroost all worked up? To participate in this adventure, you must already have an Adventurer's League legal character in Tier 3 (levels 11-16). For more information, visit https://atxal.com/GenCon, or email us with any questions. CCC-ALMOG-03 TALES03-01 Claws of Fury. An Adventurers League adventure for Tier 3 Characters (levels 11-16).
sd: Citizens of Hawksroost claim to have spotted a dracolich in the night skies. The city's militia seeks adventurers to investigate. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 11-16.

ds: East of Beregost, nestled in the outskirts of the Wood of Sharp Teeth, Durlag’s Tower has intrigued and stymied adventurers for decades. Stuffed full of mechanical traps and arcane wards, and rumored to be inhabited by fiends, very few have managed to extract any REAL treasure from the former home of Durlag Trollkiller. However, a powerful item in the ancient fight against the giants is said to be housed there, and the cloud giant Baron Rajiram has committed significant resources toward recovering it. After a pleasant tea in her garden, SEER calls upon you to beat him there and put a stop to his efforts! To participate in this adventure, you must already have an AL character in Tier 3 (levels 11-16). For more information, visit https://atxal.com/GenCon, or email us with any questions. DDAL05-08 Durlag's Tower. An Adventurers League adventure for Tier 3 Characters (levels 11-16).
sd: The legendary Durlag Trollkiller is said to have secreted a powerful artifact key to rebuilding the giants' Ordning in his namesake tower. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 11-16.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Beneath the Fetid Chelimber's Descent
ds: Deep in the Marsh of Chelimber lie the ruins of a great wizard’s tower. Its buried rooms hold knowledge of older magics that could be just what the village of Parnast needs to resist the onslaught of Bad Fruul and his armies. Parnast needs adventurers to overcome the watery magic of the fetid marsh and return with the key to their survival. A beginner-friendly Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4. New to D&D or AL? No problem! Pregen characters will be available, or you can create your own character using the Adventurers League organized play guides, which can be found on our website (https://atxal.com/Gencon). Have your own AL character already? Great! These modules are fun for all levels of D&D and AL experience. DDAL-05-06 Beneath the Fetid Chelimber / DDAL-05-07 Chelimber's Descent. We will play both 2-hour modules as a single 4-hour adventure during this session.
sd: The ruined wizard tower in the Marsh of Chelimber may hold the key to defeating the superintelligent hill giant, Bad Fruul. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.

ds: The village of Efeler is under attack by malign creatures after a falling star crashed into the nearby hills. Spirits of wrath boil out of the night, attacking the village, while even more terrifying shapes lurk in the darkness beyond. The elders fear they are coming from the Screaming Crypt, so called because of the demonic face carved into the sealed entrance. Villagers rarely go there because it’s believed to be haunted. Can you help?
sd: Residents of Efeler village are menaced by foul creatures in the aftermath of a falling star's nearby strike. What has happened and what does it have to do with the Screaming Crypt?

ds: It’s 1993, intrepid travel show host Veronica “Ronnie” Sinclair has insisted on filming the next episode of her show, A Road Less Traveled, in the remote mining town of Ossington, Virginia—a place so small it barely appears on any map. She was adamant about this location, determined to capture something “truly authentic” for the show.
sd: As last-minute hires on the production crew, your job is simple: meet Ronnie, finish the shoot, and bring back a great episode. If you can find enough content to film, that is.

t: D&D Adventurers League: No Time to Die
ds: *Author-run adventure* An old nemesis has resurfaced and looks to not only spread their influence across all the realms, but also endeavors to finally get their retribution against you. Can you stop this ancient evil before it is too late, and the fabric of your very existence unravels? CONTENT WARNING: Death, Mind control, Time Distortion, Existance threats. PS-DC-HYS-03 No Time to Die. A 4-Hour Adventurers League adventure for Tier 4 (levels 17-20). Please bring an AL-legal Tier 4 character. This game is not for beginners or anyone who doesn't already have a Tier 4 character for AL. SERIES NOTE: This is Part 3 in a 3-part series but each part can be played independently. If you enjoyed this adventure you can check out the other 2 in the series designed for different tiered characters: SJ-DC-HYS-01 The Hystero (Tier 2) and SJ-DC-HYS-02 Darkside of Selune (Tier 3).
sd: An old nemesis resurfaced, spreading influence across the realms while seeking retribution against you. Stop this ancient evil before it unravels existence. A D&D AL adventure for levels 17-20.

t: Master Thieves from the Future Save Reality TAKE HOME GAME
ds: The perfect heist. Getting in, getting out. Smooth talk and careful bluffs. Stealth, hacking, and quick action. You and your crew pull it off every time. Because you’re not just master thieves—you’re master thieves from the future, who bend the very rules of reality when you need to. And you’re going to need to, as your perfect heist encounters astonishing twists and turns in this unique zero-prep new game where players and GM collaborate to create the scenario and the plan at the same time.
sd: You're not just master thieves - you're master thieves from the future! And your ability to bend reality will come in handy as you face unexpected twists and turns in a heist to save reality itself.

t: The Savior of Saint-Marcel (Black Letter Qualifier)
ds: September 1665, France. The Malady has come to an Alpine village. Half are dead; some are still sick, some have been sent down the mountain for safety. Rumors say the Abbot is sending up help, but at the price of some sacrifice? There is hardly anything left to give. Exhausted from the efforts just to survive, and with dwindling supplies and an uneasy fear, the remaining villagers must band together before winter comes...or the Malady takes them all.
sd: 1665, France: A deadly Malady ravages an Alpine village. Most are dead or gone. With winter near and hope fading, the weary survivors must unite as rumors spread of help arriving

ds: *Author-run adventure* After many adventures, you have grown in strength and renown across Faerûn, but lately something just isn’t right. You are happy, wealthy, and content but there something else, like an itch you can’t scratch, or a splinter in your mind that you just can’t reach. Your most recent adventure has you headed to the outskirts of the city of Waterdeep to investigate some missing people and supply shipments for a local merchant, but you can’t help that nagging feeling in the back of your mind that something just feels off. Will you figure out what is going on with the missing shipments and what nags in the deep recesses of your mind? CONTENT WARNING: Blood, Claustrophobia, Possession, Death, Dismemberment, Parasites, Loss of Self, Tentacles, Mind control. SJ-DC-HYS-01 The Hystero. A 4-Hour D&D Adventurers League adventure for Tier 2 Characters (levels 5-10).
sd: Missing supply shipments need investigating, but there is something else, like an itch you can’t scratch, a splinter in your mind, bothering you. A D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 5-10.

t: D&D Adventurers League: Dungeon Crawlers: The Processing (Premiere)
ds: When the gatetown of Automata's slide into Mechanus fails catastrophically, you're trapped in an automated processing facility - a demiplane treating sapient beings like errors to be corrected. Fight through hostile levels, survive deadly trials, and find an exit before the plane collapses. The only way out is down. Welcome to the dungeon, crawlers. Achievement system: activated. Advancement: mandatory. Death: permanent. Pt.1 of the Dungeon Crawlers Series. Inspiration: Elements of this adventure are inspired from Matt Dinniman’s “Dungeon Crawler Carl” novels. If you like this adventure, I can not recommend them enough. *Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author.* CONTENT WARNING: Death, Beheadings, City Destruction, Genocide, Drug use, Profanity, Suggestive language. PS-DC-DCS-01 Dungeon Crawlers: The Processing. A 4-Hour D&D Adventurers League adventure for levels 1-4.
sd: A collapse of a city traps survivors in a demiplane that treats beings like errors to be corrected. The only way out is down. Welcome to the dungeon, crawlers. A D&D AL adventure for levels 1-4.

t: WHPA-13: Nightmares at the TV Station
ds: Rules light, d6 pool-based resolution system that pays homage to the personalities of 80s and 90s public access programming. You and your fellow players are hosts of public access television shows. Hosts that range from chill painting teachers to high-octane fitness instructors to bozo the clown rip-offs. Before the adventure we will build your characters and the town you all reside.
sd: Strange things are afoot at the public-access TV station. Well, stranger than usual. Is that blood part of the campy horror set or did someone actually die in the station you call home?

ds:
You begin as a young knight errant, seeking the glory to lead warbands, earn a place in court, and rule your own domain. Glory is found in hunting the Myths of this world, manifesting them into reality while protecting the Realm from their strange influence. 
 Each player is one of 72 Knights, with personal equipment, a unique ability, and a passion that fuels their spirit. As your glory grows, you might eventually embark on the legendary City Quest, an impossible challenge to find The City itself, a shining metropolis seen only in dreams.
sd: Take the Oath and venture into Myth. You are a Knight, powerful and doomed. Traversing the land in search of something you may not even know.

ds:
About You: You are an elite member of one of two teams of Troubleshooters who will participate in this tabletop session. There will be “friendly” “competition” between the two tables.
 
 About Paranoia: As a Troubleshooter, you are a member of Alpha Complex’s most expendable elite force. Tasked with finding trouble and shooting it, you will be hunting mutants, terrorists, traitors, [CLASSIFIED], secret societies, and renegade bots, which are [REDACTED]. You’ll save Alpha Complex from its greatest threat, unless you accidentally become Alpha Complex’s greatest threat. 
 
 Table Tone: Paranoia is about crazy, collaborative, zany storytelling. We will go where players’ actions take us. No Paranoia experience is required.
 
 Bring a laptop, tablet or mobile device with internet connectivity so you can send direct messages to the GM during the game.
sd: Dive into the chaos. In this session, two (count ‘em) two teams of troubleshooters will “work” “together” to “complete” a “mission” for Friend Computer. No experience required.

t: The Tower of Gaxx: Meatgrinder (for charity)
ds: Join us as we play the game that started it all and remember the man who created an industry. The Meatgrinder is played arcade style with additional generics allowing you to re-spawn and continue your adventures, or new players to rotate in when you're had enough! New events start every hour. As in previous years, this event remains a charity event. Explore the Tower of the mighty Archmage Gaxx, whose awesome wizardly powers led to the rise of a great city in the nearby countryside. But Gaxx was seduced by an evil god, and the ensuing conflict led to the fall and destruction of both the city and his Tower. Come discover, explore, and delve into the deeper levels and chambers found beneath the Tower of Gaxx! What new treasures and artifacts can be found? What deadly traps and monsters lie ready for the unwary adventurer? Walk-ins welcome. Paper tickets accepted.
sd: Are you ready to strap on your sword & shield like it was 1977? Can you survive an old school dungeon designed as Gary Gygax intended: fast & furious with enemies & traps lurking behind every door?

ds:
Friend Computer has identified a bug in the standard cloning process: there is too much duplication of DNA, decreasing its inherent value. To rectify this, your team has been "minted" onto the Alpha-Chain. You are no longer mere clones; you are Unique Digital Assets with real-time market valuations.
 
 In this high-stakes satire of bureaucracy and blockchain, you must transport your team's Validation Token to a secret location within Alpha Complex. To keep your personal market price from going into the red, you’ll need to prove your worth and avoid "Right-Clicker" traitors who want to download your identi-key.
 
 Vibe: dark comedy, dystopian future, creative sandboxing, profitable finger-pointing, snipe hunting, cookie-clicking, peer-to-peer backstabbing.
sd: Congrats! You’ve been minted on the Alpha-Chain. Can you achieve your team's mission objectives while maintaining enough market value to avoid early termination? Failure is non-fungible!

ds: A malformed motorcycle gang didn’t just steal supplies - they took a vital gasoline truck, a crate of rocket launchers, and the governor’s most beloved possession: Immortal Normal, his 33-year-old dog who refuses to die. The town answers by sending its toughest survivors, the PCs, into the desert to hunt down three feuding gang chiefs scattered across miles of hostile terrain.
sd: A gonzo, high-octane post-apocalyptic adventure set in a scorched wasteland. Civilization is gone, replaced by radioactive craters, mutant warbands, and blazing meteors that streak across the sky.

ds: The Soviets have sourced a powerful amnesia drug from a secretive inventor. After months of searching, MI:6 has discovered the middleman for the drug. Elite agents must parachute on to a luxury cruise ship to find the name of the inventor. From there, the agents are embroiled in a global race with the KGB to find the scientist and stop him from selling the drug… or persuade him he’s selling to the wrong side!
sd: A slick, cinematic 1960s spy thriller. In the shadows of the Cold War, British Intelligence uncovers a stolen Russian drug that could rewrite minds, shift power, and tip the balance of the world.

ds: Two-fisted action, mustache-twirling villains and an unfortunate number of things that are just accidents since we know that curses aren't real.
sd: Set in the world of Space:1889. Your adventures must return a cursed Martian artifact to Mars before it destroys civilization. No pressure.

ds: There is no reason that a monster can't decide to save people for a change instead of eating them.
sd: Set in the world of Serpents & Strongholds. "Let me get this straight, the humans kidnapped the princess, and the monsters must save her?" Role reversal in a world of swords and sorcery.

t: Lola Granola and the Undead Cyber-nazis of Mars
ds: Silver-tongued Lola convinces a group of cyber villains to break their programming and turn on their Martian controllers. Game contains occasional drug references and a negative portrayal of Nazis that fans of fascism may find triggering.
sd: What if the only thing standing in the way of an alien invasion of Earth was an elderly hippie and a group of reprogrammed cybernetic monsters?

ds: There is no reason that a monster can't decide to save people for a change instead of eating them.
sd: Set in the world of Serpents & Strongholds. "Let me get this straight, the humans kidnapped the princess, and the monsters must save her?" Role reversal in a world of swords and sorcery.

t: Wake of Blood (Play with a Designer)
ds: Face off against British-aligned frontier militias as you follow reports of burned settlements and massacres, all laid at the feet of one enigmatic, unaccountable American rebel. In this Nations & Cannons game, play as a 3rd-level, historically-sourced character from the American Revolution; complete with new rules for black powder firearms, period-appropriate Backgrounds, and brand-new classes and subclasses. Take on the redcoats and more!
sd: While the Revolutionary War rages, the party sails up the Mississippi River into the heart of darkness to investigate rumors of a rebel expedition gone rogue

t: Flintlock Fantasy: The Salem Reckoning (Play with a Designer)
ds: It has been over 80 years since the last accused witch was killed in Salem, Massachusetts, but the legacy of the infamous Trials is far from buried. Join an elite company of Continental soldiers as they uncover the deadly supernatural secrets behind the Salem Reckoning! In this Nations & Cannons game, you will play as a 4th-level, historically-sourced character from the American Revolution; complete with new rules for black powder firearms, period-appropriate Backgrounds, and brand-new classes and subclasses. Take on the Redcoats and more!
sd: A century has passed since the Trials, but their legacy is not buried. Now, a Reckoning has come to Salem, with the players caught in the middle! Survive the past in this Revolutionary adventure!

t: Whites of Their Eyes: The Battle of Bunker Hill (Play with a Designer)
ds:
Play with the Designer games come with your choice of a PDF of our core Rules or a 10 Dollar booth voucher.
 
 It’s summer, 1776. While the Patriots outside Boston have the British garrison under siege, most of the ragtag militia stationed on Bunker (and Breed’s) Hill has never fired a shot in anger. As the redcoats prepare a fearsome sortie, it falls to you to extract key intelligence before all hell breaks loose! In this Nations & Cannons game, you will play as a 4th-level, historically-sourced character from the American Revolution; complete with new rules for black powder firearms, period-appropriate Backgrounds, and brand-new classes and subclasses. Take on the Redcoats and more!
sd: The British are coming! The ragtag militia in Boston is under threat as a fearsome force of redcoat grenadiers storms the Patriot lines! Can you repulse the enemy in this Revolutionary adventure?

 wo fathers try to avenge their sons, a daughter tries to save her father, and all events lead towards legendary American frontiersman Daniel Boone. gm: Sammi Burch, David Mitchard, Doug Moore, Buster Pishkur, Phil Sorensen, Heather Ashcraft, Grayson Post, Elisa Ford, David Chase
ds:
The league finals are right around the corner and the Arkham Investigators have just concluded the penultimate bout. As the league leaders the honor of hosting the championships falls on them. But, hold on, why is the head ref missing? Where is the Trophy? Not to mention, all the games where things at the Arkham Roller Rink have mysteriously gone wrong. Surely this isn’t some kind of conspiracy orchestrated by the Innsmouth Ancients. But there’s no time to think about that, the Arkham Investigators have a bout to prepare for.
 Join us for a Nascrag Pulp Cthluhu roller derby adventure, with big hits, torn fishnets, weird voices, missing refs, puzzles, mysteries, and…fish?
 Most importantly, where are we going to get the beer for the after party?
sd: The Arkham Investigators are about to host the league championships against the Innsmouth Ancients. Can you host one bout without the mysterious "accidents" that have plagued your team all season?

s: Index Card Role Playing Game - Homebrew
ds: Your team of fantasy heroes has been hired to investigate/eliminate the Cult of Moloch that has infested the cliffs and caves on the edge of the town of New Haven. Climb, Loot, and Fight your way to the top in an attempt to rid the town of the evil cult before they summon the unimaginable. Pre-generated characters and miniatures will be provided. Custom made terrain will consist of a large vertical cliffside and various caves.
sd: Ascend the Cliffs of New Haven and battle the Cult of Moloch and its unimaginable horrors to free the town from the evil that has festered for far too long..

t: I Love You, Olive You Not
ds:
Save room for dinner! The award-winning NYTBS Image comic book series of CHEW is on the menu at a game table near you. The dark & funny food noir about cops, crooks, cooks, & clairvoyants is out now! 
 
 Set in a world where all bird meat (chicken) is illegal after a catastrophic outbreak of the bird flu killed 116 million, the U.S. Food & Drug Administration is now the most powerful law enforcement agency on the planet. As a member of the Special Crimes Division, it is your job to investigate food crimes and to put food-powered criminals behind bars. 
 
 I Love You, Olive You Not: Sometimes broken hearts call for more than an obscene amount of ice cream. The flames of passion are roaring across the city in a very literal way, lighting a path of charbroiled crime scenes. At the heart is a family and a meteorologist who bit off more than she could chew…
sd: The flames of passion are roaring across the city in a very literal way, lighting a path of charbroiled crime scenes. At the heart is a family and a meteorologist who bit off more than she could chew…

t: Wonderbedlam - Inspired by Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
ds:
2023 ENNIE Nominee for Product of the Year and Best Adventure! 
 
 A dark fantasy game of upside-down fairytales, where villains seek redemption, and nothing is as you remember. Play as a who's who of infamous folklore villains—Big Bad Wolf, Baba Yaga, The Pied Piper, and more—each with scene-stealing abilities, sent to investigate events and threats beyond human understanding in an eerie 18th-century Europe.
sd: Rescue Alissa, a defiant young noble, and uncover the sinister secrets lurking within Wonder Asylum—England’s most notorious institution. Will you expose the truth or be lost in the darkness?

t: The Quest for S.T.I.C.K. (Smashing Tool Intended for Crushing and Killing)
ds: Join a band of kobolds high on risk tolerance and low on self-preservation as you try to stay focused on the simple task in front of you. Get to the Leweyville bat factory and find a S.T.I.C.K. Bring it back to King Torg, don't die, and celebrate with a chicken feast and maybe a fire dance. What danger do a few bats present? This is going to be easy! Why are we going out again?
sd: You are Kobolds. The only thing lower than your intelligence is your life expectancy. You have a quest, and that is to find a S.T.I.C.K. before King Torg loses his patience.

ds: Silver-tongued Lola convinces a group of cyber villains to break their programming and turn on their Martian controllers. Game contains occasional drug references and a negative portrayal of Nazis that fans of fascism may find triggering.

ds: This campaign puts immense power in the hands of your characters, but exacts a dire price for their use? An ancient spirit of vengeance has found passage back to the world and found it a ripe field for a harvest of rage . Can you contain your own anger and make the cold hard choices required to stop it? What price would you pay to protect your world from a reign of terror that might never be purged if allowed to take hold and thrive?
sd: A weapon that can harm anything but uses regret for ammo. A Spirit of Rage set to explode and engulf the world. How much would you hurt the ones you love to save the world?

ds:
After the fall of Earth, people hang on by a thread, surviving in orbital colonies and eeking out a living while the megacorps and few remaining governments control the moon and the mega-colonies. Highly educated, deeply trained, you still sacrifice everything to pay for oxygen, food, and radiation-reduced living space. Your crushing debt has led to you being convicted of vagrancy or some other crime, and you are sentenced to the surface to recover materials the colonies need to survive.
 
 This is a playtest of a funnel for a new DCC/MCC mash-up setting from Blind Visionary Publications. Players will get to experience the adventure and provide feedback for improving it as we move towards publication. All players will leave the game with a copy of an Earth Crawl Ashcan 2.0 class!
sd: You are convicted of a crime and sent to the surface of the post-apocalyptic Earth to recover material vital to the survival of the colonies. But will you survive? Playtest a new setting from BVP!

t: This Isn't Even My Final Form
ds: Play teen ninjas in an apocalyptic world, unleashing outrageous special moves to save humanity—then sprinting back to class to survive crushes, quizzes, and the big dance. Roleplay through every punch, rivalry, and desperate comeback as much as the quiet moments between fights. Every fight escalates, every opponent demands more power, and every victory pushes you beyond your limits. Think Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, Naruto, or My Hero Academia!
sd: Create a world on the brink, then play teen ninjas saving it with outrageous martial arts techniques—between classes, crushes, and rivalries. Big feelings, bigger fights, maximum shonen energy.

sd: You are convicted of a crime and sent to the surface of the post-apocalyptic Earth to recover material vital to the survival of the colonies. But will you survive? Playtest a new setting from BVP!

t: When the Bell Rings, We Fight
ds: Play teen ninjas in an apocalyptic world, unleashing outrageous special moves to save humanity—then sprinting back to class to survive crushes, quizzes, and the big dance. Roleplay through every punch, rivalry, and desperate comeback as much as the quiet moments between fights. Every fight escalates, every opponent demands more power, and every victory pushes you beyond your limits. Think Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, Naruto, or My Hero Academia!
sd: Create a world on the brink, then play teen ninjas saving it with outrageous martial arts techniques—between classes, crushes, and rivalries. Big feelings, bigger fights, maximum shonen energy.

ds: Run, run, don’t shrink and cower, and join us at the witching hour!” Atop the highest hill in the gloomy moorland stands a titan made of wicker, casting its crooked shadow over a throng of devotees that sing praises to the Crooked Queen. t: The Crooked Moon: The Drowned Crossroads

ds:
In 229CE, Hadrian's Wall in Britannia, and the brave auxiliary soldiers who man it, provide the physical security for the northern frontier of the mighty Roman Empire. However, only an enlightened few understand the graver supernatural threats lurking amid the dark forests and trackless marshes of the border region - and in the hearts of men. Those enlightened few are yourselves, the Brotherhood of Mithras, who serve among the auxiliaries. 
 The Prefect of your cohort has another mission for you, though thankfully this one seems less politically fraught than the last couple. Villagers from the Brigantes tribe south of the fort have reported an unusually poor harvest, followed by strange disappearances - and for some reason the Prefect seems to care enough to send you to investigate.
sd: Britannia 229CE. A Brigantes village has reported an unusually poor harvest, followed by unexplained disappearances. The Brotherhood of Mithras are sent to investigate.

ds: Many adventurers have heard stories of untold riches stashed away in the mad wizard Arnon’s mysterious keep nestled somewhere deep in the Valris Tops. Some die trying to find it, withering under the scorching desert sun and lost in the sea of identical mountain peaks. Other adventurers - like yourselves - actually made it through the front door to behold an unmatched trove filled with treasures of indescribable form, function, and value. Any single item from this hoard could fund a lifetime of heroic deeds. However, as is so often the case, things may seem a little too good to be true. When the heavy iron door slams shut behind you on the way in and sparks with magic, sealing you inside, you find yourselves with a formidable challenge: to find a way out!
sd: Learn to create characters and play this new game with a special introductory adventure!

ds:
2022 ENNIE Nominee for Best Rules! 
 
 A dark comedy tabletop roleplaying game inspired by the misadventures, cartoon logic, and over-the-top characters of slacker sitcoms like The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, the Regular Show, Rick & Morty, and It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia. 
 
 Plays with a Two-Color Jenga-ish Block Tower and a unique deck of 108 cards that teach the rules, describe characters, and create overarching problems. 
 
 Mature Themes for Immature Play 
 *Contains suggestive themes, crude humor, and strong language.
sd: Fill the shoes of a fed-up deadbeat that happens to share a pad with none other than the Grim Reaper! What can go wrong, does go wrong in this slacker sitcom about bad days and difficult friendships.

t: Murder on the Orien Express: An Eberron One-Shot
ds:
Your party has been invited by Jorlana d'Cannith to attend an international gala celebrating invention and progress. Your passage from Sharn on the maiden voyage of the new luxury express line has been paid for by House Cannith. What should be an easy overnight trip turns complicated as one of the passengers finds a threatening note. 
 
 As the party is asked to find its source, a complex web of lies and secrets is slowly uncovered. Now redesigned from previous years, this roleplay and puzzle-heavy one shot for level 5 characters features physical props and an immersive mystery that the party must work to uncover the truth before the journey ends in blood. 
 
 This original one shot mystery is written and told by Erin (Travel Nerding) - a professional dungeon master who has run games for events such as D3 at Sea as well as running games at multiple conventions across the country.
sd: Tensions rise on the maiden voyage of the new Orien Express. Will your party prevent a murder on the House Orien Express or will you be made to play detective to a passenger's untimely demise?

Now redesigned from previous years, this roleplay and puzzle-heavy one shot for level 5 characters features physical props and an immersive mystery that the party must work to uncover the truth before the journey ends in blood. 
 
 This original one shot mystery is written and told by Erin (Travel Nerding) - a professional dungeon master who has run games for events such as D3 at Sea as well as running games at multiple conventions across the country.
sd: Tensions rise on the maiden voyage of the new Orien Express. Will your party prevent a murder on the House Orien Express or will you be made to play detective to a passenger's untimely demise?

t: Red-Hood Iskra - Inspired by Little Red Riding Hood
ds:
2023 ENNIE Nominee for Product of the Year and Best Adventure! 
 
 A dark fantasy game of upside-down fairytales, where villains seek redemption, and nothing is as you remember. Play as a who's who of infamous folklore villains—Big Bad Wolf, Baba Yaga, The Pied Piper, and more—each with scene-stealing abilities, sent to investigate events and threats beyond human understanding in an eerie 18th-century Europe.
sd: Unnatural beasts terrorize Durfort, and the Papacy demands answers. Inspired by Little Red Riding Hood, this grim fairy-tale hunt explores loss, revenge, and wolves that aren’t fully human.

ds:
In the dark fantasy steampunk setting of Eden; you find yourself invited to the Faultline, a massive wall that divides a city between two country borders. In this adventure you will have the choice of deciding for yourself whether or not you wish to support or go against the revolution by taking matters into your own hands and casting the die with your own hands.
 
 Eden uses a new kind of combat system supporting all 5e content which will be demoed in this adventure. Combat will be challenging; causing players to think using what they learn to solve puzzle-like mechanics as the fights go on. Additionally unique subclasses and classes will be available to try out!
sd: Take part in either the beginning of a violent revolution or take your place as guardians of the status quo to decide the future of not only a city; but the entire country within the world of Eden.

ds: Think Inception (movie) meets Mass Effect! Play unique explorers trained to forge powerful connections with alien worlds on the brink of destruction through their memories and experiences. Race against time, piecing together an impending problem from a muddled memory. Unravel the mysteries of the universe as you discover who you truly are. What makes you tick?
sd: Lost to a frozen planet 350 years ago, a Seeker team has never returned. There, a fabled Seeker’s beacon has awakened while all other life has ceased to exist. What life awaits after all this time?

ds:
In the dark fantasy steampunk setting of Eden; you join a group of travelers who mean to traverse through the mountain pass in order to find the source of a number of disappearances that have occurred over the last few months.
 
 Eden uses a new kind of combat system supporting all 5e content which will be demoed in this adventure. Combat will be challenging; causing players to think using what they learn to solve puzzle-like mechanics as the fights go on. Additionally unique subclasses and classes will be available to try out!
sd: Travel through dangerous territory prowled by a violent creature in the hopes of solving the mystery behind a growing number of disappearing merchants and travelers in the world of Eden.

ds: Both seasoned and new players alike will experience the core components that make Deadlands tick. Deadwood can be a dangerous place but something isn't right about the recent murders just out of town. Made to look like they were done by local Sioux but there's one too many details that don't add up. In turn, a group of Sioux invoke the aid of your Posse to help get to the bottom of the matter to prevent further bloodshed. The further the Posse ventures, the weirder things begin to get. You will have to use quick thinking and even quicker reflexes to survive The Horse Eater.
sd: Many dangers surround the small town of Deadwood, but when a group of Miners are found dead, questions arise. Who were the real murderers and what's got everyone so spooked?

sd: It is 1879, the Age of Steam and Sorcery. A private train steams towards Graz, Austria carrying Humans and Faerie with diverse agendas. War with Prussia may hang in the balance.

ds: Your adventures have brought you to the legendary city of Ath-Cliath. The Norns have woven your fate with that of the gods. Recent grizzly murders cannot be traced to a source. Your rich benefactor has asked you to restore his business pipeline - whatever the cost. You find yourselves embroiled in Otherworldly machinations, can you be the heroes the city needs?
sd: The Norns have woven your fate with the great city of Ath Cliath. Recent grizzly murders cannot be traced to a source. Your rich benefactor has asked you to restore his business pipeline.

t: The Devil’s Due at Broken Keel Bay
ds: This is a fast, brutal one-session descent into salt, blood, and betrayal. Characters are fragile, violence is sudden, and mercy is a liability. Expect boarding actions, cannon fire, rusted blades, mutiny, and the constant threat of drowning. Every choice makes things worse, and the sea does not care who you are or what you believe.
sd: Desperate pirates hunt cursed plunder through storms, mutiny, and blood-soaked decks. Survival not guaranteed.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: While your starship in the Stellar Alliance is monitoring the trajectory of a rogue planet, you receive a call from a nearby Alliance cultural monitoring station. The station's commander has gone missing during a routine visit with the native population...
sd: Become a member of Spacefleet and the Stellar Alliance, and go on a Trek reminiscent of an episode of the long-running sci-fi television show.

t: The Sablewood Messengers w/ GM Atari (200+ Professional Sessions)
ds:
Marlowe Fairwind, the right-hand sorcerer of King Emeris, has gathered her most trusted allies to carry an important package to Hush, a small village within the ancient forest of Sablewood. The crate is large, heavy and sealed with magic, addressed to the Whitefire Arcanist. You’ve been given a map and a carriage, and the promise of reward upon your arrival.
 
 Pre-generated characters will be provided and the rules will be explained during the session. Grab your character, and join this adventure!
sd: You trek through an ancient forest with the King's court sorcerer by carriage, bearing a large, mysterious crate addressed to the Whitefire Arcanist. Atari has hosted over 200 pro sessions on SPG!

ds:
Dwindle is a domain of loss and loneliness: a vast desert realm where memory and mirage are one and the same. On the eve of a much-anticipated dinner, an elderly resident of Dwindle, Forough Khanom, awakes to find her vegetable garden trampled. To save her dinner, the characters must brave the dunes of the departed in search of ingredients from the Sabzi Knoll.
 
 Rules will be taught during the game. Pre-generated characters will be provided during the session.
sd: Based on one of the Feywild Domain of Delight, with a good mix of combat and roleplaying. Perfect for new players that want to learn.

ds:
The city is broken, the lights are still on, and someone is about to get paid.
 
 This is a fast, brutal one-session dive into neon-lit chaos and bad decisions. Characters are fragile, violence is sudden, and implants fail at the worst possible time. Expect tense negotiations, dirty hacks, street-level firefights, and the constant pressure of being hunted by forces with better gear and fewer morals. Every move closes one door and opens a worse one.
sd: Street operators take a high-risk job in a collapsing megacity where tech fails, bullets don’t, and escape is never clean.

t: All Part of the Plan: A Roleplay-Heavy One-Shot
ds: Bummed that every Con game seems to be all about number crunch and combat? Well chin up, adventurer - you’ve found the exception! Join a professional DM and embrace the improv, voice-acting, and quick-witted kind of storytelling that will have you rolling in laughter, and crying tears of joy. While combat can be found here, it is not the focus. These challenges are often best overcome with your social tools - and the reward is what we create together by the end. DM Travis is an improv-leaning professional game master and winner of WotC’s 2025 Homebrew Community Contest - The Realms Will Know Your Name. His winning entry will play heavily in this game as a “party feat” - something you can use together to make the magic happen and reinforce that even the mistakes we make in TTRPGs can be All Part of the Plan.
sd: Join a professional DM and let loose in a wild and role-play focused heist full of mischief and improv. If quick-thinking, improv, and voice-acting are your jam - don't miss this!

ds: Some say Ravomere is cursed. Something didnt go right with the blessing of the Sacred Pyre, or maybe corrupt hands held the Blessed Branch for too long. Whatever the cause, the protections around the city of Ravomere weaken considerably whenever a red moon rises: the Blood Hunters’ Moon. Tonight that same moon will rise, and it will require a miracle just to see the morning light. Lately, the city guards have been picked off by disease or wretched beast and the people are losing hope. The mayor is promising riches, advancement, and more comfortable living for any that can endure the slaughter tonight, but it is a feeble gesture. No one really believes Ravormere will see the dawn… except for you and your team. See, you arent ready to die, and you wont do it tonight in Ravomere of all places. So grab your weapon, and get ready to face the horror ahead. It’s going to be a long night.
sd: Beware! The Blood Hunters' Moon rises as foul creatures from beyond the walls prowl in the city streets. It will take hunters most brutal and defenders most grim to see our city through the night.

ds: When the Iron Collar slavers strike the crossroads village of Waymere, they leave behind ashes, silence, and broken families. Survivors whisper of iron brands, forced marches, and a caravan already vanishing down the old roads. The players take on the roles of heroes drawn into Waymere’s aftermath, whether by duty, conscience, or coincidence. The trail leads through dangerous wilds and hard choices, where every decision weighs freedom against fear. The Iron Collar is ruthless, organized, and unashamed. They are not the only danger waiting along the road. Where Chains Break is a fast-paced Daggerheart one-shot focused on pursuit, consequence, and hope under pressure. Expect tense social encounters, moments of decisive action, and choices that test not just your blades and spells, but your hearts. You may save lives. You may fail. But the world will remember what you chose to do.
sd: When the Iron Collar enslaves a trade village, heroes rise. Chase the slavers, save the innocent, and test your heart in a world that won’t look away.

ds: A heart-pounding blend of high-stakes adventure and shadowy mystery, where larger-than-life heroes chase peril and uncover secrets in a gritty, atmospheric world. Expect daring escapades and dangerous liaisons as you navigate a labyrinth of intrigue and excitement, one twist at a time. Your friend from the Last War shows up at your office after hours with a job for you. A lady says her husband is missing-- a big shot from the upper wards. If you can track him down, there's 50 gold galifars with your name on it. Good luck finding him. It's a big city, and the Watch aren't going to be much help. Eberron is an amazing setting, blending all my favorite genres and tropes in one world. It's all about gray morality and dashing heroes. Adventure is out there! --Pregenerated characters provided, using the new Eberron species from Forge of the Artificer!--
sd: You'll be playing the part of private investigators. Indiana Jones meets Daredevil, in a stunning continent of pulp adventure and noir intrigue. Level 2 pulp noir intrigue.

t: The Sablewood Messengers w/ GM Isaac (500+ Professional Sessions)
ds: Learn all you need to know to get playing the new TTRPG from Darrington Press, the creative team behind Critical Role, the all new Daggerheart! In this one shot adventure, you are tasked with guarding a carriage delivery to a village nobody has heard of, buried deep in the heart of a dark and mysterious forest, the Sablewood. The carriage bears none other than Marlowe Fairwind, the right-hand mage of King Emeris. The most precious cargo, however, is a plain wooden crate with the words "WHITEFIRE ARCANIST" painted on the side. Who is the Whitefire Arcanist? What's in the box? Why is such an important sorcerer traveling into the Sablewood? And why were you invited? Play to find out!
sd: You trek through an ancient forest with the King's court sorcerer by carriage, bearing a large, mysterious crate addressed to the Whitefire Arcanist. Isaac has hosted over 500 pro sessions on SPG!

ds: The 1980s; late night radio. Music, call-ins, and strange characters on-air broadcasting weird vibes through the ether to your ears.
sd: Players will be part of the late night radio crew and will contend with the mysterious goings-on at their small, remote station.

ds: Returning from 2025, this 2nd level, 5.5 Edition has you leaving the cave after a storm to hear the mournful cries of travelers. They tell the tale of seeking shelter in an abandoned mansion, only to be chased out - and left their daughter behind! Can you rescue her? Be warned - this PG-rated adventure highlights combat, exploration, and features a real-world puzzle to solve! Fun for novice and experienced players, happy to help those new to the game. 2025 players wanted a copy of the adventure to take home, so you'll take it home too! Character sheets and dice of course provided.
sd: Returning from rave reviews last year - the low level one shot of Beauty and the Beast! Can you and your fledgling party rescue her from the haunted mansion and - The Beast?

ds: Where love blooms, so does sorrow. This is a Kingdom Hearts-themed RPG with a focus on drama and intrigue using a rules-light PbtA system. Pre-generated characters will be available, though players will also have the option to make their own characters. While there won't be any explicit themes, there will be some emotionally heavy moments.
sd: You have been invited to the wedding of Cinderella and Prince Charming. When tragedy strikes, so must you, or let this world fall into darkness like so many others.

ds:
“Since the Red Star lit the sky, both the Elders and the Sabbat have disappeared. The mortal government now hunts those of us who remain. Yet, we are Kindred. We do not cower from those destined to die in a matter of decades. We adapt, we persevere, we reign. Come celebrate the crowning of those of us who have persevered through modern perils. Who will be crowned at the end of the night?
 Who: Those with Vitae in their veins
 Where: At The Casino located on the Mississippi River between Iowa and Illinois
 Dress Code: Bold and daring. Mysterious and alluring. Grotesque and unforgettable. Wear what brings out the best in you.”
 
 Navigate the politics of the Vampire world in the Quad Cities in what is bound to be a promising night of revelry far from the eyes of the mortal hunters who seek to end you. After all, what could be hiding in the Quad Cities?
sd: You see rows and rows of corn. The Casino is sure to be the best place to cut loose. There's even rumors of competitions and relics. There's nowhere to hide secrets in all that corn, anyway.

ds:
The Emperor has invited all of the greatest fighters in the empire to compete in a grand tournament for the honor of being his new personal bodyguard. There's just one catch; everyone is there in bad faith.
 This is a tale of love, revenge, and kung fu; A soap opera with fight scenes. Pre generated characters will be provided.
sd: The Emperor has invited all of the greatest fighters in the empire to compete in a grand tournament for the honor of being his new personal bodyguard, and everyone is there in bad faith.

ds:
You remember when all you had to worry about was the world ending. But now it's not just the end of the world; it's the end of every world. God-Emperor Jafar's madness has spread across the cosmos, dragging world after world into darkness. You're here to make a desperate last stand - a final strike against his stronghold at Neo-Aggrabah. Your odds aren't good, but it's the only option you have left.
 This is a Kingdom Hearts-themed TTRPG with a heavy emphasis on action and tragedy using the Anima Prime system. Characters will be provided, though players will have the option to make their own.
sd: You've undertaken one last desperate attempt to unseat God-Emperor Jafar from his throne in Neo-Aggrabah.

ds: This is a horror-themed RPG based around the legend of Bluebeard. You and other party members will play as Sisters, a collective of archetypes that together represent the psyche of Bluebeard's bride. Explore the palace that is your new home while uncovering the truth about his former wives, his secrecy, and why you've been forbidden from entering That Room.
sd: Join your Sisters to explore your new palace home and uncover the dark truths about your husband—and the fate that may be waiting just beyond the corner and behind the curtain.

t: The Siege of the Little Apple Inn
ds: Someone at the Government Lab discovered how to make zombies, and the got loose. They go into torpor in daylight, so they always seek the shadows. Your squad of soldiers has ducked into an Inn only to discover civilians still here after they were all supposed to have been evacuated.
sd: Stuck in a hotel, your squads task is to make sure the civilians see the dawn of a new day.

t: Raid of the Tomb of the Elf smiths
ds: The elvin smiths are known for their delicate and complex items of power. Upon their deaths, as rare as that may be, they are normally entombed with the last items they were working on or had completed, not to mention a great deal of other wealth. Heavily magiced, and set with strange protectors only the most foolish would dare to try to raid one of the tombs. After many a harrowing adventure together you and your companions are just the fools to try.
sd: Cursed? Certainly. Guarded? Assuredly. Filled with their final and most potent items of creation? That's why we are going.

t: Big Convention, Little Mermaids - an Out of Water Body Experience
ds: "Those who swim" (mermaids in human language) have come from all the waters of the world to study, make friends, and practice their magic songs. Now, it's time to test their abilities by heading to land for the first time. Each mermaid has a personal goal they'd like to achieve: ride a roller coast, visit a museum, or pet a dog. They must help each other in this strange, dry land to accomplish their goals and return safely to the water in three days.
sd: "Those who swim" have studied hard and are ready to take their first field trip to land. Each has a personal goal they want to achieve in the next three days, and the skills and magic to so.

Now, it's time to test their abilities by heading to land for the first time. Each mermaid has a personal goal they'd like to achieve: ride a roller coast, visit a museum, or pet a dog. They must help each other in this strange, dry land to accomplish their goals and return safely to the water in three days.
sd: "Those who swim" have studied hard and are ready to take their first field trip to land. Each has a personal goal they want to achieve in the next three days, and the skills and magic to so.
