Come play original Advanced Dungeons and Dragons in one of the original gothic horror settings of Ravenloft. Players will be provided premade characters. Adventure slightly condensed to ensure enough time to complete.
 
 Step into the mists of Barovia and discover why Ravenloft is considered one of the most iconic and unforgettable adventures ever written for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons. This isn’t just another dungeon crawl—it’s a masterclass in atmosphere, storytelling, and villainy, centered around the brilliant and terrifying vampire Count Strahd von Zarovich
sd: Your party is summoned into a gothic nightmare, where shifting secrets, undead horrors, and ancient terror await.

By entering the event, you will receive:
 --A set of RPG dice. 
 --Your choice of a medium or small adventurer from those available (we'll have a variety of archetypes from various manufacturers). 
 --A pregenerated character sheet for the game. 
 
 You'll keep the dice, the mini, and the sheet no matter the outcome of the battle, but the player who deals the last point of damage to the monster will keep the monster mini as well.
 
 The prize for this battle is the Epic Encounters: Lair of the Drider from Steam Forged Games. (Note: This event is not affiliated with or endorsed by Steam Forged Games.)
 
 Please see the link for more information about the game, and please don't hesitate to reach out via email if you have questions ahead of time!

ds:
Experience a classic gothic horror adventure set in world of Ravenloft and 1st Edition Advanced Dungeons and Dragons. 
 
 Whispers seep from Gryphon Hill Manor, long abandoned after its guests vanished in a single night. Now the Hollow Guest—an echoing mysterious figure —stalks its long silent halls. As the manor shifts and memories come alive, heroes must uncover the truth before they, too, become hollow.
 
 Rules will be taught and premade characters will be provided.
sd: A cursed manor sits vacant, its halls echoing with the whispers of the dead. To break the curse, the heroes must face the house’s horrors and uncover the family’s buried secret.

t: The Tower of Gaxx: Special Event (for charity)
ds:
Are you itching to try your hand at surviving an old school pre-1978 D&D module? Are you good enough to solve the puzzles before time runs out? Can you work with your fellow adventurers and outsmart the monsters?
 
 Veteran DM Mike Boehm hosts a longer old school adventure. He has amassed a vast collection of modules from the early years of D&D. This is a limited engagement with five separate games scheduled; two each on Thursday, and Friday and one on Saturday. 
 
 Join us as we play the game that started it all and remember the man who created an industry. 
 As in previous years, this premium event remains a charity event. This is NOT a tournament.
sd: Are you ready to strap on your sword & shield like it was 1976? This 4 hour event features one of our veteran DMs and has the party going through a module from his vast collection.

t: The Tower of Gaxx: Tomb It May Concern Event (for charity)
ds:
Are you itching to try your hand at surviving one of the more challenging modules created by Gary Gygax? First revealed to the public at Origins I in 1975, Gary designed this adventure to test and challenge expert players. The Tomb of Horrors introduced to players the value of lugging around the ubiquitous 10 foot pole. It also opened their eyes to how deadly traps and puzzles can (and should) be.
 
 Veteran DM Stewart “the man of many voices” Beach hosts. This is a limited engagement with two separate games scheduled; one on Thursday and one on Saturday. 
 
 Join us as we play the game that started it all and remember the man who created an industry. 
 As in previous years, this premium event remains a charity event. This is NOT a tournament.
sd: Dare to enter the Tomb of Acererak, many have entered, none have returned! This Tomb of Horrors has been the demise of many an adventurer. Enter, and meet your worst nightmare!

t: The Tower of Gaxx: Retro Event (for charity)
ds:
Looking to play something more retro than 1st Edition AD&D? Relive the days of original (not Advanced) D&D with a run-through of an Official GenCon IX Tournament Dungeon (August 1976) tweaked to allow 8 players to participate. Veteran DM Jesse Anderson hosts this longer old school adventure. Prior experience with older versions of D&D is recommended. 
 
 Premise: Your party has offended a great and powerful (and slightly confused) wizard, and he has asked you to retrieve a wand -or was it a staff- that was borrowed (or maybe stolen) from him long ago. 
 
 This is a limited engagement with two separate games scheduled; one on Friday and one on Saturday. 
 
 Join us as we play the game that started it all and remember the man who created an industry. 
 As in previous years, this premium event remains a charity event. This is NOT a tournament.
sd: Lost for years in a box in a basement, a vague memory led to a dedicated hunt to find this treasure from 1976! This 4 hour event features one of our taller DMs and has the party questing for an item.

t: Storming the Poplar Palisades: A Mossflower Tale
ds:
The vile Tsarmina Greeneyes has built a new fort in the heart of Mossflower Wood, intent on crushing the woodland rebellion from outside the walls of Kotir. 
 
 With Dinny, Martin, and Gonff searching for the Lord of fabled Salamandastron, the Council of Resistance in Mossflower has asked its bravest warriors to destroy the fort to allow enough time to flood the halls of Kotir. Can you rise to the challenge?
sd: The evil wildcat Tsarmina has built a fort in the heart of Mossflower Forest. Can you destroy the fort and give Martin the Warrior enough time to return from Salamandastron?

ds:
To the Esteemed Masters of the College,
 I write at the urging of several concerned townsfolk regarding a matter we are ill-equipped to resolve. A local child, Ingrid, daughter of the late Hrolf, has been claiming with increasing insistence that she sees her father standing outside her window at night. The man was buried a month past, and no one has seen anything amiss.
 Most believe the girl is simply struggling with her grief. Still, her stories have become persistent, detailed, and disruptive. She refuses to sleep, speaks of footsteps where none are found, and has begun frightening other children. It is unsettling the village, and we would prefer the matter settled.
 If this is nothing, we ask that you put the child’s fears to rest. If it is something more, we believe it wiser that the College investigate before rumor and superstition take hold.
 —Signed, on behalf of the village
sd: In the cold lands of Skyrim, villagers have asked the College of Winterhold to investigate a child's claim that her dead father has returned, while many in the village insist it is nothing.

ds: You don't remember all the details of your life, and you especially don't remember being put in stasis. Now you're tasked to save a colony where everyone will return at some vague timeline given by a hologram of an old woman who you know is keeping secrets. The land needs help if you're to make it livable, and you have to do it soon. Will you do everything you need to help the colony come back to full strength? Should you? A game about piecing together the past to determine what will be your future.
sd: Do you trust the instructions left by the hologram you saw when you first woke up? A mystery with some puzzles, some exploration, and a touch of amnesia.

The land needs help if you're to make it livable, and you have to do it soon. Will you do everything you need to help the colony come back to full strength? Should you? A game about piecing together the past to determine what will be your future.
sd: Do you trust the instructions left by the hologram you saw when you first woke up? A mystery with some puzzles, some exploration, and a touch of amnesia.

ds:
For 29 years I’ve run silly games at Gen Con by taking two unlike genres and slamming them together to see what dumb stuff comes out. It’s time for one final rerun of this adventure before this Lego set retires forever!
 
 Get ready to explore the world of “Red Dragon’s Tale” as the cast of “The Lego Movie” on a fully built Lego adventure map! Use your creativity and skills as a master builder to create items to use in game! Can you save the realm and discover who is behind a nefarious plot to conquer reality? Or at least earn some delicious hot wings? Don’t worry if you don’t know the difference between Ninjago and Thac0, you’ll be laughing by the end!
 
 Rules light and fun heavy!
sd: Everything is still awesome! Play through the Dungeons and Dragons Lego adventure “Red Dragon’s Tale” as Emmet, Wyldstyle, Unikitty, and the rest!

ds:
For 29 years I’ve run silly games at Gen Con by taking two unlike genres and slamming them together to see what silly stuff comes out. Well, this year, we’re getting meta, because we’re not only mashing up genres, but game systems as well!
 
 For the first time ever, Toon is collaborating with Advanced Dimensional Green Ninja-Educational Preparatory Super-Elementary Fortress 555 from Windmill Games! In this insane crossover, you’ll be playing as a group of cartoons whose show just got canceled! The only way to survive is to infiltrate another show. You’ll be going up against another table of gamers playing as the cast of ADGNEPSEF555 while you and your team try to devise a way to become the new stars! Can you reclaim your former glory, or will you be a flop?
sd: Your show was canceled! Your group of studio rejects have decided to infiltrate and take over another popular show! Can you reclaim your role as a star or will you end up on the cutting room floor?

t: ADGNEPSEF555: The Movie!! The LARPening! (Secret Go-Racer's Birthday)
gm: J. Akira Barnes, Brian Keller, Adam Davis, Paul Krautstrunk, Andrew Oswell, ANDY NETZEL, Wendy Davis
ds:
Welcome back, my friends, to the show that never ends! Prepare for the diggety-fourth-most amazing thing in the history of the Multiverse - Advanced Dimensional Green Ninja-Educational Preparatory Super-Elementary Fortress 555!
 
 Will there actually be a plot - or, as usual, will we will throw silly things like "continuity", "canon", or "hammers" out the window! Who can say? However, this Very Special Episode was written to celebrate the 30-ish-th anniversary of ADGNEPSEF555 and the 50th anniversary of its Bald Head Writer, Akira! Coming soon to a theater near your dimension! 
 
 Experience the best cartoon that ever was, is, or shall be with classmates who are monster trainers, scientists, army brats, moon princesses, and more in an anime-themed cross-dimensional gradeschool. Come play with us, even if you don't know what's going on! (ESPECIALLY if you don't know what's going on!)
sd: It’s Secret Go-Racer’s birthday! Shenanigans and shinolagans abound at celebration of the Multiverse's coolest go-kart racer! Candy and crayons provided, TVY7 rated. What is this, plot? Sure, I guess?

lo: JW White River Ballroom E HQ
ds: The crew of the aging hauler USCSS Fidanza is en route to Jeremiah VI, a remote mining colony, on a routine supply and salvage run. But the colony has gone dark—and what little signal gets through speaks of cult violence, corporate lockdowns, and something unearthed deep below. Caught between zealots, panicked workers, and Weyland-Yutani operatives, the crew holds the only ticket off-world. Something is down there—and it’s waiting for them.

t: Mystery Inc.: Whispers Beneath Still Waters
ds: Beyond the comforts and noise of the modern world, in the midst of Lovecraft Country along old route 12 lies Stillwater Lake. A picturesque, but somber expanse of dark, glassy depths. To local developer Blake Nedley, the tomblike silence of this New England locale would be a perfect place to develop a lakeside neighborhood. However, two local schoolchildren recently vanished along the lake’s shore, their final footsteps ending where the reeds grow thick. As members of the newly expanded Mystery Inc., you have been hired to find out what happened to these children, to allay reticent mysteries, and dispel fears of foul play.
sd: Two local schoolchildren recently vanished at Stillwater Lake. As members of the newly expanded Mystery Inc., you have been hired to solve this dark mystery and ally fears of foul play.

ds: Sunnydale is in the grips of a Christmas season that could only come from the Hellmouth: bizarre outbreaks of holiday cheer, random appearances by aging celebrities, and musical numbers. The whole town is losing it. And what the heck is Life Day?! The Scoobies really, really need to figure out what is causing this, and end it. Inspired by the Star Wars Holiday Special, you have been warned.

ds:
Stardate 6872.2: The USS Ranger and the science vessel USS Kenyon are in orbit around Torvus IV to survey the newly discovered ruins of a long dead civilization. We have temporarily dubbed this civilization the “Torvans” and initial surveys suggest that they might have been on the brink of achieving warp flight before mysteriously going extinct.
 	While the Kenyon crew continue to survey the surface ruins, the Ranger’s crew will be scouting a freshly discovered burial necropolis to remove any safety concerns for the archeological teams. The passages are quite deep and have hidden deposits of toxic gases. However, thus far the mission has continued to proceed smoothly and it is my sincere hope that it will continue to do so.
sd: Stardate 6872.2: The USS Ranger and Kenyon are currently orbiting Torvus IV to survey newly discovered ruins with the Ranger's crew running safety and security of the mission.

ds: A generation after the Battle for Hogwarts, a student has been murdered. Is the threat a new one, or an old one renewed? Will Hogwarts finally be shrouded in darkness? Or will the students rise to the challenge of protecting their beloved school?

t: Fangs Gallery: Stripped Down Convention Edition
gm: Ryvre Hardrick, Haven Follmar, Daniel Dziubinski
ds:
Fangs Gallery is an art gallery and collective known for experimental pop art and provocative art films. Dozens of careers have been launched at Fangs Gallery, and some have even gained mainstream popularity. The gallery opening has brought together an eccentric mix of artists, musicians, drag queens, gallery employees, and society trendsetters—and, of course, vampires. Characters and setting are loosely based on Andy Warhol's factory. 
 
 Fangs Gallery is set in the World of Darkness using custom mechanics. Costumes encouraged. New larpers welcome! More information is available at the link provided.
sd: A rules-light vampire LARP inspired by Andy Warhol's Factory, punk music, & LGBTQ+ history. This is a stripped-down version of our boutique LARP with fewer props but all the gay yearning.

ds: The StoryPop team is excited to bring one of our most beloved games to Gen Con this year – please join us for this one-of-a-kind experience! The local tavern is abuzz with rumors of a hidden treasure as two fearsome pirate captains compete to recruit a top-notch crew. Will your choices lead you to unimaginable riches… or the bottom of the sea? Journey to a world of cannons and cutlasses through three rounds of social gameplay with help from the StoryPop app. You’ll role play an assigned character with motivations and unique objectives to complete. Your actions and decisions will shape how the story unfolds, so you’ll need cunning, courage, and charm in order to come out on top. Interact with fellow players to uncover hidden agendas, forge alliances, and chart your own course for adventure!
sd: Embrace the pirates’ life and join the hunt for buried gold in this immersive, app-guided role playing experience.

t: The Call Between the Stars, Act 5
ds:
The final year of The Call Between the Stars begins, bringing a space-spanning epic of Cthulhian scale toward its long-awaited conclusion. The Yithians stand on the edge of reclaiming their lost homeworld as ancient forces stir once more across forgotten sectors.
 
 Old allies return. Long-buried truths surface. The enemy that has haunted the journey steps fully into the light, threatening not only worlds, but the fragile threads connecting past, present, and future.
 
 And still the derelict continues its impossible voyage through the stars, carrying secrets that may decide everything.
 
 The end approaches. Whether it is victory, defeat, or something far stranger remains to be seen.
sd: The final year of The Call Between the Stars, a space epic of Cthulian proportions! Yithians fight for their home, ancient enemies rise, and our long voyage nears its end. The stars remember.

ds: Mutant-zombie horror in the year 1390! Those who die are revived with mutations. Take on the roles of Pilgrims condemned to work in the haunted mines underneath Paris. Explore a world packed with intrigue and brutal combat. No experience required. Pregens provided. Play with the game's co-developer!
sd: Historical Body Horror - when you die you may gain powers!

ds: There had always been rumors flying about that there was a hidden, secret temple beneath the Sphinx at Giza, going back as far as King Tut. Four years ago in 1922, Carter found clues that make you think it is more than just legend. Now the race is on to see who will be the first to uncover the hidden chamber, and what secrets may lie within.
sd: In 1922, clues emerged to the entrance of a hidden temple below the Sphinx. Four years later, the race is on to see who will be the first to uncover its secrets!

gm: Haven Follmar, Ryvre Hardrick, Daniel Dziubinski
ds: By the decree of the Traitor Empress, it is the year 1899, & London is a shadow of what it once was. It would be heretical to suggest it's been 1899 for over six decades, but some whisper it nonetheless. As time passes on the Surface, it has become more difficult for the Empress to maintain control. A delegation has arrived in Port Carnelian to negotiate the fall of the Sixth City. Costumes recommended--document your look in our Neathy photo booth. New larpers welcome! More information is available at the link provided.
sd: Get ready for Great Game shenanigans, Neo-Ottomans, & contraband miniskirts as the Man on Five negotiates the fall of the Sixth City!

ds:
First, let us take the time to state that we are allies of the LGBTQ+ communities. Our love of the Wizarding World does not confer agreement with the divisive and harmful statements "She Who Must Not Be Named" has made. Everyone is welcome to participate. 
 
 This Bi-Wizard Tournament celebrates a time before the decree of secrecy. Weaving in historical figures & Arthurian legends among wizards and witches. There will be competition to determine each school's champion. Unless the tournament is prevented, of course.
sd: Hogwarts & Beauxbatons are considering a cooperative tournament to evaluate students. Will the schools manage to work together to create the first Bi-Wizard tournament in 1136? Highly replayable.

t: No One Enters Mr. Roy's House
ds:
Tonight, the most powerful voices in country music gather for a private summit about the genre’s future. Sales are shifting. Tradition is fraying. Something, many insist, has gone wrong.
 
 The meeting’s timing is not accidental. It marks the 30th anniversary of Roy Acuff’s death, a name spoken with reverence… and, by a select few, with unease.
 
 Because when the current Opry House opened in 1974, the celebration did not end when the audience went home. Behind velvet curtains and locked doors, a quiet pact was made. Roy Acuff and several others struck a deal with something ancient, something that promised influence, longevity, and a sound that would endure across generations.
 
 For decades, the bargain held.
 
 Now the music is changing. Careers falter. Legends fade too quickly. The signs are unmistakable to those who know where to look. The pact must be renewed.
sd: Country music’s elite gather to “save the genre” on the 30th anniversary of Roy Acuff’s death. Behind closed doors lies the truth: a pact made in 1974 demands renewal… and possibly a life.

ds: Explore your world—after humanity. Enjoy player-empowering rules and explore a strange suburbia full of useful Stuff and terrifying Beasts. Think Mausritter/Wanderhome meets Ren & Stimpy/SpongeBob. Play with the co-developer! Pregens provided.
sd: Play as a cartoon animal on a Saturday-morning show!

t: The Seance at the House DeMarcio, Part 2
ds:
The after effects of last year's game "The Last Seance at the House DeMarcio,"friends and family" of the deceased find themselves pulled into the realm of the dead and desperately trying to escape. What began as a display of power by a wealthy occultist spiraled into catastrophe when the ritual surged beyond control, dragging several guests into the realm of the dead and leaving the living to wonder what could possibly returned.
 
 Now the aftershocks have begun.
sd: Break on Through to the Other Side. One year ago, the DeMarcio estate became the site of a seance that shattered the boundary between worlds.

ds:
The hottest disco in New York City pulses through a sweltering night in 1978. The dance floor is packed with everyone who matters and everyone who wants to: musicians chasing their next hit, scene kids chasing fame, celebrities hiding in plain sight, record executives making quiet deals, dealers working the shadows, and those who simply came to dance until morning. 
 
 But tonight is not just another perfect night under the mirror ball. 
 
 Someone believes this is the ideal moment to ascend, to shed the limits of flesh and become something luminous, eternal, untouchable.
 
 Someone else believes disco itself is a corruption that must be erased, and that a single spectacular act will make this place a warning.
 
 The music is loud. The air is electric. And before the night ends, the dance floor may become a threshold.
sd: The hottest disco in 1978 NYC burns bright! Celebrities, dealers and dancers pack the floor as plans unfold: one to ascend beyond humanity and one to destroy disco, no matter who burns with it.

t: The Hunger Within the Web: A Dark Wood Elf horror adventure
ds: Players explore a dark fantasy adventure set inside a vast living web corrupting an ancient wood elf forest. Exploration and combat drive the fight to stop its spread.
sd: Players explore a dark fantasy adventure set inside a vast living web corrupting an ancient wood elf forest. Exploration and combat drive the fight to stop its spread.

sd: Players explore a dark fantasy adventure set inside a vast living web corrupting an ancient wood elf forest. Exploration and combat drive the fight to stop its spread.

gm: Jess Geyer, Haven Follmar, Alexander Sprague, Daniel Dziubinski, Ryvre Hardrick
ds:
The Museum of Curiosities is holding a gala auction of its collection, and you're amongst the invitees. These objects aren't simply oddities: they are relics of power, and there's more than one guest who covets them for their own purposes. Depending on who wins their lot, the whole world could change at the final strike of the gavel. And what ulterior motives do the museum staff have to sell these items now? 
 
 Out of the Archive is a collaboration between Wannabe Games and Goblin Market. It's inspired by administrative horror such as the SCP Foundation and the Magnus Archives. 
 
 Costumes encouraged. New larpers welcome!
sd: An atmospheric LARP inspired by administrative horror such as the SCP Foundation & the Magnus Archives.

t: Ghost Market Heist in Doskvol’s Docks
gm: Bobby White, Jerry Cochran, Bobby White
ds:
A lucrative job pulls your crew into the chaos of the docks, where a captured spirit must be moved quietly through a packed market. What begins as a straightforward operation quickly unravels as competing interests emerge and the waters themselves seem to react to your presence.
 
 Players take on the roles of scoundrels making bold choices under pressure, balancing stealth, negotiation, and risk as complications escalate. The session emphasizes collaborative storytelling and momentum driven play, guiding participants through a complete mission from planning to fallout.
 
 Run by the Haunted Hauls podcast crew, known for character driven play and immersive heists, this experience is designed to be approachable while still delivering tension and drama.
sd: Smuggle a bound spirit through a crowded dockside market while rival crews interfere and something dangerous stirs beneath the harbor.

t: The Last Voyage of the Eluria
ds:
A deep sea exploration team vanishes without explanation in the Bahamas, only to find themselves abruptly displaced to the Arctic, their vessel locked in shifting ice far from any known route.
 
 As temperatures plunge and equipment begins to break down, survival becomes the only priority. Supplies must be rationed. Risky excursions across the ice become unavoidable. Every decision carries weight. And beneath the frozen water, something moves.
 
 The crew must endure the cold, the isolation, and the growing certainty that they were not brought here by accident.
sd: A deep sea exploration team disappears in the Bahamas and reappears in the Arctic, their vessel trapped in crushing ice. Cut off from rescue, they face failing equipment, lethal cold, and much worse.

ds:
Masks flood the city. Silk rustles across bridges lit by lantern glow. Nobles, merchants, sailors, performers, and strangers move together through crowded piazzas where identity dissolves and anything feels possible.
 
 Carnevale has always blurred the boundary between roles, between truth and performance, between the living and what waits beyond. This year, the veil feels thinner.
 
 Some have come to forget the world is changing. Some have come to profit from it. Some believe the city stands at the edge of transformation, and that Carnevale is not distraction, but ritual.
 
 The bells will ring. The masks will remain. And before Carnevale ends, Venice may decide what it is willing to become.
sd: Venice, 1348. Carnevale arrives in candlelight as masks hide rank, identity...and illness. Private invitations circulate. Some come to celebrate. Some come to bargain. Some come because they must.

ds:
Step right up to The Wandering Menagerie, a traveling circus that drifts between worlds under the watch of a ringmaster who is far older than he should be. Beneath the bright tents and impossible feats, every performer is bound by glittering contracts, their acts fueled by devotion, despair, and forgotten prayers.
 
 Guests arrive as spectators, supplicants, or prey. Some seek power, purpose, or immortality beneath the big top. Others come to break the chains and free the souls within. Every choice feeds the circus, and every revelation carries a cost. The show must go on. Whether you walk away is another matter.
sd: Step into The Wandering Menagerie, a circus drifting between worlds. Wonder dazzles, bargains bind, and every act feeds an elder god. Spectators may leave changed…if they leave at all.

ds:
The Miwok Mine made legends in ’49, turning a small crew of miners into sudden fortunes. Gold came quickly, richer than anyone expected, and for a moment it felt like luck alone had chosen them.
 
 Ten years later, most of that original crew is gone. Some died wealthy. Some vanished. Some walked away and refused to speak of the mine again.
 
 Now heirs, rivals, and opportunists gather to divide what remains. Old maps resurface. Sealed shafts draw attention. Because the gold may still be there…along with whatever made them leave.
sd: The Miwok Mine made fortunes in ’49. Ten years later, few of the original miners remain. Heirs, rivals, and opportunists gather to divide what’s left… and learn what the mine kept.

ds: 250 years after the end of the 18th century Goblin Rebellion. This is a murder mystery with theft, pride, & power at the heart of it. Will you fight to protect the artifacts, or will you scheme to make them your own? Highly replayable.
sd: Artifacts of magical & political value are traveling on the Hogsmeade Express from King's Cross. Dark wizards, Goblins, & others will kill to possess them. Protect the artifacts or take them?

ds:
A PbtA game about knightly quests and coming of age, inspired by Arthurian legends, fairy tales, Tamora Pierce's Tortall books, and Magic: The Gathering's plane of Eldraine. The game is in-development from Cloven Pine Games. It uses modular playbooks where each character is created by combining two playbooks that form two halves of a heraldic shield, e.g. The Stag and The Anvil, or The Fox and The Oak.
 
 In this scenario, the Knight-Aspirants are called upon to protect a seaside town from a terrifying apparition—The Drowned Knight. Why has he been dragging villagers off into the mist, and how will he strike next?
sd: You are aspiring knights, venturing into the wild reaches of the realm on a quest to prove yourselves worthy. What wrongs will you right and lessons will you learn along the way?

ds: An island where anything that has ever been lost can reappear. Whether memories or mementos, they reside here forever. Competitors should beware, there seems to be something supernatural at work behind the scenes.
sd: Deathmatch Island Productions presents a once in a life time adventure to the exclusive Adrift Island! Occultist on a Life or Death Game show, what could ever go wrong?

ds: Tonight, we plan the perfect heist… or at least the best one we can manage with what we’ve got. In this fast-paced, collaborative storytelling game, players become the crew behind an ambitious museum theft. You’ll case the museum, debate risky strategies, invent clever tools, and improvise solutions when everything inevitably goes wrong. Every decision shapes the plan, and every twist forces the crew to think on their feet. Success depends on teamwork, creativity, and quick thinking.
sd: The Object - Ancient Egyptian artifact, The Place - The Chicago Field Museum, The Budget: Shoestring. Let's plan a heist and see how good our problem solving is in the moment.

ds: An unlikely group of explorers get dragged into one of the most complex cases the Order of Silence has ever faced. It's up to them to finally put an end to the Darkest House, an entity whose only desire is for ruin and hate.
sd: Let us explore the depths of an estate that has no intentions of ever letting go. What happens when you try and stop something that has had centuries to prepare.

ds: 100 million years in the future, you work for a greedy space company with portals to many worlds… You play a “voidminer”—a salvager working for the Worshipful Company. Will you do your job or turn against the Co.'s directors? Play a one-shot intro with elements of exploration, diplomacy, & combat with the game's designer! Pregens provided. No experience needed to play.
sd: Politically charged, humorously weird, easy-to-learn sci-fi: take on a simple job for the Co. to travel back to Terra and explore a crashed alien ship. How dangerous could it be?

ds: You're doing the tough job of redistributing wealth on earth in early modern period (c. 1700). PICARO! puts you in the saddle of a picaresque-inspired adventure as a band of rogues and scallywags lightening the purses of the wealthy. Pull fantastical capers in a magickally-historic version of our world. Learn the rules-light, player-empowering Grit System as you play! Increase your infamy to become the people's hero! Pregens provided.
sd: Rob aristocrats with guns, swords, or eldritch wytch-craft—the choice is yours!

ds:
When a top secret Cold War mission vanishes in the Arctic after a catastrophic plane crash, a hastily assembled recovery team is sent north with urgent orders: secure the mission, find any survivors, and ensure nothing falls into Soviet hands.
 
 The wreck lies far off known routes, scattered across unforgiving ice. Questions surface immediately. Was the crash an accident, or sabotage? Why was the aircraft operating so far north in the first place?
 
 As the team pushes into the coldest front of the Cold War, they must contend with brutal conditions, limited time, and the growing suspicion that the mission carried more than anyone was told.
sd: A top secret Arctic mission crashes in the Cold War’s frozen frontier. A recovery team races the Soviets to reach the wreck, the survivors, and the truth before the ice claims it all.

ds: Mutant-zombie horror in the year 1390! Those who die are revived with mutations. Take on the roles of Pilgrims condemned to work in the haunted mines underneath Paris. Explore a world packed with intrigue and brutal combat. No experience required. Pregens provided. Play with the game's co-developer!
sd: Historical Body Horror - when you die you may gain powers!

ds:
In 1955, the Hopewell Institute stands as America’s premier paranormal research facility, called when events defy explanation. When military intelligence intercepts a strange broadcast that appears to be counting down, attention turns to a town suddenly gripped by escalating violence.
 
 Hopewell investigators are deployed, bringing their own unusual abilities to the field. The signal persists. The tension rises. Something is building.
 
 To stop what’s coming, they must decode the message, uncover the source of the chaos, and act before the countdown reaches zero.
sd: 1955. Hopewell Institute investigators are sent to a town gripped by violent crime and a mysterious countdown broadcast. The signal is real. The clock is running.

ds: 100 million years in the future, you work for a greedy space company with portals to many worlds… You play a “voidminer”—a salvager working for the Worshipful Company. Will you do your job or turn against the Co.'s directors? Play a one-shot intro with elements of exploration, diplomacy, & combat! Pregens provided. No experience needed to play.
sd: Politically charged, humorously weird, easy-to-learn sci-fi: take on a quick job for the Co. to travel to an undiscovered place and report back about what you find. Keep your wits about you!

ds:
Unusual activity surrounding a remote island prompts the UN to send a team of scientists, scholars, and a reporter to investigate. What they find are towering monoliths unlike any known structure, older than record and impossible to ignore.
 
 Closer study reveals their purpose: they are not monuments, but prisons.
 
 Now one monolith shows signs of failure. Hairline fractures spread. Instruments register impossible readings. The team must uncover how these structures were made, why they exist, and whether they can be repaired before whatever waits inside breaks free.
sd: Strange activity draws a UN team to a remote island where ancient monoliths stand silent. One is beginning to crack, and whatever lies inside was never meant to be free.

ds: 100 million years in the future, you work for a greedy space company with portals to many worlds… You play a “voidminer”—a salvager working for the Worshipful Company. Will you do your job or turn against the Co.'s directors? Play a one-shot intro with elements of exploration, diplomacy, & combat with the game's designer! Pregens provided. No experience needed to play.
sd: Politically charged, humorously weird, easy-to-learn sci-fi: take on a simple job for the Co. to travel to a distant terraformed world and find a target. But can you trust your bosses?

ds:
Inside the Wesleyan Church, women gather to demand recognition, agency, and a voice in shaping the future. Speeches are written. Alliances form. History begins to shift. Yet not every witness sits among the delegates.
 
 From the upper gallery, something unseen lingers through every meeting, every declaration, every moment of courage. It listens as names are signed and convictions harden.
 
 As the movement finds its voice, a quiet question emerges: who else is listening…and what do they intend to do with what they hear?
 
 ("The Silent Gallery" is a scenario written and facilitated by a female creator, which prioritizes and celebrates femme perspectives. While all are welcome to take part, the focus of this game is on amplifying the feminine journey. We warmly invite ALL femme-identifying individuals to take the lead in telling this story.)
sd: Seneca Falls, 1848. Women and their allies gather to demand their place in history. As voices rise and change begins, a silent presence judges from the gallery above.

gm: Alexi Sargeant, Brian Lagoda, Leah Sargeant
ds:
Join us for a mutli-table, multi-GM Masks-stravaganza. Your young superheroes live in different decades, but you all must protect the same scientist (as a kid, a college student, and an adult) from time-warping attackers. 
 
 This five-hour crossover adventure will integrate three tables of Masks. Your characters will have the chance to warp between Halcyon’s City’s past, present, and future as you jump from one table to the next. What kind of hero are you growing up to be?
sd: It’s the crossover event of the summer, as three teams of teenage superheroes, in three different eras of Halcyon City, scramble to protect the same brilliant inventor from time traveling villains.

ds:
The Titans of Tomorrow (West Titans), are the future versions of members of the Teen Titans. They have assumed the roles of their late mentors and have restructured themselves as an extremely violent group called the Titans. This alternate timeline branched from the regular New Earth timeline. 
 
 In the Titans Tomorrow era, many of Earth's foremost heroes died during this event, paving the way for an era of cold and darkness. The United States of America was split into two factions, East and West. The former Teen Titans regrouped and established a base of operations at their previous Titans Tower HQ in San Francisco. A renegade group of Titans, that maintained a more heroic outlook, re-established themselves in New York City and became known as Titans East.
 
 In this scenario the group can choose to play as either the darker Titans West, or play as the heroic Titans East.
sd: Kobra Cult has grown ever bolder in their attacks against U.S. West installations. Fairwell, NV seems to be a major recruitment center for them. The Titans West have been ordered to end them for good.

t: Buffy the Vampire Slayer : The End of the World
ds: Saving the world is stressful. Can Buffy save the world...again? Can she do it & keep the Scoobies together at the same time? Buffy & the Scoobies face another great challenge & a whole lot of mundane frustrations. Will they get out of their own way and come together to defeat the big bad?
sd: Buffy and the Scoobies have faced the end of the world; this is just another apocalypse, right? Will this be the end of the world or just the end of Buffy & the Scoobies?

ds:
This takes place during the first year of the original New Mutants. They attend the Xavier School for Gifted Children. With a world that fears and hates them, they know they must succeed to show that they deserve to remain at school. 
 
 Noticing a group of teenagers outside the mansion grounds, they're ready to let off some steam. Play as either Cannonball, Sunspot, Mirage, Wolfsbane, Karma or Magik.
sd: It's the night before the final academic exams for the New Mutants. They can't sleep. What happens if they fail? While awake they notice a group of teens skulking outside the mansion grounds.

t: It's only forever...Not long at all!
ds:
This will be an in and out job. Some loud, drunk, too-much-coin-in-his-pocket merchant in the Yawning Portal bet your wizard a hefty amount of money that the party couldn't bring back a lich's claw from Undermountain in 13 hours. Like he's even SEEN a liches claw! Your party will just find a zombie or the like and bring back its hand. The magic of the living dungeon has other plans. Welcome to the labyrinth! You have 13 hours to solve it...or be stuck here forever!
 
 5 Players will be given pre-made characters
sd: They thought they were just going into Undermountain for a laugh. One wrong turn and now the way back has vanished! The only way out is through a mad labyrinth!

ds:
Our group has hosted eight seasons of a Survivor Gen Con live action event. This year we decided to present a game experience that requires less of a time commitment, but retain the fun. Whether your a fan of the Survivor TV show or not, it's a chance to have fun in a group game that captures the Survivor experience.
 
 Gift card prize awarded to Sole Survivor.
sd: Play a homebrew system that is a cross between the party game and live-action Survivor elements. Participate in tribal council, challenges, idols & (of course) outwit, outplay & outlast.

ds:
The Heroes for Hire organization is a loosely knit network of heroes willing to offer their services for the right cause and a decent paycheck. Led by Misty Knight and Colleen Wing they hand-pick the right heroes for the job. 
 
 This time your client has inherited a large sum of money after the passing of their grandmother, but the granddaughter senses something is wrong. The look of terror on her face after her passing was highly unusual and although she had been diagnosed with stage four cancer, the Golden Bough retirement center was unaware of the recent doctor's report that stated she was in remission.
sd: A client asks you to investigate the Golden Bough retirement center. Their grandmother passed away unexpectedly. The look of terror on her face wasn't normal.

ds: Retrieve a dragon amulet from the ominous Croaking Tower. But beware - you're not alone in these ancient ruins, and something croaks in the darkness below.
sd: Retrieve a dragon amulet from the ominous Croaking Tower. But beware - you're not alone in these ancient ruins, and something croaks in the darkness below.

ds: t starts with death, dances with death, and most likely will end with death. But that is just the beginning! This is the zero-level funnel adventure that launched Death Guaranteed Games.
sd: A Play with the Author Event! Bring your pitchforks, bags of nightsoil, very smooth rocks and dive into the mystery surrounding the weird happenings around town.

t: The Crawl is Always Greener on the Other Side
ds: A Play with the Author event! Your rookie Xcrawl team gets invited to a special event. The event is hosted by a former professional golfer, and it is his first Xcrawl event. What could go wrong?
sd: A Play with the Author event! Your rookie Xcrawl team gets invited to a special event. The event is hosted by a former professional golfer, and it is his first Xcrawl event. What could go wrong?

ds: Your Xcrawl team gets lost while heading to an event in Daytona. Trapped in a cursed town, you'll need to figure things out quick to save the day and make it to your event on time!
sd: Your Xcrawl team gets lost while heading to an event in Daytona. Trapped in a cursed town, you'll need to figure things out quick to save the day and make it to your event on time!

ds:
“Aw, Rats…”
 
 An isolated forest village has fallen victim to a strange new plague, a plague that rapidly turns its victims into raging mutant monstrosities! The source of this affliction seems to be a hideous new breed of mutant rats. The desperate villagers implore your band of Seekers to help!
 
 The trail leads to an underground laboratory of the Ancients, where not one, but two holographic AI’s claim control. What mysteries lie buried within this complex, and what other terrifying monsters did the Ancients create here? Will your seekers fall victim to this virulent plague, or can they solve the secrets….
 
 Of The Rats of G.I.M.?
sd: Your seekers must help a small town afflicted with a strange plague. The trail leads to a lab of the ancients, where the seekers discover not one, but two different AIs!

ds:
Legend has it, an ancient temple in the center of a dead lake holds a powerful relic known only as the “Bane of the Ancients.
 
 Players will face horrible monsters and discover wondrous relics of the Ancients, like the small humanoid figurine with an oversized head that bobbles on its neck. They may dare to drink from the ancient water shrine sitting upon a three-foot-tall pedestal, where the Ancients gathered to swap stories with one another. But can they find the cure and return to their village in time to save it?
sd: An infectious horde is ravaging the land and a group of bold adventurers agree to travel deep into the Slouismo Fen to search for a powerful artifact.

ds: As a scholar of comparative religions at Miskatonic University, Professor Frederick Short traveled back and forth between the States and India sending relatives odd curios from his travels and keeping a journal of his thoughts and findings. Take on the role of an average person in 1920's America thrown into the investigation of a lifetime, perhaps your first and last.
sd: "Shhh shh shh. Surprise! Happy Birthday!" A poor soul gets word that Uncle Freddy has passed away. If only that were the worst of it....

ds: Similar to a Mad Lib, you will gather silly words from your fellow players for character creation. I'll get words from you to help set the scenario up and then for each encounter in the adventure. Success or failure depends on using whatever abilities and tools you’ve got in creative ways. I think this game is a whole lot of fun, but you don't have to take my word for it. Just ask the members of "The Fellowship of Varying Sizes," the band of heroes who took down the "Crunchy Gnoll Cult (worshipers of the Fast Snail God)." A fantastic game, loads of fun. You'll be laughing about it all con!
sd: A very fun, very easy RPG. It uses your random words for character generation, resulting in... whimsical and unpredictable scenarios. You will 100% succeed. You just have to explain how!

ds:
A horror game at night on the first day of the con? Brave!
 
 You are a person, called by a real estate agent to help him sell a local building. That's it. You're not a hero, a space Marine, nor an adventurer. Investigation and brains are your best "weapons."
 
 This is a game where you are normal people thrust into situations beyond the ken of mortal men ... until now. Steel your mind and protect your sanity! Enjoy this classic scenario included in every edition.
 
 "... This was hands down the best game session I've ever been in. I've been privileged to play with big names and many creators running their own games and adventures. I would play in a game run by MoraganJ over any of them and hope to join more of his in the future. MorganJ was especially good keeping players involved and getting into character, while making sure nobody was left behind."
sd: No heroes, just 1920s investigators hired to prove the Corbitt House isn’t haunted. Research its dark past first… before stepping into the unknown.

ds:
The author wrote this as a tribute to Dollhouse and Altered Carbon. In the near future, your body was not your own. You sold yourself to the Company, your mind erased, your identity wiped clean. Again and again, they imprinted you with new personalities, sent you on missions, then erased you once more. You’ve been assassins, lovers, thieves, and spies—never knowing who you truly were. Now, your contract is up. The Company offers you a choice: reclaim your original identity and walk free or stay in the dark. When the truth comes out, will you want your old life back? A high-concept thriller of identity, power, and consequence, this game is perfect for players who crave intrigue, moral dilemmas, and a cinematic sci-fi experience.
 NOTE: If you've played in the past and want to be a scientist (or just want to observe this run), see LRP26ND311178!
sd: You sold your body, your mind wiped clean. Now your contract is up—your past self awaits. Were you desperate, dangerous, or worse? When the truth comes out, will you even want your old life back?

ds: This is a special addition to the game as requested last year. It's a great way to play it again from a new angle or to participate from the sidelines while a friend or family member goes all in on the Did I Fall Asleep LARP (LRP26ND311177)!
sd: They sold their bodies. You wiped their minds clean. Now their contract is up, and you have to tell them if they were desperate, dangerous, or worse.

ds:
What would you do if a coworker stole your idea? Your kids said they liked their other parent more? The cashier got your order wrong ... again?
 
 Before you decide though, consider other points of view. What if your coworker was going to get fired without a new idea, you did feel like you didn't spend enough time with your kids, your partner was a jerk, the cashier thought you were someone else, or you reminded the cashier of their ex?
 
 Scenario Set 3: Mythic Journeys / Richard Becker, such a hit we're bringing it back! Check out LRP26ND311180 for a different set or play these again but take on another role!
 
 "I had the pleasure of playing The Road not Taken, run by MorganJ at Gen Con 2024. This game was my absolute favorite of my entire Gen Con experience. It was such a cool idea, and the setting/ambiance was perfect. I would love to play it again!"
 
 Guess what? They did!
sd: A game of difficult choices made on your own. Contemplate a moral dilemma while the other players whisper thoughts in your head. You have ten minutes. Make. Your. Choice. Then rotate.

t: Tales from the Tape Deck: Vol 1 - Righteous Ride of the Radicals
ds:
Volume 1: Ride of the Radicals is a fuel-filled romp through the wastelands on post-apocalyptic war rigs racing the clock of 80s rock. 
 A mashup of ruthless and fast-paced, old-school gameplay with a narrative-forward approach and consequences. For fans of Mork Borg, Dungeon Crawl Classics and Shadowdark.
sd: Tales from the Tape Deck, where each adventure is inspired by a music playlist from a specific genre, and the playlist itself serves as a timer for your game.

t: Sage's Sabbatical: Escape from the Arcanist's Horn
ds: This game is meant for 10th-level adventurers. All official 5e content from the 2014 PHB up to Monsters of the Multiverse is available for character creation. Use Standard Array or Point by for ability scores. Any nonmagical, mundane equipment is acceptable (e.g., plate armor is fine, mithral is not). Spellcasters are considered to have any spell component they need to cast their prepared spells. The adventure will take place in a single adventuring day with no preemptive abilities used the day before. Pre-generated characters will be available if you do not bring your own.
sd: A research mission has gone horribly wrong. You must discover the forgotten truths of the dungeon to pass it's tests and escape with your lives.

ds:
This is a Play with the Author event!
 
 Victors will receive the accolades of their kith and kin, while those that fall will be devoured by the ferocious predators that stalk the fell wastes! Each racing team is composed of two members: the charioteer and the war-master, tasked with defending the skiff. Together they will race five other teams across the desolate plateau, evading the wreckage of a thousand-year war, rogue war bands, and the machinations of rival teams. Only one team will survive to ascend the podium! Join the creator for the latest of the Purple Planet adventures! Each player controls two PCs and their chariot. All Hail the Champions!
sd: Race your gleaming skiff for the glory of your House and the undying Overlord of the Purple Planet! Only one champion will live to carry the day, celebrated as the new master of the Purple Planet!

gm: Erik Norris, Jacob White, Joshua Rorick, Dannielle Hasty
ds:
In a realm plagued by the mortal torments and temptations given away to the strifes of civilized life, there is a place unlike any other – a place of mystery, wonder, and dreams brought to reality. From the shimmering of blue to the rolling greens and the boiling depths of red to the inescapable darkness of the void below, the Starfields are a place where the agonies of men are cast aside – and yet also heightened. It is the greatest equalizer, for it is where the roads of many are put forth for judgment before The Reaper. 
 
 Those daring enough, or foolish enough, will find themselves at odds with a great question: what price will you pay, Seekers? The Deck of Fate will ensure the same story is never told twice, but only you can decide how this unique narrative ends. 
 
 Experience challenges like never before as you are asked a simple question--Will you answer the call to power?
sd: Fate, Death, and the prices you pay for Power itself - will your humanity make way for something greater or return to The Cinders without even a memory to leave behind?

ds: Do you have what it takes to be a Wyvern? Can you sort boxes with speed and accuracy? Can you keep cargo safe during shipping? Can you make it to the front door? Do you have a pulse? Sign up for this Division II crawl and show the world that You Can Deliver!
sd: A dungeon crawl based on a work day of the incomparable (and sponsor) Flock of Wyverns Shipping and Cargo!

ds: In the foothills of the Stillwater mountains, outside of the town of Fallon, resides the Spirit Cave. A sacred place to the Shashone tribe. The first settlers were frightened by the green lights when they appeared from the cave, but over time the townsfolk learned to accept them as harmless. In fact, the people of Fallon began the annual Festival of Offerings each year to mark their arrival. However, this year the lights are accompanied by loud moans from the caves and some people have gone missing. Gripped by fear, the people of Fallon are seeking help.
sd: Every year, the green lights appear at a sacred Shashone sight known as Spirit Cave. The people of nearby Fallon, NV now celebrate their arrival. However, the loud moans from the cave are new.

ds:
The people around you are unrecognizable. You have no memories of this place, no memories of these people, and no memories of yourself! Now you can only rely on your instincts and your instincts are screaming SURVIVE!
 
 The adventure centers around a devil’s bargain, made centuries ago, dooming two families to an eternity in a hotel of the damned...a hotel that travels the cosmos offering a hellish deal to the dying, and for those who solve its riddle, salvation.
sd: Consciousness comes back slowly. You awake on a cold stone floor. Black vines coat the stone walls around you. Blood and crushed grapes obscure arcane symbols beneath you. What happened?

ds: This is a Play with the Author event! A horror 0-level funnel adventure.
sd: You are invited to Ives Manor for a will reading - what can go wrong? Note that this is not your standard funnel, only 2 PCs per player and the game heavily focuses on puzzles and deduction.

ds: The town of New Babylon is celebrating the completion of the railroad spur , when a band of Cultists rides in to town creating havoc. Can the good citizens of New Babylon survive long enough to make it to the fort and help put an end to These dastardly cultists or will they get gunned down In the streets during the chaos and occult mayhem?
sd: When the town is besieged by an evil cult, can the players survive long enough to make it to the fort on the other side of town. A 0-level funnel set in the weird west.

ds: They set out it investigate what happened and get caught up in the mysterious circumstances of his death, which lead them to several of the towns other founding members! This is a 1st level adventure in the weird west.
sd: The players are newly appointed deputies of New Babylon and are informed of a mysterious death of one the town's founders. Can they solve the mystery before anything else happens?

ds: Your posse is hired by a local rancher to locate his son and daughter from their last know location, a small town a days train ride away. What type of reception will they find waiting for them? Does this posse have what it takes or are they too yella' to face what comes next.
sd: This is a 3rd Level weird west adventure. The PCs set off to rescue the family of a local rancher.

 Chapter 4: An Imperial Invitation
sd: A dive into the underbelly of Dunwall in the Dishonored universe. Characters templates provided, bring a pencil and some d20s. Prizes awarded for the MVP and a few bonus prizes too!

ds: You are coming of age in your tribe and are about to embark on your rite of passage. Called by the tribe shaman, you and your other orc fledglings are given a sacred quest that you must embark upon.
sd: This is a Play with the Author event! The PCs will play the monsters as you take on the role of a band of orcs. Make those heroes pay for their insolence!

ds: Will your common villagers be quick and smart enough to live through the challenges ahead and leave behind a life of farming forever? An introductory 0-level funnel adventure.
sd: The classic DCC 0-level funnel adventure! You're no hero. You're an adventurer: a reaver, a cutpurse, a heathen-slayer, a tight-lipped warlock guarding long-dead secrets.

ds: You wake in the middle of the night to the ringing of the town church bells. With sleep clouding your vision, you reach over to feel the comfort of your companion, only to feel cold, empty sheets. Shaken with fear, you leap up to check the other rooms of the house. Where children, family members, roommates, and pets once rested peacefully, now only vacant, deserted cots take their place. Where has everyone gone? Who is ringing the bells in the church? Will you be able to survive long enough to figure out what is happening and how to stop it?
sd: A 0-level funnel adventure with a horror twist, something a little scarier than normal. Players are encourage to use brains, as well as brawn, to survive the night. Don't trust anyone!

t: The Mind Prison of Shana Dahaka
ds: This is a Play with the Author event!
sd: Join creators Doug Kovacs and Harley Stroh, while you and your companions attempt to infiltrate the maddening mind prison!

ds: The year is 8 ABY. While the New Republic celebrates its fragile victory over the Core Worlds, a chilling wind blows from the Unknown Regions. As part of Crimson Flight, you are the scalpel used by New Republic Intelligence to cut through Imperial secrecy. This isn't just a raid for codes; it is a race to understand a new kind of threat—one that doesn't rely on the brute force of Vader, but on the cold, surgical brilliance of a strategist thought long dead.
sd: You are Crimson Flight, a group of elite pilots, chosen for an impossible mission. Infiltrate an Imperial bunker on a backwater planet to steal encrypted data. Fly, fight, and survive the shadows

ds: That's another vampire lord scared off, another city saved. Annalion the Pierced, he’s called, but the names tend to sound similar. And with his smoke form retreating to his fortress, you set off on the same path towards his estate, to not just treat the sickness but to now root out the infection. For the bloodsucker, resting now in his coffin somewhere within his lair, must be destroyed there if you are to get rid of him. Lest by inaction, it recuperates long enough to continue its works of darkness. And, as luck would have it, you are made aware that Annalion has planned an evening gala the night you are to arrive. Your contacts have secured you alternative identities to attend the masquerade, but the vampire’s associates will be filling the home to the brim. Can you secure your kill under the noses of countless enemies, or will you be discovered and destroyed yourselves?
sd: For all his fearsome reputation, you were able to mortally wound Annalion the Pierced. But he got away, and you have to finish this. Even if it means infiltrating a party of other vampires to do it...

sd: What's more fun than one tarrasque? How about multiple tarrasques stomping across Waterdeep? How about a whole planet full of tarrasques ready to rumble?

t: The Horse and Rider Are One
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: It is your first deep patrol along the villages near the borderlands. As a young Fellblade Knight, sworn to protect the realm of Eralon, you feel that something is wrong. Set in the heroic world of Hammerfall, the only home you have ever known. You will take part in the forging of a Fellblade Knight—legendary warriors whose bond with their warhorses makes them unmatched on the battlefield. This one-shot delivers the game at its most immersive, and pre-generated characters with detailed 3D terrain and a custom take-home miniature.
sd: Dark rumors drift in from the Shattermarch, the vast wildlands scarred by wars long past. Whispers speak of a shadow rising, threatening the people you are sworn to protect.

t: Trapped in the Ice Cave Lair of a Dragon
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Heroes are drawn back into the ice—trapped deep within a conquered dragon’s lair, where ancient ruins stir and rival dragons wage a silent war beneath the mountain. Powerful enemies command living ice, forgotten secrets wait to be unearthed, and a single bargain could change the fate of the world. This 15th-level one-shot blends mystery, brutal combat, and high-stakes choices—welcoming returning heroes with echoes of the past, while offering new adventurers a legendary tale where dragons, treasure, and destiny collide.
sd: Return to the frozen North of Druinnia. What began as a simple bargain with a mysterious cleric ended in blood, betrayal, and dragonfire.

ds: You must make your way through the hot gates in the deadly lava fields; Navigate a rotating labyrinth; and eradicate a Pit Fiend who has made a mockery of the Dwarves and their Gods. There is no shortage of deadly traps to survive, fiends to defeat, puzzles and challenges to overcome before you can claim victory and restore the Heart of the Fire. Bring your own standard build 12th level character (D&D 5e/2014) or choose from pre-generated characters provided. Campaign Magic Items will be provided by the DM.
sd: The Hammers of Moradin in the Dwarven City of Berronar are calling for aid to eradicate a Legion of Devils from Nine Hells, and reclaim their sacred shrine.

ds: Step into the rotating Tower of Sardior. Built by the Wizard Kovarnyl as a stronghold of chaos, destruction, and creation. Kovarnyl and his acolytes are set on annihilating all of creation to pave the way for the resurrection of Sardior and the fabled First World. As the tower endlessly reconfigures itself, you'll need to traverse its corridors, evade lethal enemies and traps, all while trying to solve the mysteries of the tower and unlock its secrets. Time is of the essence to stop their apocalyptic schemes from unfolding. Do you have what it takes to find the keystones of the tower and stop Kovarnyl before it’s too late? Bring your own standard build 12th level character (D&D 5e/2014) or choose from pre-generated characters provided. Campaign Magic Items will be provided by the DM.
sd: The Wizards of Sardior are tampering with the fabric of creation, threatening to unravel everything you cherish. You must act swiftly to stop their destructive plans.

ds: A multi-table scenario of Heart: the City Beneath. Players take on the role of hard-bitten delvers called into a foreign timeline and tasked with saving the Temple of the Moon Beneath from certain destruction as draconic locomotives, twisted vassals and protean angels march towards its walls. As the scenario progresses, characters will uncover the truth behind the Heart’s desperate assault and find ways to repel it - or seize the opportunity, here at the confluence of possibilities, to live one life where they finally get what they wanted. All six tables are fighting back the horde together (or dying side-by-side), and a central gamesmaster will connect their actions together into a greater story as players team up with their alternate selves to carve their name into the flesh of the City Beneath.
sd: The Temple of the Moon Beneath draws forth delvers from a dozen realities into one. Will you sell your life dearly to save the sacred site? Or will you make one desperate grasp towards your dreams?

ds: YOU are an ORC. You live in space aboard the Derelict - a beautiful junk rocket the size of a small country - and carve out a delirious passage through the stars towards destruction. Your telescope-prophets have spotted a planet ahead of you and determined that the Derelict must be crashed directly into it, and you couldn’t be more excited. (Now all you have to do is work out how to steer this thing.) An epic scale, multi-table game of ORC BORG that uses hacked-in CRASH PANDAS rules to let all six tables drive the spaceship at the same time.
sd: Crash a spaceship directly into heaven for fun and profit in this multi-table game hacking in CRASH PANDAS.

ds:
Blackabbey Reach has long been a containment zone for anything the arcane magisters of the Conclave could not destroy, contain or exploit. But following the burial of Lord Penrose - one of their own dishonoured dead - deep beneath Foloren Tor, even their ancient wards have been overwhelmed.
 
 The rot spreads. The late occultist’s hunger for things forbidden follows him past even the veil of death. Towers built to imprison amplify; leylines thought severed flare into infected life. Every torpid otherworld festering within looks ready to bend to his will.
 
 Join the Conclave in suturing shut the rift between worlds in this 6-table, 30-player session of Hollows - Rowan, Rook & Decard’s newly-released game of body-horror, monster-hunting, boss-fighting grimdark Victoriana.
sd: Blackabbey Reach is barren, bleak and riddled with bad magic - and unless you do something soon, it's going to get worse. A multi-table event featuring our new boss-fighting tactical masochism RPG.

Returning to Gen Con for the third year, the GCN Gauntlets let you take control of iconic characters from Glass Cannon history and pit them against the most lethal encounters our GMs can devise. In this Gauntlet, torchlight is fleeting, the darkness is alive, and every decision could be your last.
 One table. One encounter. No mercy.
 Whether you triumph or fall screaming, you’ll walk away with an exclusive GCN Swag Bag, a small consolation prize for the carnage you just endured.
 While survival is rare, it's not impossible. Do you have what it takes to beat the Gauntlet?
sd: Life is better with unforgettable experiences. Enter the GCN Gauntlet.

sd: Explore a derelict starship, scavenge for supplies, all while trying to understand what caused the vessel to crash. Players will receive a Gen Con 2026 Variant Cover of this adventure module.

Returning to Gen Con for the third year, the GCN Gauntlets let you take control of iconic characters from Glass Cannon history and pit them against the most lethal encounters our GMs can devise. In this Gauntlet, a party of heroes is thrown into a crucible of danger where survival demands teamwork, quick thinking, and just a little bit of luck.
 One table. One encounter. No mercy.
 Whether you triumph or fall screaming, you’ll walk away with an exclusive GCN Swag Bag, a small consolation prize for the carnage you just endured.
 While survival is rare, it's not impossible. Do you have what it takes to beat the Gauntlet?
sd: Life is better with unforgettable experiences. Enter the GCN Gauntlet.

ds: Leaking across the Netwürk is scrambled footage of a research facility experimenting with inter-dimensional travel. Previously undetected, the moon CAV-34R is now a hot-ticket item with Creds being offered for all sorts of information. The most intriguing is a bounty of 500CR put up by Kid Arachnid for the procurement of a keycard that unlocks the entry tower. It has been reported that facility workers on the moon will have said keycard.
sd: Your LEGION was offered a fat stack of creds to track down and steal a valuable keycard on a remote moon base. Players will receive a Gen Con 2026 Variant Cover of this adventure module.

ds:
Most of humanity has become infected by one of six different parasitic würms. When the sickness takes complete control, those infected become what’s known as The Grimm, a hive-mind, alien, zombie-like species. 
 
 With the universe on the brink of collapse, you’ve banded together with YOUR LEGION. Hell, you may not like a single one of them, but it sure does beat going it alone. You travel the ‘verse with them salvaging what you can and making the best out of a shoty situation.
 
 Now that you’ve docked your starship to a small travel station for a much-needed recharge, the universe plunges into darkness, illuminated only by blaring emergency sirens. Is this the moment your lights flicker out for good, or will you defy the odds and live to fight another day?
sd: You're on a traveling refueling station looking for work, or a way to get the hell out of there. And then it loses power. Players get a Gen Con 2026 Variant Cover of this adventure module.

 Now that you’ve docked your starship to a small travel station for a much-needed recharge, the universe plunges into darkness, illuminated only by blaring emergency sirens. Is this the moment your lights flicker out for good, or will you defy the odds and live to fight another day?
sd: You're on a traveling refueling station looking for work, or a way to get the hell out of there. And then it loses power. Players get a Gen Con 2026 Variant Cover of this adventure module.

ds:
Returning to Gen Con for the third year, the GCN Gauntlets let you take control of iconic characters from Glass Cannon history and pit them against the most lethal encounters our GMs can devise.
 In this Gauntlet, investigators chase a mystery that grows more disturbing by the minute—and the truth may cost them their sanity.
 One table. One encounter. No mercy.
 Whether you triumph or fall screaming, you’ll walk away with an exclusive GCN Swag Bag, a small consolation prize for the carnage you just endured.
 While survival is rare, it's not impossible. Do you have what it takes to beat the Gauntlet?
sd: Life is better with unforgettable experiences. Enter the GCN Gauntlet.

gm: Ashley Hemsath, Andrew Bardin, John Jones
ds:
Vast Grimm’s first Epic adventure brings four different tables of players together for one massive game. Each group is working towards the same goal: stop The Forge from melting down. With each legion on a different level of the space station, they will have to work independently to prevent a cataclysmic event.
 
 Longer than our usual convention games, the four tables will join together for one epic battle in the final chapter should the players succeed at their original mission. Each table will be led by its own Netwürk Operator (GM), the final scene orchestrated by the NO who has been communicating with each of the tables. 
 
 Be a part of Vast Grimm history in this game!
sd: The intergalactic space station known as The Forge is melting down. Can you and YOUR LEGION prevent it from imploding? Be a player at one of 4 tables working in different sectors to save the day!

ds: Frillseeker is a one-shot adventure for Raptor Ruckus where you'll toe-to-claw with dinosaurs, paramilitary, and your own crippling panic. Set on a remote island dinosaur research facility and an aspiring amusement park, chaos now reigns, and you have only one goal: Get off this godforsaken island alive.
sd: A distress signal leads to the grisly ruins of a BiSyn black ops mission in the heart of the park.

ds:
CAN YOU SURVIVE THE EXTINCTION?
 
 The survivors are running through the woods from a ridiculously large horde of infected & come across a cabin in the woods that looks to be fortified. The married couple inside allows the survivors to take refuge…but maybe it was safer on the outside.
 
 Cabin Fever is a low level scenario for a low level party of 3-7 players 
 
 Good luck, you're gonna need it...
sd: You take refuge in a cabin while being chased down by a horde, but are you really safe?

ds: In the back alleys of your Mesopotamian city-state, unable to decipher the brick's dense inscriptions but unable to get rid of it, your characters' fortunes quickly change for the worse. Meanwhile, the powerful are searching for it—perhaps the gods themselves. Build your own city and pantheon of gods. Dare to roll too high and embrace the monstrous, godlike power within you. Only your friends can save you, and only if you let them.
sd: You have found a clay tablet with the power to change the world. What do you do? Play Sword & Sorcery adventure & romance in the Bronze Age with a queer vibe.

Your choices will decide the fate of weary soldiers and captive singers, and may set you on the path to Radiance! No prep is required, but familiarity with d20-based RPGs is recommended. Just bring some dice and a pencil; we'll provide pre-generated characters.

sd: Play as a thieving crew on the mist-shrouded streets of Luthadel in Brandon Sanderson's world of Scadrial. Can your crew survive deadly nobles, desperate rebels, and duplicitous obligators?

t: Mistborn Adventure - Echoes of the Lost
ds: A year after the fall of the Final Empire, a simple job in Urteau is complicated when your boss goes missing. This 1st-level horror adventure is an exclusive preview of “Mistborn Legacy,” the era-spanning action horror adventure campaign for the Mistborn setting. Descend into a mysterious hidden compound and discover its dark purpose… No preparation needed, just bring some dice and a pencil; we’ll provide pre-generated characters. Content warning: this adventure includes horror themes, including descriptions of graphic violence.
sd: Get a taste of the upcoming Mistborn Legacy campaign book in an exclusive sneak peek. Uncover the heinous secrets of a mysterious group of nobles in the northern city of Urteau.

t: Star Trek Lower Decks: Welcome Aboard
ds: An Introductory scenario. The U.S.S. Piorun has been recommissioned and being made fit for duty. Being lower decks ensigns at your first posting, you are tasked with getting the shape of this ship shipshape during a brief shakedown cruise to pass inspection for deployment.
sd: A Tutorial adventure to get players and characters familiar with how Adventures in Starfleet work. Bring some d20s and a pencil or pen. Prizes awarded with a bonus for the MVP.

ds: 21th Day, Month of Harvest 1851. After a daring and explosive escape from Coldridge prison, An unlikely band of misfits needs a place to lie low. A gang leader has a safe place, but in Dunwall the only thing anyone ever gave away for free is trouble. He wants a problem solved first. Can they meet his demands? Can they uncover the threads of a conspiracy? Not without your help.
sd: A flight into the underbelly of Dunwall in the Dishonored universe. Characters templates provided, bring a pencil and some d20s. Prizes awarded for the MVP and a few bonus prizes too!

ds: When our client confronted his boss about the misappropriation of his programs, his boss accused him of industrial espionage, fired him, sued him, and blacklisted him with every company that uses a server. Our client invested 4 years of his life to try to make health care more compassionate and it was stolen from him and his reputation ruined. Fighting this in court would take more time and money than our client has. Fortunately, he doesn't have lawyers, he has thieves.
sd: The Rich and Powerful take what they want, you steal it back. This is your chance to prove that sometimes bad guys make the best good guys.

ds: You and your allies are hired to provide protection on a very exclusive auction taking place board the dirigible known as the Queen Victoria’s Gambit. High Rise Heist uses the Modern AGE system and uses the world-hopping setting of Threefold. PCs are members of the Aethon, a secret organization tasked with protecting Earth‘s worldline.
sd: London, 1939, your group has been entrusted with escorting several “occult” objects from the West London Hyde-White warehouse to the Queen Victoria’s Gambit which is moored at Hanworth Airfield

ds:
The shadowy forces of Arachnos, Lord Recluse's ruthless criminal empire, have launched brazen raids across Paragon City! Top-secret labs and cutting-edge corporations have been hit, with high-tech prototypes vanishing into the night. What diabolical weapon or doomsday device are they assembling from these stolen components? Whatever it is, it spells disaster for heroes and civilians alike!
 A hand-picked task force of Paragon's finest assembles to track the spider's web, confront Arachnos operatives, and smash their sinister plot before it's too late.
 This fast-paced superhero skirmish delivers explosive City of Heroes-style action—think epic powers, daring rescues, and over-the-top battles—using painted 3D-printed miniatures and detailed terrain. Minimal roleplaying; maximum heroic thrills! Powered by the Savage Worlds Adventure Edition (SWADE) rules with the Super Powers Companion.
sd: The evil organization Arachnos is on the move in Paragon City. Several companies have been attacked and high-end prototypes stolen. What are they planning, and can the heroes stop them it time?

t: Yaujta Predators - Part 4: The Temple Guardians
ds: The fearsome predators of the Warp Dancer clan of Yautja have been dragged into a rescue mission. Not of another predator, but of some stolen gear. Humans have found an ancient Yautja industrial complex, and have taken some of the equipment. The only problem, is that the defense systems have awakened, ancient and primal monsters that even the most skilled Yautja struggle to defeat. And now, there’s a pack of them roaming free.
sd: Play as a Band of Yautja Predators, suddenly put on the backfoot as they are drawn into a hunt with some of the most dangerous creatures they've ever encountered.

ds: On the Planet of Mirinoi, eight young adults find their way to a mysterious ship, in which they are granted the powers of the Ancient Kings. For the first time in 82 years, Power Rangers have returned to Mirinoi. Just in time to face off against the new emerging Mechanorg monsters, dreadful Biomechanical menaces made from the remnants of the Machine Empire and the pollutant Orgs.
sd: Witness the rise of a New Team of Power Rangers. Using the power of the Ancient Kings to defend the City of Earthfall from the new forces of the Mechanorgs!

ds: A group of gamers have somehow found themselves trapped inside a video game. Only by fighting their way to the end of the game can they escape the augmented reality of the virtual world. After what feels like weeks of struggling through glitches in the game, side-quests, and repetitive NPC dialogue, they’ve finally found the quest to the first true boss.
sd: You have been locked in an MMORPG demo, and must fight to stay alive, only by winning the game can they escape the clutches of the augmented reality, and they've found the path to the first boss.
