ds: 14th Day, Month of Darkness 1851. The Boyle Masquerade is approaching, and you have a plan to infiltrate and make off with enough coin to set your misfit crew up for a good long while. But a big score requires specialized tools. In this case, you will need an invitation and there is only one that you KNOW will be unused. The invitation issued to Her Highness, Empress Kaldwin. By tradition the Empress never attends. Liberating her invitation from Dunwall tower may seem impossible, but the two weeks before the ball the tower turns into a mini garment district as the aristocracy get fitted for opulent costumes. Lots of coming and going should cover your tracks while you make your play, and anything else you happen across.
sd: A flight into the underbelly of Dunwall in the Dishonored universe. Characters templates provided, bring a pencil and some d20s. Prizes awarded for the MVP and a few bonus prizes too!

t: Star Trek Lower Decks: Welcome Aboard
ds: An Introductory scenario. The U.S.S. Piorun has been recommissioned and being made fit for duty. Being lower decks ensigns at your first posting, you are tasked with getting the shape of this ship shipshape during a brief shakedown cruise to pass inspection for deployment.
sd: A Tutorial adventure to get players and characters familiar with how Adventures in Starfleet work. Bring some d20s and a pencil or pen. Prizes awarded with a bonus for the MVP.

ds: The mysterious signal the Brotherhood of Steel was tracking has gone offline. The Rail Roads inside agent has gone dark and dozens of Synth replicants from around the Commonwealth have simply shutdown including Mayor McDonough of Diamond City and Paladin Dans of the Brotherhood. Fearing a greater threat to the Commonwealth may be lurking in the shadows of the Institute, the leaders of all the factions have decided to work together to answer the question, what happened to the Institute. Play a hero of the Commonwealth representing one of the four major factions, The Minutemen, The Brotherhood of Steel, The Railroad and Dimond City. Work together to explore the ruins of CITC and the Institute to discover what happened the great bogyman of the Commonwealth.
sd: What happened to the Institute? The mysterious signal the Brotherhood of Steel was tracking has gone offline and dozens of Synth replicants from around the Commonwealth have simply shutdown

ds: With the power of their Zords now at their disposal, the Rangers of the Ancient Forces Team must now face their greatest enemy yet. A former apocalyptic monster risen from the dead through the corrupting power of the Mechanorgs. The Rangers must muster their power, break the Mechanorg’s control over the beast, and send it back to extinction!
sd: The Ancient Forces Rangers face their greatest threat yet, the Rex-hiran Hungersaurus. They have awoken their zords, and must call upon them for this great battle of titans.

sd: You have been locked in an MMORPG demo, and must fight to stay alive, only by winning the game can they escape the clutches of the augmented reality, and they've found the path to the first boss.

ds: Inspired by Streets of Fire, epic needle-drops, and the Happy Days episode where Fonzie promises Joanie he’d enter the dance contest with her, Dance Til Dawn is one of the most unique Gen Con experiences you can have. Let’s listen to music together, let’s listen to the silence between the notes, let's listen to each other. Let’s tell a story together inspired by a simple prompt (Example “They have to send one more ship, they can’t just leave us here, they created us....”) as the music plays the narration changes in weird and wonderful ways. Music is an intrinsic part of the game mechanics and the experience.
sd: Turn up the radio with friends old & new, tell a story together in a music-driven storytelling game: start with a prompt, songs set the mood. The story's over when the last song ends.

t: I Still Cannot Believe It's NOT the Justice League
ds: Some jobs require a real hero, some jobs require you. In this alternately fun and serious game, Justice Leaguers from across the spectrum of membership will be represented for an epic saga less absurd and more serious in nature, because you are called not just heroes, but super, for a reason.Today might be the day you save the world, or at least get scratched by a cat stuck in a tree and get to give Ten-Eyed Man 10 black eyes or explain to the Condiment King you like your hot dogs plain like hot dog purist the Flash (The Flash #67). Some deep dives, some over the top fun, this game is...WHERE THE ACTION KEEPS ON COMING! (If you will be playing and have a character request, do not hesitate to reach out: barakblackburn@yahoo.com please put GENCON in the subject line, we can discuss).
sd: Look Up In the Sky - It's - Booster Gold?! Membership has its privileges, but with great privilege comes great responsibility (parody, not infringing on copyrights). You are Justice Leaguers!

ds: This is a timed game where the players will have 4 hours to locate Ireena, as well as, any weapons that might help in the defeat of Strahd. After the 4 th hour passes, Strahd will come to deal with the unwanted guests in his castle. All character sheets will be pre generated, you will only need to bring your wits and dice (dice can be borrowed if you do not have any).
sd: Strahd snuck in and swiped Ireena right from under my nose. I besiege you, brave adventures, please join me in storming his castle and recovering Ireena before it is too late for all of us.

The Federation has a ship across the border. Do you leave your patrol to gain glory? Or do you follow your original orders and silently shadow the Federation Starship? This will be a modified version of the Modiphius Star Trek game with our own rules for playing as a Klingon.
sd: Today may be a good day to die. But it would be even better to kill the Romulan PATAQ instead!

t: Saturday Morning Spectacular: World of Darkness: The Animated Series
ds: You have stayed up all night and now have your bowl of cereal waiting for the latest episode. This series, broadcast first on Saturday mornings but also at 11:30pm on Friday nights, brought one of the most important roleplaying games in history to the small screen. Kids everywhere donned trenchcoats, painted their fingernails black, and embraced their own darkness. Primarily focused on the vampiric clans, the series hinted at so much more, but famed comic writer Steve Gerber was fired/the series was cancelled before it could be developed further. Re-live the series you loved, which introduced you to the game that brought so many to the gaming table, before an angry group of parents and Demonic Deviltry ruined it all.
sd: Clans vie for power in the city of San Lucifer, but danger lies beyond this World of Darkness. Take on the role of one of the iconic character from this classic cartoon. Nostalgia's a dangerous drug.

t: Lost in Savage Space - LISS 2 "Judy's Day"
ds: Don finally pops the question - and naturally Judy accepts. The Robinson family begins preparations for the nuptuals and reconfigures the ship for the new living arrangements. Meanwhile, a recently encountered minor native menace begins to swarm.

ds:
Drifmeyer has three factions that form the ruling council. They have reached out to your party for aid in cleansing the corruption from the sewers. But they each have a different approach, some more ghastly than others. Which choice will you make? How will that choice affect you and will it give the desired outcome?
 The Unbound Odyssey is a ttrpg game system where players have control over every aspect of their character. You can create your own class. You can create your own spells. You can wear whatever you want and wield whatever weapons you want. In this gaming system you are not restricted like most other systems.
 Sewers of Drifmeyer is an RPG that plays like a ttrpg, board game and skirmish wargame all in one with a deep story arch built in with a questline filled with player choice.
sd: The murdered elf maiden Aedra’s corpse is missing from her tomb. Since then the corruption in the sewers has grown, people are missing, and it must be cleaned out. How is up to you!

ds: A chilling letter delivered by the hands of a traumatized orphan boy, that is all it took to have your team dispatched to the remote Nordic town of Narvik. In the deep north, an orphanage stands half-buried in snow as children vanish one by one. No one sees them taken. No one follows. Your team is tasked with finding and dispersing a suspected Myling, an unnamed child spirit whose sorrow settles into the very foundation of this orphanage, pressing down on those who stay. Can your team help the orphanage and find the missing children? Who knows... what was left behind may begin to weigh heavier than what was lost.
sd: A Myling haunts the orphanage halls while children quietly go missing. No blood, no screams - only fewer beds filled come morning.

sd: Troubles arise when a local shop reports a missing employee - who was last going to the Nevernever!

t: Dresden Files - Lost Shadows of New Orleans
ds: New Orleans is a hot bed of paranormal activity, considered by many to be the most haunted city in the US, so when it seems the ghosts start disappearing from their usual haunts, a group of young investigators are called on to find out what the cause is. Role play highly encouraged. Pre gens supplied!
sd: There is unrest among the apparitions that have haunted New Orleans for years, but what has come that can make the dead want to hide?

t: Dresden Files - The Mind of a Madman
ds: In New Orleans, strange is not exactly that unusual, but after guards have begun getting sick, hallucinating and eventually some disappearing, along with some of the inmates of Cell Block 6, the building was quarantined until further notice. Now it seems similar symptoms are beginning to spread to Cell Blocks 5 and 7. No one can explain what is happening and the Conclave of New Orleans has been called to check out these unnatural occurrences. Role play highly encouraged. Pre gens supplied!
sd: Guards and inmates have gone missing from the Orleans Parish Prison and it does not seem like the reason is within the realm of "normal".

ds: For 6 years now, New Orleans Comic Con, dubbed "GatorCon!" has brought in thousands of fans of various geekdoms together! 3 years ago, they began to set "themes" due to the high volume of cosplayers that attended - this years theme? The Walking Dead! Role play highly encouraged. Pre gens supplied!
sd: A time for all the geeks and freaks to unite under a united banner! It is the yearly Comic Con!

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Some say the Meromannian dwarves abandoned the Stoneloom Mines after the Third Alder Wars, but the truth is that they were eaten by something that moved into their home. Rumors whisper that the mad wizard Zygofer cursed his family as they fled his evermore frightening presence. Tainted by a demonic infection, his daughter, Marga, sought shelter among the dwarves in the Stoneloom Mines, where she turned into a monster and consumed her hosts. None have dared to enter the caves since - until now.
sd: A survival roleplaying game. You're not heroes - instead, you are raiders and rogues bent on making your mark on a cursed world. Fight terrible monsters and wander the wild lands.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: The mystery will test the character's deductive reasoning, social skills, and - if they are not careful - their ability to fight for their lives. A dark Gothic setting steeped in Nordic folklore and the old myths of Scandinavia. Vaesen is a horror game that deals with intense themes including, death, gore, helplessness, drowning and abuse. Please consider this when signing up.
sd: The wild and barren Swedish west coast: at the time a haven for privateers, wreckers, herring barons and other riffraff.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Based on the books of Brandon Sanderson, the Stormlight Archive setting is on the world of Roshar. Familiarity with the Cosmere is not required to play! This is a Tier 2 adventure where the players will fight humans and are on the side of the "bad guys". While the setting is more complex than that, consider that you will be playing a conquering force, bent on repression when you sign up.
sd: Players take on the role of occupying Singers in the newly conquered city of Kholinar, tasked by their Fused commanders to rid the city of the last of the humans possessed by the Great Revel.

t: Dark Forest - The Bandits of Burnlake
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Although the fort sits at the intersection of two woodland riverways, it fell into disuse after it was sacked by a vermin horde two centuries hence, and water flooded the lower floors. This adventure is for 3rd level characters in a Redwall meets 1E in a Shadowdark world setting.
sd: Burnlake Ruins was once a thriving river fort, but now a mirespawn chief with a magic ring has begun harassing river traffic demanding tribute, or just outright attacking boats.

t: Dark Forest - Spire of Icy Death
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Led by the crazed chieftain Flind Scarbrand, a band of brigands have stolen a number of relics from a remote abbey. But the tower is cursed; no natural light may penetrate its walls, and in its supernatural darkness, a winter wraith has emerged from the tower’s frozen heart. This adventure is for 5th level characters.
sd: A band of hyenafolk brigands have stolen the relic Moonsilver Falchion and other treasures from a remote abbey. Can you retrieve the treasures in this Redwall meets 1E world?

t: Night Vale Presents: High School Reunion
ds:
"Night Vale High School Alumni coming together for the first time in…how long? The Faculty decided that for the first time in many years, they are hosting a class reunion (Though it is not specified which graduating year, but all are invited anyway). 
 NVHS alumni all gather in the gymnasium for a night of nostalgia in controlled quantities! But come to find out, having that many high school alumni gathered in one place turns out to be a very bad idea as the faculty have ulterior motives that may or may not involve summoning a horror from another dimension to put on the sports teams (It’s funny the lengths a school board will go to for the sake of beating Desert Bluffs and going to State)."
sd: Play as citizens of the small desert town of Night Vale, who have been invited to attend a once in a millennia high school reunion!

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: In a world where Aetherium crystals power arcanepunk tech that rivals magic, you roll into Scraphaven, a desert shantytown built from cargo containers, busted engines, and pure stubbornness. Here, the law skips trials and demands vehicle races. In this mini-sandbox one-shot, you earn Scraps by taking jobs and faction missions, then you jury-rig your ride with weapons and questionable upgrades. The table goes full throttle when the Death Race erupts on the Aetherium Road! Unique racing mechanics make the race’s speed and split-second choices feel vivid and immersive. Win the race, or let your soul ride into the rusty highways of Carhalla. Tone: Mad Max meets Mario Kart.
sd: You've been sentenced to trial by death race in an arcanepunk desert shantytown. Today: run missions, ally with local factions, and upgrade your rig. Tomorrow: win the race - or die trying.

ds: Beware as your enemies mass around you and grow stronger. You’ll need all your wits and bravery to pursue your foe…
sd: Having solved one puzzle about the poison around the hamlet, are you ready to travel to engage with the fleeing enemy?

ds: Can we wrap this up? Maybe. Possible there’s more to saving the world than three sessions…
sd: The final conclusion to the Thunder of Dragons.. or is it?

ds: Help your friend, the Computer, find and fix a bug gumming up the lives of faithful citizens!
sd:
The Computer, your friend, needs your help.
 
 You will feel honored to contribute.

ds: Scores of Warrior bugs make the troopers' task more difficult as they need to get to the top of a 1000 foot plateau to recover lost equipment, repair it, protect it, move it to the correct position, and finally, activate it.
sd: Your Mobile Infantry squad is dropped onto Pluto to recon a sector and setup a listening post to monitor any random bugs in the area.

ds: The troopers must neutralize several Plasma Bugs defending a mountain pass leading to a valley where a Bug colony is just begging to be reduced. This is one of a few routes through these mountains that ground troops will be able to use to attack the colony.
sd: You are fighting over Planet 837 - a body that will need a lot of terraforming before being of use to humans. The troopers must neutralize several Plasma Bugs defending a mountain pass.

ds: You clutch the black, vellum envelope in your clawed talon. “My dearest, this is the third time I’ve tried to send you this profession of my love. Have any of my letters reached you?” 5,000 ducats the wizened wizard paid you to deliver this note. Is it worth it though? Ahead of you, a black, featureless doorway is set into the cliffside. Except the color isn’t so much black as absorbing all light and color. This is the entrance to the lair of the spider queen. Few have survived the journey to the center of her webs. You glance down at your companions. The dwarven fighter seems nervous. But the cleric is strangely calm. What does she? You examine the doorway again for some sign of a lock or a riddle or even hinges. The wizard starts murmuring the words of a Knock spell.
sd: You bear a message to the spider queen from her lover. But first you must traverse her lair. You've heard rumors of magical webs, creatures and the Bone Monster. Few have returned...

ds:
Not long ago, the Romulan betrayal at Khitomer and massacre of thousands is still stinging, and many call for a bortaS, or revenge strike, against the Star Empire. Even as the houses bury their dead, those in control look to lay blame. It’s easy to accuse the dead, but harder to find the true traitors. What path does the Empire take to try and head off this civil war?
 The question remains, is a pact with the Federation in the Empire’s best interest? Even as we lay at the brink of a Civil War, the Romulan threat is still among us. But the Klingon’s best engineers at Ganalda Prime have discovered a new way to mask warp signatures and improved cloaking technology. This advancement will allow a tactical edge in battle that will keep the Klingon’s the most respected and feared warriors in the Alpha quadrant, if not the galaxy!
sd: The Khitomer massacre is fresh in everyone's minds, and the Empire is in turmoil. Houses are vying for power, but a new edge for the fleet will restore glory and dominate battles for decades to come!

ds:
The political shockwave from Captain Garrett’s sacrifice of herself and the crew of the USS Enterprise 1701-C to save the Klingon colony at Khitomer has led to… well a ‘softening’ of tensions with the Klingons may be bit much. However, ‘shift into a slightly less aggressive stance’ may be more accurate.
 All is not well, as a whisper of a rumor of a new Klingon cloaking technology has emerged, and it may be that the very Klingon Houses calling for war will be the ones to take it out for its’ shakedown cruise. But is it enough to take action? What could be taken, as anything could eliminate all of the good will that was so hard won.
 Is it even true, or false information planted by the Romulans to destroy a budding relationship between the Klingons and Federation that would shift the balance of power in the quadrant? Come to think of it, it’s the sort of thing they just might do.
sd: The Khitomer massacre has created a great deal of instability in the Klingon Empire. You have whispers of brewing Klingon unrest, what happens next could reshape Federation safety and destiny forever.

ds: Venadath the Vengeful, an Ancient Black Dragon, is preparing his ascension as a Greatwyrm. He is planning a grand ritual which, if successful, will empower him by sacrificing everyone on the continent. The greatest level 20 heroes of myth and legend have been called together to stop the ceremony and slay Venadath so he may never attempt such a thing again. If you succeed, you will be fighting a vengeful ancient dragon with 7th level spells. If you’re too slow, you will fight a rampaging Greatwyrm with 9th level spells. Good luck!
sd: Stop a mad dragon from sacrificing a continent so they can ascend to godhood! Your characters will be level 20, and you'll need all that power before the end of the campaign…

t: Dungeons & Deadlines - Part 1: Welcome to the Dungeon
ds: A darkly comedic etting where dungeons are corporate offices and monsters are the employees. Forget heroes—you're a dungeon worker underpaid, overworked, and surrounded by traps, coworkers with claws, and an HR department that might actually be hellspawn. Your job? Help lure adventurers in, kill them, and turn a profit for your evil corporate overlords. Navigate bureaucracy, dodge backstabbing colleagues (and actual backstabs), and survive mandatory team-building quests, hostile mergers, and quarterly reviews that could get you killed—or promoted. It's office life, but with more fireballs.
sd: Join a corporate-fantasy RPG where monsters have jobs, dungeons run on KPIs, and adventuring is a workplace hazard. Solve problems, hit metrics, and survive office politics.

ds: Half Orc Sherrif Finrej Tadal has gathered the entire community together in a desperate attempt to save her home. The wandering tribe of Orcs continue to threaten the peaceful life most of the villagers choose to lead. You will be tasked with helping to bolster the defenses, train the villagers, scout out any weaknesses, and eventually defend the village from the inevitable orc raid.
sd: Sharentop. A quiet framing village a days walk from the Gnomish town of Hardbuckler. Under threat of annihilation from orc raids. Will you save the village or sift through the ashes?

t: "And they call it a mine. A mine!"
ds:
Argrathan Hardhammer has commissioned the Sword Coast's Adventurer's guild to send help. A nearby mine has stopped production because several miners, including the foreman, have goen missing. Mine shafts have collapsed, magic moves streangely about the tunnels, and rumors of unexplained occurences continue to surface around Mirabar.
 Adventurers are expendable. Should you fail? Your deaths will mean nothing but adding another name in the ledgers of "would be heroes." Should you succeed? You will be heralded as true allies of the Kingdom under the mountain and will walk away with as much treasure as you can carry.
sd: A mine collecting precious gems near Mirabar has shutdown due to missing workers and unknown disturbances. Will you find the source of the mysterious ticking noise or become a missing person yourself?

t: Diplomats on the Sea of Falling Stars
ds:
The Lord's alliance has contacted you and your party, an elite team of adventurers, to open a portal rumored to be located in an ancient temple in the sea of fallen stars. A temple devoted to the worship of a pair of long forgotten gods of the moon and the sea is rumored to house a portal to the elemental plane of water.
 Interested in the prospect of trade and potential politcal alliances, you and your party have been tasked with clearing the temple of any enemies and completing the ritual to open the portal. But beware the guardian. He is said to test the mettle of any who draw near and his tests are not to be taken lightly.
sd: Diving into an ancient temple to open a portal into the elemental plane of water, expect deadly traps, cunning enemies, and daring challenges to succeed this impossible adenture.

sd: When new dungeons open up, guild adventurers such as yourselves are tasked with it's exploration and rating. We wouldn't want newbies dropping into death traps, now would we?

ds: You are vampire punks eking out an existence on the streets of a city that doesn’t care about you. That’s why you were surprised to get an invite to the Party. You will be able to meet and mingle with the who’s who of the undead. Is this your chance to raise your standing in vampire society? Or, will you meet your final death at the hands of fire, other vampires, or even an ancient demon?
sd: You've been invited to the Party, the most exclusive event in the undead world. Is this your one chance to raise your standing in vampire society? Or, are you more likely to meet your final death?

lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: It’s been a week since members of the city’s vampire scene have started to disappear. At about the same time, creepy wax statues have appeared all over the place. The ancient vampires don’t seem to care about what’s happening. It’s up to you, the young punks, to get the bottom of this curse before it wipes out the city’s undead.

Inspired by shows like Power Rangers and Mystic Knights of Tir Na Nog, you’ll be creating a team of color-coordinated ‘90s superheroes in high school. So don’t touch that dial because we’ve got drama, comedy, and giant dragon robots in today’s session of Teens with Attitude.
sd: It's the '90s, and the bell isn't going to save you this time. It'll take giant robots, gadgets, and a team of teens with attitude to protect it.

ds: Inspired by shows like Captain Planet, Toxic Crusaders, and Saved by the Bell, you’ll be creating a team of totally 90’s superheroes gathered together to protect the world with elemental powers when you’re not trying to survive high school. So, are you ready to rock?
sd: It's the '90s, the world is in danger, and hopefully, you're not out of your element because the Earth needs a group of teens with attitude! So let your powers combine; it may be our only hope!

ds:

 "

ds:
Taking on the classic slasher genre in the Cinema Horror game system.
 The old music hall has been locked up, but now you're locked in with someone, something. People go missing, and corpses turn up.
 The players goal? to make it out alive, and find the Cinema Slasher before he finds them all.
sd: Can you survive, as the body count rises with the cinematic crescendo. A slasher is loose in the old symphony building. Make it out alive, if you can.

lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds:
The investigators are hired to look into the disappearance of socialite Lana Maloney. Evidence points to the new church group running soup kitchens throughout California. Their enigmatic leader The Reverend has been looking for something near his compound in the Nevada desert. The members of his inner circle Festus, and Dr. Jonathan spread charity, and brotherhood. Where is sister Lana, and what happens in the desert?
 The soup is to die for.
sd: What is the secret behind The Reverends' soup kitchen, and what is he doing in the Nevada desert?

t: Metal Gods of the Apocolypse: The Basilica
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds:
The players must cleanse the basilica of demonic influence. The high priest Tipton, will guide you through this scenario for dungeon crawl classics and prepare you to meet ""The Metal Gods"".
 So Start your motors, call your priest, prepare for the sabbath, and you are the last in line.
sd: The end is coming, and the four horsemen are embodied by some familiar faces.

lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds:
Please join us once again for the Classic AD&D experience of the original Ravenloft module. The count calls you through the mists, to make you his playthings. Explore his home, learn his story, and save his people from the looming specter of the castle.
 The original trip through the mists waits for all comers.
sd: Join us for a classic. The count Strahd waits in his tower, or his crypt only the cards may tell.

t: Metal Gods of the Apocolypse: The Pit
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds:
The Avatars of the Horsemen of metal ride with you, and he time has come for final battle. Wage war on a legendary epic landscape from the sad wings of destiny to snaggletooth.
 an epic for 3rd level DCC characters (pregens provided)
 
 So Start your motors, call your priest, prepare for the sabbath, and you are the last in line.
sd: You've cleaned the Basilica now the time has come, The Horsemen are here.

t: Furfolk of Usun: The Silence of Rukoth
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds:
Something ancient stirs beneath the roots.
 In the highlands of southern Usun lies Tuskmaw Hollow, a sacred cavern where earth, spirit, and tradition meet. For generations, the Badgers guard it as a place of communion, where the primal deity Rukoth chooses initiates to walk the path of Cleric or Druid.
 Now the initiates have vanished. Scouts, warriors, and elders followed, and none returned. Most chilling of all, Rukoth is silent.
 You are Furfolk adventurers summoned to investigate. Some wield divine power; others wield blade, spell, or stealth. Within, sacred trials lie corrupted, and their guardians hostile. This crisis of faith and balance may be resolved in more than one way—depending on your choices.
 Play anthropomorphic animal heroes built with Hero System 6th Edition in a tale of exploration, spiritual mystery, and perilous decisions.
 Welcome to Tuskmaw Hollow.
sd: Furfolk heroes investigate a corrupted sacred hollow where initiates vanished and a primal god has fallen silent. Explore twisted trials, make meaningful choices, and shape the spiritual fate of Usun.

t: Gamma Team: The Annexation of Al-Mahari
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds:
In the Galactic Federation, planetary war has been replaced by sanctioned Arena combat, where elite champions decide the fate of worlds through spectacle, honour, and performance. On the edge of civilisation, the desert world Al Mahari now stands at the centre of such a contest.
 Al Mahari is strategically vital, but its true value lies in its ancient traditions, song and dance preserved from Earth’s earliest cultures. In a Federation where material needs are easily met, culture has become the true currency of power, shaped by how champions fight and perform before the galaxy.
 The Makara have issued a formal challenge for annexation, seeking not only territory but cultural dominance. You are members of Gamma Team, Earth’s superheroic champions, entering a hostile Arena. Victory preserves culture and influence. Defeat costs a world, without a single missile fired.

ds: Perhaps your map is out of date. Or maybe you just made a wrong turn somewhere. Regardless of the reason the effect is the same: you’re lost. You don’t want the sweet treats you’re delivering to get stale before you arrive at your destination and, even worse, it’s starting to get dark. The only sign of civilization within the marsh is the enormous tower that's steadily been coming into view for the past hour but it’s not on your map and something about it seems…off. Prepare yourselves, princesses, for this journey is as sweet as the reward you'll reap; if you survive.
sd: The only refuge on your journey through the marsh is an enormous tower, which doesn't seem to be on your map. Will you dare to see what mysteries the tower holds?

ds:
You and a group of teenage misfits are going to show the world that prom is stupid and fake and you didn’t even want to go anyway so who cares that no one asked you to be their date. SO LAY OFF!!!
 There are only two things you need to know:
 1. You and your friends have an elaborate plan to steal the prom queen’s crown and sabotage prom.
 2. You are an ACTUAL GOBLIN.
 Take inspiration from movies like Mean Girls, Clueless, She's All That, Napoleon Dynamite, but now add 100% more GOBLINS!
sd: Prom is soooo overrated! It's time to unleash your chaos and show the world what's what. And no, it's NOT cause you didn't get a date, so stop asking!

ds: Rumors of a Sun Titan roaming a nearby sector has the VOIDFARERS on alert but no suns have been affected. Evidence seems to indicate that he is running. What could scare a being who can devour suns?
sd: Rumors of a Sun Titan roaming a nearby sector has the VOIDFARERS on alert but no suns have been affected. Evidence seems to indicate that he is running. What could scare a being who can devour suns?

t: The Summer of Green and Gold: a 1920s Mystery
ds: An original mystery based on the writings of F. Scott Fitzgerald that explores themes of inequality and the American Dream using overtly supernatural elements of cosmic horror. In August 1922, Chicago socialite Geneva Decker calls for an investigation into her ex-fiancé, a young bond salesman named Ray Wiccarank III, member of the Wiccarank hardware store dynasty. Little do these investigators know, what starts off as a simple investigation will escalate into a complex network of rumors, intrigue, and conspiracy that will see them contending with the worst aspects of the American aristocracy. Will the investigators be able to untangle this web or will they choke foul dust that floats in the wake of the American Dream? Players will be provided a selection of pre-made investigators, but may submit their original characters to be approved for use.
sd: Unravel a deadly celebration with the wealthiest people of 1922 Long Island! CW: Discussions and depictions of bigotry, body horror, domestic violence, incest, sacrifice, suicide, & vomiting.

ds: Surviving the wasteland is hard. Thriving is a death sentence. The old world died in a roar of fire, leaving behind a jagged landscape of rusted hulks and salt-blasted deserts. Water is currency, chrome is god, and the only thing faster than the bullets is the war rigs screaming across the dunes.
sd: The old world died in a roar of fire, leaving behind a jagged landscape of rusted hulks where the only thing faster than the bullets is the war-rigs screaming across the dunes.

ds: As a new member of the very reputable investigation firm, Graves Inc, one would assume your first assignment should be a walk in the park. Right? Welcome to the rain-soaked streets where ruthless gangsters and fire-and-brimstone zealots wage a shadow war for the city’s soul.
sd: Your first assignment as an investigator should be a walk in the park. Welcome to the rain-soaked streets where ruthless gangsters and fire-and-brimstone zealots wage a shadow war for the city’s soul.

t: Secret Agents of CROSS: Mission of Mercy
ds: Your blessed team of agents have been tasked with rescue a group of missionaries lost in a remote jungle. The question hangs in the air like a fever: Did these messengers of peace fall victim to the ancient, blood-stained rites of a pagan tribe?
sd: Your team of agents have been tasked with rescue a group of missionaries lost in a remote jungle. Did these messengers of peace fall victim to the ancient, blood-stained rites of a pagan tribe?

t: Salvage: The Wreck of the Black Nebula
ds: There should be great salvage to be found in the wrecked starship, Black Nebula. Rumors of something dark in the heart of the wreck has kept this claim undisturbed.
sd: There should be great salvage to be found in the wrecked starship, Black Nebula. Rumors of something dark in the heart of the wreck has kept this claim undisturbed.

ds: Zombies have started springing up in the city. The government thinks it's a lethal viral outbreak. The shady pharmaceutical company thinks it's an experiment gone wrong. You know that they're Nightmares borne from someone's fear of contamination. Now the question is: can you put an end to them before something terrible happens? Take the light of Hope into the shadows -- and blast a few monsters with friendship lasers along the way.
sd: Zombies shamble the streets, created by a Nightscape borne of the fear of contamination. As a magical girl, you have to defeat the fear and free its prisoner before someone does something drastic.

lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: Enjoy 1-Page Dice Dungeons as you lean into your character and storytelling. Learn in 10 minutes and finish a game in 2 hours as a Girl Power GM guides you in a flexible adventure that is never the same twice. All you need are dice and a place to take notes (and those will be provided!) When playing in Hindenburg's Redemption, your game master may pull from encounters across five different adventures of the world: Sky Serpent Siege, Fall Of Skysunder Isle, The Forge Awakens, The Crashed Sky Engine, and The Silent Veil. You'll play in a 1-Page system based on a core decision die that will allow you to choose character-centric play OR heavy mechanics. Great game for RPG Newbies OR for experienced players. Overwhelmed by complex rulesets? Interested in pushing the limits of unique mechanics? This is the time and Hindenburg's Redemption is the place. Play how you want to play!
sd: Navigate the starry sky over a colony of sky islands down to the ruins of Earth That Was in this Steampunk World's Theater of the Mind adventure with Red Rose Works' Girl Power.

ds: Navigate storms, toxins, & one another! Dungeon Race RPG is character-first play in a system with flavorful, choice-driven mechanics that reward creativity & dynamic relationships. Based on the Broken Fault Lines series, the heart-pounding quest is broken into 2 unique missions across 2 tables. Engage in team play at sea and on the drowning Earth to eventually find yourself at a melting ice shelf in an all-hands-on-deck, pulse-pounding race to launch off-planet, even while you don't know which players are your allies. Bits, bots, cards, maps, and partially pre-gen characters that leave room for customization work to create the tactile experience of board games and the freedom of tabletop storytelling in a unique roleplaying adventure. Accessible enough for newcomers and layered with enough complexity to challenge veterans who’ve rolled dice for decades.
sd: Race against time & one another as you outfit your ship in time to leave a drowning planet on a biodome. High action and adrenaline play in a multi-gamemaster adventure across 2 faction-based tables.

t: Swamp Prison - A One-Shot In The Arm
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: Created as part of a "Create Your Own 1-Page RPG" workshop, this world-heavy adventure not only challenges players as much as any one-shot adventure in a traditional system, it also lays out a great foundation for how to develop one's own singular adventures for when a group needs that shot in the arm to liven things up. What better way to prove it out than to enjoy the adventure! Played in an easy-to-learn D20 system ("Theater Of The Dice") that rewards creativity and imagination.
sd: A world with little room for redemption tries to keep you from achieving it in this Theatre of the Mind system. Plants, shadows, & the swamp try to trap you, but there's hope if you find it in time.

lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: The Martian Campaign is a full-length collection of short stories by Ray Bradbury tied together with short TTRPGs by today's leading game writers. There are experiences for wanderers, colonists, and explorers, but each one is for those who love an adventure! It will be played in one of 6 easy-to-learn rulesets that will be rolled for at the event!
sd: A 1950s pulp-sci-fantasy adventure based works of Ray Bradbury. Written by Tiffany Rose Nickel (Goodman Games, Chaosium, G20), join Wanderers from Earth, Mars, & beyond as they encounter the unknown.

lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: Navigate storms, toxins, & one another! Dungeon Race RPG is character-first play in a system with flavorful, choice-driven mechanics that reward creativity & dynamic relationships. Based on the Broken Fault Lines series, the heart-pounding quest is broken into 2 unique missions and, on a single table with all of the factions, you may not know who you can trust! Enjoy play at sea and on a drowning Earth before finding yourself in a pulse-pounding race to launch off-plane. Bits, bots, cards, maps, and partially pre-generated characters that leave room for customization work together to create the tactile experience of board games and the freedom of tabletop storytelling in a unique roleplaying adventure. The system is accessible enough for newcomers and layered with enough complexity to challenge the TTRPG veterans who’ve rolled their dice for decades. No experience or materials needed!
sd: Outfit your ship in time to leave a drowning planet on a biodome in a shortened, intensified faction race epic. High action and adrenaline play in a 2-part game with unique encounters and mechanics!

ds: A new cave system has been discovered behind waterfalls known as the Falls of Sekolah. Now, adventuring parties from across the continent race to explore the depths and uncover its secrets. But few know what actually awaits them in the dark. Planned for Level 8 characters. Players can create their own, or pre-gens will be provided.
sd: Will your party uncover lost treasures behind the Falls of Sekolah? Others race to find the secrets hidden in their depths, but your party seems to have arrived early enough to get your share!

ds:
Gallack Anasul wants his staff back. His rival, Moritz Eisenbaum has stolen it and left it at the top of his own tower, filled with challenges and monsters spawned from the elemental planes. Can you and your party defeat them and claim the reward from Gallack?
 
 Planned for Level 8 characters. Players can create their own, or pre-gens will be provided.
sd: Can you breach the elemental challenges of the wizard's tower to gain the prize? Or will you be yet another party drowned/burned/crushed/suffocated by the forces ahead?

ds: The last thing your party remembers is the smell of honeysuckle and juniper. But you now find yourselves in a fantastical world with no clear way home. Perhaps you can entreat those creatures who live her to return you? Or will you enrage them by treading upon their sacred ground? The stories of the Faewild leave you uncertain to the outcome, but fear is a powerful motivator. Planned for Level 8 characters. Players can create their own, or pre-gens will be provided.
sd: Your party awakes in the forest of Fae, uncertain how to get home. Can you do so before the protectors of the forest defeat you? Or will your souls be ever lost to the Faewild?

t: Hunt Myths, Seek Glory (New Players Welcome!)
ds: New to roleplaying? Perfect! This game is designed for you! Step into the role of knight errant in a dreamlike medieval realm inspired by Arthurian legend and British folklore. Your quest: hunt down myths - legendary creatures, strange phenomena, and mysterious forces - while earning glory and protecting the realm. Combat is quick and decisive - you skip straight to damage rolls, no complicated attack sequences. The game emphasizes creative problem-solving, bold action, and collaborative storytelling mechanics. Whether you've never played an RPG before or you're a veteran looking for something fresh, you'll find yourself quickly immersed in a world of knights, legends, and mythic quests.
sd: Play a knight hunting myths in a dreamlike medieval realm. Fast, simple rules perfect for new players. No experience needed. Just bring your imagination!

t: The Rabid Arena - Player Versus Player
gm: Erik Norris, Dannielle Hasty, Andrew Kelble, Craig Baker, Celeste Bloodreign
ds:
In a turn-based miniature battle using premade characters to match their designated miniatures, players will fight it out while entertaining the Emperor who watches from above.
 
 Each signup includes;
 A blind box of 3 resin printed minis
 Custom pre-made character sheets to go with your blind box mini’s
 3 Deathwish 5e cards for use in the Rabid Arena or future Deathwish 5e Sessions
 1 Rabid Arena Promo Card for Deathwish 5e
 A code to unlock an exclusive set of virtual dice for DDDice
 A prize for the winner of each session
 
 Players will get to keep all signup materials.
sd: A gladiatorial arena using modified rules where players will battle a grand boss and each other until just one is declared the Arena Champion.

ds: An old, walled-off garden in the middle of the city is said to hold olden power, though rarely do citizens find anything amiss when walking the brick paths. That is, until of late, when strange rumors have been circulating. Howling winds and spectral hoofbeats that cease the minute you exit the garden. The baying of hounds. Apparitions in the winter sky. With Yule fast approaching, you wonder if these are typical festive ghost tales, or warnings of something more..

ds:
The slaughter at the Battle of the Somme in 1916 tore the veil between our world and realms unknown. From that wound crawled the demonic Others, eager to twist the Great War into something far worse. In this grim supernatural survival adventure, a battered squad of WW I soldiers, known only as the “Benothings" (BENOTHS) by command, find themselves cut off, outmatched, and stalked by enemies human and inhuman alike. Is a Benothing’s dream of home already lost to the mud and the Others?
 Body horror, blood/gore, supernatural/occult, violence (PG-13/R)
sd: A battered squad of WW I soldiers, known only as the "Benothings" (BENOTHS) by command, find themselves cut off, outmatched, and stalked by enemies human and inhuman alike.

lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: The Guilds of Ravnica once again call for your aid! The past events of the 6 guilds has led to mass public distrust and unease around the city. The reputation of the Guilds is starting to decline, and trust in them is faltering, threatening to break down the status quo that we have. That cannot happen! The Azorius have decided to hold a public forum about this issue, answering questions and reinstating of various laws to keep the peace. You must escort Judge Espershroud from his safe house and towards the Azorius forum where he will deliver his speech and attempt to start fixing the public image of the Guilds.
sd: Once again you must answer the call of your guilds, as your city needs your aid in these dark times! The past events of the guilds has brought distrust to the public, and we must settle their minds.

ds: The basic plan is agreed upon- You will go under the cover of night while the King's army attacks with siege engines and fire. But what is the best way in? Through a neglected or forgotten passageway into the fortress through an aged, rotted back-door covered in briars and old forest growth? Up through the murky river's effluence from beneath the fortress? Or through the breach in the roof on the backside up against the mountain face, slipping in while the guard is distracted? And do you trust the dark-cloaked figure standing before you, paid to betray his clan for this information?
sd: The King's sister was abducted and sold to the rival state. You stand around a map of the rival stronghold in the war room as you consider options to infiltrate the fortress and extract the captive.

t: A Twisted Time for Teen Heroes
gm: Andy Ashcraft, Eric Spuur, Jared Logan
ds: In this 3-table / 3-GM game, players will take on the roles of the Golden Age teen heroes of the Justice Society, the modern Teen Titans, and the Legion of Super Heroes of the 30th Century in a mystery that spans over 1000 years. Actions taken in the past will affect the heroes of the future as the teen heroes stop a calculated cross-time heist! New to The Hero Instant? Great! No experience necessary. Contact us if you have a special request or question. (Note: if this seems familiar, this is a revamp of a game we ran in 2025.)

t: JLA + Avengers: Two Universes, Two Teams
ds: In this 2-table / 2 GM crossover game, you'll play as the greatest heroes of two separate realities try to work together to solve parallel mysteries in parallel universes! New to The Hero Instant? Great! No experience necessary. Contact us if you have a special request or question. (Note: if this seems familiar, this is a revamp of a game we ran in 2024.)
sd: When parademons invade New York City, you know there is a real problem between the parallel universes! How can the Avengers and the Justice League work together to solve this problem?

ds: You are a do'er, a ganger in the Echo Lords clan and tensions are on the rise on your clan's borders with frequent clashes with the Death Hawx and Hive Dragons. The every day part of being a do'er is to make sure wasters aren't sleeping on duty and nufkins aren't slacking on their jobs, of course this is day-to-day when you ain't at war with other clans. With the state of things being what they are, you are finding yourself on nightly patrols. One night in particular seems to be like any other night until you happen upon a bovirac cattle massacre. It now falls on you and your crew to track down who or what committed this atrocity before more of the clan's food supply is destroyed.
sd: You are a mutant like any other mutant trying to survive the waste-lands. You're a do'er, whether it be a Scavver, Rager, Prophet, etc, you are expected to protect the clan and get stuff done.

A new shadow is approaching from the south, threatening the fragile peace of the northern nations. To keep the darkness at bay, Aliyah Sandspeaker has a plan, to activate an ancient magical failsafe against invasion, a barrier that will seal off the southern continent. 
 
 To do so she will need to find the fabled ancient city of Zerura, which holds the magical mechanism that can activate the barrier. 
 
 A call has gone out for brave heroes to escort her on this perilous journey.
sd:
Travel through a desert wasteland in search of a ruined city and aid a sorceress with a ritual to keep a dark army from invading.
 A dnd mini-campaign for lvl 7 characters. This is session 1 of 3.

Heroes have set out to seal off the darkness, but their effort may be in vain as something is siphoning off and absorbing magical energy, preventing powerful spells from working correctly. Sevento, a mysterious halfling wizard claims to have found the origin of the arcane disturbance. 
 
 Within a deep unexplored crevasse lies a perilous jungle. Within this jungle an evil parasite is feeding on the magical energies that course through the world. 
 
 Sevento is looking for those willing to descend into the unexplored wilderness and hunt down this magical parasite.
sd: Something is feeding on arcane energies. A wizard is looking for heroes to hunt down the creature responsible. A mini-campaign for lvl 1 characters. This is session 1 of 3

t: Dungeons & Deadlines - Part 1: Welcome to the Dungeon
ds: A darkly comedic etting where dungeons are corporate offices and monsters are the employees. Forget heroes—you're a dungeon worker underpaid, overworked, and surrounded by traps, coworkers with claws, and an HR department that might actually be hellspawn. Your job? Help lure adventurers in, kill them, and turn a profit for your evil corporate overlords. Navigate bureaucracy, dodge backstabbing colleagues (and actual backstabs), and survive mandatory team-building quests, hostile mergers, and quarterly reviews that could get you killed—or promoted. It's office life, but with more fireballs.
sd: Join a corporate-fantasy RPG where monsters have jobs, dungeons run on KPIs, and adventuring is a workplace hazard. Solve problems, hit metrics, and survive office politics.

t: Dungeons & Deadlines - Part 2: Teamwork Makes the Screams Work
ds:
Q3 was a success—against all odds, the Dungeon hit its numbers. Now Corporate wants more. The Dungeon has been flagged for a merger under a new Synergy Initiative, and integration is already underway.
 
 Immediately, things begin to break. Reports disappear. Systems conflict. Someone inside the Dungeon doesn’t want this merger—and they’re willing to do anything to stop it.
 
 This one-shot blends investigation, roleplay, dark humor, and tactical combat in a corporate-fantasy dungeon setting. Success or Failure of the merger relies upon you and your choices—and how well you handle synergy under pressure!
 
 Attendees will receive: 
 - Dungeons & Deadlines T-Shirt
 - Custom Character Mini
 - Commorative Employee ID
 - Custom Character Sheet
sd: Join a corporate-fantasy RPG where monsters have jobs, dungeons run on KPIs, and adventuring is a workplace hazard. Solve problems, hit metrics, and survive office politics.

Forget heroes—you're a dungeon worker underpaid, overworked, and surrounded by traps, coworkers with claws, and an HR department that might actually be hellspawn. Your job? Help lure adventurers in, kill them, and turn a profit for your evil corporate overlords. Navigate bureaucracy, dodge backstabbing colleagues (and actual backstabs), and survive mandatory team-building quests, hostile mergers, and quarterly reviews that could get you killed—or promoted. It's office life, but with more fireballs.
sd: Join a corporate-fantasy RPG where monsters have jobs, dungeons run on KPIs, and adventuring is a workplace hazard. Solve problems, hit metrics, and survive office politics.

t: Dungeons & Deadlines - Part 2: Teamwork Makes the Screams Work
ds:
Q3 was a success—against all odds, the Dungeon hit its numbers. Now Corporate wants more. The Dungeon has been flagged for a merger under a new Synergy Initiative, and integration is already underway.
 
 Immediately, things begin to break. Reports disappear. Systems conflict. Someone inside the Dungeon doesn’t want this merger—and they’re willing to do anything to stop it.
 
 This one-shot blends investigation, roleplay, dark humor, and tactical combat in a corporate-fantasy dungeon setting. Success or Failure of the merger relies upon you and your choices—and how well you handle synergy under pressure!
 
 Attendees will receive: 
 - Dungeons & Deadlines T-Shirt
 - Custom Character Mini
 - Commorative Employee ID
 - Custom Character Sheet

ds:
"Sunday, January 2nd, 1927. A roaring New Years party at the New Green Mill Café ended with a man lying dead in a snowy alley behind the speakeasy. You’ve been hired to find out who did it and why. After that? Make them pay. But when your investigation leads you through the smuggling tunnels beneath the city, what long forgotten secrets will you find?
 
 Dry January is a one-shot Cthulhu Awakens adventure set in 1927 for four to six players. If you want to bring your own dice, bring three d6 where one die is recognizably different from the other two.
 
 Content warnings: body horror, alcohol and drug use, violence, death, and depictions of horrific creatures. No real life bigotry, hate, or harassment will be tolerated."
sd: It’s an open secret that the mob runs booze through the tunnels under Chicago. But will what you discover while solving a murder at an infamous speakeasy make you swear off drinking for good?

ds: And so, Santa has decided to offer one final gift to the children of the world. The cleansing fire. But hope still remains for the people of the world! For Santa has grown weak in his years of dormancy. A brave group of adventurers travels to the far north to put an end to Santa's plans. They arrive at Santa's workshop on the eve of Evil Christmas!
sd: It has been 3000 years and the ancient celestial being known as 'Santa Clause' has finally returned to his people. But this is not the nice world he left behind, the world has become naughty!

ds: But now something stirs beneath the crumbling blocks. Beastmen howl in the night and your fellow villagers are snatched from their beds. With no heroes to defend you, who will rise to stand against the encircling darkness? The secrets of Chaos are yours to unearth, but at what cost to sanity or soul? This is a 0-level funnel placing adventurers against the legacy of the Chaos Lords and their corrupted hordes. Delving beneath the crumbling ruins, the characters discover ancient crypts, a starless sea, and an ancient ziggurat, where death and treasure await in equal measure!
sd: You and your people have always toiled in the shadow of the cyclopean ruins. Of mysterious origins and the source of many a superstition, they have always been considered a secret best left unknown

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Pre-gens provided, no experience needed. Can you stay ahead of the law while you figure it out?
sd: The team has had a rough week of running ops. They get to Vegas and blow off some steam. Nobody remembers last night, especially the dead body. Who is it? How did they get in the room?

t: Rockers and Rollers: The First Gig
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: It’s time to find out if one-night stands are harder while playing in a rock and roll band. Begin a career playing ting gigs (a school gym or a church basement), rocket to stardom and become superstars or burnout, break up, and fade away. Think Spinal Tap meets Behind the Music. Talent is optional, a sense of humor is mandatory. This is an Adult themed game for S/D/ and Rock and Roll. Nobody under the age of 18 will be admitted.
sd: Are you an axe grinder, a pile driver? Do you have what it takes to rock and roll all night. Because they say it's a long way to the top if you want to rock and roll.

t: The Sablewood Messengers w/ GM Atari (200+ Professional Sessions)
ds:
Marlowe Fairwind, the right-hand sorcerer of King Emeris, has gathered her most trusted allies to carry an important package to Hush, a small village within the ancient forest of Sablewood. The crate is large, heavy and sealed with magic, addressed to the Whitefire Arcanist. You’ve been given a map and a carriage, and the promise of reward upon your arrival.
 
 Pre-generated characters will be provided and the rules will be explained during the session. Grab your character, and join this adventure!
sd: You trek through an ancient forest with the King's court sorcerer by carriage, bearing a large, mysterious crate addressed to the Whitefire Arcanist. Atari has hosted over 200 pro sessions on SPG!

ds:
Dwindle is a domain of loss and loneliness: a vast desert realm where memory and mirage are one and the same. On the eve of a much-anticipated dinner, an elderly resident of Dwindle, Forough Khanom, awakes to find her vegetable garden trampled. To save her dinner, the characters must brave the dunes of the departed in search of ingredients from the Sabzi Knoll.
 
 Rules will be taught during the game. Pre-generated characters will be provided during the session.
sd: Based on one of the Feywild Domain of Delight, with a good mix of combat and roleplaying. Perfect for new players that want to learn.

ds: Welcome to Briarholt Academy of Arcane Studies, a hidden magical school tucked in an Appalachian holler—its lantern-lit halls and stone stairways carved straight into a red rock canyon. You’ll play first-year students navigating house rivalries, secret faculty agendas, and the unsettling truth that the school isn’t just a place of learning… it’s a containment system with a long memory. This game is for players who enjoy school-season drama, secrets, and solving problems creatively—with just enough danger to keep the lantern light feeling precious. You don’t need deep system mastery: I’ll keep rules support friendly and focus on immersive scenes, meaningful choices, and a finale you’ll enjoy.
sd: Prepare to craft a potion with your group, then follow your sense of adventure as something dark and slimy roams the Academy grounds. (Team Puzzle/Mystery/Boss Battle) [Rule of Cool]

ds: If you're interested in the system but not sure you want to commit to multi hour sessions this is for you! A short 1 hour session to give you a small taste. Potion crafting is a 3-phase, teamwork mini-game where you build a dice pool from ingredients. After rolls, you record pairs: pure pairs raise Stability, mixed pairs raise Tension, and the values of all pairs (plus bonuses) become Yield—the potion’s strength. Phase 1: (swap ingredients, set rerolls, neutralize opposites, or split/downgrade dice). Phase 2: (shift polarity, boost a die, reroll for pairs, or convert mixed to pure). Phase 3: (reroll a polarity, lock a pair, vent failures, or purge mixed pairs). Final strength is based on Yield. If Tension > Stability, Pressure = Tension−Stability and you roll that many d6 for side effects/complications, on a 1 and 6 something bad happens.
sd: Prepare to craft a potion with your group, choose your ingredients, strategize with your group over the three phases of potion crafting to make the best potion! (Team Puzzle/Mini-game) [Rule of Cool]

ds: The recent Wolf War between Haven and Fanewick had cost a number of lives, mortal and minor divinity alike. There was no true victor. In the aftermath of destruction, you stumbled upon an unlikely survivor of the battlefield: a new Faint Divinity in the form of a wolf named Tasa. You realize this may be the last of the Wolf Tribe, and if you do not help her, her kind will perish from the land forever. The Party chosen by destiny to defend this young god will face challenges deep in the wilds. Pursued by hunters, fanatics, and soldiers from Haven, the Party also needs to protect the young pup from the Withered monstrosities that are rampaging the woods, harsh magical habitats, and competing tribes of Faint Divinities with grudges against the Wolf Tribe… By the warmth of the campfire and the heat of battle, you can count on your new friends to see the quest through to the end.
sd: In the aftermath of a great battle with Haven, the last pup of the divine Wolf Tribe needs safe passage home to the forests of Fanewick. Can you safeguard them through the wonders and perils ahead?

ds: Your home of Argent needs regular supply runs, and this time you have been called upon to fulfill your duty. Travelling along the post-apocalyptic landscape, ancient and unfathomable dangers will arrive in the form of metal, electricity, and glass. Under high-caliber wires and the shadows of crumbling steel towers, you must defend your supply vehicle, an octopedal supply truck from older times, or risk irreversible hardship for your community. Medicines, seed stocks, and engineering parts vital to keeping Argent safe are at risk. Road blockages, hostile machines, and the persistent trials will test what you are really made of. And through it all, a hidden menace will chase the party until there is nowhere left to run. So, in this post-apocalyptic sci-fi Daggerheart game, are you made of metal or glass?
sd: It is quiet through the Echo Vale, save for the sounds of soft rains, the arachnid cargo truck lumbering along Dish Ridge, and the predatory machine Remnants that stalk the caravan.

ds: In this special Daggerheart event, you will be transported to a royal masquerade ball featuring lively voiced NPCs, enchanting soundscapes, detailed miniatures, and a seasoned improv GM. But however magical the ambiance is, you come with goals beyond hors d'oeuvres and hobnobbing. This might be your one chance to catch the king’s ear and make your dreams come true. Of course, there’s over a dozen VIPs with goals of their own. Each one pursues their own set schedule as the clock ticks down to midnight, and your intervention could hinder them, help you, or just send the night into absolute madness. With so many character and event combinations, no two games are exactly the same and the masquerade ball you create is a unique experience you’ll never forget! Come in costume if you like, the GM certainly will!
sd: You're cordially invited to celebrate the engagement of Princess Toadbottom to Prince Nightscale of the Sand Kingdom. Experience a night full of romance,roleplay, hidden agendas, and chaos galore.

t: Leaving Erin: A First-Time Delve into Beast World
ds: In the kingdom of Allemance, four friends are about to trade their plows for swords. "Leaving Erin" is a high-energy adventure designed to take players from humble beginnings to legendary delvers. You’ll start in the sleepy village of Erin, where a missing sister and a strange monster provide the first test of your heroism. From there, you'll secure a "house-wagon", a modular, moving fortress, and join the Littfeld Caravan, a massive traveling city of adventurers. This session is specifically built for beginners to D&D 5e or experienced players new to Beast World. It features a focus on camaraderie, community, and the thrill of the open road. All materials, including dice and pre-generated "Beast" characters will be provided.
sd: Leave the farm behind and join a crew of animal adventurers! Repair your house-wagon, join a traveling caravan, and survive your first dungeon.

ds: Cosmic forces have conspired to bring together all the biggest bads of the Monster Manual, and it's up to you to smack them down. You're a level 20 hero of legend and you've got the feats, spell levels, and magic items to prove it. Yet while many of the threats are iconic, someone unknown is pulling the strings. And that someone is sure to offer some surprises you won't find in the pages of popular books. Come for a chance to finally cast Wish, stay for an experienced DM who's rated highly for his fast-paced, creative, and engaging combat! This is a great game to bring back characters who never got to reach high levels, players who have never tried level 20 play, or that busted multiclass build your DM won't let you play.
sd: Want to play your character at the highest level? Wield legendary weapons and bring your Simulacrum into battle without jumping through hoops? Here's the no-holds-barred brawl of your dreams!

ds: What was supposed to be a day to relax without an impending apocalypse is quickly becoming anything but. The strange, hooded messenger before you assures you the fate of the multiverse depends on you following them through a swirling portal. Stepping through, you emerge into a land that feels familiar, even nostalgic, though you’ve never been here before. From other portals, messengers wearing similar cloaks appear, each leading an adventurer. One by one, each messenger announces the adventurer they escorted... An ancient time dragon beseeches you for aid, to save her lover and the balance of the multiverse itself!
sd: The misinterpretation of an ancient prophecy now threatens the entire multiverse! A group of powerful adventurers are needed to save the planes.

ds: You are now a powerful adventurer, but earlier in your life it was you in need of rescue. Whether from a fight you couldn't take on yourself, suffered from a curse and needed restoration, or were simply going to die in the forest from starvation due to your pitiful survival skills, the Ethlezelli elven tribe took you in and nursed you back to health. You owe them a life debt, and years later it's time to collect. For the Ethlezelli have fallen into serious trouble: a crystal infection that spread from their sacred forests into their very own bodies and hearts. They are in desperate need of aid, and their leader magically reached out to you and several others in order to stop the corruption.
sd: Help save an elven village that once saved you from a crystalline infection!

ds: The long sought after demiplane known as Horizon's Edge has been located in the Deep Ethereal plane. Created by an ancient empire of giants from ages past, legends say their magical and technological advances surpass even our present age. Secrets, relics, and glory are for the taking- if you have the mettle to face its ancient guardians, the wit to surpass arcane wards, and the courage to accept the trial of Annam.
sd: Can you survive the Trial of Annam?

ds: Low level adventurers have recently gone missing while traveling through the city of Phlan, including one of your own mentees. You've decided to team up with several of your fellow level 20 friends to investigate what's going on. But not all is as it seems, and perhaps the real enemy is only minutes away... The final countdown begins... and only the strongest will survive!
sd: A search and rescue mission goes sideways when you find an alien ship.

ds: Zhentarim traders. Shadowy figures roaming the fields near Hillsfar. How do these all relate? Everything traces back to the recently unearthed grave-barrows. Rescuing a caravan from undead attackers, you learn of an ancient danger. Can you delve into the barrows, rescue the missing traders, and get out alive?
sd: Discover the mystery behind the ancient sword Dawnfire and stop the restless undead!

t: The Golden Lady and the King of Dragons (level 20)
ds: The Golden Lady is missing. Odyssey Enterprises, an imperial trading company that has risen to power on the backs of its workers, has claimed Waukeen, the Golden Lady and goddess of trade, as their patron. Her voice has been quiet for the past year, but some believe she waits to overthrow one who would rule trade in her stead. Reclusive founder Jorgen Reeve, the affluent “Lord of Coin” and “King of Dragons,” has promised a grand new venture to be announced at his annual gala… tonight. Sources say a clandestine ritual is at work and the silence of a goddess bodes ill.
sd: When a goddess reaches out to you, pleading for help, can you rise to the challenge?

lo: JW White River Ballroom E HQ
ds: The crew of the aging hauler USCSS Fidanza is en route to Jeremiah VI, a remote mining colony, on a routine supply and salvage run. But the colony has gone dark—and what little signal gets through speaks of cult violence, corporate lockdowns, and something unearthed deep below. Caught between zealots, panicked workers, and Weyland-Yutani operatives, the crew holds the only ticket off-world. Something is down there—and it’s waiting for them.
sd: The crew of the USCSS Fidanza is en route to Jeremiah VI, on a routine supply run when the colony goes dark. The faint signal hints at cult violence, lockdowns, and something unearthed deep below.

gm: Erik Norris, Shyann Jobe, Dannielle Hasty
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds: Embark on an adventure of heart and heroism: Pack your basket of goodies, sharpen your trusty hatchets and call upon your Fairy Godmotherʼs magical Gift to help you face the perils ahead. When your quest to deliver precious goodies is interrupted by the evil witchʼs candy magic, itʼll be up to the party to brave the fairy tale tricks and traps of the witchʼs tower to stage a daring rescue. If youʼre new to the Perils & Princesses system, no worries. Weʼll teach you everything you need to know and get you started on your adventure with a pre-generated character. Perfect for seasoned gamers, new players and families alike.
sd: A gritty and pretty fairy tale adventure. Stealthily explore a candy-cursed witchʼs tower to stage a daring rescue before the witch returns and you find yourselves in needof rescue as well.

ds: Get a sneak peek at Oddfish Games forthcoming RPG, a “narrative forward and rules-medium”. Captures the feeling of disaster and kaiju movies, like Godzilla, Them!, or The Core by pitting everyday humans against titanic, catastrophic forces beyond their ability to fight. You will take on the role of rookie agents at the Leviathan Agency, an international NGO created to research and contain "unnatural phenomena". Your job is to investigate the hundreds of reports The Agency receives to determine whether they warrant more attention. You will receive three ‘case files’ and, as a group, choose which to investigate. The story will evolve from there, based on your choices and rolls. The tone of Leviathan games can run anywhere from serious and philosophical to wacky and heroic - it will be up to the players to decide where we go in this game!
sd: It’s your first assignment as a rookie agent with the Leviathan Agency. You’ve been trained to handle anything: Mad scientists? Aliens? Check. Giant monsters? Big check. What could possibly go wrong?

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: This is a routine haul of tritium gas to a Frontier colony. You are a member of a Weyland-Yutani crew which intercepted a decades old distress signal from a long lost freighter. Chariot of the Gods is a sci-fi horror scenario for Alien RPG. The system keeps a focus on tension, survival and making hard choices. We will be playing with the new Evolved Edition (aka. 2nd edition). No prior experience needed. All materials provided, select from available pre-made characters each with their own agenda.
sd: Deep space hauling crew needed. Keep the ship afloat, follow orders, and don't ask what the Company isn't telling you.

ds:
In Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils, a narrative-driven, wild west, steampunk magipunk adventure bursting with chaos, light rules, and ridiculous fun, your homeless, hungry kobold clan is one bad torch away from extinction—and desperate times call for reckless real estate acquisition. The plan? Seize Castle Raisinloaf and make it yours.
 
 Unfortunately, it’s occupied by the brooding (and extremely bitey) Vampire Lord C'hahd and a buffet of monsters, mercenaries, and things that skitter in the dark. Rumor whispers his still-beating Heart lies hidden deep within the castle’s cursed halls. Capture it, and the pale tyrant must kneel. Fail, and you’re appetizers. Grab your six-shooters, your posse, and your questionable courage—tonight, the kobolds raid.

t: Whispers from the Deep - Midnight Sun
ds:
Special Horror Edition! 
 
 Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils is a high-octane, improv-driven, rules-light, card-powered narrative heist set in a lawless western steampunk magipunk frontier. Devil’s Gulch has gone dark. Travelers vanish. The wildlife has fled. Vultures circle above an empty town that should not be empty.
 
 Gather up to six other kobolds and venture into the silent streets to uncover the truth, seize the mysterious Mind Shard, and escape… “alive.” This two-hour, loosely cooperative chaos-fest rewards bold creativity, reckless teamwork, and increasingly catastrophic decisions as you break in, grab the prize, and get out — preferably before everything (and everyone) explodes.
 
 What is the Mind Shard? Why do you need it? How many kobolds can you fit in a trench coat? Only time will tell.
 
 Presented by Kobold Game Labs — please use your Kobold Posse Responsibly.
sd: Devil’s Gulch is silent. Team up with 6 kobolds to uncover the mystery, grab the Mind Shard, and escape “alive” in this high-octane magipunk heist.

ds:
Become one of the brave rangers who harry the terrors of the night! No pay but grateful thanks, no provisions save what the kindly free folk of Inoka can spare, but danger and adventure in abundance! Sign here friend and live a life of glory and fame!
 Centuries ago, another reality collided with ours, bringing magic and alien invaders, altering the land and changing the very nature of the world. The Heartlands, a fantasy setting much like ours, so much it might lie out there down the wrong fork in the trial, on the other side of the creek, in the darkness of a limestone cave.
 The forest is calling, and we must go.
sd: Coming upon the Jones freestead under attack by pumpkin headed monsters, our heroes intervene to stop to the Headless Horseman and his master, the Demon of Red Hills!

In Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils, a narrative-driven, wild west, steampunk magipunk adventure bursting with chaos, light rules, and ridiculous fun, your homeless, hungry kobold clan is one bad torch away from extinction—and desperate times call for reckless real estate acquisition. The plan? Seize Castle Raisinloaf and make it yours.
 
 Unfortunately, it’s occupied by the brooding (and extremely bitey) Vampire Lord C'hahd and a buffet of monsters, mercenaries, and things that skitter in the dark. Rumor whispers his still-beating Heart lies hidden deep within the castle’s cursed halls. Capture it, and the pale tyrant must kneel. Fail, and you’re appetizers. Grab your six-shooters, your posse, and your questionable courage—tonight, the kobolds raid.
sd: Homeless kobolds raid Castle Raisinloaf to seize Vampire Lord C'hahd's hidden Heart. Win a new home. Fail and become dinner. Chaos, guns, and magipunk mayhem!

sd: Get in, get out, and murder everything (and everyone) in between! Your team of up to 7 Kobolds must cooperatively (or competitively) heist the Heart of Tr'shad!

ds:
In Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils, a narrative-driven, wild west, steampunk magipunk adventure bursting with chaos, light rules, and ridiculous fun, your homeless, hungry kobold clan is one bad torch away from extinction—and desperate times call for reckless real estate acquisition. The plan? Seize Castle Raisinloaf and make it yours.
 
 Unfortunately, it’s occupied by the brooding (and extremely bitey) Vampire Lord C'hahd and a buffet of monsters, mercenaries, and things that skitter in the dark. Rumor whispers his still-beating Heart lies hidden deep within the castle’s cursed halls. Capture it, and the pale tyrant must kneel. Fail, and you’re appetizers. Grab your six-shooters, your posse, and your questionable courage—tonight, the kobolds raid.
sd: Homeless kobolds raid Castle Raisinloaf to seize Vampire Lord C'hahd's hidden Heart. Win a new home. Fail and become dinner. Chaos, guns, and magipunk mayhem!

ds:
You awaken with a box. A single glowing rune burns across its surface. You step into town - moments later, the sky tears open in an arcane cataclysm. Everyone dies. You awaken again. The box remains. Now two runes glow.
 
 Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils is a high-octane, improv-driven, rules-light, card-powered narrative adventure set in a lawless western steampunk magipunk frontier. Trapped in a deadly time loop, you and up to six other kobolds must explore the town, unravel the mystery of the Time Shard, and break the cycle before the world ends - again.
 
 This two-hour, loosely cooperative chaos-fest rewards bold creativity, reckless teamwork, and increasingly catastrophic decisions as you experiment, adapt, and desperately try to escape… “alive.”
 
 What is the Time Shard? Why is it bound to you? How many kobolds can you fit in a trench coat?
 
 Only time will tell.
 Track 3 (2026)
sd: Trapped in a deadly time loop, you and up to 6 kobolds must unravel the Time Shard’s mystery and stop an arcane cataclysm in this fast-paced, chaotic magipunk adventure.

t: Final Fantasy: Tales of the Turks
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: Greetings Turks, we have a new mission for you, consider this a promotion. A new town is being built and our informants have discovered that there might be a piece of Jenova left, having taken over a new vessel in order to once again bring about the end of the Planet. Your mission is to find and exterminate this rogue factor, contain or destroy the piece of Jenova, and initiate damage control of the mission at hand, expunging all records of Jenova and the rogue factor from as many areas as possible. Upon completion of this quest, you will be up for your promotion. Shinra thanks you for cooperation and support, and the Planet thanks you as well.
sd: Welcome to the Turks, recruits. You know that we're doing intense damage control after Meteorfall and Geostigma Incident. We have a mission for you to accept to better the public trust of Shinra.

ds: The city of Al-Yaman has been attacked! The infamous band of Forty Thieves has ransacked the city, spreading terror and disquiet. They even breached the royal palace! The only thing stolen? A family heirloom, an old brass lamp. The Princess Scheherazade has summoned her Knights (that’s you!) to quest out and retrieve the lamp before the ancient and malevolent Djinn trapped within can be released! Once three wishes have been made, the demon within is free. Journey forth to save the land and stop the thieves once and for all!
sd: An intro to the Fabula Ultima game system. Join a party of adventurers on an Arabian Nights themed quest to recover a stolen magical lamp and prevent an evil djinn from being released.
