ds: The attack of the scientifically-advanced Myrmidan goes poorly. Can a team of space soldiers from many species steal one of their ships to understand it? Or is galactic civilization doomed?

ds: There's an intercollegiate party at the beach, with not only students from good old Arkham College, but Y’ha-nthlei Pelagic University, Die Schwarzwälder Schule der Hexen und Totenbeschwörer and even Cryptofash Wizarding Academy! No one's going to forget this party! Even with therapy!
sd: It's Spring Break! All the students from Arkham College are at the beach, just off Devil's Reef! Students from rival colleges will be there, too! What could go wrong?

ds: As students at a hidden school of magic, you're at the whim of your professors for odd assignments. But this one's simple-- finding books in the basement archives. How bad could it be?

ds: The Kingdom of Vacuo is where minimal government exists, and the law of the land is dictated by the personalities you cross on its streets. Your group of Huntsmen are aiming to bring hope to the desolate sands of Vacuo City, but they have encountered a problem. Their local contact in Vacuo, Drake White, seems to have fallen into debt, causing his shop to be closed for the foreseeable future. The team must find a way to settle their ally’s debt before his business is permanently lost. Players will navigate various social situations and buy time to devise a play for repaying the debt. Be cautious about whom you cross, for it may be the last thing you ever do. A focus on role-play and descriptive actions will help you fully enjoy and immerse yourself during the game!
sd: Adventure into the lands of Vacuo from the world of RWBY and join your fellow Huntsmen on an adventure to aid a friend in need!

ds: Queenie, the reigning monarch of the Brindlewood Bay Casserole Competition has decided that this year she is going to retire. It is time for her to pass the crown to the next aspiring cook. You and the other Murder Mavens are bringing your best meal to vie for the title of Best Casserole in Brindlewood Bay. Everyone is milling about the school gym enjoying themselves. Brindlewood Bay is a role-playing game about a group of elderly women-members of the local Murder Mavens mystery book club-who find themselves solving actual murder mysteries in their quaint New England town. Imaging it as an episode of Murder She Wrote guest starring the Golden Girls and written by H.P. Lovecraft.
sd: Everyone at the Brindlewood Bay Casserole Contest is having a good time. That is, until you find the body of Millie Vanderbilt laying dead on the cafeteria floor. This is going to be one hot dish.

t: I Kill U Keep - Sailors on the Shadowless Sea
ds: Since time immemorial you and your people have toiled in the shadow of the cyclopean ruins. Of mysterious origins and the source of many a superstition, they have always been considered a secret best left unknown by the folk of your hamlet. But now something stirs beneath the crumbling blocks. Beastmen howl in the night and your fellow villagers are snatched from their beds. With no heroes to defend you, who will rise to stand against the encircling darkness? The secrets of Chaos are yours to unearth, but at what cost? In the real world you will take home your own treasures. Any characters that I kill, you get to take the miniatures home as a souvenir.
sd: In this level 0 gauntlet you will delve into a dungeon to claim treasures unknown. Any characters that I kill, you get to take the miniatures home as a souvenir.

ds: Will the crew survive their encounter with beings of unimaginable power and cosmic terror? Or will they become another forgotten echo in the endless abyss? A Level 5 Oneshot. You can create your own character or premade characters will be available. Additionally, if you send a STL file with a miniature it will be available at the convention.
sd: A lone vessel, swallowed by the silent void, drifts beyond the boundaries of charted space.... soon discover they are not alone. Ancient entities stir in the darkness between stars.

ds: In a desperate plea from Tamily Tanderveil, the Fishery's owner, you're called upon to face this mysterious menace. With the town guard occupied elsewhere, she seeks brave souls to descend into the warehouse depths and put an end to the threat. The question beckons: Do you have the courage to confront the unknown peril lurking beneath Otari? The call to adventure awaits!
sd: Today, rumors circulate about a menacing presence in the Otari Fishery's basement, threatening the town's vital salted fish supplies and instilling fear among the locals.

ds: Five children are summoned to the estate of their late father for the reading of his last will and testament, but what they are given is far more terrifying than anything they could imagine and they only have one night to decide who will pay the ultimate price. You will be taught the rules for 13 Omens as you play. This is a horror game; content warnings and safety tools will be discussed at the start. Character death is extremely likely.
sd: Your inheritance - and your life - are on the line.

t: PFS (2e) #7-09: The Chitterwood Walks, Part 1: Scrambling the Tribes
ds:
When the longshanks of Isger start to gather troops, the goblins of the Chitterwood Forest get nervous, especially when one side of those troops are mostly composed of Hellknights. Throughout the forest, there have been reports of undead attacks on goblin tribes, prompting some of the larger tribal leaders to gather together to discuss their next actions as a whole. As an ally of the Chitterwood goblins, the Crookedtoes tribe has requested that the Pathfinder Society offer some protection during the discussions!
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. Travel to the Chitterwood Forest to protect goblin tribal leaders as they work together to create a plan to defeat undead Hellknights.

t: PFS (2e) #8-01: Intro: Year of Clockwork Mystery
gm: Paizo Org Play, Hali Douglass, Willis Sloat, Nicholas Ruchlewicz, Joshua Ericson, Victoria Hopkins
ds:
During the previous year, the Pathfinders located a strange artifact in an Azlanti temple: the clockwork compass. This artifact is shaped as a normal compass, however it has four empty slots that look as though they'd fit a number of different aeon stones. Sorrina Westyr, master of spells, calls on the PCs to help her with some experiments.
 
 This adventure is an introductory adventure for Pathfinder Society. New Pathfinder players are encouraged to make this one of their first adventures. Gen Con 2026 is your first chance to play this adventure!

ds:
The self-proclaimed Runelord and newly minted venture-captain Zinthyra Tannol has finally gotten her lodge set up within Kaer Maga. The purpose is to explore a site beneath the City of Strangers that an Azlanti wizard sealed, and which hasn't been opened since. While Venture-Captain Tannol is an expert on all things Azlanti and Thassilonian, she does not know what lies beyond the door, nor why it was sealed.
 
 This is a high-level adventure. No pregenerated characters are available; players must bring their own valid character to play.

ds:
During the exploration of an ancient ruin, the automaton Star goes missing. The head archeologist calls upon the Pathfinder Society for assistance, but warns the agents that arrive that the ruin is filled with dangerous creatures and traps and that they should be careful while exploring. A strange frozen automaton meets the Pathfinders on each floor, slowly pointing the way deeper and deeper into the ruin. 
 
 This adventure is an introductory adventure for Pathfinder Society. New Pathfinder players are encouraged to make this one of their first adventures.

ds:
The Windspire strix tribe has gone completely silent, causing concern in the tribes throughout the Devil's Perch in Cheliax and the coast of Ravounel. When an ally to the Pathfinder Society requests their help in investigating this silence, the Pathfinders find not only plans for an ambush on the tribal lands, but also that Hellknights from the Order of the Chain have already invaded! The Pathfinders will need to ally with the winged strix to help them throw off this invasion and forced conscription into the Chelaxian army!

The Windspire strix tribe has gone completely silent, causing concern in the tribes throughout the Devil's Perch in Cheliax and the coast of Ravounel. When an ally to the Pathfinder Society requests their help in investigating this silence, the Pathfinders find not only plans for an ambush on the tribal lands, but also that Hellknights from the Order of the Chain have already invaded! The Pathfinders will need to ally with the winged strix to help them throw off this invasion and forced conscription into the Chelaxian army!

The Pathfinders will need to hurry to help the citizens of Anthusis fight back against part of the Chelaxian fleet before winding up face to face with one of the most brutal captains in the navy. It's up to the Society to help remind Cheliax that Vidrian is a free nation!

ds:
The PCs are sent to a remote fishing village on the southern shore of the Lake of Mists and Veils to investigate a hidden vault. The former Head Librarian of Restov’s largest librarian, Nephaira Savakress, spent years searching for the truth behind the myths and legends of Choral Rogavaria also known as Choral the Conquerer. She found the location of the vault and of the history of Choral, but her source mysteriously disappeared. She has chosen to place her trust in the Pathfinder Society to retrieve this information.

ds:
The Thane, a fey monarch of great power, had their eyes drawn to the Pathfinder Society when agents were drawn into one of their celebrations. They have decided to play a game with the Society, with the fate of Bhopan, the small island off the Impossible Lands, at stake. Bhopan is small, and strongly tied to the first world, and they cannot hope to stand against someone as powerful as the Thane.
 
 Gen Con 2026 is your first chance to play this adventure!

t: PFS (2e) #8-03: For the Love of Vanity
gm: Paizo Org Play, David Gilbert, Matt Clay, Benjamin Edwards, Brandon Ohrns, Bill Wheatle
ds:
Within the Foreign Quarter of Absalom, the Solstice Amphitheatre stood tall, welcoming performers and guests alike to fascinating performances. However, when the theater fell on hard times and closed, the actress never left her place, continuing to perform to empty seats and silent crowds. The locals came to avoid the theater, especially after her death, but now new disappearances have prompted the Pathfinder Society to investigate and see what remains of the Solstice's former glory.
 
 Gen Con 2026 is your first chance to play this adventure!

Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 1st-2nd level characters. Pirates have made off with Thassilonian goods the Pathfinder Society obtained in Riddleport.

ds: Lady Elinor Davenport is throwing her yearly ball, and every eligible young lady and gentleman will be there. However, everything isn't what it seems, and rumors of war are stirring on the horizon. Hidden identities, forbidden romances, intrigue, courtship, gossip, and secrets abound in this game set in Regency-era England. Build dance cards, discover mysteries, negotiate allowances, and slight old rivals. No happy ending ever did come easy. Costuming is strongly encouraged. Dancing will be instructed. Content warnings include period-appropriate sexism, homophobia, and illness; these biases are not tolerated out of game. We will be using larp calibration safety mechanics. L&L is an abridged version of our weekend-long game. Please fill out the casting survey in the CONFIRMATION EMAIL sent to your email to get cast ahead of game!
sd: Join us for a chance to play a role in your own Jane Austen novel! Social climbers, clever heroines & dashing dandies clash for an evening of dancing & dastardly plots.

ds: This is an intimate near-future LARP about relationships, identity, technology, and power. It features an asymmetrical play experience about humans interacting with robots with artificial intelligence. Participants playing AI will experience learning from the examples of the human with whom they interact. Participants playing humans will workshop a character who has found reason to engage in a focus group for testing a companion AI. This game is thoughtful, introspective, and often emotional. Come with an open mind. Content is likely to include: power in relationships, identity invalidation, emotional dependence, loss and grieving, memory erasure, and sustained one-on-one play. We use LARP calibration techniques to ensure consent and communication.
sd: Amid the gentle beeps of the near-future, a group of consumers have signed up to participate in a private trial run of companionship robots.

ds: The Addams Family clashes with the seemingly 'normal' family of their daughter's fiancé. Will the two families ever get along? Or will it be a feud for the ages? They're scary and they're spooky- You will larp as either a member of the Addams' Family or a member of the fiancé's family. No canon Addams' will be appearing as player characters. (ie. you won't be Gomez or Morticia, you'll be original Addamses.) The larp will be played in a series of timed 'episodes' to capture that sitcom feeling. We will use LARP calibration and safety techniques. Costuming encouraged. Please fill out the casting survey you'll receive in your confirmation email, especially if there are younger larpers with you. This game is open to larpers 13+ with GM approval, please email us.
sd: There's going to be a wedding. A lovely corpse of the Addams family has chosen til death do we part with someone who isn't a part of the Addams' world. Will their fiancé sink or swim?

t: Rikk's Cantina Corellia: A Star Wars Larp
ds:
"Of all the cantinas in the galaxy, you had to walk into this one.” 
 
 Drifting on the edge of civilized space, The Crescent space station is a haven for the lost, the lucky, and the lawless. Its beating heart? Rikk's Cantina Corellia, a palace of chance where smugglers rub shoulders with senators, bounty hunters drink alongside diplomats, and credits flow as freely as the Corellian whiskey. Here, fortunes are made, secrets are sold, and the only rule is simple—the house always wins. Tonight, the stakes are higher than ever.
 
 But no one comes to Rikk's without a reason. Some are hiding—from bounty hunters, syndicates, or the ghosts of their past. Some are hunting—for lost allies, powerful enemies, or one last shot at redemption. And in the shadows, war is brewing.
sd: Join us for a Star Wars larp set at Rikk's Cantina Corellia, a palace of chance where smugglers rub shoulders with senators and credits flow as freely as the Corellian whiskey.

t: Bramblewood: A WInd in the Willows Larp
ds: Join the Fieldmice of Bramblewood for a cozy party held for all woodland creatures. Inspired by media like Wind in the Willows, Brambly Hedge, Mouseguard, NIMH, and The Borrowers, this is a cozy game where players will play as woodland creatures who are visiting their friends for a party. Expect light character sheets, friendship, and familial connections with low-stakes & light-hearted conflicts that are easily resolved. We'll play some whimsical games in character, and costumes are encouraged, but not required.
sd: The Fieldmice of Bramblewood have invited their friends to a party. Play as woodland creatures and have a cozy, whimsical time. Great for players of all ages!

ds: Welcome to the swashbuckling world of Freeport! Cut-Throat’s Gold uses the Fantasy AGE 2nd Edition rules for this pirate adventure,
sd: Has the character’s luck changed? Finding what appears to be an old treasure map hidden in Freeport, they set out to find the location shown on the map.

sd: After an unknown force ambushes the comm’s militia patrol, the characters must search for survivors and determine whether further peril awaits the comm.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Step into the rotating Tower of Sardior. Built by the Wizard Kovarnyl as a stronghold of chaos, destruction, and creation. Kovarnyl and his acolytes are set on annihilating all of creation to pave the way for the resurrection of Sardior and the fabled First World. As the tower endlessly reconfigures itself, you'll need to traverse its corridors, evade lethal enemies and traps, all while trying to solve the mysteries of the tower and unlock its secrets. Time is of the essence to stop their apocalyptic schemes from unfolding. Do you have what it takes to find the keystones of the tower and stop Kovarnyl before it’s too late? Bring your own standard build 12th level character (D&D 5e/2014) or choose from pre-generated characters provided. Campaign Magic Items will be provided by the DM.
sd: The Wizards of Sardior are tampering with the fabric of creation, threatening to unravel everything you cherish. You must act swiftly to stop their destructive plans.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Join your party in this horror mystery adventure from the 2021 Candlekeep Mysteries book for 5e. Play as a level 4 adventurer and discover the fate of Vermeillon, a small mining village that has been forgotten after residents began to vanish and was never repopulated after the last inhabitants left or went missing. Spoils and danger await, for those brave enough to seek it. If your character survives the adventure and you've signed up for another of the Candlekeep Mysteries adventures, you can bring them over to continue your tale with an updated level and loot! Will contain themes of graphic violence, body horror, stalking, loss of autonomy, isolation, psychological horror, and claustrophobia.
sd: A contract from a mining guild has called for adventurers to find out what happened to Vermeillon. Explore the abandoned mining village and find out what happened to the missing inhabitants.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: The PCs return to their hometown for the first time in years to find their Aunt Lorraine ill and her restaurant suffering… but the annual food festival is next week! This is a humorous, beginner friendly adventure for Daggerheart. Pregens are provided, no experience is necessary, regular Daggerheart players are also welcome. This adventure will feature several unique environments, a couple combats, and frequent opportunities for roleplay. We will have a custom map of the main location, custom minis of the pregens, and a take home recipe card. Play this game if: you’re a foodie, you like food puns, you want some lighthearted fun, you’ve been wanting to try Daggerheart.
sd: It's the annual Plover Caves Hunger Down Under Food Festival. Take over a restaurant, compete for ingredients, hunt ferocious monsters then cook them up to win the Grand Feast best dish contest!

Tomilla Goldbrew has put up job posting offering a handsome reward to anyone who can solve the honey crisis. Pre-generated characters will be provided.
sd: Intro adventure investigating the honey shortage of the Sweet Mug Meadery.

t: The Tragic Curse of Grimhill Fort
ds: A terrible storm is brewing – you must find shelter from this accursed weather, and quickly! Veldmark, the nearest town, is over ten leagues away, so your only choice is the ruined fort on a nearby hill. As you approach, a faint cry echoes from deep within the decrepit structure. The hair on the back of your neck stands up in warning, but perhaps it was just the wind. Perhaps. Gathering up your courage, you enter the halls of the Grimhill fort. Pre-generated characters will be provided..
sd: An intro adventure exploring the ruins of an old fort, your only shelter from a brutal storm.

gm: Paizo Org Play, Bill Tobin, Jordan Howe, James Anderson
ds:
Recently the Starfinder Society acquired a map of a solitary world in the Absurdity called Oamnil. Initial surveys of this gas giant have already been completed, with the Starfinders discovering numerous moons orbiting the world, all riddled with ruins. 
 
 The Starfinder Society partnered with esteemed local explorer, Greffgo, to scout the ruins on one of these moons. Driven by the worries of an eccentric diviner, a team of Starfinders follow the flight path and exploration route of this lost Starfinder.
 
 Gen Con 2026 is your first chance to play this adventure!
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. Follow the flight path and exploration route of a lost explorer on a swampy moon to rescue them from peril.

ds:
For all its dangers, the Gelid Edge is a frontier of new discoveries and forbidden knowledge, and many anomaly hunters and occult researchers have flocked to the region to learn its secrets. Among them is Dreamlink Laboratories, a research facility that used aucturnite to create a dreamscape purportedly born from the thoughts of the Newborn. Using this dreamscape, Dreamlink Labs has pinpointed the location of a site they believe is important to the Newborn.
 
 Content Note: This scenario contains themes related to graphic depictions of disease and surreal settings intended to invoke disgust.

t: SFS (2e) #1-14: The Beasts of Bo: Part One
ds:
Dangerous raiders called the Beasts of Bo have proven to be a thorn in the side of the Starfinder Society. Armed to the teeth with tech salvaged from the Wreck of the Returned and audacious in their convoy attacks, the Beasts of Bo are a formidable foe, yet the group may still have its uses, for the leader of the Beasts of Bo is Bo-Shek, one of the only people to explore the Wreck of the Returned before its automated defenses activated. t: SFS (2e) #1-15: Ruins of the World Soul
ds:
Impressed by the Starfinder Society’s dedication and ingenuity on a recent joint rescue mission, shobhad geomancer Aruk has invited the Starfinders to explore Kor-Montak and determine the cause of its long-standing curse. Aruk is hopeful the Starfinders can break the curse and return Kor-Montak to its people, as the Starfinder Society is known the galaxy over for their expertise in excavating ancient ruins and handling strange magic. 
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.

ds:
The Wreck of the Returned has leaked volatile magic into the surrounding Sloughscar Hills. These effects have run the gamut from unseasonal storms, unnatural plant growth, and sudden bursts of magical energy to swaths of magically warped terrain, reality tears that transplant strange creatures, and regions of unstable reality that degrade matter entirely. When a sudden onslaught of magical catastrophes strikes all at once, First Seeker Sarmak dispatches teams of Starfinders to defend their allies, combat these threats, and counter this magical show of force with a concerted emergency response effort. 
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.

Having secured a secret entrance to the Wreck of the Returned, the Starfinder Society is finally ready to launch a rescue mission into the Wreck, to liberate countless citizens of Akiton who await forced conversion into mindless servitors of the Wreck. While numerous teams prepare to enter the conversion facility, First Seeker Sarmak has tasked one special team with breaching the conversion facility’s central control room and dispatching the cure to conversion through the ventilation system. If successful, all the converted innocents within the Wreck will regain their autonomy and break free from the Wreck’s control.

Having secured a secret entrance to the Wreck of the Returned, the Starfinder Society is finally ready to launch a rescue mission into the Wreck, to liberate countless citizens of Akiton who await forced conversion into mindless servitors of the Wreck. While numerous teams prepare to enter the conversion facility, First Seeker Sarmak has tasked one special team with breaching the conversion facility’s central control room and dispatching the cure to conversion through the ventilation system. If successful, all the converted innocents within the Wreck will regain their autonomy and break free from the Wreck’s control.

A team of Starfinders is tasked with slipping into the Wreck of the Returned, reaching the central core, and destroying Elovai. Without Elovai, the initial, first wave invasion launched by the First Ones will be thwarted, and the Wreck’s many forces will lack leadership, simultaneously saving Akiton and opening the Wreck of the Returned to future exploration. The fate of Akiton and the future of the Pact Worlds is in your hands!
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 5th-6th level characters. The Starfinder Society launches a joint assault alongside their allies against the Wreck of the Returned! The battle for Akiton begins!

Over the past year, numerous agents of the Starfinder Society have encountered a mysterious anomaly while traveling through the Drift: an artificial, alien structure unlike any starship or space station on record, that scrambles communication signals. This structure appears without warning and vanishes just as swiftly, and has proven to utterly confound starship scanners and magical assessment. Curious about this persistent anomaly, Venture-Captain Arvin has consulted a diviner and fellow Starfinder, Nykiti Lampadephoros, to determine the next known appearance of the site.

sd: 3rd-4th level characters. Explore a mysterious site in the Drift protected by magical safeguards and biotech robots.

The invasion of the Wreck of the Returned continues as a team of Starfinders enters the magical heart of the Wreck, a metaphysical liminal space occupied by Elovai’s mind. But can a foe as dangerous and powerful as a First One be defeated in a realm under her control? Battle your way through the heart of the Wreck to take down Elovai in a final showdown over the fate of Akiton!

ds:
A mysterious transmission broadcast to every screen and comm unit across Absalom Station heralds a magical attack on the streets of the station itself. ds:

While the nearby residents have tried to be patient, they’ve hit their wits end and are calling for the closure of Stellar Sweets.

gm: Sir John Minderman, Floyd Resler, John Sidebottom Jr
ds: On September 13, 1999, nuclear waste ignited on the moon, blasting it out of orbit. Thus began the classic TV series Space:1999. Players take on the roles of Moonbase Alpha personnel. In this adventure, Eagle 27 is on a survey mission to a planet. Without warning, the planet and the Eagle vanish! Thirty minutes later, both reappear, and the Eagle is on course for Alpha. When it arrives, no one is on board, and Alpha is heading right into the area where the planet vanished! Can your team figure out what happened before it's too late for Alpha?
sd: September 13, 1999, nuclear waste ignited on moon, blasting it out of orbit. You take on the roles of Moonbase Alpha personnel. Eagle 27 vanished on survey mission. Now it has returned without a crew.

t: Venture Into the Woods with Snow White, Alice and Dorothy
gm: Kate Evans, David Rodriguez, Michael DeVito
ds: Once upon a time, the Princesses answered the Call to Arms and were forged into an army by the Queen of Fables to stand against the power of the Great Evils. When the War of Sharpened Crowns ended, the Great Evils were defeated and the realms were saved, but the stories of countless Princesses had been erased from the narrative, the Queen of Fables was gone, and the Princesses were changed forever. Now the Great Evils have returned. And though the scattered Princesses have grown up and lost the wonder of childhood, they must reunite to defend the realms and restore the erased tales before they disappear forever. Grab your swords, your boots, and your tiaras to join Gretel the Candy Barbarian, Briar Rosa the Necromancer, Dorothy Gale the Good Witch of the South, and many others as you battle to rewrite the fables and reclaim your place in these classic stories.
sd: Be among the first to adventure into the Land of Fable, where you will take on the role of classic fairy tale princesses re-imagined as mighty RPG heroes challenging the Great Evils and their minions.

ds: The Lights of Thornwatch Abbey is an adventure set in Tahlvaen, a brand-new 5e setting. It is intended to introduce players to the world. This module is intended for a party of 4-6. Included with it are pre-generated 1st-level characters to get started quickly.
sd: Count Halric Thorne has sent for aid - he asks adventurers to journey to the small village of Oatsmille and investigate strange lights and screams heard in the abandoned Thornwatch Abbey.

t: PFS (2e) #7-14: Brastlewark at War, Part 2: The Gnome Liberation
ds:
The Andoran Army has pushed far enough into Cheliax that destruction of facilities creating war machines and liberation of the gnomes is now possible, but they can't do both. It's up to you and your fellow Pathfinders to see that the gnomes are safe, and that they can know true freedom, away from the tyranny of Cheliax and House Thrune.
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. The gnomes rescued by Pathfinders had grim tidings; much of the population of Brastlewark was being forced to construct a weapon of war.

It's up to you and your fellow Pathfinders to see that the gnomes are safe, and that they can know true freedom, away from the tyranny of Cheliax and House Thrune.
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. The gnomes rescued by Pathfinders had grim tidings; much of the population of Brastlewark was being forced to construct a weapon of war.

ds:
The Starfinder Society has established a fledgling lodge in Akiton’s Sloughscar Hills to study a massive, crashed starship known as the Wreck of the Returned. In addition to countless freelancers and independent salvagers, three prominent factions have arisen and are clashing at every turn: the Aspis Consortium, a coalition of local Akitonian salvagers, and a government sanctioned delegation from the planet Aballon. Sarmak has invited representatives from each of these factions to meet on neutral ground. 
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 1st-2nd level characters. Influence VIPs and defend a multi-faction summit from attack in the badlands of Akiton.

ds:
A mysterious spire shrouded in purple mist has been seen in the jungles of Ukulam, a continent spanning nature preserve on the planet Castrovel. These sightings are periodic but persistent, yet scientists, explorers, and tourists have all been unable to reach the site or pinpoint its exact location. Intrigued by reports of the vanishing spire, Venture-Captain Arvin has secured permission to dispatch a team of Starfinders to Ukulam to locate and explore the mysterious structure.

The Starfinders have discovered a nearby site of interest: a sizable piece of wreckage which detached during a crash and landed off-site. Eager for answers, the Starfinders dispatch a team to the crash site to investigate. 
 
 Unfortunately, Hellknights from the Order of the Eclipse are already inside the wreckage, and their mandate to control, suppress, or destroy dangerous information and technology means they have no intention of sharing anything they uncover.

sd: 1st-2nd level characters. Explore a piece of starship wreckage while facing off against Hellknights determined to seize, censor, and destroy everything in their path!

ds:
Starfinder drones and satellites traced a magical signature to a massive asteroid on the fringes of the Preluria system in Near Space. Worried over the fate of the gas giant Preluria and its numerous inhabited moons and planetoids, Fitch now gathers dozens of Starfinder field agents aboard the Master of Stars and departs to swiftly explore the asteroid and secure a moon-busting superweapon before it’s used again.
 
 This adventure is an interactive special; all tables will work together to accomplish the adventure’s goals. It is a unique roleplaying experience only available at conventions, and Gen Con 2026 is the launch of this special!
sd: Explore a mysterious asteroid to destroy a dangerous superweapon capable of annihilating worlds. This is an interactive multi-table special.

The centipede queen kaiju has gone missing, leaving a trail of destruction in her path. Amara Li, venture-captain of the Lantern Lodge in Tian Xia, calls upon the Society for assistance in not only investigating the disappearance of the kaiju, but also in the uptick of strange cult activity.
 
 This adventure is an interactive special; all tables will work together to accomplish the adventure’s goals. It is a unique roleplaying experience only available at conventions, and Gen Con 2026 is the launch of this special!

gm: Paizo Org Play, Kenya Chauche, Nathan Peever, Jay Zicht, Michael Hopkins, Elanor Smith, Anthonny Leclerc, Chester Taylor, Joanne Machin, Sean Duncan, Kai Roebuck
ds: Pathfinder is a fantasy roleplaying game in which players take on the role of daring heroes going on epic quests. The second edition ruleset is easy to learn, quick to play, and offers deeper customization than ever before. Try out the game with this short (approximately 30 minutes) demo adventure, guided by an experienced Game Master! Pregenerated characters and game aids are provided. Absolutely no experience is needed with roleplaying games; players of all skill and experience level are welcome!
sd: Face off against boggards in the swamp.

ds: You are Creators, elite artists and thinkers whose genius warps reality: poems that reveal secrets, sculptures that bend space. When your investigation leads you to an invention that appears to generate energy without entropy, you realize it could symbolically hold off the cosmic collapse of the Universe itself. But the inventor may have hidden motives, and powerful forces are already moving to control or destroy the discovery. Will you safeguard this miracle, expose the truth behind it, or unleash consequences you cannot foresee? Your choices may help to save reality—or to unravel it forever.
sd: Existential horror investigation where your artistic creations reshape reality. You may save the Universe . . . or discover that your genius is the reason it’s dissolving.

ds: Any hope for future generations may rely on an upcoming meeting with the president to discuss tortle protection. Can you save your loved ones while ensuring the diplomatic mission is a success? Use my tortle characters or bring your own. 12th level, 27 point buy, 1 rare magic item + 3 uncommon + 2 common
sd: Congratulations! Your sea tortle family should soon grow; it’s nesting season in Tortleguero. However, swamp giants poach clutch-laying tortles for soup, and displacer jaguars also hunt your kind.

ds: After receiving a letter pleading for help from a nearby village, your superiors have sent you to investigate the concerning reports that several people have disappeared. While you and your team are skilled in investigating, mediating, and, in the most common scenario, fighting the Vaesen, your superiors seem more nervous than usual. Determined the figure out the truth and restore peace to the countryside, your team sets out to discover what secrets lie buried beneath the surface. What could be so scary about a simple town?
sd: Your group has been tasked with investigating disappearances and determining if it is the work of a malicious Vaesen, or perhaps, something even the all-knowing spirits are unable to stop.

ds:
A vision of flames. Friends and family dying to ensure your survival. But you are supposed to be protecting them.
 Anger rises, but your training pushes it away.
 The vision subsides as compatriots and new friends stand by your side. It is strange—these new friends are not replacing those lost, but moving forward for you and with you, as part of a higher purpose. 
 The fear attempts to take root and a part of you is simply glad not to be alone.
 But what to do now? Where to go now?
 Master Yoda said that the future is always in motion, thus elusive in the Force. Yet you have always found it interesting how intimately Force and Destiny intertwine.
 Thank you in advance for your interest. I consider myself fortunate to have the opportunity to run Star Wars at what are the best four days of gaming every year and getting to meet the amazing players.
sd: A vision of flames. Anger rises. Friends & compatriots step to your side replacing those lost. Where to go? The future is always in motion but it's interesting how the Force & Destiny are intertwined.

t: Titan City Chronicles: The Dragon of Parkhurst Manor
ds: Dragon of Parkhurst Manor is set in the wonderful world of Titan City! Titan City is a fantasy noir setting of magic, monsters, mobsters, and costumed crimefighters, where the supernatural is common knowledge to the general public. Stories in this setting span an alternate version of the 1920s and ‘30s where ordinary citizens and governments grapple with adapting society to integrate the weird and mystical denizens of the world.
sd: Titan City, 1936. The students of the Silverthorne Academy must help a baby dragon return to its mother when they rescue it from monster smugglers outside Titan City.

t: The Day The Sky Cracked Open
ds: t’s been a few quiet months since your party returned from the Sanctuary of Aergoth, but none of you have truly felt the same since standing before the Dragon Egg. Something about it changed you. Marked you. Then the sky tears open. Like a curtain pulled back from the heavens, a radiant seam splits the clouds and the city fills with shimmering motes of light. They dart through streets and alleyways, slip through windows, and circle crowds as if searching for something; or someone. And when the lights begin to gather around you, it becomes clear: whatever the Dragon Egg awakened has come calling. This one-shot is a standalone sequel to The Dragon Egg one shot ran at Gen Con 2025. No prior play required.
sd: Months after a dragon egg changed you, the heavens tear apart and radiant lights sweep the city searching for something - or someone. And they've found you.

ds: In a not so distant past, you and the rest of your friends wake up on what the history books will come to call The Empowering, but to you it's just another Tuesday. That is until people in your neighborhood cul de sac begin acting weird, threatening to ruin one of the last days of your summer vacation. Can you and your friends figure out what is going on and use your new powers to protect summer vacation or will you fall victim to the weirdness that is going on?
sd: You woke up with powers. Your neighbors are acting strange. And summer vacation hangs in the balance. Time to become the heroes your cul-de-sac needs.

ds: Your band has been playing house shows and struggling along for years now. Landing tonight's gig on the same billing as some real names might be your ticket out of here. As the night starts to unravel, are you prepared to discover what's going on in this sleepy town? The stars are right and the songs are wrong in this 1990s era Call of Cthulhu adventure. Pre-generated investigators provided. Content warnings: smoking, alcohol use, violence, body horror, existential dread, and 90s music.
sd: This is your band's big break! You're second in tonight's lineup, plus there's a studio rep attending. But what happens when a discordant melody from the first act throws the night into chaos?

ds: During a recruiting drive in Tantervale, Senior Warden Ramesh hears something that makes his blood run cold: Unusual, twisted darkspawn are emerging from an archaeological dig in the mountains just north of the Minantar River. He knows the horror he experienced in Hormak thaig is happening again, and this time you, a handful of recent recruits, are his only allies. But you’ll rise to the challenge. Wardens always do. Content warnings: descriptions of body horror, gore, fantasy violence, and mind control. Player safety aids will be used.
sd: Twisted horrors are crawling out of the mountains north of Tantervale. Can a small team of Grey Warden recruits stop the ancient threat in time?

t: The Box of Night: Creepy Dolls, Deadly Spiders, and the Mice Who Love Them!
ds: A one-time “doll hospital,” the Box of Night is a neglected metal container surrounded by piles of discarded mannequins. A strange clan of mice, the Webthreaders, is rumored to make their home in the mannequin piles, worshiping dangerous spiders in the depths of the box and the tunnels below it. Can these strange mice be reached? Can they be reasoned with? Can they be friends? How do they really interact with the spiders? Is it safe to find out?
sd: A forgotten doll hospital looms over piles of hollow giants. Beneath it, strange mice worship spiders in silken tunnels. Are they foes, or future allies?

ds: There’s been a murder in Last Pine! Stored away in the basement of the Ontonagon Historical Society are a half dozen wax sculptures of historical Ontonagon figures – leftovers from a failed exhibit in the 1970s. While organizing the storeroom, volunteer Maribelle Pine stumbled upon something horrifying: the statue of Last Pine’s most famous founder, Albert Delcroix – his head nowhere to be found and a crescent-shaped hole carved in this chest! As things get weirder, the hunters must sort out what is happening before real people start dying.
sd: The founder's wax statue is mutilated, its head missing and a crescent carved deep. Something is stirring in Last Pine. Will you stop it in time?

ds: Juan Darniel, head of a global shipping cartel, acting president of the European Central Bank, and a mountain goat, is holding a birthday party at his private ski resort in the Swiss Alps. Darniel is using the party as cover for an auction that evening. Up for sale? Five original mint plates, stolen from the ECB. With these plates, anyone could produce all the cash they could ever need. More importantly, the lavish birthday cake is being prepared by a team of the best pastry chefs in the world. Your crew of birds wants that cake.
sd: At a billionaire goat’s alpine birthday bash, stolen mint plates go up for auction. Your elite bird crew? You're here for the cake.

t: Mapach Out of Time - A Humblewood Adventure
ds: A mysterious stranger has arrived in Alderheart, claiming to be one of the city's long dead founders and inventor Geswick Switch. Shortly afterwards, strange constructs appeared, attacking and destroying parts of the city. Tasked with investigating both these phenomena by the city council, brave adventurers set forth not just to uncover where this enigmatic stranger came from. . .but when. Players will be provided with Level 8 pre-generated character sheets for this Hit Point Press Adventure.
sd: Investigate a mysterious stranger who claims to be a long dead inventor in a journey that will make you question time itself.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Join your party in this high action adventure from the 2021 Candlekeep Mysteries book for 5e. Play as a level 10 adventurer and solve the predicament of the djinn, Gazre-Azam. Your journey will lead you to mountainous regions of the Sword Coast in search of the wizard who bound Gazre-Azam, along the way fighting hungry monsters, restless undead, callous elementals, and possibly a dragon. Will you be able to find the wizard and convince them to release the djinn? This adventure is the second of three Candlekeep sessions, if your character survived the first adventure, then you can bring them back for this one. It is not necessary to have played in the other adventure, as each story is completely independent of each other. Sensitive materials in this adventure include themes of: graphic violence, forced servitude, and drowning.
sd: A djinn lies trapped in a book. It asks for your aid in releasing it after being bound by a wizard, in exchange for a very powerful reward. Will you free it or will you keep it bound to serve you?

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Join your party in this dangerous and exciting journey into the desert in search of ancient treasure, from the 2021 Candlekeep Mysteries book for 5e. Play as a level 15 adventurer and find the lost treasure, but be warned, you must defend those that can lead you to your journey's end. The desert is a dangerous place, full of worms, fiends, giants, and other powerful evils. You may also not be the only ones who actively seek this lost Nether Scroll. This is the third and final adventure being ran of the Candlekeep Mysteries series, with any surviving characters from previous adventures permitted to join this one levelled and kitted to match the pre-generated characters. It is not necessary to have played in any of the other adventures, as each story is completely independent of each other. Sensitive topics include themes of: graphic violence, betrayal, claustrophobia, and abandonment.
sd: A lost Nether Scroll lies somewhere in the Anauroch desert, untouched for centuries. Journey there and find the legendary Sapphire Sentinel golem who can help lead you to this lost treasure.

ds: The adventure is set near a small, mist-shrouded town called Blackthorn, nestled in rolling hills dotted with ancient burial mounds. Locals speak of strange happenings around the barrows at night—phantom lights, eerie whispers, and livestock disappearing. The players must fight their way through an assortment of undead enemies to reach the source of the evil disturbance. However, undead aren’t the only things that have made the barrows their home.
sd: Delve into the haunted burial grounds and fight for the living as you battle death itself.

t: The Summer of Green and Gold: a 1920s Mystery
ds: An original mystery based on the writings of F. Scott Fitzgerald that explores themes of inequality and the American Dream using overtly supernatural elements of cosmic horror. In August 1922, Chicago socialite Geneva Decker calls for an investigation into her ex-fiancé, a young bond salesman named Ray Wiccarank III, member of the Wiccarank hardware store dynasty. Little do these investigators know, what starts off as a simple investigation will escalate into a complex network of rumors, intrigue, and conspiracy that will see them contending with the worst aspects of the American aristocracy. Will the investigators be able to untangle this web or will they choke foul dust that floats in the wake of the American Dream? Players will be provided a selection of pre-made investigators, but may submit their original characters to be approved for use.
sd: Unravel a deadly celebration with the wealthiest people of 1922 Long Island! CW: Discussions and depictions of bigotry, body horror, domestic violence, incest, sacrifice, suicide, & vomiting.

ds:
Special Horror Edition!
 
 Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils rides again in a blaze of magipunk mayhem! A dying frontier town hides an ancient relic humming with forbidden power—and every monster with ambition can smell it. Cinder, a fire-blooded dragon, wants it to rule the wastes. Lord Ashcroft, a silver-tongued tyrant, plans to crack it open and ascend as an archfiend. And your band of reckless kobolds? You’re here to steal it first.
 
 Roam dusty streets, spin rumors into leverage, duel rival gangs, rig contraptions, and cut deals that will absolutely backfire. Side with dragonfire or deviltry… or play them both. The cards drive the chaos, the story bends to your choices, and the clock is ticking. In Dust & Devils, loyalty is optional, explosions are inevitable, and tiny scaly legends are born in smoke and fire.
sd: Chaotic kobolds race a dragon and a devil-bound tyrant to steal an ancient relic. Cut deals, spark mayhem, and betray everyone before the town burns to ash.

ds:
In Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils, a narrative-driven, wild west, steampunk magipunk adventure bursting with chaos, light rules, and ridiculous fun, your homeless, hungry kobold clan is one bad torch away from extinction—and desperate times call for reckless real estate acquisition. The plan? Seize Castle Raisinloaf and make it yours.
 
 Unfortunately, it’s occupied by the brooding (and extremely bitey) Vampire Lord C'hahd and a buffet of monsters, mercenaries, and things that skitter in the dark. Rumor whispers his still-beating Heart lies hidden deep within the castle’s cursed halls. Capture it, and the pale tyrant must kneel. Fail, and you’re appetizers. Grab your six-shooters, your posse, and your questionable courage—tonight, the kobolds raid.
sd: Homeless kobolds raid Castle Raisinloaf to seize Vampire Lord C'hahd's hidden Heart. Win a new home. Fail and become dinner. Chaos, guns, and magipunk mayhem!

ds: N.K. Jemisin’s multiple Hugo Award-winning Broken Earth trilogy comes to tabletop RPGs in The Fifth Season Roleplaying Game! Enter the Stillness, a vast, furious land that is home to thousands of Comms, settlements large and small where people gather for safety in a dangerous and unpredictable world.
sd: After an unknown force ambushes the comm’s militia patrol, the characters must search for survivors and determine whether further peril awaits the comm.

t: The Truth of the Fifth Blight
ds:
Until recently you were serving in different locations in Ferelden, and are being reassigned. Your previous commanders gave you no information about the nature of your new assignment, or the other Grey Wardens you will be working with, only that you should tell no one where you were going and that your new commander is Reza. 
 
 Based on the video game by Bioware, the Dragon Age Roleplaying game uses the award winning Adventure Game Engine.
sd: You’re all newly minted Grey Wardens, a military order that follows no crown and no Chantry. You are on your first mission, what could go sideways?

sd: You’re all newly minted Grey Wardens, a military order that follows no crown and no Chantry. You are on your first mission, what could go sideways?

ds:
Those who venture into its wind-swept streets do not return, and hunters report seeing strange red lights pulsing within the ruins after dark like a dying heartbeat.
 
 An eccentric mage, however, has little patience for "peasant superstitions." He has uncovered a manuscript detailing the final days of Lysandra Moonshadow, a legendary hero who allegedly returned to Sundown with an artifact of world-shaking power—only to vanish along with the entire population.
 
 The mage wants that artifact, and he’s willing to pay handsomely for it. He’s certain the "curse" is nothing more than local gossip, but as the shadows lengthen over the Western Isle, you might find that some legends are earned in blood. Can you uncover the truth of Moonshadow’s legacy and escape the ruins before the sun dips below the horizon?
 
 In Sundown, the real nightmare begins when the light fails.
sd: The locals on the western end of the Isle of Kassa warn: never be in the village of Sundown after dark. Once a peaceful coastal hamlet, it is now a salt-stained ruin whispered to be cursed.

ds: Deep under the Moon, the Hive are carving out a new foothold and gathering strength around a rising enemy. Your fireteam drops straight into unstable tunnels where swarming thrall, ritual wards, and volatile chambers threaten to collapse around you. This one-shot for Earthwild focuses on fast movement, high-pressure firefights, and tactical bursts of power as you sabotage a growing war-pit before it becomes a full fortress. Players learn the system through action, making quick choices that shape the flow of combat while racing toward a final showdown inside a ritual chamber blazing with green fire. All materials are provided and no Destiny knowledge is required.
sd: A fast, explosive strike beneath the Moon. Dive into Hive tunnels, disrupt their newborn war-pit, and take down a rising enemy before they fortify their new stronghold.

ds: An RPG in early development based on Earthwild RPG. The system is focused on quick action and bold choices. In this early playtest adventure, you serve as part of a larger army tasked with taking back the shattered remains of an ancient temple. Your squad will breach crumbling halls, confront lingering foes, and uncover strange magical traces left behind after the fall. The session tests core mechanics still in active development, and your decisions help refine how the game plays. Feedback is encouraged, experimentation is expected, and all materials are provided. No prior experience is required to join the push and help forge this new system.
sd: Join the army in a playtest mission for Embermark RPG. Push into a ruined temple, clear threats within, and help shape this fast, early-stage fantasy system.

ds: This event will be led by TTRPG Kids and is a collaborative walk-through of one of the five solo journaling games from the new compilation Princess with a Cursed Sword by Anna Anthropy. Powered by Tarot cards, each play of the game engages with the stories in a unique way.
sd: A collaborative playthrough of the solo journaling game, the game is powered by tarot cards and centered on exploration and reflection.

ds:
The Hudson Base Ball Club of Kingston, New York proudly announces a banquet celebrating sixty years of the Grand Old Game. The gathering will be held Friday next, the 20th day of November, at the Carlton Hotel. All members, past and present, along with their honored guests, are warmly invited. Dinner will commence at 7 pm, with fellowship and celebration to follow.
 
 For six decades, the Club has endured. Generations have taken the field. Victories remembered. Losses forgiven. And as the night unfolds, some guests may begin to notice that certain traditions were not created for nostalgia alone. That some invitations are not optional. That the game, like the Club itself, was never only about what happened on the field.
 
 Fellowship and celebration will follow.
 As it always has.
sd: The Hudson Base Ball Club of Kingston, NY wishes it to be known that a banquet celebrating sixty years of the Grand Old Game will be held. All club members past and present and guests are welcome.

ds:
Take a compelling journey into humanity’s precarious future on a distant planet where living is hard and dying is all too easy. A world where GEO marshals enforce the peace, Incorporate mercenaries pilot deadly fighter subs, and bold insurgents battle for their adopted planet. A place where corporate greed and human desperation ravage an alien ecology, threatening to plunge humanity into a war of survival with an ancient, alien legacy.
 
 This session will be run by the game's designer.
sd: This session showcases the new edition of the acclaimed, hard sci-fi RPG set on the dangerous, frontier water world of Poseidon. Join the game's creator for this wild adventure.

t: 0 level funnel: The Exodus of Wolfbane
ds:
In the quiet village of Wolfsbane, life is good and simple, if not a bit strange at times. Years ago, long enough that no one living can recall exactly when it happened, a strange infant was left on a couple's doorstep. They named him Shadowforde. It quickly became clear that Shadowforde had extraordinary magical gifts and he soon became a protector of your village. Your village also keeps him safe and his talents a secret from outsiders, as even with his magical ability he is vulnerable.
 Now, King Haveron has finally caught wind of your strange magical protector, and he wants Shadowforde for himself. Your tiny village of farmers and craftsmen is the only thing standing between an army and the frail, old Shadowforde.
sd: You are a peasant living in the small farming village of Wolfbane. You are no one in particular, but you will be soon.

t: [Kids and Families] Pathfinder Academy: Year of Clockwork Mystery
ds:
Players 18 and older are not permitted at these tables unless they are accompanying a child.
 Pathfinder Society Academy is a place for children to learn how to play Pathfinder and for our younger GMs to hone their skills under the tutelage of experienced GMs. All Pathfinder Society Academy tables are family friendly and the GMs are chosen for their experience working with youth. Please note all children 12 and under need a parent/guardian to stay with them at the table. Youth 13-15 need a parent in the Sagamore Ballroom, and youth 16-17 need to have a way to contact their onsite parent. 
 This session will be running PFS2 Intro: Year of Clockwork Mystery.
sd: The Pathfinders perform magical experiments on a strange artifact found in an ancient temple. Learn in a family-friendly environment!

ds: About a month ago folks from the mountain tops of Kardonak to the cloud reaching Farelight tree began to hear strange whispers floating on the wind. Many a researcher and mesmer have tried to uncover their nature and origin, but so far none have has success. Your crew has been contracted by The Consortium of Song to sail out across the wildsea and find out what is causing this whispered message and whether or not it is a danger to The Heights.
sd: The Heights is an expansive reach full of ancient redwoods and, recently, a strange whisper heard across the treetops. Will your crew of Wildsailors be the first to discover the source?

ds:
The deepest parts of the Pathfinder Society's collection of artifacts was once maintained by an entire faction: the Dark Archive. However, as factions changed and roles shifted, the Dark Archive shuttered, leaving the maintenance of this area to Zarta Dralneen, previous faction head and now head archivist of the Society. She's called upon a group of Pathfinders to enter into the deepest areas of the archive not only in search of an artifact that may help in the war with Cheliax, but also to reseal the magical fortifications around the archive.
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 7th-8th level characters. A group of Pathfinders are sent into the deepest areas of the Society's archives when they discover not only a malfunctioning artifact but a thief within the bowels.

t: PFS (2e) #7-12: The Chitterwood Walks, Part 2: The Battle of Logas
ds:
With the success of the Chitterwood Talks, the goblin tribes are ready to march on Logas and put a stop to the undead attacks. As forces approach the city, rumors start to circle of a strange plague only affecting Hellknights, leaving the undead Hellknights covered in bizarre, circular scars and bearing the mark of an unknown order. Within Logas, a Hellknight necromancer has declared herself the head of a new Hellknight order and is using the city as her chance to prove its worth.
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 5th-6th level characters. The PCs accompany the Chitterwood goblins to fight against Logas and the undead that keep emerging from the city.

t: PFS (2e) #7-12: The Chitterwood Walks, Part 2: The Battle of Logas
ds:
With the success of the Chitterwood Talks, the goblin tribes are ready to march on Logas and put a stop to the undead attacks. As forces approach the city, rumors start to circle of a strange plague only affecting Hellknights, leaving the undead Hellknights covered in bizarre, circular scars and bearing the mark of an unknown order. Within Logas, a Hellknight necromancer has declared herself the head of a new Hellknight order and is using the city as her chance to prove its worth.

t: PFS (2e) #7-06: Brastlewark at War Part 1: The Gnome Defection
ds:
With war breaking out, the gnomes of Brastlewark in Cheliax can no longer cling to their carefree ways. Self-proclaimed King Drum Thornfiddle is eager to ingratiate himself to Queen Abrogail, and so conscripts the city's magical and creative resources towards the war effort. A few gnomes have broken free, and they have brought evidence of the various works being created in Brastlewark. They're no fighters, though. It'll be up to the Pathfinders to get them safely across the border to Andoran and freedom.

ds: You are an assistant archivist at The Addler Institute of Chicago, a sister institute to The Magnus Institute, which specializes in crytozoology. Your Head Archivist, Gertrude Robinson, has called upon you and your fellow archival assistants to dig deeper into another claimed sighting of Mothman. Usually this kind of research into a statement is more a formality than anything, but there's something about the way Gertrude's hand shook ever so slightly as she handed you the statement and your train tickets that has you on edge.
sd:
Statement of Bethany Murray, recorded June 18th, 2026
 Statement begins: "There was something about those eyes, glowing and red. It was almost...hypnotic."

gm: Paizo Org Play, Neal D Daugherty
ds:
Raiders have begun attacking the Society’s vehicle convoys, disrupting their supply chain and stealing valuable discoveries. But the Starfinders aren’t the only victim of these raiders—three other groups endure these attacks, all of whom are bent on exploring the Wreck of the Returned. Determined to put an end to these attacks, and suspecting the Functionary is to blame, First Seeker Sarmak dispatches a team of Starfinders to investigate the raiders and lure them into a trap. Gather your allies, enact your plan, and pray the raiders take the bait!
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. Dangerous raiders are attacking the Starfinder Society's convoys. Negotiate for aid from your allies and lay a trap to catch the raiders in the act!

t: [Kids and Families] Pathfinder Academy: A Theft in Riddleport
ds:
Players 18 and older are not permitted at these tables unless they are accompanying a child.
 Pathfinder Society Academy is a place for children to learn how to play Pathfinder and for our younger GMs to hone their skills under the tutelage of experienced GMs. All Pathfinder Society Academy tables are family friendly and the GMs are chosen for their experience working with youth. Please note all children 12 and under need a parent/guardian to stay with them at the table. Youth 13-15 need a parent in the Sagamore Ballroom, and youth 16-17 need to have a way to contact their onsite parent. 
 This session will be running PFS2 #8-04: A Theft in Riddleport.
sd: Pirates have made off with goods the Pathfinder Society obtained in Riddleport. Learn in a family-friendly environment!

t: PFS (2e) #7-21: The Home of Empty Breath
ds:
As part of the Pathfinder Society's attempts to make allies across all nations, a few Pathfinders have made contact with a low-ranking Blood Lord among the leadership of the undead nation of Geb, the lich Msasa Kuatuz. As part of her attempts to climb the ranks, she's agreed to introduce the Society's representatives to her fellow Blood Lords, so long as the Society is willing to assist her with one little problem: she hasn't seen her ghoul friend in a number of years and she'd like the Society to check on them.

sd: 5th-6th level characters. To make friends with a lich in Geb, the Pathfinders need to break into a ghoul academic's home.

ds:
As part of the Pathfinder Society's attempts to make allies across all nations, a few Pathfinders have made contact with a low-ranking Blood Lord among the leadership of the undead nation of Geb, the lich Msasa Kuatuz. As part of her attempts to climb the ranks, she's agreed to introduce the Society's representatives to her fellow Blood Lords, so long as the Society is willing to assist her with one little problem: she hasn't seen her ghoul friend in a number of years and she'd like the Society to check on them.
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 5th-6th level characters. To make friends with a lich in Geb, the Pathfinders need to break into a ghoul academic's home.

t: [Kids and Families] Starfinder Academy: Rites of Rekindling
ds:
Players 18 and older are not permitted at these tables unless they are accompanying a child.
 Starfinder Society Academy is a place for children to learn how to play Starfinder and for our younger GMs to hone their skills under the tutelage of experienced GMs. All Starfinder Society Academy tables are family friendly and the GMs are chosen for their experience working with youth. Please note all children 12 and under need a parent/guardian to stay with them at the table. Youth 13-15 need a parent in the Sagamore Ballroom, and youth 16-17 need to have a way to contact their onsite parent. 
 This session will be running SFS2 #1-10: Rites of Rekindling.
sd: Participate in a festival celebrating the rekindling of a dying sun. Learn in a family-friendly environment!

t: Better Angels: One World Under Tyranny
ds: Better Angels is a narrative-driven RPG about temptation, power, and moral erosion. Characters are humans bound to demons that grant devastating superpowers at a personal cost, resolved through a fast dice-pool system that combines how you act with why you act.
sd: Your superheroes are put under house arrest after a botched mission. You later emerge to a changed world. Crime is down, war has ended, and world peace has begun under the new leadership of Tyranny.

t: The Goblin Menace of the Broken Keep
ds: In this game, you will venture to the nearby keep which is infested by vicious goblins (among other things). The local villagers need your help if they are to survive another winter. You will make your character at the table, and get an introduction to the rules. Both are quite simple, so we should get playing quite quickly.
sd: You and your compatriots have come to the village of Cadmore. They need your help to rid the land of the goblin troop which has taken up in the old broken keep on the hill.

ds: You will play either agents within the program or "friendlies" pulled in for this assignment. While experienced players are welcome, this event is designed keeping new players in mind. I (your handler) will run you through a truncated version of the character creation process, or you can show up with a pre-built character.
sd: "The Program" has called you in for a simple cleanup operation. But in Delta Green, nothing is ever simple. This is a Delta Green one shot particularly appropriate for new players to the system.

ds:
This is a 0-level Funnel for the Mutant Crawl Classics Role Playing Game. In a funnel, you take on the roles of hunters and gatherers living in the ashes of a once highly advanced civilization. Players take on 2-3 of these characters in a deadly dungeon, where they must use their wits and their luck to get to the end.
 
 You will be given characters at the table, do not bring any pre-made characters to this session.
sd: You and the other younglings of your village must go on a daring expedition into a recently discovered installation of the Ancient Ones. Bring back great treasures for your people or die in ignominy.

ds:
"PEACEMAKER is a quickdraw roleplaying game where we play characters in a wild west showdown: the final confrontation to settle our dispute. We open on the finale of our feud — but we’ll play to find out how we got to this moment of desperate revenge through flashbacks. Together, we’ll create scenes about threats to the people, places, and things that matter to us most. Whoever wins a scene gets to decide the truth in the story of our feud.
 
 At the end of the game, we’ll return to the showdown. All of the decisions we made in each flashback will colour the dramatic tension between us. We’ll find out what’s at stake, what your feud cost, and how it impacts our chances of survival.
 
 To make peace, one of us needs to die."
sd: A quickdraw western role playing game for two

t: A Vampire, a Werewolf, and a Ghost Buy a House
ds: Low Stakes is a GM-less RPG where you portray a gothic horror monster (like a vampire, werewolf, or ghost) or one of their human friends sharing a home with other monsters in the modern day. Sit-com style shenanigans ensue as your character works on their problem areas and vies for influence with their roommates.
sd: A GM-less RPG where you portray a gothic horror monster (like a vampire, werewolf, or ghost) or one of their human friends sharing a home with other monsters in the modern day.

ds: One of the Triarchy’s most powerful corporations, CaripCorp Industries, plans to launch the latest in personal defense gear soon. The “Buckler” can absorb and store massive amounts of energy and unleash it at a target later…assuming the unit doesn’t fail first. Founder Regis Hawn says, “safety issues be damned” and is fast tracking this dangerous tech to market. Climb aboard your starship with your fellow Resistance members and ensure this dangerous tech never goes public. In Cosmic Corsairs, you play members of the Resistance fighting back against the Triarchy with guns, swords, and cosmic power you draw directly from celestial bodies.
sd: One of the Triarchy’s most powerful corporations plans to launch the latest in personal defense gear soon. It's your job ensure this dangerous tech never goes public.

t: The Self-Portrait of Velasquez , Sky Pirate TTRPG Demo
ds: In this adventure you and your crew will face off against tyrannical imperials, discover a powerful treasure, and drink your fill of grog! Character sheets will be provided. The system runs on pools of d20s.
sd: Explore a vast world of sky islands with your trusty pirate crew and magic airship!

t: Mapach Out of Time - A Humblewood Adventure
ds: A mysterious stranger has arrived in Alderheart, claiming to be one of the city's long dead founders and inventor Geswick Switch. Shortly afterwards, strange constructs appeared, attacking and destroying parts of the city. Tasked with investigating both these phenomena by the city council, brave adventurers set forth not just to uncover where this enigmatic stranger came from. . .but when. Players will be provided with Level 8 pre-generated character sheets for this Hit Point Press Adventure.
sd: Investigate a mysterious stranger who claims to be a long dead inventor in a journey that will make you question time itself.

ds: This is a One Piece game. No knowledge of the setting is required, but it's a good series. This game will have a non-canon set of warlords, so you will have free reign to play them as you see fit
sd: Years ago, the World Government granted 7 pirates clemency in exchange for them being required to work for the Government when there was dire need. Can this ragtag group work together?

ds: A 80s themed game in the vein of ET, the Goonies, and Stranger Things. In this game, paranormal, extraterrestrial, or another unexplainable event will happen and it will be up to you and your friends to save the day. Kids on Bikes is a rules-light system and this game will be set in the summer of the 80s in small-town America.
sd: It's the 80s, you & your friends will always be together 4ever. The summer heat is sticky, but popsicles are sweet & cool & your parents don't care where you are as long as it's out of the house.

t: Beyond the Mist w/ Jason Azevedo
ds:
Join a group of trailblazing adventurers as they venture out beyond the mists of Barovia in search of truths that have been veiled for hundreds of years.
 Your character will be canonized in the narrative of the upcoming series called 'Beyond the Mist' - a follow up to 'Into the Mist' (DM'd by Jason w/ 1M views, 2M hours watched). Your character will be named in the pre-roll credits of season one as a tribute to their bravery (series premieres in August 2026).
 
 Jason thrives on running character-driven, immersive gameplay experiences that focus on collaborative storytelling. You can expect a PG-13 experience with hand-painted miniatures and terrain. Jason has had the honour of having many notable personalities at his table including: Matt Mercer, Matthew Lillard, Christian Navarro, Deborah Ann Woll and Sean Gunn.
sd: Strahd is Dead. What lies beyond the mists of Barovia across the Balinok mountains?

t: Escape from Castle Ravenloft w/ Jason Azevedo
ds:
You and your party have 3 hours of real-time to try and escape the bowels of Castle Ravenloft, located deep in the dread realm of Barovia. This session will be based on the Curse of Strahd campaign from Dungeons & Dragons.
 
 Jason is best known as the creator and DM for 'Into the Mist' (1M views, 2M hours watched). He thrives on running character-driven, immersive gameplay experiences that focus on collaborative storytelling. You can expect a PG-13 experience with hand-painted miniatures and terrain. Jason has had the honour of having many notable personalities at his table including: Matt Mercer, Matthew Lillard, Christian Navarro, Deborah Ann Woll and Sean Gunn.
sd: You find yourself, alongside your fellow adventurers, chained up in the dungeons deep below Castle Ravenloft. Can you work together to escape the castle before becoming Strahd's next dinner guest?

t: [Kids and Families] Starfinder Academy: Solar Shake Up

"Strange things happen all the time in Norville, but it’s rare that a stranger comes to town. Now there is an unfamiliar face walking among the people you know, and everyone is acting like they have always been there. You know better, though. 
 
 This stranger isn’t from here, but they didn’t come from the outside world either. You get a chance to investigate when they invite you to a dinner party at their house, which you could swear wasn’t there before. The mystery simply will not let you go, but if you aren’t careful, the it might not let you leave."

ds:
"PEACEMAKER is a quickdraw roleplaying game where we play characters in a wild west showdown: the final confrontation to settle our dispute. We open on the finale of our feud — but we’ll play to find out how we got to this moment of desperate revenge through flashbacks. Together, we’ll create scenes about threats to the people, places, and things that matter to us most. Whoever wins a scene gets to decide the truth in the story of our feud.
 
 At the end of the game, we’ll return to the showdown. All of the decisions we made in each flashback will colour the dramatic tension between us. We’ll find out what’s at stake, what your feud cost, and how it impacts our chances of survival.
 
 To make peace, one of us needs to die."
sd: A quickdraw western role playing game for two

ds:
The Windspire strix tribe has gone completely silent, causing concern in the tribes throughout the Devil's Perch in Cheliax and the coast of Ravounel. When an ally to the Pathfinder Society requests their help in investigating this silence, the Pathfinders find not only plans for an ambush on the tribal lands, but also that Hellknights from the Order of the Chain have already invaded! The Pathfinders will need to ally with the winged strix to help them throw off this invasion and forced conscription into the Chelaxian army!
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. The strix tribe at the Windspire is in trouble; Hellknights have invaded and the Pathfinders need to offer assistance!

ds:
Having secured a secret entrance to the Wreck of the Returned, the Starfinder Society is finally ready to launch a rescue mission into the Wreck, to liberate countless citizens of Akiton who await forced conversion into mindless servitors of the Wreck. While numerous teams prepare to enter the conversion facility, First Seeker Sarmak has tasked one special team with breaching the conversion facility’s central control room and dispatching the cure to conversion through the ventilation system. If successful, all the converted innocents within the Wreck will regain their autonomy and break free from the Wreck’s control.
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. Rescue mind-controlled innocents from the Wreck of the Returned!

ds:
Pathfinder agents have been turning up dead around the Woodsedge Lodge, and no one knows who or what is responsible. None of the investigative avenues, mundane or magical, have been able to solve this mystery. You and your compatriots, some of the most experienced agents in the Society, have been assigned to get to the bottom of this and deal with whatever it is that's causing this trouble.
 
 This is a high-level adventure. No pregenerated characters are available; players must bring their own valid character to play.

sd: 13th-14th level characters. Someone or something is killing Pathfinder agents near the Woodsedge Lodge in Galt.
