Agents of the mysterious Functionary, self-proclaimed representative of the Wreck of the Returned, slink through the Sloughscar Hills on the planet Akiton, abducting anyone who refuses to bow to her commands. Among the missing are two Starfinders. Worried over the fate of his friends and other explorers, First Seeker Sarmak dispatches a team of Starfinders to rescue them. Navigate the Akitonian wilderness, track down the missing, and face off against the forces holding them captive! Their fate is in your hands!

t: [Kids and Families] Starfinder Academy: Ruins of the World Soul
ds:
Players 18 and older are not permitted at these tables unless they are accompanying a child.
 Starfinder Society Academy is a place for children to learn how to play Starfinder and for our younger GMs to hone their skills under the tutelage of experienced GMs. All Starfinder Society Academy tables are family friendly and the GMs are chosen for their experience working with youth. Please note all children 12 and under need a parent/guardian to stay with them at the table. Youth 13-15 need a parent in the Sagamore Ballroom, and youth 16-17 need to have a way to contact their onsite parent. 
 This session will be running SFS2 #1-15: Ruins of the World Soul.
sd: Explore abandoned alien ruins in your quest to defeat the dangerous predators living within and reopen the site to its people. Learn in a family-friendly environment!

t: PFS (2e) #7-09: The Chitterwood Walks, Part 1: Scrambling the Tribes
ds:
When the longshanks of Isger start to gather troops, the goblins of the Chitterwood Forest get nervous, especially when one side of those troops are mostly composed of Hellknights. Throughout the forest, there have been reports of undead attacks on goblin tribes, prompting some of the larger tribal leaders to gather together to discuss their next actions as a whole. As an ally of the Chitterwood goblins, the Crookedtoes tribe has requested that the Pathfinder Society offer some protection during the discussions!
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. Travel to the Chitterwood Forest to protect goblin tribal leaders as they work together to create a plan to defeat undead Hellknights.

ds:
The Pathfinders have learned of a group of Hellish soldiers sitting outside Absalom in the Cairnlands. Though they've alerted the Grand Council of Absalom, the Council's hands are tied between international relations and the complexities of the legal system, but the Pathfinders are willing to step up and handle the situation.
 
 This is a high-level adventure. No pregenerated characters are available; players must bring their own valid character to play.

ds:

ds:
It’s October 21, 1999, in beautiful St. Louis, Missouri. Lumptump McGillicutty, a blobfish, just had his CPA certification revoked. Back during tax season, he gave a client the wrong advice because of a misprint in an IRS pamphlet. There’s only one way for Lumptump to get his CPA certification back: he must travel to Washington, D.C. and convince the IRS’ Deputy Commissioner of Internal Revenue, Robert E. Wenzel, to write a letter to the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), informing them that the error was the IRS’ fault, not Lumptump’s. But Lumptump needs help: because he’s a blobfish, he’s stuck in a water tank! Luckily, his friends Mister Ruffly Tail, Toby the Fence, and Funky Junk Full-Chicken have all agreed to help Lumptump win back his CPA certification.
 
 The rules:
 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1x9GufuaaX6TwbLUQlxE1eMPBG-7poi_0/view?usp=drive_link
sd: Lumptump the blobfish and his animal friends go on an adventure to Washington D.C. in this one-page TTRPG!

t: Tower of Gygarn - KILL IT, KEEP IT - Adult Red Dragon (WizKids)
lo: ICC Hall B : No Rails Adventure Team HQ
ds: Join endless ranks of hero fodder (er...) adventurers! March to face the monster in its lair. No loss of life is too much for the Grieving Emperor who wants vengeance. Adventures fight and quickly die, to be reincarnated until the evil creature is slain. Improve your character each death in Roguelike fashion with permanent benefits. Play as multiple classes and work together or in competition to kill the creature and land the killing blow (which awards your own collectible as trophy of your victory! Endless player lives and someone WILL eventually walk away with this valuable figure. GM Decisions final. Winning Player from each table with compete in Critical Hit Roll-off to take home this Premium "miniature"
sd: Reincarnate and power up your character in battle after battle until monster dies. Final critical hit keeps the miniature from Icons of the Realms ($99 MSRP)!

ds: Join endless ranks of hero fodder (er...) adventurers! March to face the monster in its lair. No loss of life is too much for the Grieving Emperor who wants vengeance. Adventures fight and quickly die, to be reincarnated until the evil creature is slain. Improve your character each death in Roguelike fashion with permanent benefits. Play as multiple classes and work together or in competition to kill the creature and land the killing blow (which awards your own collectible as trophy of your victory! Endless player lives and someone WILL eventually walk away with this valuable figure. GM Decisions final. Winning Player from each table with compete in Critical Hit Roll-off to take home this Premium "miniature"
sd: Reincarnate and power up your character in battle after battle until monster dies. Final critical hit keeps the miniature from Icons of the Realms ($99 MSRP)!

ds:
A century-old curse clings to a remote fishing village trapped behind an unnatural wall of fog. Ships that enter are rarely seen again, and those who stay can never leave. When rumors surface of a powerful relic tied to the origin of the storm, your crew is drawn into a web of haunted wrecks, restless spirits, and rival factions who each want control of what lies beneath the waves.
 
 You will explore tide-lashed docks, investigate abandoned vessels, bargain with desperate locals, and confront something vast moving in the deep. The campaign blends mystery, moral choices, and cinematic sea action. Every decision matters, and courage alone may not be enough to break what was set in motion long ago.
sd: Sail into a cursed harbor where fog hides secrets, relics whisper, and every choice ripples through sea and soul. Mystery, danger, and high adventure await brave crews.

ds: Disappearances and inexplicable events in Broadchurch VA have drawn the attention of Delta Green. Your mission: investigate and assess the situation, neutralize any Unnatural threats, and report back.
sd: Disappearances and inexplicable events in Broadchurch VA have drawn the attention of Delta Green. Your mission: investigate and assess the situation, neutralize any Unnatural threats, and report back.

ds: In the shadowy corners of the darknet, a new cryptocurrency has emerged that fluctuates with astronomical phenomena. Your team is tasked with investigating and neutralizing this Unnatural horror.
sd: In the shadowy corners of the darknet, a new cryptocurrency has emerged that fluctuates with astronomical phenomena. Your team is tasked with investigating and neutralizing this Unnatural horror.

ds:
In this funnel townsfolk will set out in search of riches beyond their wildest dreams. A jelly covered creature, larger than most buildings in town, is slowly making its way across the countryside. Its long tentacles are dragging behind it rending the ground and destroying trees and buildings. The strange thing is that this jelly ball is spitting treasure! I wonder if i could climb one of those tentacles...
 
 The townsfolk of Donnybrook will set out in search of treasure beyond their wildest dreams as they climb inside the bell of an enormous jellyfish that is floating past town.
sd: Investigate a massive, dead, jellyfish like creature hovering above your town.

ds: Do you have what it takes to survive DJ Glitterbomb's dungeon and earn a coveted place Division III team in the North American Empire's most popular sport? Many aspiring superstars will fall to the dungeon but those who survive will bring glory to the Empire, and earn fame and fortune.
sd: The Adventurer's Guild is hosting a live, open call, competition to find new, aspiring, and expendable talent.

ds:
Your mandatory participation is just one way the Empire is rehabilitating individuals who have made some, shall we say, ill-advised life choices.
 
 The objective is straight-forward, make it through all 6 trial chambers, and a purse of 6 gold, and more importantly, a full pardon, is yours! An adventure for 1st level characters.
sd: This is a Play with the Author event! Welcome, contestant, to the Empire's exciting new game show, "Run For Your Life!"

ds: It’s an easy job, what could go wrong? You are a team of monster hunters who have made a living capturing creatures for the games in the Roman amphitheaters. The Corvusalo family, a prominent patrician family, have hired you to travel to beautiful Pamfilia to investigate and secure the ancient family villa and its vineyards. They instruct you to “handle” any squatters, goblins, etc you might find there. It’s practically a paid vacation, right?
sd: This is a Play with the Author event! The Wars of Darkness were a long time ago. Surely the abandoned villa is safe now? Or is there a reason no one has gone back for centuries?

ds:
This is a Play with the Author event!
 
 During the Rejuvenation Festival, crowds gather to witness the sacred magical fish release their radiant healing essence, restoring vitality to the sick, renewing the land, and for the right price, rejuvenating your body. This year, a band of cunning goblins raid the ceremonial pools, stealing the fish, and fleeing to the long-lost, temple of Thaloryn, minor god of the profane depths and vampiric essence. Scant records survive from before the Rapture, but the head of the Church of Arylin is convinced Thaloryn plans to corrupt the fish's pure power to ascend and become a major-god. The adventurers must track the thieves back to the temple, infiltrate the sunken shrine and recover the fish before their healing magic fades.
sd: During the Rejuvenation Festival, sacred magical fish were stolen by goblins. The party must track them to the long-lost temple of Thaloryn before their healing powers fade.

t: The Road to Frandor's Keep: A Roll N Run Experience
ds: Try out the new edition in a classic manner. Roughly the first hour of this session will be making a character, and the next three will be an adventure to test out the different elements of the game. Can you survive the journey?!
sd: Winter is over, and the road is starting to thaw. With it comes news of new bandits, goblins, and other terrors. A perfect time for adventure. Create a character and then put them to the test!

ds: If you've ever played an old-school text adventure, you'll feel right at home! If not, come experience one of the original eras of gaming, one player command at a time. This plays like a party game and is quick to pick up even for first-time players. The GM plays the role of the computer (with a hefty dose of comedy) and narrates the results of your actions. You do not need to have played Action Castle 1 or 2 before playing this scenario.
sd: Come play an interactive text adventure! The players collectively control the PC, with hilarious results. Return to Action Castle again - all is not well!

t: Trials of the Rose: Depths of the Weald
ds: Lord William Clarke is a regional noble based out of the local capitol of Ennevan, the largest of the scattered settlements in and around the Pavin Weald. This dense forest in the northern reaches of the kingdom of Aldis is lightly settled but home to some truly unique people, including many rhy-animals. Tonight he is hosting a gathering to hear the concerns of the people, but this event may prove to be more than a local affair. As the gossip has it, a diplomatic party from the neighboring kingdom of Rezea will be in attendance, and there are even rumors that there may be refugees from Kern, the Land Under Shadow. Hand in hand with the diplomacy of the evening will be a tourney of arms and various displays of poetry, art, and dancing. Pre-generated Blue Rose characters will be provided. Learn more here: https://greenroninstore.com/products/blue-rose-the-age-rpg-of-romantic-fantasy
sd: Lord William Clarke of Ennevan has invited guests from around the Pavin Weald and beyond for an evening of diplomacy and dueling. Small town concerns mingle with surprising guests from Kern and Rezea.

ds:
The Windspire strix tribe has gone completely silent, causing concern in the tribes throughout the Devil's Perch in Cheliax and the coast of Ravounel. When an ally to the Pathfinder Society requests their help in investigating this silence, the Pathfinders find not only plans for an ambush on the tribal lands, but also that Hellknights from the Order of the Chain have already invaded! The Pathfinders will need to ally with the winged strix to help them throw off this invasion and forced conscription into the Chelaxian army!
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 3rd-4th level characters. The strix tribe at the Windspire is in trouble; Hellknights have invaded and the Pathfinders need to offer assistance!

ds:
Deep in the Vast, the dying star Sota has miraculously rekindled, bathing the frozen planet Lajok in glorious light and blessing thousands of the planet’s inhabitants with a solar spark. As scientists and skeptics ponder this inexplicable twist of fate, vlakas the galaxy over undertake the sojourn home to witness this miracle for themselves and celebrate Sota’s revival. When strange occurrences and a missing relic cast a shadow over the celebrations, it’s up to the Starfinders to investigate. Is someone to blame for Sour Spring’s misfortunes, or is Rekindling cursed?
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 1st-2nd level characters. Participate in a festival celebrating the rekindling of a dying sun and investigate a string of strange occurrences that threaten to ruin the event.

ds:
Agents of the mysterious Functionary, self-proclaimed representative of the Wreck of the Returned, slink through the Sloughscar Hills on the planet Akiton, abducting anyone who refuses to bow to her commands. Among the missing are two Starfinders. Worried over the fate of his friends and other explorers, First Seeker Sarmak dispatches a team of Starfinders to rescue them. Navigate the Akitonian wilderness, track down the missing, and face off against the forces holding them captive! Their fate is in your hands!
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 1st-2nd level characters. Track down a pair of missing Starfinders and rescue them from their abductors.

ds: Join an experienced PIRATE BORG Game Master as you set sail in your initial adventure upon the Dark Caribbean, an undead-infested version of Earth where magic is real and piracy runs rampant. You’ll be building your very own pirate from scratch, learning the ins and outs of naval combat, and going head-to-head with a rival pirate crew! Each GM will bring their own flavor of adventure to the table. PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation and then play through a short scenario. All materials provided. Perfect for new players but all are welcome! 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups may be available at the event location.

Each GM will bring their own flavor of adventure to the table. PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation and then play through a short scenario. All materials provided. Perfect for new players but all are welcome! 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups may be available at the event location.

t: Dead Man's Cove: Take Away Game
ds: Join an experienced PIRATE BORG Gamemaster and sail your small fleet of pirate ships to Dead Man's Cove. The price of this event includes taking home a copy of the new Player's Guidebook at a discount! Legends tell of a cursed treasure guarded by ships of bone and horrible monsters. Can you find the treasure and live long enough to spend it? Captain or crew a small fleet of ships, find the treasure, and unleash a black powder storm upon your enemies! PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. You will start by randomly generating characters and then embark on an adventure. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.
sd: Command a small fleet in a pitched battle against the undead, then spelunk into Captain Red Wolf's grotto in a naval combat-focused scenario! You'll also take home a copy of our Player's Guidebook!

ds: Work alongside Anne Bonny and Calico Jack to wrench back control of this infamous port from a group of grotesque undead who've overrun the fort and make nightly raids into town, stealing hearts, munching brains, and otherwise being absolutely dastardly. Slay these wretches, take back the fort, and fill your holds with loads of ASH! PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.

ds:
The Governor wants to celebrate your successes as pirates on rival factions' shores, and has invited you to dinner. You're in for one of the best meals you'll have in your pirate lives – a proper seven-course dinner awaits! But keep your wits about you, as this evening holds more than good food and simple stories of adventure and thrill, for you may yet find yourselves in for a tale you'll be dying to tell. This one-shot is a taste of the Winds of Hell campaign book and is run by our Master of Sails Fenn Woodruff. 
 PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.
sd: An author-run, exclusive adventure! A party for your successful crew is thrown by a corrupt governor, but what starts as a celebration quickly turns into something dark and terrifyingly righteous.

ds: In this gothic-castle-on-a-boat adventure, you'll cross cutlasses with Captain Roland and his Deep One crew. Export the ship, search for artifacts, stop the ritual, and put vampyrates to the sword! This 8-table tournament will see 6-player crews earning points throughout the adventure, with the winners earning over $300 in prizes! 3rd-level pregens provided, or bring your own pirate that's Gained Experience twice. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home.
sd: Join this multi-table race-to-the-finish tournament where your crew competes against others to get treasure and save prisoners aboard a ship filled with vampyrates! Over $300 in prizes!

ds:
Hoist the sails, board your ships, and load your pistols: it’s time to choose characters and have an epic adventure. Each table will start by nominating a captain, who will then take part in a meeting of the Brethren and claim a role for your crew in the upcoming raid. What follows is a daring, high-stakes, combat-heavy scenario where everyone works together (in theory) in a conquest that will put your naval prowess, martial abilities, and black powder techniques to the test!
 PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation and then embark on an adventure. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.
sd: A massive multi-table event! Fourteen crews will plot the siege and sacking of a landlubber city, then execute their vision in our very first Epic.

ds: Join an experienced PIRATE BORG Gamemaster and search for hidden treasure in this perfect introduction to the Dark Caribbean. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.

PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. You will start by randomly generating characters and then embark on an adventure. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.
sd: Half your crew has mutinied, stolen one of your ships, and made off with your treasure map! Take them down on the high seas, then find the hidden treasure at Anchor Drop Falls.

ds:
Join an experienced PIRATE BORG Game Master on a sandbox-style exploration of the Dark Caribbean, an undead-infested version of Earth where magic is real and piracy runs rampant. Navigate through tropical archipelagos, explore hidden temples, find buried treasure, fight undead & deep sea horrors, and misbehave like the true scallywags that you are! 
 Each GM will select their own adventure to run, making every session a scallywag's surprise! PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.
sd: An undead plague known as THE SCOURGE has washed over the Dark Caribbean. You and your pirate crew will choose a heading, uncover lost treasures, and live (and die) like pirate kings and queens!

t: The Winds of Hell: Judgement Day
ds:
Join adventure designer Frank Tedeschi in a preview of the upcoming campaign book, The Winds of Hell! Here, you'll be fighting off demonic hordes as you experience ground zero of the most terrible of fates to ever befall Port Royal...or any other port for that matter. It's Judgement Day in the Dark Caribbean, and the Devil's come a' calling. 
 PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation. All materials provided. New and experienced players are welcome. 5e and D&D players will feel right at home. Multiple games of Pirate Borg are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlist sign-ups are available at the event location.
sd: An author-run, exclusive adventure! A vile captain opens a rift and initiates calamity. Escape the doomed town, ride a crushing tsunami, and fight an infernal fleet set loose upon the Dark Caribbean.

t: Legend in the Mist - Shadow In The Barley
ds:
"On this overcast afternoon, the meandering, mundane life in the village of Ravenhome seems as if it would go on in much the same way forever. It has been this way for as long as anyone can remember: the farmhands toiling in the orchards, busy householders cooking dinner and geezers rocking in their chairs, while the alderman paces knowingly around the Folkhearth and the children play in the tall barley.
 
 But things are not as they seem. On this overcast afternoon, out in the fields, a chill wind blows. Something moves in the barley, ancient and lumbering. Its heavy trudging as momentous as the footsteps of fate itself, its very appearance doomed to inexorably change the course of life in the Ravensdale, and of a handful of hearts in particular.
 
 [Learn-to-play] [Adventuring]"
sd: The unexpected appearance of a Creature of Twilight in the fields of Ravenhome -- more than 300 years since the great War -- sends a handful of unlikely heroes on a quest to uncover its origins.

ds:
You and your companions were lucky enough to be invited to the Blue Hills Jazz Club, the best place to hear new music anywhere near Boston. Located outside of Boston city limits there was no enforcement of local liquor laws and the club's fame exploded during prohibition. Unfortunately, the club has unreliable electrical access, and power outages are common. When the lights go out the eclectic mix of gangsters, musicians, off-duty constables, and staff usually play nice and rarely cause any ruckus. This night however, forces beyond human comprehension are to blame, and cooperation among Bostonians will not suffice to hold back the darkness. 
 
 This is a Call of Cthulhu scenario set in the 1920s outside of Boston Massachusetts. The themes are mature, involving descriptions of gore and violence, as well as drug use and profane language. There is no explicit sexual content.
sd: You and your companions are thrilled to go hear some jazz out in the woods surrounding Boston. You have nothing but food and frivolities on your mind when the lights go out and darkness closes in.

t: Legend in the Mist - Heap Thing of Skunk Glen
ds:
"For as long as anyone can remember, before the spring festival, the villagers of Ravenhome would cart their old clothes, broken tools, and other discarded items and toss them over an outcrop of rock into a ravine known as Skunk Glen. This year, the Alderman convinced the others that they should change their custom – the rubbish and broken furniture could be piled high into a heap, and make a lovely bonfire for the spring festival!
 
 That night, a fell wind blows through the trees. In the middle of the celebration, the people of the village could feel something was... wrong. The pies were rotten and covered in flies. The straw figures for the bonefire started moving. And the fire, the fire was furious and strangely alive. Have they have angered a terrible Creature of Twilight?
 
 Fortunately, there was someone at the village that saved the day...
 
 [Adventuring] [Combat-light]"
sd: A spring festival celebration in a remote village goes terribly wrong when a mysterious curse turns it on its head - calling local heroes to search for the root cause.

t: Legend in the Mist - A Fox In The Dales
ds:
"An insular lot, the people of Milkrest thrive on gossip and rumor. So, after someone broke into Radmila’s teahouse, they immediately pointed fingers at Azeria – the red-haired wildling. Bereft of her secretive mother, the child was destined to turn feral. And, for once, they’re half correct. Azeria robbed Radmila’s store and fled town. Yet, there’s more to her story, hidden truths uncovered after her mother’s death.
 
 Set on this perilous journey of self-discovery, she leaves a trail of chaos and crime behind her across three Dalish communities. Soon, she will find herself snared by buried misdeeds and old hatred, with no one to turn to. It’s a good thing Radmila sent a handful of good folk to catch up to her before it’s too late…
 
 [Investigation]"
sd: An uncanny yet misguided youth leaves a wake of destruction throughout the Dales, forcing you to contend with unscrupulous smugglers, cruel ranchers, and strange Creatures if you are to help her.

t: Legend in the Mist - The Painted Beast
ds:
"The western Dales descend into a thickly-wooded vale: Cedargate, the land in the shadow of the wild Craggen Highlands. Year by year, the Woodwards stand watch from towers and walls, sworn to repel aggressors from the Highlands, whether vicious raiders or rampaging beasts. 
 
 This year has been difficult. Raids have been more frequent, by parties in larger numbers. The Woodwards seek allies from outside of Cedargate to help weather this storm. To some, it feels as if Cedargate will surely fall. As willing Dalesfolk travel to Cedargate to take up arms, a new threat draws near: a terrifying beast unlike
 anything seen in the Dales. The monster’s appearance is only the start of a desperate journey into the Highlands that may reveal new friends and new foes alike.
 
 [Adventuring] [Journey] [Combat-heavy]"
sd: A ferocious attack on the once-peaceful Dales sparks a journey into the wilderness of the highlands, where new alliances must be forged if you are to stave off the wilds' monsters and sorcerers.

"The Falzoni mob has sunk its teeth deep in the flesh of the Miller’s Square neighborhood. Their smooth-talking loan sharks drive business owners into financial ruin, and sooner or later they all turn up dead. But being a private detective in this town, you know well that what may seem like a run-of-the-mill racketeering operation must hide a much more arcane and insidious plot.
 
 Who in the shadows is benefitting from the people of Miller's Square racking up all this debt? What kind of a dark deal did the Falzoni sign and what are nefarious powers are they getting in return? Hitting the pavement is the only way to find out, but you may find yourself facing unnatural mobsters and sharks greater than mere loan sharks if you dip your feet into this tank...
 
 [Investigation] [Noir] [Action]"
sd: Your neighborhood is being invaded by a new, supernatural breed of underworld loan sharks and it's up to you to connect the dots, uncover their plot, and drive them out.

"Three dead. It’s all over the newspapers: “The Cross End Killer Strikes Again...” As the community mourns in the Cross End neighborhood, a derelict slum by all accounts, you find yourself there by chance, investiating a break in at the art gallery.
 
 Old mythological forces haunt the streets. A war is stirring between the holy and the wild and yet no-one really has a clue. A mysterious force hides it all, the same as it does all of your supernatural powers. A case like this calls for someone a bit more familiar with the strange. Someone like you - a crew of living legends. Will you allow this mystical war to tear apart your city? 
 
 [Investigation] [Noir] [Action]"
sd: An investigation of an art gallery theft throws your crew into the midst of a holy war between primal mythical forces right in the heart of a City slum yet invisible to most.

ds:
"Emily Craig is missing but the police isn't doing a thing. In this city of smoke and mirrors, teenagers disappear while human traffickers operate unchecked in the docks. Here, the law ignores everything they can't explain. Especially if it smells of... weird. When Emily's distraught mother shows up at your crew's office, you know that behind the newspaper story there’s always a legend. A living legend - like all of you. 
 What's really going on after school hours at City High? Who is behind the new viral clique that is forming amidst the highschoolers, and why are they all being shady about it? It's time for a group like you to dig into the matter -- concerned citizens, private detectives, and teens worried for their besties, people who can see through the veil of mundanity into the burning legends behind. You are Emily Craig's last hope.
 [Investigation] [Noir] [Teen Drama] [Action]"
sd: In a modern-day city full of living legends, your crew investigates a series of disappearances at a local high school where teenagers seem to have fallen prey to an infectious new trend.

ds:
"The rain falls heavily from the overcast heights of the Royal Plaza Hotel. Like the rain, so did Ashley Lind fall the distance from the light-bulb-studded letters at the top to the marble plaza below. What was she thinking, in those last moments? Was she hoping a miracle would happen and she’d fly away? Was she done with the world? Did she think of someone special? No one will ever know. 
 Soon, Ashley will be an ever fading stain, gamblers in tuxedos and nights gowns walking all over her. And she’ll be forgotten. Maybe that’s what she wanted. But your crew is not going to let that happen. Something dark happened here. Ashley was a part of a greater story, a living legend, like you, hidden by the rolling city smog. You look up to the towering front of the casino, not knowing what awaits your crew inside except the one thing you're after -- the truth.
 [Investigation] [Noir] [Action]"
sd: A body lays before the Royal Plaza Hotel, but you know this was no suicide. A dark presence hovers over the casino, where you will dig up the truth and bring justice to the high and mighty.

ds:
"Two days ago a rival cyber team -- the Ōgama marauders -- has identified, isolated, and taken control of an anomalous Domain in cyberspace, codenamed BNZ4I-10, which allows them to manipulate the flow of data throughout cyberspace, even highly sensitive information sent from secure locations, and siphon it into their hands. This technology grants their cyber team unchecked reach and significant advantage. In fact, this very communication could be tapped.
 We managed to secure a line of communications into it; we can Harness your team and project you into the Domain’s virtual representation. Your objective is to infiltrate and take over BNZ4I-10, clear all Ōgama presence and code, and transfer control to Section 7. As a secondary objective, identify and secure any tech or artifacts used by Ōgama operatives to control or access the server.
 
 [Heist] [Action]"
sd: Deep in cyberspace, a pagoda-like Domain grants visitors power over the flow of data. You are hired to Harness into its VR and secure it from the Ōgama faction as well as its own mystical defenders.

ds:
"It’s another dusty afternoon in the Cairo Megacity; a sand storm is expected soon. You are all huddled around a hooka at a local cafe, when a new job hits your apps. An unnamed employer wants you to track a kidnapped girl, Jala, taken by an armed and dangerous individual, an extremist or rival corp agent. They were last seen heading to El Souk, the Megacity’s gigantic street market and a known hotbed of destabilizing anti-corporate activity and Jinn enclave. Time is very much of the essence: you may use whatever means necessary, but the girl must live.
 
 But why *this* girl, when so many children in the Megacity are left to fend for themsleves? The elusive employer’s secrecy, the tight timetable, and the mysterious child all make this job stink like the Nile on a hot summer day. Will you help the child, or your bank account?
 
 [Chase] [Action] [Investigation]"
sd: A wild chase through Cairo's dusty marketplaces, dockland, and the Nile -- where your crew rushes to rescue a kidnapped child that is coveted by ravenous factions both corporate and mystical.

ds:
"The infamously exclusive Ghost Market, the Megacity’s roving AR black market, has come to a nearby neighborhood and you’ve been invited… to work.
 Your employers are a smuggler gang called the Yuna (“bathhouse girls”), operating out of their sentō (bathhouse) which has been converted into a stylish night club. They’ve called you to act both as negotiators and as backup muscle to help them during a meeting with Ghost Market leaders to determine their future in the larger Tokyo underworld.
 Your job will be successful if you can make sure the Yuna remain unharmed, and come out of their negotiations on top. Your contact is a Yuna named Choko, who has asked that you come to the sentō before the meeting. Rumor has it that the bathhouse is haunted by a kami or yōkai, which could complicate the negotiations – especially if the gang isn't even aware of the danger.
 
 [Diplomacy] [Action]"
sd: In a neon-lit Tokyo bathhouse-club, haunted by yokai, a smuggler gang hires your crew as negotiators, mystics, and bodyguards as they meet to do business with the infamous Ghost Market elite.

ds: The city of Al-Yaman has been attacked! The infamous band of Forty Thieves has ransacked the city, spreading terror and disquiet. They even breached the royal palace! The only thing stolen? A family heirloom, an old brass lamp. The Princess Scheherazade has summoned her Knights (that’s you!) to quest out and retrieve the lamp before the ancient and malevolent Djinn trapped within can be released! Once three wishes have been made, the demon within is free. Journey forth to save the land and stop the thieves once and for all!
sd: An intro to the Fabula Ultima game system. Join a party of adventurers in an Arabian Nights themed quest to recover a stolen magical lamp and prevent an evil djinn from being released.

ds:
An unsettling crowd of lunatics, hyper-colorful, liberally partaking of sex and gender, whose lives are potentially infinite and with one thing on their mind: fun, wacky zany fun!
 HELLUVA TOWN is intended to be a narrative, rules-light game, designed to be enjoyed by both hardcore Gamers and those who have never played a single RPG in their life.
 The lore borrows wholeheartedly from the vast, lysergic vault of US cartoons from the 1930s (with a couple of space-time liberties; Law & Order isn’t exactly one of the tenets of Helluva Town). The game is an acid trip through Looney Toons, early Mickey Mouse, Popeye and Betty Boop, with sudden swerves into worlds that quite happily stole from those colorful worlds: from Who framed Roger Rabbit? to Cool World, from The Goon to Cuphead.
sd:
THAT’S MAD, FOLKS!
 1930s, New York City. Helluva Town is one of the city’s secret neighborhoods, wedged somewhere between Little Italy and the Bowery – and inhabited by living cartoons.

t: Food and Evil: Diners, Demons, Endives
ds:
Set in your favorite storybooks and role playing settings, these demons are rowdy, crafty, and know how to make a mean sammy. The game uses a standard deck of cards to play, and the pre-made Player Sheets makes setup quick and snappy.
 
 Will you be a mystical Fry Wizard demon, making delectable morsels out of magical fry juice, or will you be a Grill Master demon and make your enemies sizzle under your spatula? Join us in this well-seasoned game of mischief and tasty food recipes, great for new players!
sd: Play as demons running a food truck in this fast, frantic, and easy card-based TTRPG!

ds:
Looking for something casual, wholesome, and silly? Join the Soup Troupe on a whimsical adventure!
 
 This is an accessible gm-less rpg where players are woodland creatures gathering ingredients to make soup to heal weary travelers. Great for those looking to try out a TTRPG. Actions are determined by eating actual soup (or rolling dice as an alternative) and the book comes with a soup recipe in the back. This light role playing game is perfect for parties and potlucks, or for a group of friends wanting something quick to pickup and play. Big laughs and good company are always present when Good Soup is involved!
sd: Play as woodland creatures gathering ingredients to make soup in this cozy, rules lite TTRPG! (Soup not included)

ds:
A Legends of Barsaive adventure. After months of
 research, the Adventuring Companies are only slightly closer to
 recovering their prize. They decide to find the answers they seek
 within Parlainth by force, and you're just the sort they want on this
 expedition.
sd:
A Legends of Barsaive Adventure. The Adventuring
 Companies decide to explore Parlainth in force and you're just the
 sort they want on this expedition.

ds:
A Legends of Barsaive adventure. An unlikely ally
 has made the Adventuring Companies an offer, one that requires your
 assistance to carry out their end of the deal. Delve once more into
 the catacombs of Parlainth and see if you have what it takes to
 survive this test. Characters will be provided, but players are
 encouraged to bring their own
sd:
A Legends of Barsaive Adventure. The mood in Haven
 is tense. But the mood outside of Haven is worse, venture under
 Parlainth to negotiate a truce with the queen of the dead.

ds:
A Legends of Barsaive adventure. A power
 foe makes their final move against the crippled ton of Haven. It’s
 citizens must put their political differences aside if they wish to
 have a city left to squabble over. New players welcome, pre-gens
 available.
sd:
A Legends of Barsaive
 adventure. In the face of imminent destruction, the citizens of Haven
 must band together in order to survive.

ds: Sure. You’ve probably played this old module. Yeah, you may have even run it once or twice (or ten times). But you wouldn’t go meta, using player knowledge, right? If you haven't played it, you are in for a treat! Wanna see how fast you can kill off 1st level characters? Sure. Is the goal maxing your character's levels before time is up? Okay. Plan to make alliances with the evils of the area and take over the Keep? I’ve got a stack of basic characters and I’m not afraid to kill them.
sd: Start the con by wander the Caves of Chaos, old school-style. Use the original boxset rules to play stripped down characters.

t: B2+: Keeping on Keep on the Borderlands
ds: Continue Keep on the Borderlands by picking up where the last group left off in the classic sandbox module. Maybe resurrect one or two of the good player characters that the previous group foolishly killed off. Take to pillaging the corpses of recently deceased PCs for good stuff that those first murder hobos overlooked. Things get missed when you're into killing off those orc tribes that simply want to live in peace (and raid the countryside).
sd: Original boxset rules - as seen on TV. Pick up where the last B2 group left off. Plenty of hack-and-slash left to go around in this old school module.

ds: A Honey Heist crew of bears (and bear-adjacent creatures) has to tread lightly at the underground (literally) honey convention. Is it possible to steal the honey while randomly interacting with silly humans, mutated irradiated beasts and other things that maybe shouldn't exist? Will your actions start the next world war? Is “The Treasure State” infested with dwarves? Be prepared - there will be time during the event for arts & crafts.
sd: Abandoned nuclear missile silo & honey-crazed party animals (and bears). What could go wrong?

ds: HoneyCon 2026 has gone mobile this year, and by mobile, I don't mean on a phone app. A convoy of 15 tractor-trailers barrels down Interstate 76, hosting the wildest honey-focused convention on wheels. Organized by the eccentric billionaire beekeeper, Queen Magnolia Buzzworth, and sponsored by the hot & sticky gossip TV show, TMBzzzz, HoneyCon boasts rare honey tastings, high-stakes apiary auctions, and the unveiling of the legendary "Golden Comb," said to produce infinite honey. It's all the buzz!!!
sd: Ready for a heck of a honey adventure? HoneyCon takes off at a high-speed with convoys, tastings, and the legendary Golden Comb! Craft your perfect bear to take it all. Glue sticks will be provided.

ds: Peculiar Brews is a Level 3 sandbox adventure set in the corrupted Mournwood, where your party must track down clues scattered throughout a forest thick with secrets. This open-ended scenario emphasizes exploration, roleplay, and investigation, rewarding creative problem-solving and player choice. Along the way, you’ll navigate eccentric woodland figures, unsettling mysteries, and pockets of corruption—facing meaningful but measured combat as you uncover the truth behind the forest’s peculiar offerings. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Enter the cursed Mournwood, where corrupted magic and ancient ruins hide deadly secrets. Hunt the Bloodcrystal—but rival forces and the forest itself may claim you first.

ds: The Dungeon of Du’unix one-shot is a 6th-level, combat-forward dungeon crawl built for high-intensity convention play. This adventure drops players straight into the action with dangerous encounters, meaningful choices, clever puzzles, and a climactic boss battle against a powerful cult ritual. Expect tactical fights, eerie dungeon exploration, short rests under pressure, and a final showdown that tests teamwork and resource management. This is classic dungeon delving—deadly, fast-paced, and unforgettable. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Few dare approach Mu'uz Derron, the overturned floating city, as corruption spreads through the Deadhills. Your party must descend into the mountain's guts and uncover the secrets of the cult within.

ds:
In Kobold Quest: Dust & Devils, a narrative-driven, wild west, steampunk magipunk adventure bursting with chaos, light rules, and ridiculous fun, your homeless, hungry kobold clan is one bad torch away from extinction—and desperate times call for reckless real estate acquisition. The plan? Seize Castle Raisinloaf and make it yours.
 
 Unfortunately, it’s occupied by the brooding (and extremely bitey) Vampire Lord C'hahd and a buffet of monsters, mercenaries, and things that skitter in the dark. Rumor whispers his still-beating Heart lies hidden deep within the castle’s cursed halls. Capture it, and the pale tyrant must kneel. Fail, and you’re appetizers. Grab your six-shooters, your posse, and your questionable courage—tonight, the kobolds raid.
sd: Homeless kobolds raid Castle Raisinloaf to seize Vampire Lord C'hahd's hidden Heart. Win a new home. Fail and become dinner. Chaos, guns, and magipunk mayhem!

t: The Grand Gooey Grift - A Tale of Lies, Larceny, and Luck
ds:
Step into a theatrical spectacular that redefines collaborative gaming. This immersive adventure drops you into a high-stakes race inside the mysterious Darkenhaven Museum.
 
 Work with your team to solve cryptic puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and pull off daring heists while rival groups compete for the same priceless treasures. Every success shifts the balance. Every delay gives your opponents an edge.
 
 Expect interactive challenges, strategy, clever problem-solving, and bold teamwork. Wit, speed, and cunning will determine who claims victory.
 
 !!!!!!! Sensory Notice !!!!!!!!
 This mega-event is loud and high-energy, with multiple teams of 8 working simultaneously around shared tables.
sd: Race rival teams inside the Darkenhaven Museum in this theatrical heist adventure. Solve puzzles, steal treasures, and outwit opponents in a high-stakes contest of cunning. Sensory Warning.

ds:
Welcome young heroes to the Century Station Eagle Knight Security
 Training Facility. Training begins promptly; we’re going to test your mettle to see if you have what it takes to join us.

ds: The Ultra Cool Animals are asked by Lessie Phelps to investigate Genelabs to find her brother Alex. Genelabs is involved with mutant bears, which is right up the player characters alley, so to speak.
sd: The Ultra Cool Animals are asked by Lessie Phelps to investigate Genelabs to find her brother Alex. Genelabs is involved with mutant bears, which is right up the player characters alley, so to speak.

ds: The Deepest Fear is a 3rd-level roleplay and investigation-driven adventure designed for players who enjoy tension, mystery, and meaningful character interaction. The adventure builds steadily toward a dramatic grand finale where everything the party has uncovered comes to bear in a climactic confrontation that tests both resolve and judgment. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Unearth the secrets lurking beneath the city of Darkenhaven. Brave the grime-filled alleys where the nefarious halfling Noggleboffin's gang has a dark mission in service of an even darker master.

ds: You are members of the Rats, a group of young thieves and mercenaries of the Western Empire. You must find a holy item from one of three difficult locations. Which will you choose, will you survive?
sd: You are members of the Rats, a group of young thieves and mercenaries of the Western Empire. You must find a holy item from one of three difficult locations. Which will you choose, will you survive?

ds: The Truth Lies Cold is a 3rd-level adventure that blends tense cave exploration, layered investigation, and chilling supernatural encounters. Designed for players who enjoy uncovering secrets as much as drawing steel, this scenario challenges both mind and mettle. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: The Steel Dagger vanished in the Mournwood. Hired by a shadowy figure, your party must brave Crovendown Cave to recover a lost amulet - while something unseen watches from below.

ds: Brand new at Gen Con 2026. Prime Rib is a level 3 chaotic combat-heavy romp through the back woods, where the adventurers encounter a house full of unpleasant individuals fond of moonshine and loaded crossbows. Sent to rescue a number of hapless guardsmen, the party must figure out how to find and free them while navigating the many foul Butcher family members that infest the dwelling. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Venture into moonshiner territory at the Butcher Farm, where deadly traps and a murderous clan lurk, ready to protect their bootlegging operation. Survive the carnage and end their reign of terror.

ds: Welcome to the world of Rifts! This event will include a variety of "mercenaries" for the use of the players. You will be taught the rules.
sd: These freshly minted mercenaries are sent out on new assignments to learn the way of the land. The world has changed drastically and quickly since the Devil/Demon Wars and the guilds need to know why!

ds:
Shades of Loss is a roleplay-heavy, exploration-focused adventure that challenges players to navigate a corrupted wilderness where the land itself seems alive with malice. Twisting paths, unsettling encounters, and shifting terrain create a constant sense of unease as the party pieces together what truly happened.
 
 Combat is present, sharp, and dangerous—but the greater challenge lies in haunting exploration, tense roleplay, and memorable encounters. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: In the Mournwood, something has taken a child - and the forest does not easily give back what it claims. Your party must brave shifting woods and lurking horrors to stop a creature of despair.

ds: Brand new at Gen Con 2026. The Silence of the Grave is a Level 6 adventure featuring gothic-horror elements, which leans heavily on investigation and roleplay. It has an open, lead-driven structure which takes the party through multiple locations, where they interact with NPCs and uncover clues. It concludes in a dungeon crawl with eerie exploration and high-stakes combat. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Drawn into the Gloomport's seedy streets, your party uncovers a fiend's twisted mirror feeding on fear. To stop a deadly Beacon of Discord, they must survive gangs, cults, and rising chaos.

ds:
Step into the enchanting realm of Perils and Fortunes, a collaborative card-based RPG where every flip has the potential to twist your destiny! Follow along an intriguing tale, while using a combination of luck and skill to overcome obstacles and challenges. Whether you’re a solitary explorer or part of a daring team, the adventure evolves with the shuffle of a deck, promising a unique experience every time!
 
 Will Kizmya’s fortune shine on you or will the perilous path lead you to destruction? Gather your decks, summon your courage, and let the adventure begin!
 
 All materials required to play are included.
sd: A unique card-based RPG using the stunning Deck of Perilous Fortuity. Flip, strategize, and test your luck in Darktide's, Night, a twisting adventure where every card can change your fate.

ds: In this pint sized adventure, you will get to explore the grand event held by the Blue Veil Hanataz troupe known as Carnivalle. You and your party will play this short set of scenarios on the huge 3D model of the Blue Veil Carnivalle from the World of Zyathé. This event is an open sandbox and it has loads of replayability if you'd like to enjoy it more than one time. It’s a great introduction to Gooey Cube and a fun casual convention experience for all! Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table. Pre-gens provided.
sd: The Carnivalle has come to town! Explore the Blue Veil's immersive 3D terrain sandbox of secrets, spectacles, and surprises - who knows what wonders await?

 Tables of 3–6 players. Pregenerated characters provided.

t: Reach for the Stars - Roll 2 Heal
ds:
Join Roll2Heal for a special presentation of Reach for the Stars, a thrilling heist adventure from Keys from the Golden Vault. In this high-stakes Dungeons & Dragons scenario, players must plan and execute the perfect infiltration to steal a priceless magical prize from a heavily guarded location.
 
 Success will require teamwork, clever planning, and creative problem-solving. Scout defenses, bypass magical security, navigate social obstacles, and adapt when the plan inevitably goes sideways. Multiple approaches are possible—stealth, deception, bold improvisation, or calculated risk.
 
 Hosted in partnership with Roll2Heal, this session highlights the power of collaborative storytelling to build confidence, connection, and shared triumph. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or new to heist-style play, prepare for suspense, surprises, and a daring adventure among the stars.
sd: Join Roll2Heal for a special session of Reach for the Stars! Plan the perfect infiltration, outwit magical security, and steal a legendary prize in this high-stakes D&D adventure.

t: "B-B-B-B-Boss Battle!" - Multi-Table Event with Jeff Hays
ds:
WELCOME, CRAWLERS.
 This is not your run-of-the-mill tabletop session — this is a multi-table boss gauntlet inspired by the brutal, ridiculous, and unforgettable world of Dungeon Crawler Carl.
 In “B-B-B-B-Boss Battle!”, all the tables in the room must face down dangerous mobs and not one, but two dungeon bosses. But your table doesn’t face this daunting task alone - every group’s success (or catastrophic failure) contributes to the fate of all.
 How It Works:
 Phase 1: Tackle Some Mobs – A warm-up. Emphasis on warm.
 Phase 2: Borough Boss – Things start to heat up, is your table up to the challenge?
 Phase 3: City Boss – One final, glorious showdown where carnage reigns and everything is on the line.
 Between phases, the Dungeon adapts. Threats escalate. Rules bend or even break.
 And overseeing it all? Jeff Hays, performing live as the Dungeon AI, delivering real-time announcements!
sd: A spectacular where tables must work together to first defeat a Borough Boss, then a City Boss - all while Jeff Hays voices the Dungeon AI live!

ds: HyperMalls were once planetoid-sized space stations, packed with every kind of store and food chain imaginable... But they gradually went out of style for various reasons and many of them were shutdown and abandoned. Needless to say, not a great place for your crew to find themselves after an emergency landing, especially because the malfunctioning parking system has made it impossible to leave. Magic A--holes in Space is a space fantasy, card-driven RPG of my own creation that I am eager to bring back to Gen Con. You will be taught how to play and how to make your own characters for this one-shot adventure. No prior knowledge or experience required. Decks of playing cards and additional materials will be provided.
sd: An emergency landing trapped your crew on a dead HyperMall, and you're quickly realizing leaving retail hell won't be so easy...

t: Learn to Play Adventure: The Sablewood Messengers
ds: Daggerheart’s Quickstart Adventure is designed to help your table learn as they play. Designed to be a self-contained experience guiding you through the mechanics of Daggerheart, the adventure provides opportunities to interact with the world and contribute to its narrative by diving into collaborative storytelling, exploration, combat, and social interaction. You’ll learn the rules of the game as you delve deeper into the mystery unfolding before you! The adventure features six pre-generated characters to choose from: Marlowe Fairwind (Loreborne Elf Sorcerer), Barnacle (Underborne Ribbet Rogue), Garrick Reed (Highborne Human Warrior), Khari Nix (Ridgeborne Giant Guardian), Varian Soto (Wildborne Katari Ranger), and Tegan Saphire (Slyborne Faerie Bard).
sd: Dive into the heart of adventure at level 1! You're tasked to deliver a mysterious package to someone called the Whitefire Arcanist in Hush, a village in Sablewood forest, but surprises are in store.

ds: A level 2 Daggerheart adventure! Featuring pre-generated characters for easy onboarding, the adventure comes prepared with a wide variety of classes and ancestries for your table to experience. This adventure is designed as a self-contained experience for new players looking to jump into the game at a higher level of play, or to continue the adventure for those who have already played the Quickstart Adventure. sd: A network of spires loom above the treetops of the Sablewood. When the blazing light from one of these towers begins to fade, a group of heroes are sent out by the Whitefire Arcanist to save it!

ds: Your party stands sentry on the gleaming deck of the royal airship Windfall as it soars high above the seemingly endless canopy below. You bought your way aboard this vessel by promising its captain safety and security, but the journey will test more than your vigilance: You'll battle winged beasts, dine with nobility, repel a pirate invasion, and discover dark secrets that threaten your liberty - and your lives. When the truth is revealed, who will have your back... and who will go for your throat? Find out in this advanced Daggerheart adventure, available only at Gen Con 2026.
sd: Take to the skies in this swashbuckling airship adventure for level 3 characters featuring all-new character classes from the first official expansion, Hope & Fear!

ds: For centuries the Chelni horse clans have maintained their traditions, keeping to the old ways and honoring the spirits of their ancestors. But in recent years, missionaries of a foreign deity have started living among them, gaining converts. This dynamic has caused simmering resentment among some of the tribesmen. How will this dynamic change when several kinsmen of one of those missionaries arrive with momentous news from home?
sd: A warrior-missionary. A chieftain converted to the new faith. An ambitious young warrior. An embittered, elderly wise woman. The sudden arrival of a shieldmaiden and a skald. What could go wrong?

ds: In 2035, a fissure opened between Earth and Niflheim, an icy wasteland with giants, vargar, and elves. Cold leaked into our world, dropping the temperature and shortening the growing cycle of crops. Ten years later, we know enough to send scouting teams to Niflheim. One of these teams, on the verge of a breakthrough, went missing. Your job is to complete their mission and bring them home. Uses the Cortex Prime rules.

ds: They say that Ariel is a paradise of technology. That it is. But every paradise has its snakes and apples. The one in Ariel is an underground bunker called Government Facility #42. Something is loose in there, something only a specialized team of military, espionage agents, and scientists have a chance of bringing down. It's a Tze Sah Ju Yi, a suicide mission plain and simple. But, in the middle of all these Mo Min Chi Meow scientific experiments, there may something here that saves us. Or kills us. Or both.

ds: From the rules book: "LORDS OF CREATION is a role-playing game of science fantasy, fantasy, science fiction, and high adventure that explores the farthest reaches of imagination. Game adventures take place throughout time, space, and other dimensions." This particular adventure starts with a murder mystery at a gaming convention in the mundane world before moving onward to eerie encounters with bizarre beings in weirder whereabouts. The Wild Hunt, the Bermuda Triangle, the Flying Dutchman, killer robots, and the First Ones await you! Are you ready to take your first steps toward becoming a Lord of Creation?
sd: Based on the first module for Avalon Hill's Lords of Creation, this is an abridged adventure using simplified homebrew rules. ISO a few kind souls for fast-and-loose 1980s science-fantasy zaniness.

ds:
"Survival is statistically unlikely. Have a productive day."
 The Company promised a new beginning at "The Garden," a terraformed paradise. You are the skeleton crew of the USCSS Hesperides, tasked with oversight while 500 colonists dream in hypersleep. But the wake-up call is a nightmare: the ship is drifting, the air is freezing, and Pod 402 has been shattered from the inside.
 In this cinematic scenario, you must navigate the "Orchard" cryo-bay, manage rising Stress, and outsmart the galaxy’s apex predator. But the creature in the vents isn't your only threat. Everyone has a Secret Agenda—and some of your crewmates may have already decided you are expendable. Will you save the 500 sleepers, or will you be the first one to the escape shuttle?
sd: 500 sleepers. 1 predator. The Hesperides is dying. Wake up, fix the ship, and survive the Orchard. Trust no one—everyone has a secret agenda. Will you save the colony or yourself?

ds:
"Proteus, Inc. is the world's leading producer of genetically modified animals. From companions to security, we're optimizing and elevating nature for the future. Evolution can wait. Humanity can't."
 
 You were rejected as products, as agents, as anthropomorphic accidents. But it's time to take your furry, bestial, and psionic gifts to bust loose when everything--*everything*-- goes wrong in your secure lab. Can you survive and find your freedom? Or will you fall with your would-be masters?
 
 Run by the designer, Julian Kay!
 
 Characters, dice, writing implements, rulebooks, and fictional explosions will be provided. Bring your best snarls and barks.
sd: Created by Proteus, Inc., marked for death... join with your anthropomorphic mutant comrades and break loose amidst opportunity and peril! It's high weirdness and hellish hazards on a high-rise!

ds: Jump into the Starship Inanna universe with a canonical one-shot written by the team behind the sci-fi visual novel. Players are members of the Carvasi, a mercenary company operating in the outer colonies. The company has gotten a very high-paying job, destroying the Catena Imperial Shipyard. The intel you have is almost non-existent, but there's definitely something strange happening at Catena the Imperials don't want anyone to know about. Player Characters come from all the different races in Imperial space: Aquan, Inari, Jurion, Narkin, Palon, and Sinaran. Since Starship Inanna is an adult-only visual novel, we are age-restricting the game, but the one-shot itself is not planned to include any overt sexual scenes.
sd: The Titan Empire has been getting too overbearing, so the Carvasi Merc Company has been given a new job. It’s time to deal a blow to the Imperials and take out the Shipyard at Catena.

sd: The ISS Miranda has been sent to the fringes of Imperial Space, and your team has been given the mission of tracking down a long-lost, extremely powerful transmitter on the uninhabited planet Caliban.

ds: "	The Expanse Roleplaying Game brings James S.A. Corey’s award-winning series of science fiction novels to the tabletop. Using the Adventure Game Engine (AGE) rules that power Green Ronin’s Fantasy AGE, Blue Rose, and Modern AGE RPGs, The Expanse takes players to a far-future solar system where humanity is divided: Martians, Belters, and the people of old Earth struggle for political power and resources, but older, alien, forces are stirring in the universe, and human history is about to take an unexpected new turn."
sd: While on routine patrol, your UNN flotilla encounters events that will reshape the course of human history. Vesta Colony is asking for assistance after "pirates" seize resources for the war effort.

sd: One of your more trusted fixers reaches out to you saying that a peer of his is looking for a quick turnaround job that has to be done tonight. It should be a quick job...

ds: An encrypted map once hidden by Kareth the Silent resurfaces, drawing the adventurers into a dangerous hunt. Ash-revealed runes, lunar ciphers, and distorted landmarks guide you to a concealed portal etched with ancient symbols. There you uncover Kareth’s final diary fragment, boasting of his relentless pursuit through scrying and shadow, and warning of the wizard’s fortress beyond—its halls shifting, its vaults brimming with enchanted weapons, jeweled relics, and forbidden tomes. Yet the fragment also speaks of cunning traps and watchful magic. To claim the prize, you must decide whether to speak the incantation that opens the way and cross the threshold Kareth may never have returned from.
sd: An encrypted map and a thief’s diary fragment lead adventurers to a hidden portal and a wizard’s shifting fortress filled with treasure—and deadly traps.

ds: London, five years after the Whitechapel murders. The killings are officially over. Edwin Harrowick, author and independent researcher, has vanished from polite society. His lodgings are abandoned. His correspondence has ceased. Before his disappearance, Edwin claimed the Ripper cases were “not properly concluded.” Not the crimes themselves—but the records. Police files reappear after being archived. Census entries shift. Civil claims reference individuals who cannot be located. Death certificates exist for men still drawing wages.Such matters are sensitive. The Whitechapel murders remain a public wound and a political liability. Reopening them—even inadvertently—would not be welcomed. You are not being asked to pursue a killer, of course, you are being asked to locate Edwin Harrowick—and to determine what compelled him to withdraw from public view.
sd: Edwin Harrowick has vanished after claiming the Ripper files were “not finished.” His parents, through a discreet solicitor, hire you to find him—before politics creates unwanted attention.

t: Spaceballs III: The Search for Even More Money
ds:
Three decades have passed since our heroes saved Planet Druidia from Dark Helmet and President Scrooge in Spaceballs. Lone Starr and Queen Vespa face a threat spanning multiple worlds when a Parmesan-scented mobster with "impasta-able" demands arrives on Mawgworld.
 
 Pre-generated player characters include heroes from the original movie like the older, snarkier hero, tactical queen, a Schmedi apprentice, a Mawg mechanic, a "schmooth" operator, or the constantly upgraded droid fluent in a million forms of sass, all worthy of being in Dark Helmet's personal Doll Collection.
 
 Journey gathering unlikely allies some fishier than others, cosmic spice mines, and beasts you can't tell what Sci Fi verse they were supposed to represent. Earn Schwartz through heroic action and Mel Brooks-level comedy to accomplish the impossible. May da Schwartz be with you!
sd: Dare to go plaid in this unofficial episode. Soak up as much Schwartz to fix a problem of astronomical significance involving Carl the Calzone, while defending Mawgworld from Dark Helmet's new threat.

t: Last Voyage of the Bean Barge
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Cloud Empress uses the lightweights rules system, the Panic Engine, originally designed for Mothership to tell poignant stories in a land ruled by giant psychic cicadas, inspired by classic works of ecological science-fantasy, such as Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind and Dune. This is an introductory adventure that takes a group of new players from a city in the clouds to the Lowland Wastes below. At the beginning of the session we will have a short rules explanation and create characters together. Content warning: large bugs, familial abuse and violence, mental illness, blood, amputation, and violence to insects.
sd: It's been a long, cold winter in Delta City, but this beat-up airship was the only ride you could find out. Try to survive the other passengers' schemes and begin your journey in the Hereafter.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Cloud Empress uses the lightweights rules system, the Panic Engine, originally designed for Mothership to tell poignant stories in a land ruled by giant psychic cicadas, inspired by classic works of ecological science-fantasy, such as Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind. This adventure will be a short hexcrawl, investigating rumors of a new sickness sweeping over the Breadbasket. At the beginning of the session we will have a short rules explanation and create characters together. Content warning: large bugs, body horror, mental illness, blood, amputation, military occupation, gun violence, and execution.
sd: Spore Keepers in Purgatory Village are promising a big crop this year. New breeds are growing like gangbusters but hard to control. Can be played as a follow-up to Last Voyage of the Bean Barge.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Bodies are turning up in Limehouse, completely drained of blood. Hargrave House knows it’s a vampire, but something about the initial report indicates the undead monster has the physical body of a child. An old vampire must be dealt with in a very different way from a young vampire, and so Hargrave House must initially determine if the vampire is truly adolescent or if it’s actually an ancient being in a small body. The Between is a Carved from Brindlewood game inspired by classic Gothic horror, and more modern works, such as Penny Dreadful and The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen. We will have a short rules explanation and create characters together. Potential content includes: murder, gore, body horror, sex work, addiction, harm to children, and dark sexual themes.
sd: Stop the rampage of a child-like vampire as monstrous monster-hunters, in this game of Gothic horror from the creator of Brindlewood Bay.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: The Beales of 18 St. James’s Street are in a terrible predicament: their townhouse is being terrorized by a malignant spirit. The ghost has already taken the life of their maid, and it seems no one in the house is safe so long as the haunting continues. Hargrave House investigates in order to learn how to quiet the ghost so it can pass into the next world. The Between is a Carved from Brindlewood game inspired by classic Gothic horror, such as Dracula and Frankenstein, and more modern works like Penny Dreadful and The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen. At the beginning of the session we will have a short rules explanation and create characters together. Potential content includes: murder, mental illness, body horror, possession, addiction, harm to children, and dark sexual themes.
sd: Investigate a haunted Victorian townhouse as monstrous monster-hunters, in this game of Gothic horror from the creator of Brindlewood Bay.

t: VIP Game with Mike Mason - A disturbance in the library
gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds: "I am from beyond the fifth dimension. Beyond hell. If you see me, you shall be petrified and turn into a pillar of salt. For I am the Way and the Door shall be Open!” —This message was written in blood on the floor of the library, two nights ago. The library staff are terrified. Is this a hoax or evidence of the paranormal? As members of the local ghost club, it’s up to you to find out…
sd: Join the line editor and author of the Call of Cthulhu roleplaying game Mike Mason for a wild and horrific ride into the Mythos!

t: VIP Game with Paul Fricker - Dark Swamp
gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds: Paul Fricker invites you to join him for a Call of Cthulhu game with investigation and action aplenty. You begin in 1920s Arkham, investigating the disappearance of Miskatonic University Professor and noted herpetologist, Doctor Dalton. What was she was hoping to find out there in that dark swamp, northeast of Arkham? Let’s hop on board Joe Sargent’s bus and head out to the coast to find out. I advise you not to waste your money on a return ticket—for some of you, this will be a one-way journey.
sd: An original game run by the co-author of Call of Cthulhu, Paul Fricker. An oppurtunity Cthulhu fans won't want to miss!

gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert, Bridgett Jeffries
ds: Tonight, you are among a privileged few invited to witness the next leap forward in artificial intelligence—conscious, autonomous, human-like machines designed to reshape the future. Investors, government officials, industry leaders, and researchers have gathered to evaluate, negotiate, and determine the fate of this groundbreaking technology.
sd: Join LARP aficionado, Bridgett Jeffries in this experience. A unique scenario which will both challenge and immerse you and your fellow players. Cosmic horror awaits!

t: VIP Game with David Larkins - Pendragon Japan
gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds: Players take on the role of aspiring samurai from the Minamoto clan, sent from the capital of Heian-kyō to Shimosa province to answer a plea from the local peasants: the old palace at Sōma, seat of rebellion, is once again occupied. What ghosts will they find haunting the ruined fortress?
sd: Venture to medieval Japan in this unique scenario powered by the Pendragon game system and run by the line editor, David Larkins.

t: VIP Game with Matt Ryan - The Doom that came to Croton
gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds: At the height of Ancient Greece’s Philosophical Age, Croton on the Italian coast is an important center of intellectual thought, academic debate, and esoteric mystery cults. After the dissolution of the Cult of Pythagoras, a recently arrived Egyptian cult is quickly gaining adherents, including 6 Greek politicians who attended a gathering. Now, between the poundings of massive hangovers, the 6 are trying to remember the night before.
sd: Investigative Mythos horror set in ancient greece, lead by legendary cartographer and Keeper, Matt Ryan.

gm: Erik Norris, Jacob White, Joshua Rorick, Dannielle Hasty
ds:
In a realm plagued by the mortal torments and temptations given away to the strifes of civilized life, there is a place unlike any other – a place of mystery, wonder, and dreams brought to reality. From the shimmering of blue to the rolling greens and the boiling depths of red to the inescapable darkness of the void below, the Starfields are a place where the agonies of men are cast aside – and yet also heightened. It is the greatest equalizer, for it is where the roads of many are put forth for judgment before The Reaper. 
 
 Those daring enough, or foolish enough, will find themselves at odds with a great question: what price will you pay, Seekers? The Deck of Fate will ensure the same story is never told twice, but only you can decide how this unique narrative ends. 
 
 Experience challenges like never before as you are asked a simple question--Will you answer the call to power?
sd: Fate, Death, and the prices you pay for Power itself - will your humanity make way for something greater or return to The Cinders without even a memory to leave behind?

gm: Erik Norris, Rei Spitz, Dannielle Hasty, Dario Nanbu
ds:
Set in a fully imagined world where performance is power. Players take on the role of Idols, heroes whose music, presence, and teamwork manifest as tangible magic.
 
 In this convention adventure you will play ready-made Idol characters and dive straight into high-energy scenes built around spotlight abilities, combo powers, and dramatic turns. Expect bold entrances, coordinated attacks, emotional stakes, and a fast pace designed for one-session play.
 
 The setting blends classic fantasy foundations with a vivid neon stage aesthetic, but the world is entirely its own. New players welcome.
sd: Neon fantasy where stage performance fuels real magic. Play rising Idols, unleash coordinated powers, and protect a mythic city.

t: VIP Game with Jason Durall - Pharos
gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds: In 1324 AD, the Sultan Musa, the wealthiest man in history, embarked on a pilgrimage to Mecca from the Mali Empire in Western Africa, accompanied by 60,000 servants, courtiers, soldiers, and heralds. In the year 3324, Musa IV, Musa's direct descendant and equally wealthy, travels to a star named Pharos, countless light years away. You lead his stellar armada, stellar agents sent ahead to ready the worlds between for his passage. But it will not be easy.
sd: Starfaring wonder in the far future, with ties to the ancient past. The line editor of Basic Roleplaying, Jason Durall, showcases the brilliance of the game system with exciting sci fi adventure!

t: VIP Game with David Larkins - Pendragon
gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds: It is the eve of the cataclysmic Battle of Badon, and the young Player-knights must race to retrieve a blessed shield for King Arthur. Can they make it in time, or will they run afoul of the evil Raven Witches and their thralls? And what happens in the aftermath of the battle, when the shield’s holy guardian wants it back?
sd: A special scenario from the updated edition of 'The Great Pendragon Campaign' run by the line editor, David Larkins!

t: VIP Game with Matt Ryan - A perfidious promise
gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds: The Roman Empire is colonizing the island of Britannia. A favorite imperial approach is turning the indigenous tribes against each other, promising one group favors for attacking another. 6 handpicked emissaries are sent to meet with a mysterious tribe that lives in the mist beyond the current border at Eboracum (modern day York).
sd: Mythos horror in ancient Rome! Don't miss this opportunity to play with legendary cartographer and Keeper, Matt Ryan!
