gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert, Derek Young
ds: A private estate auction on the outskirts of Arkham features artifacts seized from a disgraced explorer. Wealthy collectors bid on relics that send shivers and whisper when touched. When the storm knocks out power mid-auction, the items begin bidding on them.
sd: Join your keeper in this game of mythic horror. Pre-gen characters will be provided.

t: The Last Masque of Blackwood Manor
ds: October 1937. At Blackwood Manor’s annual midnight masquerade, one rule stands: no one removes their mask before twelve. But this year, a séance goes terribly wrong and something stirs beneath the manor. Navigate ballroom intrigue and chandelier-swinging pulp action before midnight claims another soul.
sd: At Blackwood Manor’s annual midnight masquerade, one rule stands: no one removes their mask before twelve. But this year, a séance goes terribly wrong and something stirs beneath the manor.

t: Novus Ordo Seclorum Tournament Round One
ds: A two round tournament. All of the first rounds will be written by and feature the talents of veteran GMs Alex Elder, Jim Beecher, and Dr. Michael Furlong. Everyone at the table will vote to advance their favorite roleplayers, and those who advance will be welcomed to play in the final round on Sunday to determine who is the 2026 Novus Ordo Seclorum Champion. Call of Cthulhu is easy to learn and everyone is welcome. This tournament contains horror elements that may be disturbing.
sd: Reality is a lie. Pierce the veil and embrace the truth. The Novus Ordo Seclorum tournament is a series of immersive Call of Cthulhu adventures focused on roleplaying. Join us!

gm: Erik Norris, Ysabel Dela Riva, Joey Agabiti, Dannielle Hasty
ds:
Set in a fully imagined world where performance is power. Players take on the role of Idols, heroes whose music, presence, and teamwork manifest as tangible magic.
 
 In this convention adventure you will play ready-made Idol characters and dive straight into high-energy scenes built around spotlight abilities, combo powers, and dramatic turns. Expect bold entrances, coordinated attacks, emotional stakes, and a fast pace designed for one-session play.
 
 The setting blends classic fantasy foundations with a vivid neon stage aesthetic, but the world is entirely its own. New players welcome.
sd: Neon fantasy where stage performance fuels real magic. Play rising Idols, unleash coordinated powers, and protect a mythic city.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: A security guard has been found dead in Stone Mountain Park. He apparently burned to death, but there are no signs of a fire around him, or any other evidence that a fire had occurred. His clothing was still intact. The local media is abuzz with talk of "Spontaneous Human Combustion," but the Park just wants it dismissed as a tragic accident so they can focus on the "New Dawn Festival" currently underway at the park. Don't want visitors to be scared off, after all. "Spontaneous Human Combustion" is obviously on Delta Green's radar. And no one seems to have a good explanation as to what is going on. So, a group of Agents have been activated and sent to investigate what lurks within the "Heart of Stone."
sd: A guard at Stone Mountain Park has died from what the media is calling "Spontaneous Human Combustion." Delta Green needs this resolved. Is this a normal event, or is something else there?

t: Where in the World is Working Group Ouroboros?
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: A week ago, everyone within a few miles of the small, southern-Georgia town of Templemont passed out simultaneously. There were wrecks, accidents, and other problems. Even some injuries and a few deaths. First responders had no idea what was going on. Working Group "Naga" was sent in, and they reported that they had "identified and terminated the vector," then went off the grid. The Working Group "Ouroboros" was activated and sent in after The Program found Naga's report...lacking. The members of Ouroboros reported back to their home agencies that everything was fine. Then they... vanished. Now, Working Group "Phoenix" is being sent in. The "official" Government Agencies involved just want this to go away. And Delta Green wants to know WTF is going on. Can you discover "Where in the World is Working Group Ouroboros?"
sd: Everyone in the town of Templemont blacked out. The first group sent in said they solved the problem. The second group said everything was fine, then vanished. Now you're here.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: Multiple people have vanished in the north Georgia mountains in the Chatokee Wilderness Area, all in the general vicinity of the new "Chatokee Village" construction site. Designed as a new mountain resort/vacation home/gated community, "Chatokee Village" was approved by the state of Georgia last year, selling off a part of the Chatokee Wilderness Area to a private consortium. The area used to belong to the Chatokee Native American tribe, who are not happy that their ancestral land is being given away without being offered to them first. And environmental groups are angry about allowing a major development in what had been a pristine wilderness area. But that has fallen into the background as multiple people in the area have gone missing. Far more than anyone can explain. It may be a coincidence. Or, there may be something else going on beyond the sound of The Wind in the Pines.
sd: A family vanished in the middle of the night. Two hikers are reported missing. And they aren't the only ones. Is something happening in the Chatokee Wilderness, or is it just "The Wind in the Pines"?

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: A few hours ago, scattered blackouts and power disruptions started occurring across the northern part of the city. The problems seemed to be coming from a substation off Franklin Street, but the crews sent in to investigate didn't report back. Then, multiple accidents were reported on Franklin Street, but the response teams sent in to investigate didn't report back. Now, you are being sent in. Something is going on. Something Unnatural. But... can you succeed where multiple others have failed, or will you just be the next people to succumb to the siren strains of The Lullaby?
sd: An unexplained power outage. Multiple vehicle wrecks. And no one sent in to investigate has come out. Something is happening on Franklin Street. Can you determine what it is?

ds:
Hiding in plain sight, overlapping the Mundane is the Secret World, a strange walled garden of magical power and the supernatural, guarding the gates to the Invisible world beyond. The Invisible world is the underlying truth, a realm formed of humanity’s noblest efforts, failed aspirations, worst faults, and mind-numbing horrors. It is the kingdom of shadows that hides the Goëtic Spirits, the Archons, and all manner of strange creatures that seek a way into our world…
 
 Play as a Brawler, Hunter, Occultist, Operative, Psychic, Spiritualist, or Witch. Draw from the unique Arcana card deck that enhances the story and modifies the game in every scene. Use the power of Bloodline’s enhanced attunement mechanic that empowers you to attune to people, places, abilities, and skills to enhance your power and customize your character.
sd: A dark modern fantasy game where the Mundane and Invisible Worlds overlap. Play one of 7 magically blooded agents hunting monsters in the woods of Wisconsin. Be warned, it’s a Bad Night for a Hunt…

ds: Five children are summoned to the estate of their late father for the reading of his last will and testament, but what they are given is far more terrifying than anything they could imagine and they only have one night to decide who will pay the ultimate price. You will be taught the rules for 13 Omens as you play. This is a horror game; content warnings and safety tools will be discussed at the start. Character death is extremely likely.
sd: Your inheritance - and your life - are on the line.

sd: In Boston, a pair of art students and their professor have gone missing, but something about their predilection for graveyard scenes makes you wonder if they may have brought this on themselves.

t: 500 Worlds of Ultramar: Alliance Under the Treason
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: Alliance Under the Treason follows a grim, necessity-driven alliance between the Imperium of Man and the Aeldari Craftworld Beul Wok’na. A newly emerging Chaos cult, calling itself the Inheritors, has escalated from minor, covert actions into increasingly bold and destabilizing attacks. Their pattern draws both factions to the planet Biham, a rare and irreplaceable hospital-world on the edge of Ultramar. One of only three such worlds in the entire Ultramar system, Biham is essential to sustaining Imperial forces and civilian populations alike. Its fall would be catastrophic. The threat deepens when evidence reveals the cult has also targeted Aeldari Craftworlds, implying motives that endanger both species. This alliance is not born of trust or diplomacy, but of survival, as ancient enemies are forced to stand together against a shared, growing darkness.
sd: A forced Imperium-Aeldari alliance strikes the hospital-world Biham in Ultramar to stop a rising Chaos cult. Trust is absent, but survival demands cooperation before devastation follows.

t: 500 Worlds of Ultramar: The Dead and the Damned
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: On the planet Orion, just beyond the borders of Ultramar, a brutal three-year war has raged between the Imperium, the Aeldari, and the T’au. Each faction believes the world is rightfully theirs: the Imperium seeks glory for the Emperor, the Aeldari claim it as an ancestral home, and the T’au have lived there undisturbed for four centuries. Endless conflict drives all three powers to the brink of annihilation, exhausting armies and shattering defenses. When nothing remains but survivors and ruins, a far greater threat reveals itself—Genestealers rising from beneath the surface, unseen until it is too late. With extinction looming, the remnants of each faction are forced into a desperate alliance. Trust is nonexistent, but one truth binds them together: the Genestealers must not escape Orion, no matter the cost.
sd: A three-year war on Orion between Imperium, Aeldari, and T'au ends in ruin when Genestealers emerge, forcing bitter enemies into an uneasy alliance to stop extinction.

ds: Join Sinbad’s legendary crew on a voyage beyond the map! When the Starborn Seven sails into the icy realm of Hyperborea, the sailors discover a world of frozen seas, strange creatures, and ancient magical ruins. Work together to outwit monsters, solve mysteries, and find a way back home in this high-adventure tale of courage, teamwork, and discovery.
sd: Sinbad’s Sailors are recruited to go on a perilous voyage to Hyperborea to obtain the horn from a huge ferocious beast!

t: 500 Worlds of Ultramar:  Storms of the Past
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: Rogue Trader Vendet Corbin of House Vonice has led his dynasty for many years, when he is personally conscripted by the Lord Regent to transport a critically important package. The destination is secret, and the stakes are immense. Along the way, Corbin becomes the target of numerous assassins, forcing him to seek armed escorts. The reasons for the attempts on his life are uncertain: some believe they stem from his connections to criminal organizations, while others argue his flexible, non-dogmatic approach places him at odds with the Inquisition. It may be both—or something far more dangerous tied to the contents of the package itself. Whatever the truth, Corbin must survive long enough to escape Ultramar and complete the delivery. Failure is not an option, as the fate of Ultramar itself hangs in the balance.
sd: Rogue Trader Vendet Corbin is ordered by the Lord Regent to deliver a vital package. Hunted by assassins and trapped in Ultramar, he must survive - or doom the realm.

ds: The world of New Harkryn is a marshy expanse of peat bogs and grotesque, unnatural flora. . Whether the planet is like that by nature was once touched by Chaos unknown. Nestled tightly between two forward worlds and reachable only with the proper tools, New Harkryn is widely considered a place best avoided. Many claim it is cursed by something beyond the Warp itself. Despite the warnings, a Rogue Trader ventured to the planet out of curiosity and vanished. His last transmission was a distress beacon sent to his ship. The rescue team dispatched after him also disappeared without a trace. By direct order of Lord Inquisitor Durus Rudd the investigation has been seized from previous failed efforts. You are the latest team sent to uncover the truth and attempt a rescue. Good luck, and do not expect to come back.
sd: New Harkryn is a cursed swamp world of twisted flora and vanishing expeditions. A Rogue Trader and a rescue team are missing. By order of Lord Inquisitor Durus Rudd, you are sent in.

ds: Join the HyJynx gang when they win a free tour along the coast.It goes terribly wrong! When a routine excursion turns into an unexpected island adventure, the gang must use their wits, courage, and teamwork to uncover secrets, survive strange dangers, and solve a mystery before time runs out. A fun, fast-paced mystery adventure inspired by classic teen sleuths and tropical misadventures.
sd: A free coastal tour for the HyJynx gang turns into a mysterious disaster!

t: 500 Worlds of Ultramar: Behind the Aquila's Shadow
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds:
A loyal Imperial fortress has gone dark. Official records list it as destroyed, yet recent astropathic echoes suggest otherwise. Vox traffic, encrypted signals, and irregular troop movements indicate the installation is still active—now operating under unknown control.
 
 You are deployed covertly, inserted far behind enemy lines under false identities and incomplete intelligence. Your objectives are simple on paper: infiltrate the stronghold, identify who or what now controls it, extract a high-value prisoner held within, and cripple the facility before it can threaten nearby Ultramar systems. Nothing about this mission is expected to go cleanly.
 
 Good luck. The Emperor protects...sometimes."
sd: An Imperial stronghold in Ultramar has fallen silent behind enemy lines. Disguised, outgunned, and expendable, you're sent in to sabotage, extract a prisoner, and escape - if escape is even possible.

t: 500 Worlds of Ultramar: The Lord Regent, the Farseer, and Macragge's Honour
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: The world of Bova V lies battered in the aftermath of a sudden and devastating assault, its defenses shattered, and Imperial forces stretched thin. For the Imperium, the situation is dire—but that concern is not yours. Your mission is singular and absolute: locate and recover an ancient Aeldari artifact known as Partecion Yess Quas. Long hidden, its presence has been revealed by the chaos of war. If the Imperium secures it, the balance of power may shift in ways no Farseer can fully predict. If the Necrons find it, the artifact may be lost to history—or worse, repurposed. Time is short. Guilliman’s forces tighten their grip on Ultramar, and the legendary Macragge’s Honour casts a long shadow across the region. The artifact must be found and returned to the craftworld at all costs. Failure is not measured in death, but in consequence.
sd: After a Necron assault on Bova V, Ultramar burns. You are Aeldari agents tasked with recovering an ancient artifact before the Imperium claims it or the Necrons erase it forever.

ds: Danger in the Dahrk Forest is a teen mystery adventure filled with suspense, teamwork, and a touch of 1980s supernatural weirdness. RPXpress emphasizes fast play, cinematic moments, and collaborative storytelling.
sd: Two school friends disappear investigating a Bigfoot sighting. The high school gang investigates! Characters provided, roleplaying emphasized.

t: 500 Worlds of Ultramar: The Silent Vault
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: Long-range scans suggest the ship is less a warship and more a fully mechanized fortress, layered with internal defenses, sealed bulkheads, and autonomous systems designed to repel boarders at every turn. Imperial intelligence believes the vessel contains a hidden map vault—a central command chamber storing strategic star charts, supply routes, and forward-operating data crucial to ongoing T’au expansion efforts. If secured, this information could shift multiple campaigns in Ultramar’s favor. You are deployed via boarding action into the vessel’s interior, where corridors shift, defenses activate without warning, and enemy resistance grows stronger the closer you draw to the vault. The ship itself seems designed to mislead, isolate, and destroy intruders before they ever reach their objective. This is not a mission of conquest, but precision. Find the map room. Secure its data.
sd: A captured T'au vessel drifts above Ultramar, its interior a mechanized fortress. Your mission is to breach the ship, locate its central map vault, and seize strategic data before it can be purged.

ds: The mummy of Tutankhamun is being displayed in London. The press is having a heyday with the alleged curse found outside the tomb. What is particularly annoying is that several people associated with either the excavation or the exhibition of the mummy have mysteriously died. The English Scientific Society has requested people from various backgrounds to meet with their president to discuss investigating and lay to rest this preposterous idea of a curse.
sd: Victorian Heroes investigate mystery surrounding a mummy exhibition! Characters provided, roleplaying emphasized.

t: 500 Worlds of Ultramar: Of Dust and Devil
lo: ICC Hall A : Cincinnati Arsenal Gaming HQ
ds: On the surface, it remains a symbol of Imperial luxury and stability. Deep within the Corv Desert, the Inquisition has uncovered an ancient Chaos temple—one that appears in no Imperial records or archives. The structure predates all known settlements on the planet. Grafted directly into the temple’s sealed gate is the corpse of a long-dead heretical priest, his body fused with metal etched in blasphemous runes, as though the gate itself consumed him as part of some forgotten rite. Worse still, intelligence reports suggest the presence of two separate Chaos cults, locked in violent conflict over the site. Your mission is to investigate the temple, uncover the truth behind the cult war, and ensure whatever lies buried beneath the sands never threatens Ultramar. May the Emperor protect.
sd: Carnadeuos is a lush Imperial pleasure world, but beneath the Corv Desert lies an unrecorded Chaos temple. A dead priest fused to its gate and warring cults signal a growing threat.

ds: To stop domination by an evil villain challenges heroes in the Victorian/Steampunk world! The world is counting on you! Will you let them down? Extraordinary Adventures, the RPXpress setting for excitement! Come join the in fun adventure!
sd: The greatest Victorian heroes go to San Francisco to stop Wo Fang using the curses of the Jade Dragon to destroy San Francisco!

t: Tyranny of Dragons Chapter 1: Embers of Conspiracy
ds:
An eight-part epic where each mission stands alone yet shapes an unfolding struggle against draconic forces and hidden conspirators.
 This adventure unfolds across eight connected sessions held throughout the convention. Each chapter is a self-contained mission with a clear objective and resolution, while player outcomes influence the direction and stakes of later chapters. Victories, failures, alliances, and discoveries carry forward, gradually revealing a far-reaching plot tied to powerful dragon-aligned forces.
 Participants may join a single session or follow the full arc across multiple days. Returning players will see the evolving consequences of earlier events, while new heroes can step directly into the action without confusion.
 The eighth and final session serves as the campaign’s conclusion, where accumulated choices determine how the larger conflict is ultimately resolved.
sd: Rumors of secret gatherings and strange dragon symbols draw heroes into a growing threat beneath the surface.

t: Blood for the Khan - Part 1 of 3 (Premium)
ds:
This is a 3-part, 3rd-level adventure trilogy packed with roleplay, meaningful character moments, and dynamic combat. You’ll experience the full story in a dedicated private event space with the same group of players and a hand-picked, top-tier GM guiding you through all three sessions. Additionally you'll receive a unique signed copy of the "Shadows in Genzacon" adventure module, a $70 retail value.
 
 Enjoy 12 total hours of immersive gameplay, spread across three four-hour play periods.
 
 Registration for the first session secures your seat in Parts 2 and 3. Players may not join later installments without participating in the first session, as the campaign is designed to be experienced as a complete trilogy.
 
 Our intention is for each group to journey through the entire story together - "from beginning to epic conclusion."
sd: Influential patrons require your assistance retrieving a powerful item in the fearful Mournwood. But all is not as it seems. Can you discern the mystery of the dark forest - or will you die trying?

t: Silent Ascent: The Escape of Senator Rylar
ds:
You are a party of demigod-like beings called Champions, on a quest to smuggle Senator Lance Rylar of the now-defunct Republic of Smyrna off of the island of Smyrna. Lured by the United Merchants Collective’s (UMC) promises of prosperity, fractious elements within the Republic of Smyrna launched a successful UMC-backed coup. Senator Rylar was the leader of the coalition government of Smyrna, and was very outspoken about the threat posed by the UMC. 
 The only way to save Smyrna is to get the senator off-island so he can organize a government-in-exile. The only clear method to get Senator Rylar out is to smuggle him onto one of the UMCs very own airships.
 The first hour of the session will be a heist-style preparation, followed by a 10-minute break, and the rest of the time will be taken up by the execution of your plan. Snacks and pre-genned characters will be provided.
sd: The UMC has taken over the Republic of Smyrna. Smuggle the outspoken Smyrnian senator Lance Rylar off the island via one of the UMC's very own airships. A non-combat scenario.

ds:

s: Back Again from the Broken Land
ds: The game begins after the great war with the Doomslord, and the the stories you tell with determine the details of the adventures you've had and the home to which you return. The game is inspired by the works of J.R. R. Tolkien, especially the melancholy and emotional passages of The Lord of the Rings.
sd: You are small people who walked into a big war. Your fellowship played a humble, crucial role in the fall of the Doomslord. Now, laden with stories to tell and burdens to bear, you set off for home.

ds:
One year ago, the Alliance to Restore the Republic destroyed the Death Star at Yavin, dealing a major blow against the Galactic Empire. Since then, the Rebels’ ranks have swelled with new recruits. You are among those recruits. For the last year, you have trained at a Rebel training camp on the planet Sorgan. Now, just weeks before graduating boot camp, your training facility has been attacked by the Empire. Your mission is to save as much material and personnel as you can and escape.
 We will play for two hours, take a 10-minute break, then finish the session. Snacks, dice and pre-genned characters will be provided. If you wish to bring your own character, make them only using official SW FFG books and standard character creation rules, +20 XP to represent your year of training (may not be spent on Characteristics)
sd:
Year: 1 ABY.
 Emboldened by the Death Star’s destruction, you joined the Rebellion. But just before graduating boot camp, the Empire attacks. Escape the training facility while saving what you can.

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman, Melissa Darnley
ds: This game offers a glut of rules expansions, player character options, and job opportunities for CY_BORG punks willing to risk it all. You’ll use the new rules to do character creation and explore the city of Cy by undertaking one of the zine’s four death-defying jobs. New players will be taught everything they need to know to play the game, while experienced players will find fresh spins on everything you love about CY_BORG.
sd: Walking cathedrals roam the edges of Cy. The Ports are rife with corruption, bleeding up into the edges of space. And there’s every chance it all comes crashing down. Take your punks to the edge!

t: Pyramid of Norcreus (Afternoon Track) Part 2 in 3D - Death on the Du'unsarra
ds:
This is Part 2 of a 3-part adventure trilogy for 4th-level characters, blending roleplay, exploration, and dynamic combat. Continue the journey with the same group and GM in this 12-hour epic series.
 
 A year after the events at the Blue Veil Carnivalle, the secret keepers of the Banviy tribe seek your aid. A hidden temple to the lord of the undead has risen within the Du’unsarra Sea—a vast expanse of Murkcrystal that flows like liquid sand and conceals deadly dangers. Cross this treacherous sea to find the pyramid before darkness prevails.
 
 Played on the massive 3D Du’unsarra layout from the World of Zyathé.
 
 Part 1 is "A Murder in Motley". Part 3 is "The Pyramid of the Undead".
 Registration for the first session secures your seat in Parts 1 and 3. Pre-gens provided.
sd: A secret temple has appeared upon the Du'unsarra Sea creating much fear. Can you brave the Du'unsarra and find the pyramid before it is too late?

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman
ds: You are a Dreamer, tasked with protecting the Dreamlands while seeking enlightenment. The pursuit of your own dreams has led you to a lavish estate, its guests a myriad of dreams, ideas, and familiar faces. Has the dream beckoned you to this place to court your own desires? Or does your host have more insidious goals? This session is great for new and experienced players alike, offering a sandbox style exploration of a fanciful party. New players will be taught everything they need to know about this tarot deck building TTRPG that combines tactical card dueling with art-led interpretive improvisation. Experienced players will see new twists on familiar mechanics as the assembled Dreamers balance temptation and purpose. Each room in the mansion holds new mysteries & joys, while a ticking clock encourages a divide-and-conquer style of gameplay that will push teamwork to its limits.
sd: Your dreams have invited you to a ball! Luxury & intrigue abound in this courtly estate where every desire has a face.

ds:
Year: 2075. Dr. Ella Belladonna is a brilliant geneticist who, until very recently, worked for Biotechnica. Two weeks ago, she fled Biotechnica. Now freed from Biotechnica’s (very few) ethical and legal constraints, Dr. Belladonna is free to experiment on the forgotten unhoused people in Pacifica. You are a team of Edgerunners who have been approached by a Biotechnica’s executive, Darius Sinclair. He is offering you E$30,000 to return Dr. B to Biotechnica. Track down her secret lab, capture her, and put an end to her unsanctioned experiments.
 We will play for two-and-a-half hours, take a 10-minute break, then finish the session. Snacks, dice and pre-genned characters will be provided. If you wish to bring your own character, make them using only official R. Talsorian material and standard character creation rules, +300 IP and 2,500 eddies to represent your years of experience.
sd: Dr. Ella Belladonna, an ex-Biotechnica geneticist, has gone rogue. Now she is experimenting on people in Pacifica. Biotechnica has put out a E$30,000 bounty on her. Capture Dr. B and get paid.

t: Pyramid of Norcreus (Afternoon Track) Part 3 in 3D - Death on the Du'unsarra
ds:
This is Part 3 of a 3-part adventure trilogy for 6th-level characters, delivering the climactic finale of this epic campaign.
 
 After braving the Du’unsarra, your party has uncovered the Pyramid of Norcreus, lord of the undead. Now you must delve into this massive dungeon on the continent of Sundestia in the World of Zyathé and fight your way to Ambatru’s Tomb to end the rising evil once and for all.
 
 This is the thrilling conclusion to the trilogy. Part 1 is "A Murder in Motley" and Part 2 is "Death on the Du’unsarra". 
 
 Registration for the first session secures your seat in Parts 2 and 3. Players may not join later installments without participating in the first session, as the story is designed to be experienced as a complete saga from beginning to epic conclusion.
 Pre-gens provided.
sd: The Pyramid of Norcreus has been found! Do you dare delve into its depths in hopes of vanquishing the evil that dwells therein?

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman, Ruel Fox, Melissa Darnley, Nishaant Pandita
ds: System Administrator Malous, using an alien titan class dreadnought, has declared war on The Brink. As if its weapon systems were not terrifying enough, it is equipped with technology that prevents skipping the pattern, trapping you in this sector of space. A threat like this cannot be tolerated, and so a flurry of contracts have been posted by factions throughout the Span to oppose/harvest/control the dreadnought. You must fight to escape, but if you play your cards right you might just score a profit! This mega-game will have up to 5 tables play as both independent crews *and* as a united front against Malous and his dreadnought. Each table’s choices will impact the others as the threats adapt to your efforts. Choose the contract that matches your crew’s playstyle and try to survive threats both human and xeno. Solo-play options are available for those interested!
sd: A mega game where multiple crews (tables) do battle against a massive alien capital ship that has fallen into the hands of a CoreSys administrator turned would-be space king.

t: A Ray of Light from Synthetic Dawn
gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman
ds: The galaxy was supposed to save us. Perhaps entropy moved faster than we thought. Perhaps the galaxy decided humanity isn't worth saving. Either way, you left the pointless life of a planet-dweller behind to travel the stars, hoping against all odds for a chance at fortune, fame, or family. Keep your Skip running, keep your crew safe, and don't let the Scourge find you. Welcome to the Span! In this learn-to-play intro session, you'll create your space-faring characters and attempt to survive a derelict mining station. Should you release the emergency lockdown, you will repair (and create!) your Skip and set out for the freedom of the Span. Assuming you don't get turned into stardust, that is. You will be taught everything you need to know to pilot your skip and adventure in a dying galaxy. Bring your creativity and have fun!
sd: Experience a new space survival horror game. Rules light, vibe heavy. Grab a skip and rip adventure from the jaws of an entropic galaxy.

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman
ds: Join your fellow gamers in a 2 hour learn-as-you-play session that will teach you everything you need to know to enjoy this duet ritual puzzle game. The group will be divided into pairs: one plays The Wisher, who attempts to manipulate a sequence of dice representing their appeal to gain a wish; the other plays The Old God, who twists both reality and perception to corrupt this wisher and their intended wish. Will the Wisher's risk pay off and bend reality to their fleeting desires? Or will the Old God claim another supplicant? Learn from the game’s creators and craft entire worlds, all while trying to manipulate dice into the precise arrangement that advances your goals.
sd: A Wisher seeks a wish, and the Old God is amused. Discover a duet ritual puzzle game that combines worldbuilding, improvisation, and dice dueling.

ds: You are a Dreamer. No matter what you do in your waking hours, your dreams will pit you against horrible Nightmares, both personal and universal, to save us all. This introductory session will teach you everything you need to know about a tarot deck building TTRPG that combines tactical card dueling with art-led interpretive improvisation. Both you and your character will be introduced to the Dreamlands, its people, and its struggles. Prove your worth to the Guardian Troll, restore peace to tumultuous lands, and discover a growing threat at the heart of everything by playing tarot cards in a cooperative narrative experience where death & rebirth are all part of the fun. The dream continues as long as you have cards, but it’s only a matter of time until you wake up. Will you have enough time to make a difference?
sd: Learn what it takes to be a Dreamer as you build a deck of tarot cards and embark on a surreal quest of enlightenment, defending the Dreamlands against the insidious influence of Nightmares.

t: The Being Aboard the Gamma Blackstar
gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman, Jacob Collins
ds: Welcome to the Span, a galaxy reaching its terminus. You are likely the generation that will witness the heat death of the universe, but you won’t go quietly into that dark oblivion. In this learn-to-play session, you'll create your space-faring characters and the skip they serve aboard just in time to rendezvous with The Gamma Blackstar, whose owner has offered to buy the mysterious scourge artifact you got on your last job. It doesn’t take long for things to go awry. Who can you *really* trust here? This Mörk Sol contract emphasizes the alien and body horror elements of its grimdark science fiction, bringing you face to face with the horrors lurking in the dark corners of space. You will be taught everything you need to know to pilot your skip and adventure in a dying galaxy. Bring your creativity and have fun!
sd: Something lurks in the hullways of the Gamma Blackstar, a Star Syndicate ship that might become your crew’s tomb if they can’t figure out who to trust.

t: The Dungeon of Du'unix - Part 1 of 3 (Premium)
ds:

 This listing is for Part 1 of 3. Registering here secures your seat for the remaining sessions, as the story is designed to be experienced as a complete saga from beginning to epic conclusion.

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman, Melissa Darnley, Ruel Fox, Jacob Collins, Nishaant Pandita
ds: System Administrator Malous, using an alien titan class dreadnought, has declared war on The Brink. As if its weapon systems were not terrifying enough, it is equipped with technology that prevents skipping the pattern, trapping you in this sector of space. A threat like this cannot be tolerated, and so a flurry of contracts have been posted by factions throughout the Span to oppose/harvest/control the dreadnought. You must fight to escape, but if you play your cards right you might just score a profit! This mega-game will have up to 5 tables play as both independent crews *and* as a united front against Malous and his dreadnought. Each table’s choices will impact the others as the threats adapt to your efforts. Choose the contract that matches your crew’s playstyle and try to survive threats both human and xeno. Solo-play options are available for those interested!
sd: A mega game where multiple crews (tables) do battle against a massive alien capital ship that has fallen into the hands of a CoreSys administrator turned would-be space king.

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman
ds: You are a Dreamer, tasked with protecting the Dreamlands while seeking enlightenment. The pursuit of your own dreams has led you to a lavish estate, its guests a myriad of dreams, ideas, and familiar faces. Has the dream beckoned you to this place to court your own desires? Or does your host have more insidious goals? This session is great for new and experienced players alike, offering a sandbox style exploration of a fanciful party. New players will be taught everything they need to know about this tarot deck building TTRPG that combines tactical card dueling with art-led interpretive improvisation. Experienced players will see new twists on familiar mechanics as the assembled Dreamers balance temptation and purpose. Each room in the mansion holds new mysteries & joys, while a ticking clock encourages a divide-and-conquer style of gameplay that will push teamwork to its limits.
sd: Your dreams have invited you to a ball! Luxury & intrigue abound in this courtly estate where every desire has a face.

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman, Nishaant Pandita
ds: You are a Dreamer. No matter what you do in your waking hours, your dreams will pit you against horrible Nightmares, both personal and universal, to save us all. This introductory session will teach you everything you need to know about a tarot deck building TTRPG that combines tactical card dueling with art-led interpretive improvisation. Both you and your character will be introduced to the Dreamlands, its people, and its struggles. Prove your worth to the Guardian Troll, restore peace to tumultuous lands, and discover a growing threat at the heart of everything by playing tarot cards in a cooperative narrative experience where death & rebirth are all part of the fun. The dream continues as long as you have cards, but it’s only a matter of time until you wake up. Will you have enough time to make a difference?
sd: Learn what it takes to be a Dreamer as you build a deck of tarot cards and embark on a surreal quest of enlightenment, defending the Dreamlands against the insidious influence of Nightmares.

gm: Matthew Best, Conlin Durbin, Andrew Beauman
ds: Join your fellow gamers in a 2 hour learn-as-you-play session that will teach you everything you need to know to enjoy this duet ritual puzzle game. The group will be divided into pairs: one plays The Wisher, who attempts to manipulate a sequence of dice representing their appeal to gain a wish; the other plays The Old God, who twists both reality and perception to corrupt this wisher and their intended wish. Will the Wisher's risk pay off and bend reality to their fleeting desires? Or will the Old God claim another supplicant? Learn from the game’s creators and craft entire worlds, all while trying to manipulate dice into the precise arrangement that advances your goals.
sd: A Wisher seeks a wish, and the Old God is amused. Discover a duet ritual puzzle game that combines worldbuilding, improvisation, and dice dueling.

t: A Menace in the Mist (Premium) - Part 1 of 3
ds:

ds:
Long, long ago, we saw life stirring in the depths of the primordial sea. It was vulgar by nature, mindlessly acquisitive. As time passed, we saw it grow hungry, and eventually, desperate. So, we split the waters of heaven from the waters of earth. Thus, the firmament was born. It must not fail us now.
 
 The Firmament is a new tarot-based, GM-less cooperative roleplaying game for a 1-3 hour session of play, solo or with up to 7 players. It's inspired by kabbalah, cosmology of the ancient Near East, Baroque (1998), and Angel's Egg (1985). 
 
 Take the role of a denizen of Heaven and descend through the labyrinth that separates Heaven from earth. Stop four factions of ravenous humans from breaching the Chambers of Heaven, lest they disturb the unfathomable power that dwells there.
sd: Humans have clawed their way into the firmament, the maze that separates the Chambers of Heaven from the earth below. Cast them out before they destroy the world with their foolish hunger.

gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert
ds:
Join Paula Deming (Things Get Dicey, Good Time Society, The Glass Cannon Network), for a unique Mythos experience unlike any other! Paula will guide a group of players through a session of investigative horror that will carry with it that unique, Paula flair! Players of all skill levels are welcome.
 
 Could the recent spate of disappearances in a small, Massachusetts town be related to a decade-old tragedy? Or are the townsfolk barking up the wrong tree? A group of investigators must venture into the woods to find out in this original one-shot investigation, taking place in the classic 1920s setting.
sd: An exclusive game lead by Actual Play performer and YouTube star, Paula Deming!

ds:
This Level 3 adventure blends haunted wilderness exploration with tense investigation and dangerous combat. Navigate twisting woodland paths, uncover the truth behind the tower’s return, and confront the darkness spreading through the Hollows before it takes root for good.
 
 Designed as a two-part track experience, this story unfolds across both sessions with the same group and Game Master, building toward a chilling and hard-won conclusion.
 
 Registering in this sessions secures your seat in both games.
sd: An ancient evil stirs in Mistwood Hollows. Caravans vanish and a forgotten tower awakens. Dare the cursed woods and uncover the secret rising from the dark.

t: The Tomb of Gyzaengaxx (Afternoon Track - Premium) - Part 1 of 3
ds:
This is old-school D&D at its finest—deadly exploration, crunchy encounters, clever puzzles, hidden doors, resource management, and hard-earned victories. Every chamber presents risk. Every spell slot matters. Careful planning and bold action will determine whether you uncover the wizard’s fate—or become another cautionary tale whispered in taverns.
 
 Designed as a three-part track adventure spanning 12 total hours (three four-hour sessions), this campaign is meant to be experienced with the same group and Game Master from beginning to thrilling conclusion.
 
 Registering for the first session reserves your spot for all three parts.
sd: Gyzaengaxx's abandoned tower glows with warped magic above Etholmm. Ascend Abalon Hill, solve arcane puzzles, and brave its depths to uncover the wizard's fate.

ds: Celebrate the 250th anniversary year of the Declaration of Independence by playing a TTRPG set during the American Revolution! Characters acting on the behalf of the revolutionaries soon find themselves on the path to discovering a nefarious and supernatural plot unfolding in the heart of colonial-era New Jersey. No prior experience playing this system is necessary, and premade character sheets will be provided. While this adventure is appropriate for most ages, a word of warning that it features a rather gruesome villain and some moderate elements of horror not recommended for elementary school age children.
sd: 1776. You've been sent to discover what happened to an ally carrying an important item, last seen in Trenton, NJ. Our characters soon find themselves pulled into a more sinister missing persons case.

t: The Frostfire Fjord: Siege of the Cold Heart
ds: When a supernatural blizzard cripples your vessel, you are left stranded on the ice-rimmed shores of Skadi’s Fangs. The village of Lune is gripped by terror. A Winter Wyrm descends, its eyes gleaming with "playful cruelty" in the moonlight. The beast’s behavior is erratic—methodical and cautious one night, a bloodthirsty engine of chaos the next. You must lead the desperate locals, bolster defenses, forge armor-piercing ammunition, and man a massive, groaning ballista for a final stand. Can your band outsmart a predator that has haunted these fjords for generations? Survival means more than just safety; the dragon’s mountain lair holds a hoard that could change your destiny, if the cold doesn't claim you first. Come join The Wrecking Crew as we present for you the new Midgard from Pegasus Spiele. In this game all can cast magic and roleplay is rewarded. Tell me how will you fare?
sd: Stranded in Skadi’s Fangs, your ship is broken. A Winter Dragon hunts the fjord, shifting from thief to killer. Build the siege, kill the beast, and become legend.

sd: You are part of a small, elite unit of mecha pilots who get ambushed during an airdrop. Now, you must link up with your fellow soldiers and complete the mission or humanity may well go extinct.

ds: You're not a soldier. You're a thief, but if you don't want to get thrown in the Great Northern Ocean with a proton pack tied to your ankles, you're going to go steal the Tension Rider and bring it back so the good team can win for once.
sd: The Tension Rider was just a myth. A mecha powerful enough to win the war by itself? It can't exist. Except it does. Now you're going to steal it.

t: The Greatest of Things Is Hope
ds: This solarpunk mecha game lets the players clean up after the last Last War. Their job is to do no harm and rebuild where they can, but not everyone agrees on how best to go about that.
sd: We nearly broke the Earth. Fortunately, it turns out we just bent it up real bad. Now, it's our job to fix it using what used to be great weapons of war before it's too late.

ds:
An ocean world under military occupation for over a century. A population that has never forgiven what was done to it. In the pressurised tiers of a vast undersea arcology, resistance lives in spiritual movements, union halls, and criminal networks the occupiers cannot destroy without destroying the economy they depend on.
 
 Three objectives. Each demands different skills. Each carries moral weight the scenario deliberately refuses to resolve.
 
 The antagonist is a counter-intelligence director who has broken five networks and is already watching. A local sleeper contact is six years deep and beginning to crack. Between operations, pressure seals fail, industrial tiers flood. The ocean does not care about mission deadlines. The locals will bear the pressure now and into the future.
sd: SolSec agents pursue subversion, social, economic, and political, against a military occupation of an underwater city that cannot be fought with guns. Tradecraft, not violence.

gm: Angela Washko, Grey Mangan Blackwell, Cass Zegura
g: University of Michigan Roleplaying Realities Lab
ds:
You are running an anti-capitalist café. It’s just like a regular coffee shop…but it’s anti-capitalist…and you have magical powers.
 While the café is very popular, Capital Coffee Company, an evil corporate chain using entirely exploitative AI-based labor to maximize their outlandish profits, has their sights set on your building and your customer base. They plan to displace you by any means necessary.
 As a worker-owned, barter-based, anti-capitalist café, the workers and community invested in this utopian coffee shop have to take matters into their own hands. You and your crew have 2 months to save your café!
 
 This TTRPG is card-based and GM-less, and involves collaborative map-drawing.
sd: A new GM-less TTRPG about building/maintaining an anti-capitalist coffee shop in a world of magic. Build a character and community while slaying corporate greed in this card-based map-drawing game.

ds: Driftworlds is a d6 system that focuses on player agency and collaborative storytelling. In this one-shot, you will take on the role of Whisperers, agents of the Marchioness of the Whispering March, searching for one of your own number, who disappeared in the mining town of Cayrn while trying to uncover the source of its sudden wealth. Pre-generated characters will be provided so you can dive right in. This one-shot is designed to give you experience with the core features of Driftworlds, including its Crisis System.
sd: Can you uncover the secret of songsilver? Or will you be buried by your enemies?

t: Escape from the Court of Dark Waters
ds: Driftworlds is a d6 system that focuses on player agency and collaborative storytelling. In this one-shot, you will take on the role of Whisperers, agents of the Marchioness of the Whispering March, investigating a series of disappearances in the city of Drakefall. Pre-generated characters will be provided so you can dive right in. This one-shot is designed to give you experience with the core features of Driftworlds, including its Crisis System.
sd: Seek, and you will find them. Flee, and they will follow you.

ds:
By day, The Silver Swallow Club is a place for bird watchers and nature enthusiasts. After dark, it offers something else entirely: A rowdy speakeasy where free thinkers flout Prohibition laws to enjoy jazz, bootleg liquor, and roaring good times. Tonight, however, someone at the Silver Swallow Club has murder on their mind… 
 
 Get ready to solve a Gatsby-era murder mystery through three rounds of social gameplay with help from the StoryPop app. You’ll role play an assigned character with motivations and unique objectives to complete. Your actions and decisions will shape how the story unfolds, so you’ll need cunning, courage, and charm in order to come out on top. Interact with fellow players to discover hidden agendas, unearth secrets, and identify the killer before it’s too late! The StoryPop team is thrilled to offer this one-of-a-kind experience at Gen Con – don’t miss out!
sd: Step back in time to a swanky 1920s speakeasy where the revelry is disrupted by a vicious murder in this immersive, app-guided role playing experience.

t: Murder at the Black Cinder Saloon
ds:
The Black Cinder Saloon offers liquor and entertainment to townsfolk, rail workers, cattle ranchers, and even outlaws. Tonight, the saloon’s poker tournament has attracted gamblers from all around. When a murder raises the stakes, patrons of the Black Cinder must prove their innocence (or hide their guilt) while jockeying for power amid vigilante justice and corruption.
 
 Get ready to solve a Wild West murder mystery through three rounds of social gameplay with help from the StoryPop app. You’ll role play an assigned character with motivations and unique objectives to complete. Your decisions will shape how the story unfolds, so you’ll need cunning, courage, and charm in order to come out on top. Interact with fellow players to unearth secrets and identify the killer before it’s too late! The StoryPop team is thrilled to offer this one-of-a-kind experience at Gen Con – don’t miss out!
sd: Saddle up for a Wild West murder mystery in this immersive, app-guided role playing experience where you might be a suspect, a victim… or the killer.

t: Out of the Frying Pan, Into the Prison Break (aka... Roll for Parole)
ds: Your adventuring party has been working for a few years with a wizard, who has a secret. In his basement is a portal that can open a gateway to the far-flung reaches of the world. This crafting wizard contracts the party to seek out rare or hard to get materials for his unique & custom magic items. Compensation is lucrative for the party, so they are happy to maintain the wizard's secret advantage over his competition. On *this* arranged trip, however, something goes terribly wrong. The portal shunts the adventurers to the wrong target location. Will the party survive the transport to the unknown location? Will they find their way home? Will they survive the all-out war ongoing in the prison? So much mayhem, so many possible outcomes.
sd: A prison break scenario, with a twist. Fully equipped characters get dumped into the ongoing situation. Premade selection of Level 7 characters will be available to choose from.

t: The Ruined Keep of the Raven Shaman
ds:
The local villagers speak of unnatural shadows stretching from the ruins and the rhythmic, metallic thrum of wings in the night. They are desperate, and you are brave (or perhaps just broke) enough to answer the call.
 
 This is a 3rd level adventure. Feel free to bring your own characters or use the pregenerated ones that will be provided.
sd: Enter the keep and find treasure and much darker secrets! An adventure for 3rd level characters.

ds: Fresh out of Lancer training your team has been sent to the deepest darkest corner of Union territory. Your job, shoot down anything trying to leave the Epsilon Tau 7's atmosphere. Your team has been here 3 months and other than a passing meteor shower a week ago the most excitement you've had was when the zero G toilet malfunctioned. Well until 3 minutes ago when the atmospheric exit warning systems started going crazy...
sd: Your rag tag team of newly licensed Lancers has been stationed at a remote space station to ensure nothing makes it off this quarantined planet. The Union has denied to reveal any further details.

ds: They seem to be originating from reality warping spheres randomly appearing and disappearing all over the Hisui region. Those affected have sent their best trainers to Orchid Town as a starting point to find and eliminate the cause of this madness.

ds: Welcome to Briarholt Academy of Arcane Studies, a hidden magical school tucked in an Appalachian holler—its lantern-lit halls and stone stairways carved straight into a red rock canyon. You’ll play first-year students navigating house rivalries, secret faculty agendas, and the unsettling truth that the school isn’t just a place of learning… it’s a containment system with a long memory. This game is for players who enjoy school-season drama, secrets, and solving problems creatively—with just enough danger to keep the lantern light feeling precious. You don’t need deep system mastery: I’ll keep rules support friendly and focus on immersive scenes, meaningful choices, and a finale you’ll enjoy.
sd: Prepare to craft a potion with your group, then follow your sense of adventure as something dark and slimy roams the Academy grounds. (Team Puzzle/Mystery/Boss Battle) [Rule of Cool]

ds: Cosmic forces have conspired to bring together all the biggest bads of the Monster Manual, and it's up to you to smack them down. You're a level 20 hero of legend and you've got the feats, spell levels, and magic items to prove it. Yet while many of the threats are iconic, someone unknown is pulling the strings. And that someone is sure to offer some surprises you won't find in the pages of popular books. Come for a chance to finally cast Wish, stay for an experienced DM who's rated highly for his fast-paced, creative, and engaging combat! This is a great game to bring back characters who never got to reach high levels, players who have never tried level 20 play, or that busted multiclass build your DM won't let you play.
sd: Want to play your character at the highest level? Wield legendary weapons and bring your Simulacrum into battle without jumping through hoops? Here's the no-holds-barred brawl of your dreams!

ds: A thrilling introductory adventure for 3–5 players using 1st-level characters! Choose from pre-generated heroes or build your own using the 2024 Basic Rules (subject to DM approval). New and veteran players welcome. Descend into a shadow-haunted dungeon filled with twisting corridors, dangerous foes, hidden secrets, and glittering loot. This adventure showcases the core pillars of D&D. It's perfect for learning the system or jumping back in. Professional DM experience includes a full-color battle map, unique miniatures, character sheets, dice, NPC voices, reference sheets, and immersive visual aids.
sd: Brave the shadow dungeons, solve eerie clues, battle monsters, and uncover a mystery before the Upside Down leaks in!

t: The Sablewood Messengers w/ GM Ace (300+ Professional Sessions)
ds: A thrilling introductory adventure for 3–5 players using starting Daggerheart characters! Choose from ready-to-play heroes or craft your own (subject to GM approval). New and veteran players welcome. Journey into the shadowed wilds of Sablewood, where whispered rumors, dangerous paths, and rising corruption threaten fragile settlements. Face tense choices, cinematic combat, and story-driven challenges as you uncover what stalks the forest roads. This adventure highlights Daggerheart’s narrative focus, collaborative storytelling, and dynamic mechanics. It's perfect for learning the system or diving into a new saga. Professional GM experience includes a full-color map, unique minis, character sheets, dice, NPC voices, reference sheets, and immersive visual aids.
sd: You trek through an ancient forest with the King's court sorcerer by carriage, bearing a large, mysterious crate addressed to the Whitefire Arcanist. Ace has hosted over 300 pro sessions on SPG!

ds:
The Big Boss of Detroit, master fighter and ruler over the streets of Detroit in the year 19XX has wronged you all, need I say more?
 
 But it's not going to be as simple as busting down the door, you gotta fight through waves of his goons; a series of his lieutenants; and pave a path of destruction through the back alleys, dive bars, and famous locations around Detroit before dealing one final blow to the man himself. 
 
 Taking inspiration from 80s retro beat-em-ups, this high octane stomp through Detroit has you fending off ninjas, battling waves of thugs, and defeating lieutenants of the big boss to pave the way to one final confrontation with the ruler of the underworld.
sd: A drifter owes a debt; a monk robbed of his dojo; a street tough who has something to prove; a mother lost a son; and a gang member hoping to rise in rank. Your mission: Kill the big boss

ds: Old Nantuk, the wise old elder that had been your great great great grandfathers father. When word of his dying came to the burrow, they mourned. But for the young, they were called to the death bed of the elder. "Carrots lie within the darkest pits of the burrow, I've seen them! When I was your age, I traveled with my brothers into this ancient place, and found this trove that could feed our people for generations. Yet, I was the only survivor of the expedition... for something dangerous lurks in the darkness of that place that prevents us from taking our rightful pile!" he dies after passing his last words. Will you heed his warning, or dare enter where few bunnies dare dwell?
sd: Old Nantuk's dying, and in his final days, he brings forth the youngest of his clan with a plea- "Carrots in the thousands, deeper then where any root plant should be!" dare you search for this trove?

ds: Take up the role of investigators on the White Chapel case as you uncover a grand conspiracy, and horrors beyond your imagine. Will you be able to stop Jack the Ripper and his conspiracy, or will the horrors be too much to bare. The conspiracy goes deep- and each layer unraveled might ask more questions then give answers.
sd: The news calls him Jack the Ripper, murdering working woman of the White Chapel late at night. The watch is desperate for answers, but as the truth is unraveled, are you prepared for the consequences.

gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert, Brian Forester
ds: Following the trail of the Carlyle Expedition, the investigators uncover a sprawling conspiracy involving secret cults and ancient powers. Their search for answers may take them across the globe, including London, Cairo, Nairobi, Shanghai, or even Sydney. New investigators are welcome, though returning players will continue the developing story.
sd: Jump into a continuing investigation and join a group of investigators pursuing the dark mysteries behind the Masks of Nyarlathotep. New players are welcome and pre-gen characters will be provided.

gm: Andy Cowley, Jeremiah Evans, Robert Lambert, Brian Forester
ds: Clues gathered across the world point toward powerful cults working toward a terrible purpose. The investigators must decide where to pursue their leads next as the danger grows and the truth behind the Carlyle Expedition slowly comes to light. Returning investigators will continue the story, but new players can join the investigation at any point.
sd: The investigation continues as the investigators push deeper into the global conspiracy surrounding the Masks of Nyarlathotep. New players are welcome and pre-gen characters will be provided.

sd: Players have been called in to investigate a gruesome murder scene in Ealing, West London. Pre-gen characters will be provided.

t: A Moment of Peace and Quiet
ds:
The desert southwest is a land of vast skies, near-alien plant life - and when you give the Impala a break to make sure it doesn't overheat, a stillness so quiet it almost makes your ears ring. Your group of hunters is on edge, and none of you can say quite why.
 
 The town of Two Pines twenty miles down this two-lane highway should have a little more life. There'll be townsfolk to chat with while you stretch your legs, snacks for your dwindling supply, gas enough to get you to your next hunt. Maybe there'll be some tourist trap to visit, like an old mine or hot springs or old west kitsch. Maybe you'll be able to truly rest here after so long on the road.
 
 Surely Two Pines won't be as abandoned as the rest of the desert. 
 Surely the whisper of the wind won't be the loudest thing in town.
 Surely the first folks to greet you won't be corpses.
 Surely your next hunt hasn't found you.
sd: Gas up the Impala, grab your friends, and make your way into the US southwest and the forgotten history of Two Pines that won't stay forgotten. Hunt down the threat & break the town's silence at last.

ds: Welcome to the tunnels below Ptolus. Solve the clues, traverse the traps and slay the monsters in time and you could be set for life.

 No experience needed. Rules will be taught. Pregens provided.

t: Operation: Snowglobe, A Lunar Horror RPG
ds:
Your orders? Classified till you reach orbit.
 
 This mission is of the utmost importance. The fate of the world is at stake. You and your fellow crew members have been told nothing of the details of your mission, only that you are embarking on a top-secret Lunar Mission. Houston, aka Mission Control, will brief you once you reach the moon’s orbit. Not a word is to be spoken to anyone of this mission. No one can know you are about to leave Earth.
 
 No experience needed. Rules will be taught. Pregens provided.
sd: Your elite team of astronauts is selected for a top secret lunar mission on Christmas Day, 1979. Your fellow crew members have been told nothing, but you've left Earth and entered pure horror.

ds:

ds:

Perhaps, if you do a good job, you'll work off some of the debt your family has incurred to the demonic idol. And maybe you'll be her next meal. You should try your best to avoid that outcome. 
 
 No experience needed. Rules will be taught. Pregens provided.
sd: Alison the Succubus, your Dark Lord, has called up on you to enact a series of assignments to help her powers grow. What devious plans does she have in store?

ds:

 No experience needed. Rules will be taught. Pregens provided.

ds:

You'll utilize your best detective skills to uncover the culprit, only to reveal something never seen before. 
 
 No experience needed. Rules will be taught. Pregens provided.
sd: The Djali are sent to Aye Ijiwa in the Switch Blade Nebula after a string of musterious murders occurs. Can your detective skills to uncover the mystery?

ds:
Isola di Malamente, a small island off the coast of Sicily, is home to an an abandoned hospital and chapel. The Spektral Krew is a group of ghost hunting YouTubers looking to take their channel to the next level. If they can hit 1 million subscribers, they're looking at serious monetization, brand partnerships, maybe even a TV deal. To make it to the big leagues, they plan to sneak onto Isola di Malamente, livestream their exploration, and hold a midnight seance. But unknown horrors await them - can they survive with their lives and sanity?
 
 Pre-generated characters will be provided. 
 
 Viral contains themes of body horror, disease, patient abuse, murder, suicide, drug abuse, and other sensitive topics.
sd: A group of ghost hunters sneaks into an abandoned hospital for their biggest livestream yet. A modern scenario suitable for new or experienced players.

t: The Silence Between Stars: A SciFi Horror One Shot
ds:
A distress call, a derelict ship, and nothing but the silence of space around you. What horrors await you in the dark as you investigate the fate of a derelict ship, and will you survive them? 
 
 Inspired by titles such as Alien, Event Horizon, and Invasion of the Body Snatcher, this SciFi Horror game utilizes the Dread system, pulling blocks from a tower instead of rolling dice to add to the suspense and impending doom. 
 
 Dread is a rules-light system where the goal is not survival, though it can happen. Rather, it focuses on building suspense and creating a satisfying, collaborative horror story. 
 
 Characters will be created at the table prior to gameplay (using base templates that will be provided by the GM). You need no prior knowledge or preparation to play, only a love for SciFi horror and a willingness to embrace the suspense and impending doom of the Dread system.
sd: A distress call, a derelict ship, and nothing but the silence of space around you. What horrors await you in the dark as you investigate the fate of a derelict ship, and will you survive them?

ds:
Washington D.C., 2009. Operation GOLD WATCH: You are a newly inducted Agent of Delta Green, a conspiracy within the U.S. government to eliminate and cover up the unnatural. Your first task is to search the apartment of a recently deceased former Agent and scrub it of any references to the unnatural or Delta Green. Sounds simple, but any Night at the Opera with Delta Green rarely is. 
 
 Pre-generated characters will be provided.
 
 Last Things Last contains themes of violence, body horror, and abuse. Player discretion is advised.
sd: Want to learn how to play Delta Green, the modern conspiracy-horror RPG from Arc Dream Publishing? This short scenario is a great introduction for new players.

gm: Lain Smith, John Hoard, Rozanne Lorenzanna
ds: Play the Ennie award-winning and Nebula finalist game, Wanderhome! Take on the role of traveling animal folk as they navigate the countryside. Built on the Belonging Outside of Belonging engine, Wanderhome is a storytelling game that is written as you play. With a guide to help you along your way, our sessions consist of character creation, world building, and roleplaying, as we meet one another and develop stories collaboratively.
sd: Come with us on a journey into the land of the Hæth, a pastoral table-top roleplaying game. Play as anthropomorphic animal travelers, and find your own stories to tell.

ds: Inside this unassuming bed & breakfast you'll find witches, monsters, cursed knights, and wannabe musicians; and that's just the staff! Spend some time at Yazeba's Bed & Breakfast and find yourself embroiled in all manner of hijinks and calamity. The game uses pre-set characters, quick-play chapters, and an adaptable ruleset unlike anything else out there. It takes less than a half hour to learn how to play and get started, but with new chapters and secrets to unlock folks can stick with the game for years and years. A guide will be available to help you along the way.
sd: Visit a magical bed & breakfast in this slice-of-life tabletop RPG about a heartless witch, a peaceful house, and all the folks who have made their home inside.

Spend some time at Yazeba's Bed & Breakfast and find yourself embroiled in all manner of hijinks and calamity. The game uses pre-set characters, quick-play chapters, and an adaptable ruleset unlike anything else out there. It takes less than a half hour to learn how to play and get started, but with new chapters and secrets to unlock folks can stick with the game for years and years. A guide will be available to help you along the way.
sd: Visit a magical bed & breakfast in this slice-of-life tabletop RPG about a heartless witch, a peaceful house, and all the folks who have made their home inside.

ds: Galactic Dawn is a faction-based, sci-fi worldbuilding game that is told through collaborative narratives and notecards. This is a GM-less game that uses collaborative narrative resolution. The game has two goals: (1) to tell compelling stories during play and (2) to create a pile of detailed cards outlining the lore and history of people, places, and the themes that connect them. Players take on a dual role of pursing their own faction’s interests and collaboratively advancing the narratives of other factions and the universe at large. The end of the game leaves you with a detailed worldbuilding history with plenty of narrative hooks. Like Microscope meets Civilization, with no win condition.
sd: A rich duke has challenged your factions to rebuild a post-apocalyptic frontier planet. What threads and secrets lay buried here? With different ambitions, how will you take this world for yourself?

ds: Runecaster is a narrative game where you think creatively about magic and science in order to create engaging narratives. Players are mages who make magic through scribing combinations of nine flexible runes. Players explain and creatively determine what the intent of each spell is based on their interpretation of the runes and how they might combine. Magic is also tied to both analytical reason and emotional expression. Magic is full of unintended consequences and new discoveries. Runecaster is a dice optional system that uses narrative guides to decide outcomes.
sd: Force. Heat. You’ve been studying these runes your whole life. Can you harness your magic to finally get into college? Use creative thinking to cast spells and avoid blowing yourself up.

ds: Enclave is a diceless TTRPG where each game is a self-contained one shot generated on the spot based on word prompts from the players. Because setting is boundless, adventures can happen in a wide variety of environments and genres. Character creation is quick and will be done on-site, and learning the mechanics is simple through play. Accessible to those new to RPGs, and offering storytelling depth to the seasoned, anyone can join the Enclave.

lo: ICC Hall B : No Rails Adventure Team HQ
ds: The Droid Saga is meant to be a satire dripping in sarcasm and heavy foreshadowing. Players will create a unique droid and play through scenes in different ears of the Star Wars universe. Names and situations are painfully punny and obvious to the outsider, but intensely serious and mysterious to the organics involved. The droids in the story are the true heroes, making things happen that go unnoticed but are ultimately responsible for the outcomes of the story we all know and love. This role play and problem solving heavy adventure uses edited 5th Edition rules to create a quick and simple game designed for all ages and skill levels.
sd: While Heroes fight, the droids work. For decades, Palpatine plans and plots to install himself as the ruler of the Galaxy. See his behind the scenes machinations in this co-op tale.

t: Tower of Gygarn - KILL IT, KEEP IT - Adult Emerald Dragon
lo: ICC Hall B : No Rails Adventure Team HQ
ds: Join endless ranks of hero fodder (er...) adventurers! March to face the monster in its lair. No loss of life is too much for the Grieving Emperor who wants vengeance. Adventures fight and quickly die, to be reincarnated until the evil creature is slain. Improve your character each death in Roguelike fashion with permanent benefits. Play as multiple classes and work together or in competition to kill the creature and land the killing blow (which awards your own collectible as trophy of your victory! Endless player lives and someone WILL eventually walk away with this valuable figure. GM Decisions final. Winning Player from each table with compete in Critical Hit Roll-off to take home this Premium "miniature"
sd: Reincarnate and power up your character in battle after battle until monster dies. Final critical hit keeps the miniature from Icons of the Realms ($99 MSRP)!

ds: Dry clean your cape, stash a corsage in your utility belt, and ask your parents if you can borrow the invisible car, because its prom night at The Zeddemore Institute for The Empowered! Do you have what it takes to pass your classes, find a date, and fend off attacks from the rival school for super villains across town? Find out at the dance of doom, the hop of horror, the Prom of Peril!

ds: Matilda Frey has sent word to you, an adventurer of some renown, claiming she has coin and mystery available for those brave and capable enough. Not one to let either slip through your grasp, you find yourself on the road to Frey.
sd: Something strange is happening in the quiet hamlet called Frey, at least that's what Lord Frey's daughter believes.

ds:
The skull of an enormous, long-dead fire giant looms over the frozen hills as your caravan crests the ridge. A faint orange fire flickers within the giant’s open mouth, where a pair of travelers sit warming themselves. At the base of the skull, a massive door has been built into the giant’s throat, sealed with ancient runes and a strange locking mechanism. Whatever lies beyond the door descends deep through the giant’s hollow bones—and something down there is beginning to stir.
 
 This RP-light game will be a dungeon crawl for the combat/puzzle driven adventurer.
sd: A colossal fire giant skull hides a rune-sealed door and ancient mysteries within. Descend The Hollow Flame, solve it's mysteries, and face what lies within in this dungeon crawl.

ds: He was a wizard. Nobody recollects else. The elders say — in hushed tones after glancing over their shoulders — he arrived one fall morning nigh forty years back. He spoke nary a word and strode with purpose, oblivious to the villagers’ gawping. The light of the next dawn revealed a stone tower erected in Gorin Cowherd’s western field. Gorin did not make a fuss. He simply shook his head and moved his cows to another field. Wizard, after all. As the months and years passed, Gorin mustered the courage to return to the field and graze his cows in the shadow of the tower. The wizard was not seen again and the tower has been silent. Life moved on. Three days ago, an Adventurers Wanted posting appeared on the tower’s door. Since Gorin’s boy, Joris, first noticed the note, a crowd of trepidatious door knocking adventurers has grown around the base of the tower. Gorin, again, didn't make a fuss.
sd:
ADVENTURERS WANTED 
 Couriers to retrieve and transport package. 
 High risk; high reward. 
 No questions asked.
 Knock to inquire.

ds: The program has tagged a recent high profile robbery of a rare folding harpsichord. The harpsichord, on loan from the Met, was set to be the centerpiece of a new musical antiquities exhibit and premiered in a public benefit concert at the Smithsonian. According to the police report, the driver and guard were ambushed by thieves at a rest stop in Maryland while transporting the harpsichord. Shortly after being detained in the bathroom, the guard stated he heard screaming from the thieves as well as as an overpowering buzzing sound which caused both the guard and driver to pass out. When the police arrived, they found the harpsichord missing and two of the thieves in a severely desiccated state. Given the unusual state of the robbery and the deaths involved, the program is activating O-Cell to locate the harpsichord and determine any potential vectors.
sd: When the theft of a rare musical artifact results in the mysterious deaths of those who stole it, Delta Green must find out what caused their deaths before song of doom is played for the public.

ds: While on mission to inventory a Green Box facility in Santa Fe, Delta Green auditors discover the contents of one of the storage containers ransacked. While most of the items were accounted for, several unknown artifacts turned up missing in the report. While attempting to contact the veteran agent in charge of the box facility, the auditing team discovered his corpse at his house in an advanced state of decay. Additionally, the auditors also captured footage of a figure on a motorcycle fleeing the veteran agent’s house when they approached it. Fearing exposure to a possible biological hazard or other unknown vectors, Delta Green has sent a team to assess any potential threat to the pubic and contain or eliminate it if necessary.
sd: When a inventory mission at a Green Box facility turns up missing artifacts and a dead veteran agent, Delta Green activates a cell to investigate the possible beginnings of a large scale vector event.

ds: While excavating land around a Catholic church near Norfolk, Virginia as part of a centennial renovation, local construction workers have unearthed a strange find. Inside a hillside crypt nearly 200 yards from the church, the workers discovered 30 skeletal remains arranged in a circle along the walls of the crypt. Each skeleton was found to have had its skull removed and placed in front of a central skeleton holding a long blade with spiral etching. While a preliminary investigation has resulted in no immediate concerns, observations from DG friendlies on the site have determined that the blade may be a point of concern. To head off any possible vectors, Delta Green is sending a team in order to assess the burial site for concerns and to contain and dangerous artifacts.
sd: When a secret crypt containing skeletal remains and apparent eldritch artifacts is discovered in Norfolk, Virginia, DG send agents to investigate this unusual find for vectors and threats.

t: The Five Demons of Gorthus Kane
ds: The fortress of the evil Gorthus Kane has come down from the stars to land outside of the peaceful town of Luum. Now the warlord lays siege to Luum, aided by his five demon generals. The call goes out for heroes willing to send Gorthus Luum back to outer dark!
sd: The evil Gorthus Kane has come down from the stars to lay siege to the peaceful town of Luum. The call has gone out for heroes to defeat the alien warlord and his five demon generals!

t: The Evil Dr. Panderghast Must Die!
ds: For too long your rustic Carpathian village has suffered under the evil shadow of the mad Dr. Panderghast! Now, one of his monstrous creations has abducted a group of young people, no doubt doomed to become part of one of his twisted experiments. Dr. Panderghast’s evil dies tonight! Grab your torch and pitchfork and join the mob to storm his castle. A 0-level funnel!
sd: For too long your village has suffered under the shadow of the mad Dr. Panderghast! His evil dies tonight! Grab your torch and pitchfork and join the mob to storm his castle. A 0-level funnel!

t: Nice Borg - The Ghosts of Moonhallow Manor
ds: Nothing grim or dark here! Strange things are happening at Moonhallow Manor. As agents of Hope, it’s up to you to investigate the ancient manor house and lay its troubled spirits to rest.

t: The Invasion of Taslefar: A Warhammer 40k Horror Game
ds: This is the dice less, block tower horror game, where success is measured by your ability to make a successful pull. Each player will get a bespoke character and will have to run and fight against the Word Bearers as they try to conquer the planet of Taslefar. Knowledge of Dread or Warhammer 40k is not needed to enjoy this game experience.
sd: Play as ordinary Imperium citizens as it is being invaded by Chaos Space Marines in this horror 40K Dread game. Can you survive the invasion and live to serve the Imperium another day?

ds: The Focus has been shattered. Mongo is no longer a single world. Massive chunks of land float around each other bound by science verging on magic. The Kingdoms are now Moons of Mongo. And Flash is still missing.... or is he? Rumors swirl around Ming's return, his cruel insanity, and the strange mask he wears. You know the truth. You've glimpsed the secret behind that mask. Escape Ming's Fortress! Inform the Freemen! Find the Garrison and rescue the prisoners there! The future and freedom of Mongo depend on you!
