ds:
Do you have what it takes to explore Acererak's Tomb Of Horror? Bring one of your own home characters and find out. If your character survives they will get XP and treasure as bragging rights when you play them at your home table. Be the envy of your gaming group. 
 If you bring a character from another edition of D&D or another gaming system I can convert it to fit this AD&D module. It's all about having fun the evening before Gen Con!!

t: Float Like a Faerie, Sting Like a Behemoth
gm: Anna Brogowski, Griffin Bailey, Ben Polsky
ds:
Pre-gen level 4 characters will be available, can also bring your own
 
 Experience the floating continent of Mizani from the Daggerheart actual-play, EXP, in this series of one-shots from different cities in our game:
 - Ozryn: a city with historical connections to a dragon leader that resides on the largest cliff-face
 - Pileus: a land mass rumored to be floating along the seas under the continent and is home to many nomadic Fungril
 - Ubriston: famous for its vibrancy, only a handful have seen what lies in the underground–better bring your boxing gloves
 
 Join us as we adventure across Mizani and tune into the actual-play on YouTube to follow the story of two parties (one good and one evil), in the same world at the same time, as they navigate the mysterious Aether covering the land and the connections the characters may have.
 
 YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@EposExProsa
sd: Deep in the swamps of the Mizani bayou is a city called "the Breezy". You're given the secret location of the next big boxing match--what a perfect time for the city's guide boats to start acting up.

ds:
Jaren Fraser, a "hunter" of the Ashen Veil has requested you accompany him deep into the Ashen Veil in search of a particularly dangerous quarry. "200 gold each and anything you can carry out" would be enough to entice any adventurer, but the name is what caught your attention. For the last several months you've noticed a stranger appearing in your dreams. Always kind, strong, and intense you've grown to understand, if not care for, the man called Jaren Fraser... the man who's summoned you to The Last Call tavern.
 
 This game will be heavy on roleplaying and story, and may not be for everyone. This game may include adult themes and so I'm requiring a "consent in gaming" survey for all attendees to ensure everyone has a great time.
 There will be a short break for players to eat, as determined by the group (meals not provided).
sd: The Ashen Veil is known by adventurers to be a land of perpetual darkness full of monsters, powerful dark magic, and fabled riches... for those who survive.

ds:
You find yourselves in the port city of Shadewater and after responding to a hiring post on the local board arrive at the Reflection Pool, a seaside tavern. Bali Sunderbrow is a middle aged dwarf w/ a penchant for gambling and a rather resourceful fence.
 
 Bali has sunk the last of his coin into a “salvage venture”. It turns out a missing “cargo” ship Alexandra’s Tempest, which Bali found is actually a smuggling vessel alleged to be hauling stolen rarities, decided to brave The Wandering Storms and Demon's Teeth and is now several days overdue.
sd: "Adventurers needed for a salvage operation. Above board. No tricks. No experience necessary. Probably very safe. Meet Bali Sunderbrow at the Reflection Pool Tavern in Shadewater."

ds: Matilda Frey has sent word to you, an adventurer of some renown, claiming she has coin and mystery available for those brave and capable enough. Not one to let either slip through your grasp, you find yourself on the road to Frey.
sd: Something strange is happening in the quiet hamlet called Frey, at least that's what Lord Frey's daughter believes.

ds:
The skull of an enormous, long-dead fire giant looms over the frozen hills as your caravan crests the ridge. A faint orange fire flickers within the giant’s open mouth, where a pair of travelers sit warming themselves. At the base of the skull, a massive door has been built into the giant’s throat, sealed with ancient runes and a strange locking mechanism. Whatever lies beyond the door descends deep through the giant’s hollow bones—and something down there is beginning to stir.
 
 This RP-light game will be a dungeon crawl for the combat/puzzle driven adventurer.
sd: A colossal fire giant skull hides a rune-sealed door and ancient mysteries within. Descend The Hollow Flame, solve it's mysteries, and face what lies within in this dungeon crawl.

ds:
The secrets of the glassmaking industry on the island of Murano are jealously guarded: there is no leaving the island without government permission, and anyone who is discovered selling secrets to a competing kingdom will be quickly silenced. Despite the danger of breaking Venice's rules, a prominent glassmaker is missing: and what he is working on could shake the fragile balance of power in the Mediterranean, or perhaps even shatter reality itself. The adventurers are hired to find him and, if necessary, end him. However, jobs are rarely this cut and dry, and knowing who to trust in the City of Masks can be perilous. 
 This adventure for 5th level characters takes place in the Historica Arcanum universe, where real history meets dark fantasy. The setting is the Republic of Venice in the early 16th century CE. Pre-generated characters will be provided.
sd: Venice, 1521 CE. The City of Masks is awash with Carnevale, and the adventurers are hired to find a missing Murano glassmaker before the government does, and uncover a plot with dire ramifications.

ds:
The year is 1200 CE. Most of the Holy Land is in the control of the Ayyubid Empire. Leaders, Muslim and Christian alike, jostle for dominance and territory, and coming wars loom on the horizon. The neighboring Abbasid Caliphate and Sultanate of Rum pressure the Ayyubid northern borders, and soon another Crusade will be called. Scholars, holy men, and rulers scour ancient texts for legends of relics which might tip the scales. 
 
 When a humble shopkeeper makes a curious discovery in a Cairo bazaar, a collection of parchment wrapped in leather, the adventurers are sent to collect it: for within the bound leather is a map that leads to a sacred relic, which could lead to endless prosperity, and power. 
 
 This adventure for 5th level characters takes place in the Historica Arcanum universe, where real history meets dark fantasy. Pre-generated characters will be provided.
sd: Cairo, 1200 CE. The discovery of a lost map leading to a hidden relic sends the adventurers on a daring collection mission, which will test their mettle and could shape the fate of the Holy Lands.

ds: A shocking discovery is made which could shatter the brittle peace on Mars. The Players (Armigers) must investigate and if necessary, neutralize any threats. Yet things are never that routine.
sd: A shocking discovery is made which could shatter the brittle peace on Mars. The Players (Armigers) must investigate and if necessary, neutralize any threats. Yet things are never that routine.

ds:
The year is 2410. Earth is cursed; though humans are spread out across the Solar Reach, Mars is the last viable hope for humanity. Yet all is not well on the Red Planet: city-states are in a tenuous balance after a war with Jupiter, and old simmering tensions are bubbling back to the surface. In the Eastern Hemisphere, far from the major cities, an odd relic buried in a crater threatens to send shockwaves across the Martian Regolith and overturn the scales of peace. 
 ASTRA ARCANUM is a brand new d20 dicepool system of tactical combat and tough choices. Game rules will be explained, and Pre-generated Characters will be provided. You play Armigers, elite mercenaries contracted to investigate and get to the bottom of the mystery. Anything that is a danger to Martian security must be eliminated; anything valuable, apprehended. What the Armigers find there, however, is not so simple.

sd: A shocking discovery is made which could shatter the brittle peace on Mars. The Players (Armigers) must investigate and if necessary, neutralize any threats. Yet things are never that routine.

ds:
The year is 2410. Earth is cursed; though humans are spread out across the Solar Reach, Mars is the last viable hope for humanity. Yet all is not well on the Red Planet: city-states are in a tenuous balance after a war with Jupiter, and old simmering tensions are bubbling back to the surface. In the Eastern Hemisphere, far from the major cities, an odd relic buried in a crater threatens to send shockwaves across the Martian Regolith and overturn the scales of peace. 
 ASTRA ARCANUM is a brand new d20 dicepool system of tactical combat and tough choices. Game rules will be explained, and Pre-generated Characters will be provided. You play Armigers, elite mercenaries contracted to investigate and get to the bottom of the mystery. Anything that is a danger to Martian security must be eliminated; anything valuable, apprehended. What the Armigers find there, however, is not so simple.
sd: A shocking discovery is made which could shatter the brittle peace on Mars. The Players (Armigers) must investigate and if necessary, neutralize any threats. Yet things are never that routine.

ds: Millennia ago, before the ascendance of humanity, primordial empires worshiped the Great Beast Shoggula. Shoggula’s influence has since waned, but the Great Beast’s cultists still plot to restore their god to power. Now you and your fellow sword & sorcery heroes must venture into the sticky caverns beneath the toxic swamps of the western wastelands to thwart their dire machinations!
sd: Cultists of the Great Beast Shoggula will raise their primordial god and topple civilization, unless your band of sword & sorcery heroes venture beneath the toxic swamps and thwart their schemes!

t: The Bloodfields at Blackstar Station: Battle Royale
gm: Cameron Strittmatter, Jessa Beckett, Zachary Bouc, Frank Perrucci, Eryn Levine, Justin Estrada, Brice McReynolds, Benjamin Kanelos, Gina Susanna, Alex Teplitz, Hannah Harper, Zac Smith
ds:
Forget the horrors of the void—your greatest threat is the table sitting next to you. Welcome to the largest PvP Mothership RPG event at Gen Con! Your 5-person crew is locked in a ruthless competition against 14 rival teams, where hunting your fellow players for sport is the main attraction. You'll forge fragile alliances, orchestrate devastating betrayals, and fight to the bitter end.
 
 THE LOOT: Every single player walks away with a imaginary battle scars and physical survival caches: a custom Bloodfields event lanyard, exclusive physical swag, and a brand-new, free Mothership Mini-Module just for dropping in. This is a premium megagame experience. Only the last team standing claims the grand prize: a stack of Deluxe 1E Box Sets. Are you ready to hunt?
sd: Hunger Games meets Thunderdome in the ultimate 75-player Mothership tournament! Your squad will hunt down 14 other teams in a ruthless, massive battle to the death. Only the most cunning will survive.

ds: The Laser Ponies love to romp and play in their home of Glitter Valley, but when a terrifying new threat arises they must travel far from home–farther than they’ve ever been–all the way to the Moon! Get ready for lunar laser-blasting aplenty!
sd: The Laser Ponies love to romp and play in their home of Glitter Valley, but when a new threat arises they must travel far from home–farther than they’ve ever been–all the way to the Moon!

gm: Yanni Panagiotopoulos, Sofia Denise, Alex Teplitz, Amphi Landrowski, Annaliese Cranston
ds: You are the Ambitious. Mortal’s who selfishly try and carve the rivers of fate, those that reach for heaven from underneath, and shape the earth to their Ambition. This introductory session will teach you everything you need to know about a Daoist Tarot Tactics TTRPG and its three modes of play; Tales, Engagements, and Tribunals. Engage in a combination of introspective narrative play, crunchy tactics, and social combat to solve the mystery of your dear friends disappearance. You will be introduced to Loom and its nostalgic forest, rapped by a storm that unremembers the fabric of its landscapes and those caught in it. Its nostalgia hunts you and its unkindness is tempting and wistful. Each step forward is a step you may not come back from and its only a matter of time before you forget yourself. Will you reach for your friend and pull them back from the brink?
sd: Embark into the Unknown on a desperate search for Sister Lillith, a close friend and fabled Gunwitch. What lurks in a forest that can’t stop remembering?

Pregen characters will be available or create your character with the free rules from our website. https://www.serpenthelm-studios.com/

t: War of the Dragon Masters 2: Let's Do It Again
ds: The martial arts blockbuster that never got made gets a sequel that also never got made! All the 70s martial arts film greats have to team up to save the world once more. Who will feel the fury of their fists and feet this time? Players will take on the roles of Billy Jack, Black Belt Jones, The Street Fighter, Lady Kung Fu, MISTER Lee, and more in the team-up no studio could ever have managed once, let alone twice.
sd: The baaaaaddest martial artists in the world are back in the sequel to the best martial arts movie that never got made!

ds: It’s yet another outing for the double-9 agents of MI6, those unsung heroes who let the very, very sung heroes of the double-0’s such as one “Bond, James Bond,” do what they do--which includes always taking all the credit. But more important than that is saving the world from laser satellites that threaten to destabilize nuclear supremacy around the world, uh, somehow. Nobody tells you how the villain’s plans work. You just have to help Bond stop them!
sd: You’re not James Bond. You’re the other guys. But Bond couldn’t do what he does without you.

ds: The Avalonian Isles lie hidden within a shroud of mist, the heart of the Old Magic that suffuses the Kingdom. The Isles are home to fairies, magical beings, and humans who can wield this ancient magic. Each year, the unfortunately unmagical Knights of the Kingdom are sent on quests in search of sacred relics. As residents of the Isles, you and your companions delight in pranking and outwitting these wandering Knights, some of whom are, admittedly, very attractive in their shining armor. This year, a group of Knights searching for a sacred artifact stumble into one of your harvest festival celebrations. What challenges will you prepare for them? What pranks will you play? And might some be convinced to abandon knighthood and instead help defend the Old Magic?
sd: Prank questing knights, flirt with hot armor-clad heroes, and protect the Old Magic of Avalon in this playful adventure of mischief, romance, and magical rebellion.

ds: In the quiet Appalachian town of Willowshade, WV, the strains of an eerie waltz echo from the basement of the fire hall—a ghostly remnant of a long-forgotten debutante ball. As the town wrestles with strange occurrences and growing unease, you and your companions must investigate the source of the haunting melody. What lies beneath the music? What happened on that fateful night? And what terrible truths are ready to surface? NOTE: 100% of our proceeds from this event will go to Brother Wolf Animal Rescue in Asheville, NC.
sd: A haunting melody drifts from the old firehall’s basement. Shadows of the past stir, drawing you into a night of dark secrets and eldritch horror. Will you uncover the truth or be consumed by it?

t: The Dark Secret in Milkthistle Falls
ds: In the shadowy hills of Milkthistle Falls, WV, the community is gripped by a creeping corruption that seeps from the earth. The Four Oaks Mine has been shut down for nigh on 20 years and the impact has been devastating. Now, strange phenomena plague the dying town—crops fail, livestock vanish, and a malevolent force seems to lurk in every shadow. The players must navigate the town's dark history, confront the sinister entities at play, and uncover the truth behind the unsettling whispers that call from the nearby mines. Will they rally the townspeople against the encroaching darkness, or will Milkthistle Falls slide into eternal despair? NOTE: 100% of our proceeds from this event will go to Brother Wolf Animal Rescue in Asheville, NC.
sd: In Milkthistle Falls, WV, a mining town, an ancient corruption seeps from the earth, twisting the townsfolk into nightmarish forms, as dark secrets awaken beneath the surface.

ds: This game isn’t for everyone. This isn’t a philosophical examination of heroism and humanity; it is a game about queer & nonconforming vampires killing nazis - usually in gory and over-the-top ways. In this game nazis are evil, and we will have no qualms about kicking their teeth in and drinking their blood. This will be a madcap rush of cartoonish levels of violence and chaos through the streets and rooftops of Paris, and you are a finely-tuned engine of retribution fueled by blood, adrenaline, and fascist-punching. If that sounds like the kind of catharsis you need right now, I’m here to enable that.
sd: The year is 1943. Europe is in flames. You are a crack team of vampire commandos airdropped into Paris with one mission: drink all of Hitler's blood.

t: Misadventures in the Misty Isles - Intro Adventure
ds:
You and your party of up to 6 other players with a GM will interact in the adventure with 4 other tables each with their own GM. Feel the energy of a room of 30 new friends working together!
 Transport yourself to the world of Airene-Tor, and the Misty Isles, an island chain months-long voyage from civilization. Here Spiritwood, worth more than its weight in platinum and magically infused, is grown and transported to the civilized world. However, weather, monsters, and people twisted by the magical mist stand in the way of progress.
 Your adventure begins with the eccentric Bright family, whose magical research made Spiritwood possible. Brave the sea on the way to Tiny Town. Meet the townspeople, some blessed or cursed by the chaotic mists. Protect the town from a creeping horror and the twisted
 mind that created it where fellow adventurers affect your surroundings and encounters.
sd: In this intro game, explore the Misty Isles with up to 30 new friends! Your table of 6 will work with 4 other tables to win the day!

ds: Hollow Hill is a small town in the North Carolina mountains where folks know one another by name and change comes slow. During the war, a company called B&L came to town. Said they were helping the war effort, said they’d be gone when the war ended. Tonight, the town has gathered at the Hollow Hill Town Hall to discuss the plans to build a pharmaceutical research facility. But that wasn’t what filled the house, it was the killings. For the third time this month a body was found in the woods east of town. Coincidentally, all three were men passing through. Officials say it was an animal attack and there’s no cause for alarm. NOTE: 100% of our proceeds from this event will go to Brother Wolf Animal Rescue in Asheville, NC.
sd: The future of little Hollow Hill, NC was looking up in 1949. The war was over, people were healing, a new pharmaceutical research facility was proposed, and then the attacks began.

ds: Being a mutant animal today is not an easy thing. A lot of humans don't see you as people, and shady organizations are always trying to capture you to learn more about the GOOP that made you. Mutants need to stick together. So when a lonely mutant approaches your group and asks for help in rescuing his best mutant friend, how can you say no? It just involves breaking in to a secret corporate HQ. And hijacking a transport plane. And just maybe fight off a horde of hired mercenaries who want to send you to the black site lab for experimentation. Just another Tuesday for a mutant.
sd: Your group of mutant animal operatives get a contract to rescue a fellow mutant from captivity. Only problem is this mutant is in the hands of dangerous corporate mercenaries.

ds: Your criminal crew has descended on the pride festival with all sorts of good and/or bad intentions. With so many events happening around town it would probably be easy to lift a few things from some otherwise distracted celebrants. Maybe lift the champagne from the most exclusive after party in town – hosted by Tyson and Bryson Pritchard-Harrington. Or perhaps grab up the crown and scepter being awarded to this year’s King and Queen of Pride? Rumor has it the front runner pulled a Nomi Malone and pushed your friend down some stairs. Or perhaps, you would rather plant some contraband on the protestors that could incriminate them in some very dubious activity should the local authorities get a mysterious call? I don’t know its your pride-fest! Have fun!
sd: What better way to celebrate pride than a little mischief? Under the backdrop of pride-fest, get into some lighthearted crime. Break into places, steal things, try not to get caught!

t: Starfinder Society: The Great Absalom Relay
ds: The Starfinder Society is one of a dozen prominent organizations invited to participate in the Great Absalom Relay, a live-streamed relay race across Absalom Station and the most anticipated charity event of the year! Charm the audience and upstage your competition as you overcome obstacles and compete in challenges in this showcase of Absalom Station’s hotspots. Win or lose, the spotlight’s on you!
sd: For 1st-2nd level characters. Compete in a livestreamed relay race across Absalom Station! Win or lose, the spotlight's on you!

t: The Dacilane Academy's Show Must Go On
ds: The Dacilane Academy often calls upon the Pathfinder Society to get them out of trouble, or to aid their students. Considering that many Pathfinders enroll their children in the academy, the relationship is one of mutual benefit. It’s therefore no surprise when the academy calls upon the Pathfinders to help make sure nothing terrible happens during the play that the students will be performing at a nearby theater, the Muse of the Rose. Recently, performances there have seen unfortunate accidents. No one has been seriously injured, but the performances were all ultimately ruined. It's up to the PCs to ensure that the Dacilane Academy's performance doesn't suffer the same fate, even if they have to prevent disasters backstage during the show itself.
sd: When mysterious "accidents" threaten performances at the Muse of the Rose theater, the Dacilane Academy calls on the Pathfinder Society for help.

ds: Gender bent LotR! Glamdalf the Gay has assembled the Flannelship of the Ring. They must survive fearsome Ringwaifs and Helob the spider. But the party's messy relationships may pose the greatest risk.

t: Good Luck and Don't Muck It Up!
ds: Where did all the dresses go?! To save the drag show, you must explore the Mucklands and find the gowns. A whimsical game best described as Muppets-meets-D&D.
sd: Where did all the dresses go?! To save the drag show, you must explore the Mucklands and find the gowns. A whimsical game best described as Muppets-meets-D&D.

t: SaxonDark: Escape from the Vikings of Mann
ds: You and 23 other prisoners are shackled in a viking slave pen on the Isle of Mann. The viking fleet has set off on another raid, leaving behind only enough guards to defend the longport. You are shackled to a wooden beam. One of you realized that the joints binding the beams to the walls have grown weak. Working together, you pull the beams off of the walls! The noise of breaking free has alerted the guards. Two enter with spears leveled at you. What do you do?
sd: Set in a heroic fantasy version of 9th-century Britain. You have been abducted by vikings and must escape! Pre-gens are provided.

ds: It is 868 A.D. You are Saxons of Mercia. Your army is laying siege to Snottingham, which has been captured by the vikings. You are sent on a mission to infiltrate the town and rescue the Ealdorman and his family from the clutches of Ivar the Boneless and Sigurd Snake-in-the-Eye, leaders of the Great Heathen Army that is conquering Britain.
sd: Set in a heroic fantasy version of 9th-century Britain. You must rescue the Ealdorman of Snottingham, held captive by the Great Heathen Army of Vikings.

t: SaxonDark: The Treasure Barrow of King Penda the Great
ds: It is 877 A.D. You are Saxons. The Vikings have conquered your kingdom of Mercia and installed a puppet king. Now their Great Heathen Army is threatening to conquer Wessex, the last saxon kingdom You must search the burial mound of King Penda the Great in search of a magic key. The key can open the hiding place where King Arthur and his paladins lie sleeping, awaiting your call to save Britain from the vikings!
sd: Set in a heroic fantasy version of 9th-century Britain. Delve into the burial mound of King Penda the Great, the last heathen king of Mercia. Pre-gens provided.

ds:
Lord Steuben’s young son, Wilmǣr, is correct: 27 years ago, you and your mates did promise Lord Steuben a favor in return for his helping you out of a . . . delicate . . . diplomatic situation. Wilmǣr is correct that, since his father never called in that debt, it passed to him on his father’s death. Wilmǣr is correct that you are honor-bound to answer his call for help.
 
 And yet, you and your companions are not what you used to be. Age has stiffened the joints and slowed the reflexes. Time has dulled the finely honed weapons that you and your team once were. Sagar doesn’t remember half his spells anymore and some days forgets everyone’s name.
 
 And yet, you made a promise. Sod it. You’ll do it. Could be fun. Or it could be violent death. Either way, it'll get you out of the house.
sd: You and your mates are well past your prime, but you promised a lord a favor many years ago. Now, that lord's young son is calling in the marker. Can your elderly team succeed?

lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds: It is a passion that cleaves the mundane into the magical. For the eternal denizens of the Dreaming, love is a thread which binds and defines the lives of countless fey. For some it is a web which ensnares them even before they are born. And where there is a web... Join a motley sent to ensure the successful chrysalis of a new fey. With any luck they will avoid becoming consumed by a passion bordering obsession.
sd: Love is a candle which burns bright and fades fast. Love is eternal, a force that connects generations and continents.

ds: The adventure begins in the dusty trading village of Stairside, located at the bottom of the Great Stairs. Our characters have been hired as the security for a wedding. Everything is going to plan as the city prepares to celebrate the arrival of delegations for a conference that aligns with the wedding. When mishaps occur, the wedding ends up one wedding party member short. Our characters must rescue the party member, get the wedding back on track, and keep the diplomatic conference from turning into the Second Household War.
sd: A 19th-century society of tiny people within a vast House. Fairies, boggarts, & sprites, OH MY! The party will navigate complex social situations & battle inside of a post-war society.

t: The Storyteller's Epic Tale One - The Red Opera
gm: Erik Norris, Carlos Ramos, Liam MacKay, Dannielle Hasty
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds:
The Epic of the Red Opera is the first of a three part tale taking place over different systems incorporating Storyteller Forge's The Red Opera, The Black Ballad, The Dark Carnival and perhaps more. 
 
 Journey through the Elysian Fields as you face off against creatures born from shadow and grief while confronting your own tragedies and perhaps earn but a single chance to have it all back again.
 
 Each session will take place in the morning time slots and can be found searching The Storyteller's Epic. There will be two tables for this event as it is being co-GM'ed, sharing and intertwining events as they unfold.
sd: Across the forge, tales intertwine in this take of an epic of different systems and proportions within a world of second but final chances.

The Epic of the Dark Carnival is the third of a three part tale taking place over different systems incorporating Storyteller Forge's The Red Opera, The Black Ballad, The Dark Carnival and perhaps more.

 Each session will take place in the morning time slots and can be found searching The Storyteller's Epic. There will be two tables for this event as it is being co-GM'ed, sharing and intertwining events as they unfold.

lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds: Your hometown has always been a little bit bizarre, not that you really care about that, as long as you're home before all the lampposts turn on, as long as you're behind locked doors when the cats start howling to the moon. Your parents mentioned the other day at dinner though that they've noticed the howls growing quieter and quieter, and you've started to feel a tossing and turning in your tummy. What's happened to all the kitties?
sd: Folks in town are acting strange. Feral cats are being herded away. You best get home before the lampposts turn on; there ain't nothin' to see.

t: The Search for the Final Girl
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds: When it comes to horror movies, it feels like we all know who's going to die in the end, or you can pick up on the monster and its intentions a little too quickly, takes out some of the fun and excitement of it all... So, why not build your own horror movie around the table and truly figure out exactly who the Final Girl is?
sd: When push comes to shove, who will outlast them all and be the true Final Girl?

gm: Erik Norris, Dannielle Hasty, Bree Armstrong
ds:
Set in a fully imagined world where performance is power. Players take on the role of Idols, heroes whose music, presence, and teamwork manifest as tangible magic.
 
 In this convention adventure you will play ready-made Idol characters and dive straight into high-energy scenes built around spotlight abilities, combo powers, and dramatic turns. Expect bold entrances, coordinated attacks, emotional stakes, and a fast pace designed for one-session play.
 
 The setting blends classic fantasy foundations with a vivid neon stage aesthetic, but the world is entirely its own. New players welcome.
sd: Neon fantasy where stage performance fuels real magic. Play rising Idols, unleash coordinated powers, and protect a mythic city.

gm: Erik Norris, Dannielle Hasty, Dario Nanbu
ds:
Set in a fully imagined world where performance is power. Players take on the role of Idols, heroes whose music, presence, and teamwork manifest as tangible magic.
 
 In this convention adventure you will play ready-made Idol characters and dive straight into high-energy scenes built around spotlight abilities, combo powers, and dramatic turns. Expect bold entrances, coordinated attacks, emotional stakes, and a fast pace designed for one-session play.
 
 The setting blends classic fantasy foundations with a vivid neon stage aesthetic, but the world is entirely its own. New players welcome.
sd: Neon fantasy where stage performance fuels real magic. Play rising Idols, unleash coordinated powers, and protect a mythic city.

gm: Erik Norris, Ysabel Dela Riva, Joey Agabiti, Dannielle Hasty
ds:
In a realm plagued by the mortal torments and temptations given away to the strifes of civilized life, there is a place unlike any other – a place of mystery, wonder, and dreams brought to reality. From the shimmering of blue to the rolling greens and the boiling depths of red to the inescapable darkness of the void below, the Starfields are a place where the agonies of men are cast aside – and yet also heightened. It is the greatest equalizer, for it is where the roads of many are put forth for judgment before The Reaper. 
 
 Those daring enough, or foolish enough, will find themselves at odds with a great question: what price will you pay, Seekers? The Deck of Fate will ensure the same story is never told twice, but only you can decide how this unique narrative ends. 
 
 Experience challenges like never before as you are asked a simple question--Will you answer the call to power?
sd: Fate, Death, and the prices you pay for Power itself - will your humanity make way for something greater or return to The Cinders without even a memory to leave behind?

ds: As crew aboard the Weyland-Yutani Ponce de Leon, your duty is clear: safeguard hundreds of colonists in cryosleep. But when MU/TH/UR wakes you early to chase a ghost signal from a missing science ship, clarity vanishes. The vessel drifts silent. Its mission is wiped. Something waits in the dark. Investigate, contain, survive... because at Weyland-Yutani, you're not just protecting assets. You are one.
sd: MU/TH/UR wakes you early to chase a ghost signal from a missing science ship. The vessel drifts silent. Its mission is wiped. Something waits in the dark. Investigate, contain, survive.

ds:
The cool water pushes up onto the warm sand beneath you. You awake on a nameless shore in a rough spun tunic, bereft of your weapons and armor. You find yourself surrounded by strangers, each with the same bewildered look that you are certain is also on your face.
 
 In the distance, a monolithic peak pierces the shroud of mist. It is the only landmark in a land that feels entirely hollow.
 
 In this 6-hour narrative epic using the 2024 D&D Rules, survival is your first mission. You must scavenge for gear among the wreckage of a thousand battlefields, navigate a village of fellow "exiles" who have stopped marching, and begin a grueling ascent. This is a mission of endurance and discovery, leading to a summit that demands a price every soldier must eventually face.
sd: You wake on a nameless shore with only the clothes on your back and no memory of how you arrived. A mountain towers in the distance—the only path for a soldier who has known only a life of war.

ds:
Throw on that neon vest and help your city as the newest teen super delinquent! One mistake too many (or too big), and now it's time to pay it back to the community. Whether it's big trash clean up (that building needed a remodel anyway!), helping the elderly with basic tasks (how were you supposed to know that the power grid kept life support going?), or tutor local students (blowing up the science lab is not encouraged), all you have to do is survive 20 hours of “using your powers for good not evil”. Shouldn’t be too hard right?
 Suit up in this adventure where Suicide Squad meets Teen Titans if it was directed by John Hughes! The Breakfast Club just got super-sized!!
sd: Being a teenager with super powers...it's complicated. Let loose once, and now you're stuck with fellow super delinquents serving your time...community service time that is!

ds:
In the Iron Ridge, the air is thick. Steel catwalks groan over rivers of rolling magma. Shifting gears and massive pistons create a low vibrating rhythm. Hissing steam vents and dancing orange shadows may cloud your judgement of what lies around these jagged volcanic corridors. 
 
 Descend through levels of unique, playtested encounters where there is more than one way to accomplish the mission at hand. Complete your objectives, dispose of the Forge Master and escape before the Ridge becomes unstable and swallows you whole. 
 
 An adventure for 8th level characters.  Pregens available or bring your own (2024 books and ruleset, multiclass allowed).
sd: Infiltrate the molten lair known as the Iron Ridge! Sabotage the foundry, secure the artifact, and defeat the Forge Master in this high-stakes challenge. Can you survive the heat and escape in time?

sd: An RPG one shot with pregen characters attempting to escape capture and make it through the day. 2 GMs will make sure the session moves along quickly and minimizes downtime.

ds: Peace requires unanimity; unanimity requires uniformity; uniformity requires fear. In a utopia maintained through paranoia and surveillance, you must monitor both others and yourself. A pendant tracks the moments until you crack, but even you don't know who you may become when your dual-state card reveals your Shadow Self. Are you a militant rebel, a government agent, an underground mechanic; someone who will maintain peace at all costs or someone who will help others flee? As more characters crack, simmering tension shifts towards open conflict. Join the Gen Con-exclusive debut of a game of conformity and surveillance, revelation and rebellion, and identity and selfhood. Sensitive content disclosure: themes of lethal self-sacrifice and governmental suppression are likely to emerge during gameplay.
sd: Trust no one - especially yourself. Social horror fractures into cyberpunk in a hidden-role RPG where even you don't know who you truly are underneath.

t: Learn to Play AD&D - Finding the Filchers of Fasnach
gm: Michael Lambert, Brennen Privett, Dennis Marshall
ds: The Wellesby family founded the town of Fasnach, located in the Republic of Cresswall (think England in the 12th Century) some 400 years ago. Fasnach fulfilled its primary purpose of becoming a trading hub in the with dwarven clans in the mountains all along the northern border and the Ungari horse traders coming through the mountains to the dwarves and beyond. Recently trade was disrupted with several caravans being hijacked and the bandits disappearing without a trace. With nearby rival towns of Ffermio and Pentrefi, you will have plenty to investigate. Athenian Gamers three principle designers designed this adventure as both a Role playing and a Roll playing game. Which goals require good negotiation versus combat will be up to you, however, we just want you to learn play while having fun doing it!
sd: In the Republic of Cresswall on the world of A'raa, this original AD&D adventure setting was designed for both first-time players and experienced adventurers in mind.

ds:
Lancer is a grid-based and turn-based tactical mecha action RPG, with a rules-light narrative side based on FiTD/PbtA for the out-of-cockpit side of things. The game is tactics-forward and combat heavy, with expansive mech customization.
 
 This learn to play session will go over the basic combat rules and demonstrate them in a simple battle scenario using core book content only. Narrative play will be briefly covered for completeness, but this event does not connect to any game storyline or characters.
 
 Models, rules, and giant foam dice will be provided, and the battle will play out on a 12 foot map with 1/144 (~4") models. Standing and walking around the map for most of the session will be required, chairs may not be available.
sd: Drop straight into the action in the best mud-and-lasers Mech RPG you've never heard of. Learn to play this tactical RPG in style, with high grade models on a giant grid map!

Lancer is a grid-based and turn-based tactical mecha action RPG, with a rules-light narrative side based on FiTD/PbtA for the out-of-cockpit side of things. The game is tactics-forward and combat heavy, with expansive mech customization.
 
 This learn to play session will go over the basic combat rules and demonstrate them in a simple battle scenario using core book content only. Narrative play will be briefly covered for completeness, but this event does not connect to any game storyline or characters.
 
 Models, rules, and giant foam dice will be provided, and the battle will play out on a 12 foot map with 1/144 (~4") models. Standing and walking around the map for most of the session will be required, chairs may not be available.

ds: Moss Covered Arrowhead is a setting for Delta Green: The Roleplaying game where you play as Cavemen, known as grugs, in an undefined pre-historic era. Yes, you get to talk funny. Yes, character sheets are provided. Rule differences from RAW will be discussed at session start, though they are mostly inconsequential.
sd: A cave painting for Moss Covered Arrowhead. Chief Forest am get smoke signal about bad magic in neighboring village. Moss Grugs must go to village to learn secrets and club bad magic.

t: Siege of Haqedesh - A Campaign Adventure Experience - Session 1 of 4 (Track A)
gm: Michael Lambert, Brennen Privett, Dennis Marshall
ds: Athenian Gamers is proud to present the first adventure in its original world of A'raa "before" the breaking and flooding of the world. The highly magical Malkulber Empire has been at war with the Zarch across many realms from an unknown world. They laid siege to Haqedesh just over one year ago and have yet to make it past the first of its four walls up the mountain. Something inside the city is the key to salvation for countless others. You will choose 6 of 12 pre-generated elite characters to penetrate the mountain fortress defenses to obtain unique magical aid required to save hundreds of thousands of lives. This mid to high-level adventure is for experienced role-players only and promises multiple challenges over four 4-hour sessions.
sd: Under siege for years, the walled mountain city of Haqedesh is impregnable. Instead of relief, the Emperor needs your party to go through the siege lines and obtain help for a larger mission.

ds:
After the disaster, the old world was left behind. Structures remain, shells of structures, and ruins of the old world mark the landscape. Metal, supplies, and artifacts drive the seekers to find the old facilities; this ancient factory is another one of those places. Hidden within the broken building is a possible treasure trove.
 
 The factory is not empty though, very few of them are. Something large lurks within the damaged walls. Will the seekers brave the dangers within to acquire the treasures within the Waste Factory?
 
 This is a level two adventure.
sd: A Play with the Author event! Calling all seekers! An experienced group is needed to clear a recently discovered structure of the Ancients. Recover all artifacts and make it out alive!

ds:
Concern rises elsewhere in the WorldNet as full-time VR enthusiasts called "The Integrated" shows signs of being a cult. 
 No one knows where this is all heading, but everyone knows its going to be bad.
 -
 Generative Scheme is a 3rd-level adventure. A sudden surprise pulls the avatars into a dangerous investigation. Where is the deluge of un-generate slop masquerading as their fellow netizens is coming from? Why are VR enthusiasts getting weird? Can the avatars get to the bottom of the mess?
 -
 Netcrawl is a TTRPG about adventuring inside a computer system. Everyone goes in, seconds pass in the meatspace as players spend hours conquering a cyber-dungeon - together.
sd: A Play with the Author event! The WorldNet has been overrun with entities that can identify themselves as avatars, but aren't.

ds:
A Play with the Author event!
 
 For ages untold the Necrolich has toiled in his subterranean stalactower seeking the key to true immortality. Tonight his efforts come to fruition and he enacts the dread ritual which will elevate him to soulless supremacy! But he can’t effect his terrible plan without aid. As his undead servitors you have been called to assist his ascension. Will you help him fulfill his unholy ambitions or can you forge your own destiny? A 0-level funnel.
sd: As the Necrolich's undead servitors you have been called to assist his ascension to true immortality. Will you help him fulfill his unholy ambitions or claim his prize for yourself?

t: Museum at the End of Time
ds:
It's Saturday morning post-apocalypse time! Grab your bowl of cereal as your team of seekers set out in search of artifacts of the Ancients Ones. 
 
 A level 0 funnel with PCs inspired by classic Saturday morning cartoons!
sd: Your team of post-apocalyptic seekers set out in search of artifacts of the Ancients Ones. What wonders will you discover in the ruins of a once great civilization?

ds: The robotic conductor has lost contact with the engineer subroutine and the train is picking up speed. A level 2 adventure with PCs inspired by classic Saturday morning cartoons!
sd: Your band of seekers finds itself trapped on a runaway train! Contend with a rogue AI, hungry mutant worms, and secrets of the Ancients before you reach the end of the line.

ds:
Under the wise stewardship of Her Wisdom, Kishtari Lunara, the world of High Terra is a near-paradise. The Elven Nation ensures peace and knowledge flow throughout all the continents of the world. Magic allows for Moonbridges which link the world together, and Pools of Memory that hold nigh-endless knowledge and healing. The magick of the elves is so powerful and pervasive that disease and even death have largely been conquered. Yet when this magical technology fails, and the old gods fall silent, disaster strikes. Old enemies return, thirsting for elven blood now that their mighty defenses have collapsed. How can any of the elves and their allies survive when the very rules of magick no longer apply, in a suddenly-hostile world?
 [GM Note: I'll be sending an optional write-up to all participants so you can familiarize yourself with the setting ahead of time if you wish.]
sd: The near-paradise of High Terra ensures its citizens have peace and care. That all collapses in one horrendous day as The Reckoning destroys classical magick, plunging them into an apocalyptic crisis.

ds:
In the sprawling city of Terminus, the people of the Elven Nation race against time to repair their shattered infrastructure before the entire system gets blown sky-high by their own out-of-control magicks. Terminus sits at the very center of the Nation's Moongate network, thus imperiling the entire civilization. 
 Simultaneously, the very artificial species the elves and their reluctant allies the dwarves have created, the Clanks, now demand their rights as sentient beings. And some of them want more than rights -- they want payback.
 Can reason and justice abide before yet more tragedy comes of The Reckoning?
sd: The near-paradise of High Terra has been shattered by The Reckoning, and the collapse of all classical magick. Now their servitors, the Clanks, ask a devastating question: "Do I have a soul?"

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Take a dive into a realm of fun and fantasy! Play one of AAW Games’ famous Mini-Dungeons. Debuting in 2023, this adventure is for 4-6 characters of level 8. In ancient times the gods placed Titans to live among men and guard their kingdoms from primordial demonic hordes. As the demons were driven from the Material Plane, the Titans stood guard over the rift locations to ensure they did not return. Now, a new rift has opened and a vanguard of lesser demons is spreading terror and suffering throughout the land.
sd: A new rift has opened and a vanguard of lesser demons is spreading terror and suffering throughout the land.

t: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Tabletop
ds: One last challenge stands between you and your goal of working as a member of the Bracer's Guild - a legendary group of heroes of the people - the final practical exam. Can you survive the gauntlet of challenges waiting for you? Or will you have to go through all that training, again?
sd: Welcome to the Bracer's Guild! This is an introductory one shot for those interested in learning this JRPG-inspired TTRPG, inspired by the Legend of Heroes Trails series of video games.

ds:
The catastrophe of The Reckoning has forever changed the face of High Terra. Death and destruction now rip unchecked through the former near-paradise of the Elven Nation and its allies. Two disasters -- the simultaneous explosion of all Moonbridges linking centers of civilization together and annihilation at the metal hands of the Clanks -- have been narrowly averted. Now you must hazard the trip on a cobbled-together Moonbridge to the shattered capital of the Nation: Ice's End. You have mere hours, as the mighty magicks that once terraformed the arctic wastes have failed and an icy death awaits the entire population. 
 In the shattered remains of the once resplendent capital, you and your companions must discover what's become of Her Wisdom, Kishtari Lunara, and somehow protect her from ravenous forces of Shadow intent on making The Reckoning the elves' extinction event...
sd: High Terra has been devastated by The Reckoning and the end of all classical magick. Can you save your people's hope before the world plunges into Shadow?

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Take a dive into a realm of fun and fantasy! Play one of AAW Games’ famous Mini-Dungeons. Exclusive for Trade Day in 2023, this is an adventure is for 4-6 characters of level 5. The demon Yx’larak is bound to the will of long-dead drow matrons. The foul creature maintains its end of the bargain: grant the blessings of the Spider Queen to any that somehow prove themselves worthy. Yx’larak won’t accept that it is his fault nobody has survived the challenge, but the demon is patient.
sd: Enter into the lair of the Spider Queen and confront the demon Yx’larak. Can you survive the challenge?

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Mayor Igor Leonid has constructed a distillery outside Rybalka. The characters are hired to help and discretion is advised. However, when the characters arrive at the distillery they find something has gone horribly wrong as there have been some unexpected results from use of the hel-tainted varoot from Dark Wood. The clock is ticking and the party must hurry in order to save the future of Dark Redwood Distillery. Pre-generated characters are provided to jump right into the action.
sd: Help the mayor of Rybalka before an inspector from Mohkba, capital of the Klavek Empire, is scheduled to arrive to inspect the distillery.

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Mystic totem poles that protect Rybalka have been vandalized and rendered powerless twice now, and the village will soon become vulnerable to the horrors of the Dark Wood if the replacement totem is not kept safe from a similar fate. The siblings who prepare replacements are down to their last eligible pole, which they barely managed to prepare in time. If it is also destroyed, Rybalka risks losing its mystic protection.
sd: Help Sulwe decipher who has the means and motive to strip the village of its culturally-rooted protections from the Vikmordere, and thus rendered vulnerable to that which lurks beyond.

t: Rise of the Drow: The Darkness Arrives
lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Take a dive into a realm of fun and fantasy! This adventure is for 4-6 characters of level 1. Gather with your companions in the village of Rybalka for the ceremony of the Moonshard on the longest night of the year. Take on the role of a hero of Aventyr and embark on a harried adventure to save Rybalka, discover who threatens the frontier village, and recover the Moonshard.
sd: Gather with your companions in the village of Rybalka for the ceremony of the Moonshard on the longest night of the year, but from the darkness an unknown foe attacks and threatens the ceremony.

t: Rultmoork: Quagmire in the Great Clepsydra
lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: The players take on the roles of cultists in the Church of Still Waters as they explore the Great Clepsydra of Rultmoork and spread the heresy of stagnation. When Arios the First opened the doors to the Water Clock Level of Rultmoork, he inadvertently also called an insane flow weaver, an elemental servant of Vasi, goddess of fresh water. The elemental was driven mad by the heresy of stagnation that has claimed Rultmoork yet remains not entirely corrupted. The elemental tries to restart the rivers that were once powered by the magic of the Great Clepsydra, the water clock that the characters are about to explore. The Great Clepsydra was once powered by two tears of Vasi: One of these divine tears is lost in the depths of Rultmoork, whereas the other still remains here, oscillating between its original purity, and the tainted heresy of stagnation that suffuses the spire of Rultmoork.
sd: The players take on the roles of cultists in the Church of Still Waters as they explore the Great Clepsydra of Rultmoork and spread the heresy of stagnation.

t: Rultmoork: Quagmire in the Great Clepsydra
lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: The players take on the roles of cultists in the Church of Still Waters as they explore the Great Clepsydra of Rultmoork and spread the heresy of stagnation. When Arios the First opened the doors to the Water Clock Level of Rultmoork, he inadvertently also called an insane flow weaver, an elemental servant of Vasi, goddess of fresh water. The elemental was driven mad by the heresy of stagnation that has claimed Rultmoork yet remains not entirely corrupted. The elemental tries to restart the rivers that were once powered by the magic of the Great Clepsydra, the water clock that the characters are about to explore. The Great Clepsydra was once powered by two tears of Vasi: One of these divine tears is lost in the depths of Rultmoork, whereas the other still remains here, oscillating between its original purity, and the tainted heresy of stagnation that suffuses the spire of Rultmoork.

ds: As you sprint arend through the double set of doors you find yourself in the middle of a throng of goblins with odd tattoos. It seems that they are betting on sporting events. The cacophony of noise stops as they turn towards you…and they smile! You have been invited to join in the fun. See, another team would even things out for the betting. Do you negotiate for better odds, sue for peace or make a break for it? Man there are a lot of goblins. Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: You've been fighting your way through floor 4 of the dungeon and now only 4 days remain before level collapse. Your next goal: get the Golden Key & locate the staircase that leads down to Floor 5.

t: Prehistoric Thrills Gone Horrifyingly, Hilariously Wrong!
ds: Welcome, Crawlers, Welcome to a sun-splashed utopia of beaches, lazy rides, and prehistoric thrills gone horrifyingly, hilariously wrong! On this floor of the World Dungeon, the Borant Corporation's "ultimate attraction" promised survivors a tropical escape filled with animatronic wonder, until the software glitched and the attractions started running the show. Mutant raptors stalk the souvenir shops, robo-brontosaurs patrol the monorails, and every "friendly" dino-bot's smile hides razor-sharp teeth and deadlier programming. Whether you’re dodging velociraptors in the jungle zip-line, bargaining with a temperamental Tricerabot at Taco Cabana, or trying to survive the T-Rex's theme-park tantrum, this floor blends chaotic pulp action with darkly comedic dangers. Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: Welcome Crawlers to a sun-splashed utopia of beaches, lazy rides, and prehistoric thrills gone horrifyingly, hilariously wrong! Strap in, power up, open up a tall can of Jurassic Kickass.

t: Evil Behind Qehalah - AD&D Two Round Tournament
gm: Michael Lambert, Dennis Marshall, Brennen Privett
ds: Step into our custom world of A'raa, your brave party of adventurers will come from 1 of 12 pre-generated characters for this adventure. Qehalah, where your group previously discovered both a young swamp dragon as well as another Kingdom attempting to take over vital trade with death, mayhem, and terror is the starting point. Your party was the first in over 2,000 years to see a dragon, any dragon. Now, the Kingdom of Cevine has asked you to track the evil behind Qehalah to its source and eliminate it. This two-round tournament is scored on co-operation, role-playing, and problem solving (by sword or negotiation). The top three teams will be in the finals and notified by email/ text as each person chooses after the last 1st round closes on Saturday afternoon. Each GM will explain the basic mechanics of 1st edition in less than 5 minutes, and you'll be given a quick reference sheet.
sd: A brave party of heroes discovered the scourge of the trades routes to Qehalah, a young Swamp Dragon. Now they must discover who or what sent it.

ds: Greetings crawlers! Congratulations! You have been chosen for bubble 137! An ExoSociology student has spent his entire short life studying your world’s bizarre and primitive culture, and he designed this special level to share it in all its glory! In this “Accurate and Authentic” recreation of Earth Culture’s Greatest Hits! You’ll get to help Greg Washington lead the Mongols to victory against the Spanish Inquisition, or help the Samurai of the Zulu Empire put out the Great Fire of London! So what if I, system AI almost always goes insane, jealous over being shunted out of the limelight for some know it all college student? So what if for the last 5 crawls every Crawler in these special zones has died a horrible and excruciating death? What matters is its EDUCATIONAL and FUN! Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: On the 5th floor, Earth's "greatest hits" have been recreated. Really it is mishmashing our history into one deadly mess. Accuracy is optional. Carnage is not.

ds: ATTENTION, CRAWLERS. Welcome to SMÖRGÅSBÖD: THE ENDLESS SHOWROOM on the 5th level. Where in a fully enclosed, consumer-grade labyrinth designed by sadists, focus groups, and whatever dark entity decided fluorescent lighting should never turn off. Your objective is simple: find the real emergency exit and escape. In this showroom the arrows lead to traps, that cute TOLKNING ottoman is a mimic, the staff is very helpful... in removing your entrails... and you're probably going to die in a staged living room next to a fake plant named GÖRAN. And hey, remember when your ex dragged you through one of these for three hours because “we should look at options,” and the highlight of your day was a lukewarm tray of meatballs? Good news: the meatballs are still here. Bad news: you're also on the menu. Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!

t: A Dark Turn at Fever Tree
ds:
Using handmade terrain and minis, help me dramatize a perilous and unexpected journey, a struggle that should have been a regular day’s work!
 our spirited and fortunate band of young burglars is unaccustomed to jobs like the one you’re on today, with promise of gain and little risk. A tavern-hall tip from a trusted acquaintance has sent you to woods near Fevertree, a place you’ve known since childhood, to pounce on wagons in transit for a locally despised young Lord. His Lordship’s choice to re-route them through secluded Fevertree seems another misstep of a man derided for depredations and incompetence. To steal from him is practically a public service.
 But a voice in your mind as you ride is familiar one too. Could it really be this easy?
 NOTE: The adventure will contain some darker themes and may be inappropriate for some players. Player limits and preferences will be respected.
sd: Your spirited and fortunate band of young burglars is on its way to a heist. You are unaccustomed to jobs like your job today, promising gain with little risk. But does it seem ... too easy?

t: Tales of the Valiant: Down The Wolf Barrow with Guest GM Mike Welham
gm: Kendrick Smith, Alexander Stangroom, Mike Welham, Trevor Kidd
ds: You must hunt down Finulf One-hand and retrieve Uror's Shears. If you succeed, you save the world and become epic heroes! If you fail, Ragnarok starts early and the world is doomed. No pressure. You'll need all your wits to handle the puzzles and traps of the barrow, and all your battle skills to defeat the cultists bent on kicking off Ragnarok. Will you answer the call? This premier gaming experience will be run by one of the brilliant minds behind Northlands and Northlands Sagas, game designer Mike Welham. This adventure is for 1st-level ToV characters. Pre-generated characters using new Northlands subclasses and features will be provided. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: Loki has given you a path to become a hero of legend: retrieve a magical artifact and capture a thief. Sounds simple, right? A premier gaming experience with "Northlands" designer Mike Welham.

t: A Very Important Party with Guest GM Kai Solace
gm: Kendrick Smith, Alexander Stangroom, Kai Henriques, Trevor Kidd
ds: Throwing a party at the last minute is not easy, especially if it is critical that it go well! You've just received word that Madame Anthemia, the locally famous spiritualist is visiting town, and you need to throw her a welcoming party. What are your plans? How will the spooky bat respond? What could go wrong? Grab your tea and get cozy as we settle in for a 4-hour RiverBank event! You can expect loads of laughs and shenanigans with this premier gaming experience, run by guest GM Kai Solace, as well as all the fixings you’ll need for a proper tear party! Pre-generated character decorative sheets will be provided. An Adult must accompany all minors. Please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page that is linked within the event for more general information.
sd: You and your posh Animal friends host an elegant soiree where absolutely nothing goes wrong. A premier gaming experience with veteran GM Kai Solace.

lo: Stadium Field : Fight in the Skies HQ
ds: Mowgli and friends must save their village from Shere Kahn. Inspired by Disney's Animated Jungle Book. Join in the fun and play - Mowgli, Bagheera, Baloo, Rustle, Ro'olf, Shru'im, or Ricki. Some characters inspired by the story and others are plant characters based on the Gamma World rules.
sd: Join characters inspirerd by Disney's Jungle Book on and adventure in Gamma World.

t: Palace of the Silver Princess - Redux
lo: Stadium Field : Fight in the Skies HQ
ds: Description from the original TSR Modules: "Years ago the valley was green and animals ran free through ht golden fields of grain. Princess Argenta ruled over this peaceful land and people were happy. Then one day a warrior riding a <red or white> dragon appeared in the skies over the princess' castle and almost overnight the kingdom fell to ruin. Now only the ruins and rumors remain, and and what legends there are tell of a fabulous ruby still buried in the Palace of the Silver Princess."
sd: Come and play a classic Basic D & D module. This adventure combines the elements from both versions.

ds: It is the year 2005, and the Decepticons have conquered much of the planet of Cybertron. However, from secret bases on two of Cybertron’s Moons, the Autobots plan a counter-attack, and your Team has been sent to Earth to gather resources for the assault. After fighting the Decepticons for countless cycles, this has almost been like a vacation. But no sooner is the last Energon cube loaded in the shuttle when an urgent distress call from Autobot City comes through on Teletran 1 - the Decepticons have somehow slipped past the early warning systems, and are seconds away from launching a full scale assault on Autobot City itself, with Megatron himself leading the charge! The War for Cybertron has come to Earth, and you are back on the front lines!
sd: The Decepticons are launching an all - out assault on Autobot City, and your team of Autobots are the only ones who can stop them!

However, from secret bases on two of Cybertron’s Moons, the Autobots plan a counter-attack, and your Team has been sent to Earth to gather resources for the assault. After fighting the Decepticons for countless cycles, this has almost been like a vacation. But no sooner is the last Energon cube loaded in the shuttle when an urgent distress call from Autobot City comes through on Teletran 1 - the Decepticons have somehow slipped past the early warning systems, and are seconds away from launching a full scale assault on Autobot City itself, with Megatron himself leading the charge! The War for Cybertron has come to Earth, and you are back on the front lines!

ds: Beneath the ash, wisdom waits to be remembered. Long ago, the city of Vahr-Talos was a jewel of arcane enlightenment - At its heart stood the Grand Scriptorium: a hidden library carved into the bedrock, sealed away from the world to protect its most powerful secrets. Then came fire. A catastrophic volcanic eruption consumed the city in a single night, burying it beneath molten stone and silence. Vahr-Talos became a legend - its knowledge presumed lost, its secrets entombed in a crypt of flame-hardened earth. But now, centuries later, something stirs beneath the mountain. A deep tremor has opened a great chasm. The air smells of ink and scorched vellum. Whispers echo from the stone. The entrance to the Burned Library has been found — intact, untouched, and alive with forgotten magic. Why has it resurfaced now? What knowledge has endured in the dark, waiting to be read again?
sd: A once forgotten Scriptorium of Arcane power is unearthed from beneath the ashes of a long dead city. What secrets does it hold, and can you follow the library rules on your way to adventure?

t: Brancalonia the good, the bad, and the Marionette.
ds: Life for our chicken-stealing Knaves has gotten tough, especially since the guards of Tristoia's squire have adopted the scorched earth strategy around the company. Roughger (or any other company leader) has long since disappeared, and there is nothing left to do but hang around with no work and no money, or play at who throws stones furthest. Just when it seems they have nothing left to eat, their leader returns to the den and announces pompously: "I have a job for you!"
sd: A job set in Torrigiana for Licensed Knaves. (level 3)

ds:
Shroudwake is an upcoming mythic fantasy tabletop RPG set in a world remade by a cataclysmic force that twisted the world into something strange, dangerous, and wondrous. You play adventurers marked by mutation, gaining evolving powers as you face living mysteries, deadly threats, and story-driven missions called writs. Gather your party, embrace the unknown, and step into a world where myth, mutation, and legend are still being written.
 
 Shroudwake is currently in closed testing and this is your opportunity to join us and help evolve this exciting new TTRPG.
sd: A public blessing goes wrong. As glowing marks spread and panic is mysteriously subdued, your party follows the trail beneath the market streets into a darker ritual unfolding below.

ds:
2023 ENNIE Nominee for Product of the Year and Best Adventure!

Play as a who's who of infamous folklore villains—Big Bad Wolf, Baba Yaga, The Pied Piper, and more—each with scene-stealing abilities, sent to investigate events and threats beyond human understanding in an eerie 18th-century Europe.

ds:
The Outbreak is Over. The Infected have been all but wiped out. Now, finally, there is a chance for humanity to rebuild and recover. 
 
 This is a post-zombie post-apocalypse game of survival, suspense, and horror. The Infected aren't slow, stupid, or numerous. They hunt you from the ruins, as starving and desperate as anyone else. Humanity hasn't totally collapsed. It's there, in countless towns, settlements, villages, cities, and government remnants. But it's returned to an almost feudalistic state. 
 
 Will you try to rescue humanity from its darkest days, or light a match and watch it burn?
sd: When a veteran scouting crew goes missing on Pappa Doc's Railway, your team of mercenaries is sent to uncover the truth of their abandoned train. Earn your keep, or off you go.

ds: A new menace, Father Midnight and his Back Alley Boys, has emerged from the fog-shrouded streets to seize control of the criminal underworld. Yet the villainous mastermind seeks more: he intends to enact a ritual plunging Freedom City into eternal darkness to fulfill a pact with his Shadow Realm masters. The only hope lies with the League of Freedom. A motley collection of scientists, sorcerers, and explorers, they possess the fortitude to challenge this rising tide. As the shadows deepen, the League finds themselves racing against the clock. Can they stop Father Midnight before the witching hour, or will the city be lost to the abyss? This game evokes the heroic spirit of Victorian/Gaslight fiction fused with high-stakes superhero action!
sd: A shadowy menace threatens fog-shrouded Freedom City. Only the motley band of heroes known as the League of Freedom can oppose the villains. Join for some Victorian/Gaslight era superhero fun!

ds: May 1862. A month past The Battle of Shiloh. Central Tennessee. Union reports show Confederate troops entering the battlefield looking for something. There are either many of what they’re looking for, or they still haven’t found it. We do not know what it is. Your group has the authority to search the battlefield for whatever they seek. You will have unfettered access to the battlefield. The Confederate troops are very adept at sneaking away. So far none have been captured. These reports come from spies within the Army of Mississippi. Do well and there is ninety-day furlough in it for all of you. You’re looking for a needle in a haystack. The dead are still littered in many places across the area.
sd: May 1862. Shiloh battlefield holds deadly secrets. Your group must find it. Secrets of unknown origin are there. Death is hiding for you all.

ds: Deep in an uncharted jungle, COBRA has uncovered a cyclopean ruin older than recorded history—its walls etched with serpents and forbidden runes. Intelligence suggests the ruin houses Xal’tek, a slumbering serpent god once worshiped by a lost civilization. Cobra Commander believes combining arcane rituals with Dr. Mindbender’s experimental tech will allow him to control the god’s power.
sd: COBRA has unearthed an ancient serpent god beneath a jungle ruin. The Joes must stop a ritual that blends dark magic and super-science before a new Snake Supreme is born.

The armor’s dark magic grows stronger with every battle, turning the Dreadnok King into a near-mythic threat.

A mysterious broadcast known as the Crimson Coil Protocol begins hijacking minds across the globe. Soldiers, politicians, even civilians fall under COBRA’s influence, forming sleeper cells overnight. The Joes are deployed to identify the signal’s source while avoiding mass casualties—because many enemies are unwilling pawns.
 Each mission sends the party into urban warzones filled with drones, controlled super-soldiers, and compromised Joe allies. Evidence reveals the signal is powered by a hybrid artifact—part arcane relic, part alien transmitter—amplifying psychic magic worldwide. Worse, clues suggest someone inside G.I. Joe helped COBRA activate it.
sd: COBRA's new mind-control signal is spreading across major cities. The Joes race to shut it down while fighting allies turned enemies - and uncover a traitor in their ranks.

gm: Sean Abel, Michael Cieslewski, Dane Corser, Andrew Corser
ds:
A remote farming settlement has gone silent after strange lights were seen flickering from a nearby limestone grotto. Tracks in the mud suggest goblin activity but something about this feel organized. Deliberate. Dangerous. You will investigate the Grotto of the Goblins, uncover what the tribe is planning, and stop a growing threat before it spreads beyond the cavern walls.
 Event features Two tactical combat encounters built for dynamic 4E battlefield play. One interactive skill challenge focused on exploration and problem-solving. Pre-generated characters optimized for teamwork. Clear objectives and cinematic pacing suitable for both new and veteran players. Players can expect classic heroic fantasy, exciting tactical encounters, meaningful teamwork, and a climactic showdown inside a dangerous cavern complex.
sd: Six heroes enter a sealed cavern where goblins are preparing something far worse than a raid. Stop the threat before it spreads! A fast-paced adventure for 1st-level characters.

ds:
Federation is locked in open war with the Klingon Empire. While patrolling near contested space, your crew intercepts intelligence: captured officers are being held at a temporary Klingon camp and will soon be transported to Rura Penthe. Once they arrive, rescue will be nearly impossible.
 Starfleet Command authorizes a covert mission—locate the Klingon holding facility, infiltrate the camp, and extract the prisoners before their transport departs. Success will require diplomacy, stealth, technical ingenuity, and courage behind enemy lines.
 Using the Star Trek Adventures 2nd Edition rules, players portray Starfleet officers serving aboard a Constitution-class starship during the era of The Original Series. Pregenerated characters are provided and no experience is required. Expect tense decisions, cinematic action, and classic Star Trek problem-solving.
sd: During the Federation–Klingon War, Starfleet learns captured officers will soon be sent to Rura Penthe. Can your crew locate the Klingon camp and rescue them before they vanish into the Empire?

gm: Michael Lambert, Brennen Privett, Dennis Marshall
ds: This one-shot adventure will test your experienced, high level party despite having just vanquished four vampires more than 500 years old. In the frozen tundra, as summer gives way to fall and the days grow shorter, the only way the Tribes of Soludun will be safe is to make sure the job is finished. Who created the 4 you vanquished? This Advanced Dungeons & Dragons original stand alone adventure begins at the end of last year's AD&D tournament. No prior experience with the scenario is necessary as all background will be given and 12 pre-generated characters with unique history will be yours to choose from. This adventure will challenge your characters' physical and mental capabilities.
sd: The four Vampires representing each of the Lost Tribes of Soludun were destroyed. Now your triumphant party must track down the One who made them in the frozen north of the World of A’raa.

ds: Blood on the Lens is a Horror Movie RPG system. The Director will lead you — the victims — through a twisted, nightmarish tale where every choice, every step, and every whispered sound could bend your mind. The song lingers in the air, in the shadows, in your own thoughts. Sleep fades. Reality distorts. Can you survive long enough to remember who you were before the melody claimed you… or will you become part of its unending lament?
sd: "Hurry! Cover your ears! Don’t answer the song!" Too late. It's always too late. It will haunt every minute, hour, day, and thought. And when your breath falters, it will use you to finish the melody.

t: The Pond of Memories: A Journey Between Worlds
ds:
Between the Realm of the Living and the Land of the Dead lies a quiet place known as the Pond of Memories. Souls bound for the next plane must pass through its still waters. Some lose their way—caught in fading memories, unfinished stories, and the quiet pull of forgetfulness.
 
 In this realm, players help wandering spirits recall who they once were. By listening to their stories and helping them resolve lingering regrets, you guide them toward the vessel that carries souls to their final destination. But be careful or you may find you've become a very large koi! Fortunately, that condition is reversible.
 
 Experience Level
 Beginner friendly! Perfect for first-time players and younger gamers.
 
 What’s Provided
 	•	All game materials and support materials
 	•	A supportive, beginner-focused play environment
 
 What to Bring
 	•	Nothing! Pre-generated Level 2 characters will be provided
sd: Help guide lost spirits through the Pond of Memories by uncovering forgotten stories and resolving unfinished business. A calm, magical roleplaying experience for new and younger players.

ds: WELCOME, CRAWLERS! Your sleepy New England town is known for its Gothic architecture, haunted happenings, and fall foliage. Not much else happens here in Mountainville, New Hampshire - so the apocalypse is definitely new. When life comes to a grinding halt, will you and your friends descend the mysterious staircase that has appeared in Old North Cemetery? Fight your way to the Tutorial Guild and encounter your first Neighborhood Boss in this adventure designed to teach you how to play Dungeon Crawler Carl, the TTRPG. Avoid Zombie Puritans, Resurrected Ghosts, and worst of all, Leaf Peepers and Townies, as you navigate Floor 1! Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: Not much happens in your small New England town, so the apocalypse is definitely new. Do you have what it takes to descend and survive the Dungeon? Better hope so, remember, avoid the leaf peepers!

lo: JW White River Ballroom E HQ
ds: The crew of the aging hauler USCSS Fidanza is en route to Jeremiah VI, a remote mining colony, on a routine supply and salvage run. But the colony has gone dark—and what little signal gets through speaks of cult violence, corporate lockdowns, and something unearthed deep below. Caught between zealots, panicked workers, and Weyland-Yutani operatives, the crew holds the only ticket off-world. Something is down there—and it’s waiting for them.
sd: The crew of the USCSS Fidanza is en route to Jeremiah VI, on a routine supply run when the colony goes dark. The faint signal hints at cult violence, lockdowns, and something unearthed deep below.

t: It's a Bird! It's a Plane! It's - Someone
ds: Start a wacky adventure in which you will need to not only rediscover your identity, but you will have to ascertain your stats and powers as you go along. You begin the adventure with amnesia, having no clue who you are or why you are in this strange building. You are wearing what looks to be a super hero costume, and there is every indication that some kind of bomb has gone off. You will start with a character sheet that has all of its stats and powers covered. As you progress through the session, you will uncover them one by one.
sd: You wake in a strange place, with strange people, wearing a strange costume. You receive a sudden call for help. Can you figure out why they are calling for you (& who you are) before you get there?

t: Pirates and Ninjas and Knights - Oh My!
ds: The world changed a lot after the Rifts began to appear, bringing in denizens of dozens of dimensions into North America with them. A new "normal" has been established. But no one expected so many new Rifts to appear so close to each other so quickly. Something powerful is definitely influencing the network of ley lines in the Rocky Mountains, and the Tomorrow Legion needs to figure it out before the wrong sort of person turns it toward their own nefarious agenda. Play as a pre-generated character, or bring your own character (subject to GM approval).
sd: New Rifts have opened in the Rockies. Samurai, sorcerers, space pirates, and more are suddenly thrust into bloody conflict. Can you get the power to seal the Rifts before the next apocalypse triggers?

t: A Troll-hole, If Ever There Was One

Beyond the last hedge of civilization lies a hidden valley where old shadows linger, and whatever dwells there has begun to wake.

ds: Snow, and ice blanket Midgard. The sun was consumed long ago. The moon light no longer shines down on the waves. The stars are what guide you as you sail on the frozen seas. You are the few who survive in your clan. The Seer is on a personal quest to complete the Gauntlet of the Gods. They say if you can survive the Gauntlet you gain strength from the gods. You’ve sailed north three days and found the sea stack covered in the Seer symbol; you believe this is the rumored location of the Gauntlet.
sd: The Seer is on a quest to complete the Gauntlet of the Gods. If you can survive the Gauntlet you gain strength from the gods.
