ds: April 15, 1996. Your cell parachutes into a remote island to investigate an isolated tribe's unusual religious practices. A-Cell wants you to determine if this cult poses a supernatural threat.

ds: Eons ago, a primitive war-wizard ruled this land with the aid of barbarian tribes and strange creatures from beyond the stars. When his mortal form was close to expiration, his alien allies instructed him to seal himself away in a protected tomb. Within the tomb, the war-wizard could then use astral projection to travel the stars beyond our world. He intended to return later to take possession of his mortal body, which his spirit could do when the stars were properly aligned. However, the war-wizard’s extraplanar adventures did not go as planned. Now his body sits perfectly preserved in the tomb he built, protected by enchantments and the remains of his barbarian hordes. If these defenses can be bested, the treasures within are ripe for the taking…
sd: The classic DCC 0-level funnel adventure! You're no hero. You're an adventurer: a reaver, a cutpurse, a heathen-slayer, a tight-lipped warlock guarding long-dead secrets.

ds: WELCOME, CRAWLERS! Your sleepy New England town is known for its Gothic architecture, haunted happenings, and fall foliage. Not much else happens here in Mountainville, New Hampshire - so the apocalypse is definitely new. When life comes to a grinding halt, will you and your friends descend the mysterious staircase that has appeared in Old North Cemetery? Fight your way to the Tutorial Guild and encounter your first Neighborhood Boss in this adventure designed to teach you how to play Dungeon Crawler Carl, the TTRPG. Avoid Zombie Puritans, Resurrected Ghosts, and worst of all, Leaf Peepers and Townies, as you navigate Floor 1! Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: Not much happens in your small New England town, so the apocalypse is definitely new. Do you have what it takes to descend and survive the Dungeon? Better hope so, remember, avoid the leaf peepers!

gm: Dannielle Hasty, Erik Norris, Abby Peterson
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds: It's up to you to find out how, why, and where Alice has gone. Experience interactions in which players will navigate personal dynamics, local faces, and explore some pretty heavy content as they attempt to find Alice. This game session is intended for mature audiences as Content Warnings related to: Substance abuse, Power Dynamics, Police Corruption, Death, and Manipulation. To interact with the game, players will log onto a local discord server as clues, mysteries, and dynamics will be explored both above and below the table.
sd: Hushed whispers sweep through the town as rumors swirl. A tragedy which befell the locals all asking the same question: Who took her?

ds: The Sword and Crown is an event unrivaled in Anuirean politics. Every five years, rulers come from across the land to renew friendships, cement alliances, and provoke their enemies with poisoned words and sharpened swords. Wheels turn within wheels, and plots abound. It's politics as usual in Anuire. Except this conclave is different. Not only is it taking place in your kingdom, but before the festivities can even commence, someone wages an attack on Prince Avan and kidnaps his daughter. And to whom do the regents turn to rescue the princess? The players, of course!
sd: From the Birthright setting! 5th level. Characters are pre-made, just show up and play!

ds: Eons ago, a primitive war-wizard ruled this land with the aid of barbarian tribes and strange creatures from beyond the stars. When his mortal form was close to expiration, his alien allies instructed him to seal himself away in a protected tomb. Within the tomb, the war-wizard could then use astral projection to travel the stars beyond our world. He intended to return later to take possession of his mortal body, which his spirit could do when the stars were properly aligned. However, the war-wizard’s extraplanar adventures did not go as planned. Now his body sits perfectly preserved in the tomb he built, protected by enchantments and the remains of his barbarian hordes. If these defenses can be bested, the treasures within are ripe for the taking…
sd: The classic DCC 0-level funnel adventure! You're no hero. You're an adventurer: a reaver, a cutpurse, a heathen-slayer, a tight-lipped warlock guarding long-dead secrets.

ds: WELCOME, CRAWLERS! This adventure plunges your party of six fledgling Crawlers into Level 1 of the Earth-dungeon. A gargantuan, retro elementary school classroom, where everyday objects have become monumental hazards and school supplies are sentient, aggressive monsters. It's a darkly comedic homage to humanity's "innocent" past, designed for maximum viewer entertainment and Crawler despair. Your party's challenge is to navigate this scaled-up, weaponized playground, overcome its bizarre guardians, and survive long enough to find the exit to the next level. Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: Survive a giant, weaponized classroom! Fight explosive crayons and the Honor Roll Gargoyle for a galactic audience. Can you entertain the fans, or will you be recycled into biomass?

ds:
Since time immemorial you and your people have toiled in the shadow of the cyclopean ruins. Of mysterious origins and the source of many a superstition, they have always been considered a secret best left unknown by the folk of your hamlet.
 
 But now something stirs beneath the crumbling blocks. Beastmen howl in the night and your fellow villagers are snatched from their beds. With no heroes to defend you, who will rise to stand against the encircling darkness? The secrets of Chaos are yours to unearth, but at what cost to sanity or soul?
 
 An introductory adventure for the DCC RPG, Sailors on the Starless Sea pits players against the legacy of the Chaos Lords and their corrupted hordes. Delving beneath the crumbling ruins, the characters discover ancient crypts, a starless sea, and an ancient ziggurat, where death and treasure await in equal measure!
sd: A mob of 0-level villagers must descend into ancient ruins to confront an ancient evil, facing horrors, and cosmic secrets.

ds:
Come play a 0-level funnel for DCC RPG!
 
 The Lady in Blue, a mysterious figure of cosmic power, enlists a band of simple peasants for a strange task. They are to follow an invisible bridge until they arrive at a hole in the sky – and then jump through. Death awaits all but the bravest, strongest, and luckiest, but the Lady offers a reward beyond all the riches of the world: the chance to change the very stars these peasants were born under, and thus change their destiny.
sd: A great introductory adventure by the great Brendan LaSalle. Peasants born under the "wrong" star are beckoned by a cosmic entity to journey to a portal in the sky to alter their fate.

ds: It's not often one entertains Nazgul from Mordor. Especially with a full scale incursion into your fortress going on. How embarrassing! And you call yourself powerful dark lords?

ds: Kingsdale, PA 101. A newly formed group of artifact hunters, looking to score somefame and fortune as well to be able to thumb their nose at the Coalition. They find a lead to an auction taking place for tonight! First, they’ll need to get that map, one way or another, before getting out of town to the map’s location. Behind the scenes, several plots stir - there’s more going on with the auction and the vault itself than the hunters realize…
sd: A group of artifact hunters are tipped off about a map to an unopened Pre-Rifts vault, but time is short as it’s to be auctioned off! What’s inside the unopened vault is another matter entirely.

t: A Fairly Odd Tale - Wizard Van
ds:
This event will take place in the Wizard Van!
 
 When your party is sent to parley with a mysterious witch you assume it will be a simple fetch quest. But now you've been sucked into a crazy book filled with monsters and characters from half-remembered stories. Will you survive the strange candy house, make it to the top of the beanstalk, solve the riddle of the door, and find your way back home? It's time to rewrite the ending!
sd: Come play in the Wizard Van in this epic Play with the Author Event! You find yourself stuck in a book of half-remembered tales! Can you survive long enough to create a new tale?

t: The Pull of the Blade - Wizard Van
ds: Following the launch of The Discovery of the Doomweaver from third-party publisher Death Guaranteed Games, this will be a playtest by the author for its follow-up adventure in the Six Blades of Calisdoom series. The Pull of the Blade features a classic "quest from a tavern" adventure featuring puzzles, great NPCs, and unique combat. This event will take place inside the Wizard Van!
sd: Come play in the Wizard Van! This is a Play with the Author event! A blade with a will of its own draws heroes into blood, prophecy, and ruin. Answer its call - or pay the price.

ds:
O-level gigs are get rich schemes filled with danger and black ICE. Level up or derezz.
 -
 "THE INTERNET IS A DUNGEON
 You are coherent data traveling at the speed of light, a digital avatar searching for computerized information. 
 There is something hidden in the virtual realms, and you shall hack it!"
 -
 Netcrawl is a TTRPG about adventuring inside a computer system. Everyone goes in, seconds pass in the meatspace as players spend hours conquering a cyber-dungeon - together. This will take place inside the Wizard Van!
sd: Come play in the Wizard Van! You're zeroes. The only chance left is breaking into a Zipportunity branch and hijack some glitzies. You got four trusty(?) applications and nothing left to loose.

t: Hundred Year Heist: The Black Sea - Wizard Van
ds: Join treasure hunter Captain Jacques "The Barnacle" Braek'wind on a harrowing expedition in the midst of a vast inland sea where treasure from shipwrecks piles up into an island that emerges from the waves once every century when an uncanny storm freezes over the water, clearing a path to allow anyone with the gumption to make the walk across to fortune and glory! This will take place in the Wizard Van!
sd: Come play with the Director of 5e Development in the Wizard Van! Join our own Chris Lindsay as you explore the dangerous wreckage for sunken treasure!

ds: Welcome crawlers! Because that's what you are now: crawlers! Don't know what that means? Well, you just entered a weird doorway after the entire world flattened and likely killed everyone you know. What a glorious day to be alive, am I right? The Tutorial Guild is right ahead of you, so go ahead and try your best to keep surviving! It’s a new season and a new dungeon, and you are the star attraction! Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: You've entered the dungeon after the world flattened and everyone you know is likely dead. But not you! Now head into the tutorial guild and try to keep surviving!

t: Danger in the Air - Wizard Van
ds:
In this funnel townsfolk will set out in search of riches beyond their wildest dreams. A jelly covered creature, larger than most buildings in town, is slowly making its way across the countryside. Its long tentacles are dragging behind it rending the ground and destroying trees and buildings. The strange thing is that this jelly ball is spitting treasure! I wonder if i could climb one of those tentacles...
 This event will take place in the Wizard Van!
sd: Come play in the Wizard Van! Investigate a massive, dead, jellyfish like creature hovering above your town. Where could this abomination have come from and why is there treasure falling from it!

ds: The heroes must face a new horror from Castle Whiterock bent on reigning terror and leaving a path of destruction… Welcome to the 7th chapter of the 2026 Organized Play Program! Create a character, or grab one of our pre-generated characters and join us to explore the secrets of Castle Whiterock.
sd: The mission is clear. "Find a forgotten place of forgetting that's forever fixed betwixt hither and farther." Simple - right?!

ds: Welcome crawlers! Because that's what you are now: crawlers! Don't know what that means? The Tutorial Guild is right ahead of you, so go ahead and try your best to keep surviving! It’s a new season and a new dungeon, and you are the star attraction! Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!

 Set in Shadow of Etrophia: The Shattered Empire.
sd: An adventure for pregenerated characters with a mix of derring-do, investigation, and role-playing, by Jonathan Fox.

sd: The war for Aereth has begun, and you're stuck in the Maze. The key to victory is in your grasp, but the lock couldn't be further away. Escape or face annihilation.

ds: The Magocracy of Purdun suffered greatly on the Day of the Dead. The Blue Council was utterly decimated, and the Yellow Council-- composed of functionaries, scholars, teachers, and bureaucrats-- had to rise to the occasion. Now the demons have been driven far away and the nation itself is safe enough, but its long time mainland colonies? Not so much. You, as young members of the Yellow Council, have to enter the ruins of the former port city of Softwaves and find the thief who took the Singing Stone from the royal palace. One way or another, you must get it back.
sd: An adventure for pregenerated characters with a mix of derring-do, investigation, and role-playing, by Reynolds C. Jones.

ds: Events that have been put in motion over 3000 years ago are converging to a final moment. Will your group avert the destruction of the Sun and Moon?
sd: Events that have been put in motion over 3000 years ago are converging to a final moment. Will your group avert the destruction of the Sun and Moon?

ds:
The entourage of a landless noble faces difficult prospects-- little
 opportunity and less respect. Unless, of course, the noble can impress
 one of the great thanes or earls who could grant land, status, and
 prosperity. That's worth burying your differences and working together
 for, isn't it?
sd: A game for pregenerated characters with a mix of role-playing, adventure, and problem solving in a setting very loosely based on early medieval Wales. By Adam Strong-Morse.

ds:
You are all poppets. You have been around the Imperial Theater in the provincial capital of Crestonport for years. You are in fact, dusty old poppets, but now children are being snatched off the streets of the city and disappearing. You know where they are being held, though, beneath the theater itself. Who can you tell? The Empire doesn't believe in magic, so it certainly would know you do not exist. You guess you will have to rescue the children yourself, before their captors do the worst to them.
 
 Set in Shadow of Etrophia: The Shattered Empire.
sd: An adventure for unusual pregenerated characters with an emphasis on role-playing and investigation in a steampunk fantasy world. By Reynolds Jones.

ds: Many young Royal Navy officers view an assignment to Malta, headquarters of the Mediterranean Fleet, as very nearly a vacation in paradise. And of course there are the young women (and their chaperones) of the "Fishing Fleet"--women of gentle birth hoping to find a dashing husband. Surely the ancient cyclopean ruins only add to Malta's picturesque beauty.
sd: A role-playing heavy horror adventure set in the mid-nineteenth century. By Adam Strong-Morse

ds: Experience this game that is intuitive, encourages teamwork and is filled with opportunities to make dynamic, meaningful choices. It features a four action point system and makes what number you roll on d20 really matter. In this adventure, you’ll join forces with your compatriots to protect your land and your way of life from a growing existential threat. Will you become known as one of the great Guardians of the Mother Tree?
sd: Immerse yourself in a time when magic, ecology and society were woven together to encourage all to thrive. But harmony is under threat. You must help preserve the great mother and your way of life.

ds: This event is a point-based tournament where players compete in multiple arena events throughout the 4-hour session. The highest-scoring gladiators fight in a no-holds-barred competition. The winner is crowned the 2026 Arena Champion! All players receive prizes, rewards, and a lucky few receive trophies. 5th-level pregens provided.
sd: Enter the world of Athas & face the fires of the crimson sun as you enter the famed gladiatorial arenas to battle one another for glory, survival, & the favor of the crowd.

t: Tales of the Valiant: Progeny of Blood with Guest GM Omega Jones
gm: Kendrick Smith, Alexander Stangroom, Trevor Kidd
ds: Become a Night Hunter and unravel the mystery that haunts the village of Thrushdale. What you learn will determine the fate of a young boy and blur the lines between monster and man. This premiere gaming experience is for 3rd-level Tales of the Valiant characters and will be run by actual play performer and actor Omega Jones (Oops! All Himbos, Shadows Over Baldur’s Gate) and will include a immersive terrain, minis, and condition rings. Pre-generated characters will be provided. An Adult must accompany all minors. Please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page that is linked within the event for more general information.
sd: Step into a realm where ancient whispers stir, shadows lengthen, and heroes must hunt the night - or be consumed by it. A premier gaming experience with actual play performer Omega Jones (CritBard).

t: Dark Sun Special: Assault on the Golden Tower
ds: This is a multi-table special from the Dark Sun: Echoes of the Tyrant storyline from Athascon. Pregenerated characters of levels 3-9 in tier-appropriate tables. 4-person per table minimum. All players receive a special Dark Sun themed reward. Keep Hope Alive!
sd: The Golden Tower is under siege! A secret cult moves to revive Tyr’s fallen sorcerer-king. Race through shadowed halls, clash with deadly foes, & stop a ritual that could doom the Free City forever!

t: Survive Your Night At The Lake By Any Means Necessary
ds:
This game revolves around themes of survival, isolation, and psychological strain. Challenges will force you to think quickly, work with—or against—your companions, and confront the unsettling truth that no one is ever safe. Every decision can ripple through the group, and every failure feeds the darkness.
 
 The game is designed with 3 to 6 players, including a DM (Den Mother), in mind and features a bespoke system designed by Quinn Blackwell, the Tug of War system. That promotes players to use token-based gameplay to help determine who is driving the story.
 
 This is a horror game not suitable for all audiences. Player discretion is advised.
sd: In this game, players navigate a remote setting filled with horrors & the threat of betrayal: whether by your fears, friends or forces of evil. The Lake remembers every sin you try to bury.

ds: 7th-level pregenerated characters are provided and available on the Athascon Discord. Previous adventures need not be played, but make for a more cohesive storyline experience.
sd: Delve into the Reavers of the Silt Sea campaign. Search for an ancient being infused by the elements that may be able to assist you in gathering what is needed to finally face the Silt Queen head-on.

t: Dark Sun Organized Play: RSS-11 Silt Queen's Vengeance
ds: 8th-level pregenerated characters are provided and available on the Athascon Discord. Previous adventures need not be played, but make for a more cohesive storyline experience.
sd: Delve into the Reavers of the Silt Sea campaign. At last, you venture into the floating fortress of the Silt Queen's enclave to stop her evil machinations as she attempts to rival the sorcerer-kings!

t: Robin Hood & His Merry Men Against The World
ds:
Absentee kings, sadistic aristocrats, and parasitic officials. Luckily for the people of the realm, there are people like you. Whether you were once a peasant, a wandering player, a knight, or even a hermit, you're an outlaw now resisting unjust laws and protecting those the law won't.
 
 The game uses a short lifepath character creation, exploring where each member of the band came from before finding themselves living among the outlaws of the woods. The game uses a 2d6 resolution system adapted from Traveller, Barbaric, and Tunnel Goons.
sd: This is a game of outlaws and arcana set in a fantastical version of 13thC England. Inspired by modern Robin Hood fantasy stories, the Robin of Sherwood TV series, and medieval outlaw ballads.

t: West Texas Werewolves Defend Against Late 90's American Horrors
ds:
Hattie, Texas, 1991: A nowhere town between low peaks, mesquite-covered hills, and dried-out oil fields. Just 900 residents, 200 inmates, and one pack of werewolves.
 
 Like a lot of little towns in the hills between Abilene & San Angelo, Hattie is deeply implicated in the problems of both the 1990s and the 2020s: American militarism, corporate prisons, & the carceral state. Its town fathers sold its soul for pork barrel and graft, but what they got in return were monsters. Hattie needs heroes, and in Silver Age, it gets heroes the town's respectable citizens would never choose and could never deserve.
 
 From the Silver Palace Roadhouse on the north side of 270 to the boarded-up remains of the little old cinema near the head of Porter Trail, this little town and its pack of wolves only have one lunar month to make things right.
sd: This game is about werewolves & the towns they protect—a love letter to werewolf cinema, Jack Williamson's Darker Than You Think, T.J. Klune's Wolfsong & late-night Werewolf: The Apocalypse sessions.

ds: This game is about a secretive organization tasked with protecting the United States from paranormal and alien threats.
sd: In September 1996, an unexplainable murder brings a team of Delta Green agents to a small Southern town where a hapless local man has suffered awful changes. He may not be the only one.

ds: The game of heroic starship adventure puts you at the helm of your own starship. You and your crew will be pilots, engineers, scientists and marines moving around on and operating the starship.

t: 1970's Queer Beach Resort Disco Pulp Horror
ds:
You might have come here looking for an escape, some fun, a little extra money, or even love, but now people are seeing phantasms, strange animals—and stranger old gods—wander the woods, mysterious monoliths appear randomly, and that strange music is coming from somewhere.
 
 Imagine shows like Charmed, Buffy the Vampire Slayer, or Part 4 of Jojo's Bizarre Adventure but all set in a queer-normative 1970's disco-tinged setting. You may be a witch, or a shapeshifter, or just a hot person with a secret trying to get away from your old life. There are many things that go bump in the night - whether the boogieman is literal or figurative remains to be seen.
sd: 1979. You're spending the summer working in Roseville Beach, the queerest little town on Rose Island. Manage your job, relationships, & the supernatural horrors plaguing the town w/ your roommates.

t: The Minotaur, The Labyrinth, & The Knights of the Realm
ds: For brand new players and veterans alike who wish to transition from classic dungeon-crawlers into the mythic world of Bastionland by Chris McDowall. This adventure was written by Reilly Qyote!
sd: Step inside the Architect’s abandoned labyrinth and discover the secrets locked deep within its twisted hallways in this one-shot inspired by the ancient Greek myth of the Minotaur.

t: D&D with the Dungeon Dudes: Rat's Nest with Monty
ds:
Play with the Dungeon Dudes in this one-shot adventure set in the ruins of Drakkenheim, where you’ll delve beneath the shattered Rat’s Nest Tavern to rescue a captive from a ruthless ratling warren packed with traps and ambushes.
 We’ll have a wide range of pregenerated characters for every class available, but you’re also welcome to bring your own character if you prefer. Miniatures and printed character sheets will be provided. If you’d like to create your own character, please make a 3rd-level character using either the D&D 2014 or 2024 rules. Use point buy for ability scores. Any official D&D 5e material or Drakkenheim sourcebooks are allowed. Contaminated player options may be used at your own risk!
sd: Join Dungeons of Drakkenheim co-author and YouTube content creator Monty Martin of the Dungeon Dudes for a deadly one-shot into a ruthless ratling warren packed with traps and ambushes.

t: Murder Aboard the Siren Song. Hosted by Taylor’s Tavern Tales
ds:
Welcome to the Siren Song, a floating palace of luxury and indulgence, where only the rich, powerful, and mysterious gather for a once-in-a-lifetime voyage. Arcane engines hum beneath polished decks, jazz music fills the lounges, and the cocktails flow freely. It’s smooth sailing…until someone is murdered.
 
 In this fantasy-noir murder mystery, players step into a closed-circle investigation aboard a magical cruise ship inspired by classic whodunits. With the ship isolated at sea, almost every passenger and crew member is a suspect, and everyone has something to hide.
 
 This one-shot is designed to be welcoming to both experienced players and newcomers. Set at level 3, This game has very little combat, with more of an emphasis on roleplay, investigation, and collaborative storytelling.
sd: Step aboard the Siren Song, a lavish arcane cruise liner in a noir inspired fantasy world. Inspired by classic murder mystery stories, players must find the killer before the ship reaches port.

ds: Tannisvik is a port city on the north end of the Wyrdsee. Once a vibrant, fishing town, the port has been plagued by a creeping, unseasonable cold that has swept across the area, locking the port in a prison of ice. Come join The Wrecking Crew as we present for you the new Midgard from Pegasus Spiele. In this game all can cast magic and roleplay is rewarded. Tell me how will you fare?
sd: Tannisvik is a port city on the north end of the Wyrdsee. Once a vibrant, fishing town, the port has been plagued by a creeping, unseasonable cold that has swept across the area, locking the port ...

ds:
The deepest parts of the Pathfinder Society's collection of artifacts was once maintained by an entire faction: the Dark Archive. However, as factions changed and roles shifted, the Dark Archive shuttered, leaving the maintenance of this area to Zarta Dralneen, previous faction head and now head archivist of the Society. She's called upon a group of Pathfinders to enter into the deepest areas of the archive not only in search of an artifact that may help in the war with Cheliax, but also to reseal the magical fortifications around the archive.
 
 Pathfinder Society is a worldwide fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Pathfinder Second Edition ruleset. Take on the role of an agent of the Pathfinder Society, a legendary league of explorers, archaeologists, and adventurers dedicated to discovering and chronicling the greatest mysteries and wonders of an ancient world.
sd: 7th-8th level characters. A group of Pathfinders are sent into the deepest areas of the Society's archives when they discover not only a malfunctioning artifact but a thief within the bowels.

t: Learn How to Play AD&D - Terror Along The Nichat River
gm: Michael Lambert, Brennen Privett, Dennis Marshall
ds: Learn how to play Dungeons and Dragons through our unique adventure involving a river road used for centuries by the Dakku, a caravan trading people. They go between nations tribes over mountains and deserts and welcomed almost everywhere in peace. Upon their fall journey south, back to the Kingdom of Cevine, two of their companions have gone missing seemingly without a trace. You will have a choice of pre-generated characters of every type and persuasion with a Game Master who will guide you through the process on your way to enjoying the best of Table-Top-Role-Playing-Games.
sd: This introductory game will immerse everyone who wants to try their hand at Role-Playing into our unique magical fantasy setting in the world of A'raa.

gm: Erik Norris, Andrew Watkins, Dannielle Hasty
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds: Explore a shattered world in this TTRPG from Nick Francia. Play the pilot of giant robots called Automata as you work to protect the remnants of a broken world from eldritch horrors and 'Angelic' beings bent on dominating it. Built on the Year Zero Engine with unique worldbuilding and character development mechanics inspired by Neon Genesis Evangelion, Pacific Rim, and the psychological horror of Junji Ito, Berserk, and more! Eldritch // Automata is built and played within the Year Zero engine.
sd: A team of pilots are training when horrors attack. A distress beacon was dragged along from the assumed derelict renegade base Alpha1. The message is: Send help. Backup generators gone. We need help.

The year is 1988, and the Technocracy’s Hollow Earth dinosaur preserve code named Jurassic Park is supposed to be one of the safest research environments ever created. Built on cutting-edge biotechnology, automation, and a network of redundant systems, it is a triumph of Enlightened Science over nature itself. The Cray supercomputer has just declared Condition Red. Something inside the park has gone terribly wrong. You are the field Technocrats trapped inside, fighting to secure priceless samples and escape before science’s greatest achievement becomes one of its deadliest mistakes. 
 
 Content Warning: This is a Mage: The Ascension game set in the World of Darkness and includes horror, moral collapse, and supernatural science gone wrong. It is intended for mature audiences.

t: Explore the Caves of Chaos like it's 1983!
ds:
Keep on the Borderlands!
 
 Journey into the iconic dungeon crawl in roleplaying history. Filled with classic foes, treasure and perils. Get that 10 foot pole ready! We will use the modern 5e rules. Please have a level 1-3 character ready for the adventure. Please bring your character sheet, set of dice and a miniature to represent your character in combat situations.
sd: Your band of weary but steadfast adventurers has arrived at the Caves of Chaos. Which entrance will you enter? What creatures will you face? Will you live to tell the tale?

t: The Treasure of Plaguetide with Ginny Di
ds:
Join YouTuber and game writer Ginny Di for a pirate-y D&D one-shot! We’ll be playing at level 5. Character building instructions will be provided to you before the convention, or you can request a premade character if you’d prefer.
 You and your party find yourselves in possession of a map purported to lead to a legendary lost pirate treasure: The hoard of Captain Ursula “Whiplash” Crowe, renowned for her cruelty to both her enemies and her own crew. But the map leads to the island of Plaguetide, said to be wracked with infectious disease from which no sailor has escaped alive. Can you brave the horrors of the island to locate and secure the hoard, or will you join the list of seafarers who never returned from Plaguetide’s shores?
 
 Content warnings: Undead (zombies, ghosts), disease, gore (disembodied heart)
sd: You find yourselves in possession of a map purported to lead to a legendary lost pirate treasure. But will you brave the horrors of the island of Plaguetide, from which no sailor has escaped alive?

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Take a dive into a realm of fun and fantasy! Play one of AAW Games’ famous Mini-Dungeons. Exclusive for Trade Day in 2023, this is an adventure is for 4-6 characters of level 5. The demon Yx’larak is bound to the will of long-dead drow matrons. The foul creature maintains its end of the bargain: grant the blessings of the Spider Queen to any that somehow prove themselves worthy. Yx’larak won’t accept that it is his fault nobody has survived the challenge, but the demon is patient.
sd: Enter into the lair of the Spider Queen and confront the demon Yx’larak. Can you survive the challenge?

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Mystic totem poles that protect Rybalka have been vandalized and rendered powerless twice now, and the village will soon become vulnerable to the horrors of the Dark Wood if the replacement totem is not kept safe from a similar fate. The siblings who prepare replacements are down to their last eligible pole, which they barely managed to prepare in time. If it is also destroyed, Rybalka risks losing its mystic protection.
sd: Help Sulwe decipher who has the means and motive to strip the village of its culturally-rooted protections from the Vikmordere, and thus rendered vulnerable to that which lurks beyond.

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Mayor Igor Leonid has constructed a distillery outside Rybalka. The characters are hired to help and discretion is advised. However, when the characters arrive at the distillery they find something has gone horribly wrong as there have been some unexpected results from use of the hel-tainted varoot from Dark Wood. The clock is ticking and the party must hurry in order to save the future of Dark Redwood Distillery. Pre-generated characters are provided to jump right into the action.
sd: Help the mayor of Rybalka before an inspector from Mohkba, capital of the Klavek Empire, is scheduled to arrive to inspect the distillery.

t: The Golden Promise with Dungeon Dad
ds:
This adventure will put the characters in the path of Pale Kala, a malicious archfey who is intent on collecting a debt owed to him by the people who occupy three villages in his domain. 
 
 This encounter will contain a brief hexcrawl through a forest stricken by the Shining Plague, and depending on the path our heroes choose, may lead down several avenues of investigation into the fey lord himself.
 Once the party feels confident that they are armed with all the knowledge, allies, and equipment they will need, the characters will have to delve into the depths of Death’s Rest, an ancient and abandoned necromancer’s tower. In the bottom of this crumbling tower lies the portal to Pale Kala’s domain, and the ultimate confrontation with the primeval spirit himself. 
 How this ultimately pans out is up to the heroes.
sd: Three hundred thirty-three years ago, a bargain was struck. The Golden Promise. Three villages of The Lord’s Coppice were saved by an Archfey, and now, he has returned to exact his terrible price.

ds: This is a Play with the Author event! A horror 0-level funnel adventure.
sd: You are invited to Ives Manor for a will reading - what can go wrong? Note that this is not your standard funnel, only 2 PCs per player and the game heavily focuses on puzzles and deduction.

ds: Discover the prologue to Dearg, the official Esteren campaign! This is a medieval role-playing game, with an emphasis on the horrific and the Gothic. Drawing inspiration from Celtic myths, this universe has a discreetly fantastic side hidden under a bleak, realistic surface. The world is populated with humans who have to cope with tough daily lives, and face a supernatural threat lurking in the dark. With the focus of its adventures being investigation and survival, this game favors an immersive mood and interactions among the Players. This adventure will be run by our GMs with up to 6 players per table.
sd: Dive into the confines of nightmare in an elaborate scenario with original narrative concepts and discover the secrets of the vale of Loch Varn.

ds: Tainted Grail: Song of a Dying World offers a merciless, dark fantasy setting inspired by Arthurian myths and Celtic folklore. Play as one of humanity’s last survivors after a terrible epidemic and cataclysm. Face the dangers of mysterious Avalon: the Wyrdness and the colossal Fore-dwellers… Your characters, members of these last human communities, are destined to become the legendary Guardians of Avalon, a group of individuals marked by Arthur’s power and meant to defend their people in difficult times against the island’s dangers. This adventure will be run by our GMs with up to 6 players per table.
sd: Defend a land left without lord or army. Can you prevent the revolt of a people who believe they have been abandoned? Can you overcome the human and supernatural forces that will stand in your way?

ds: Discover the new edition of the iconic roleplaying game created by John Wick! Here, you’re not a nameless adventurer. You’re the main character in a swashbuckling movie! Your decisions can overturn conspiracies, topple rulers, prevent a war between two nations, seize an artifact from a secret society before it can gain power over a kingdom, turn an entire fleet with a single act of panache that shifts sailors’ allegiance, or bring a historical truth into the light, reshaping Théah’s balance for the next ten years. Your character is a Hero. They take risks when everyone else hesitates, win with style even when the situation is desperate, make choices that impact the world, and live with the consequences. This adventure will be run by our GMs with up to 6 players per table.
sd: Heroes are thrown into the thick of the action. Attend a grand reception at the court of the king of Castille and thwart an attempted attack that quickly turns into a barely disguised coup.

ds: Creana has spirits great and small worshipped by its people. One of these, the spirit of an oasis serving a far-flung outpost, has been kidnapped. The people are suffering. As agents of Pharon, you must chase down and recover this minor Passion, and bring its kidnappers to justice!
sd: Someone stole a spirit! Race them across Creana to get it back and save an oasis town.

ds: A human woman has lost her aunt and she needs some freelance snoops to track down what happened. Not all is as it seems, however, as you investigate the Curators and the local poor house. Everyone seems interested in how your case is going.
sd: A Legends of Barsaive Adventure. When the infirm disappear from Haven, who could benefit?

ds: Another artifact has disappeared while under the Adventuring Companies’ guard. What was this device and how does this keep happening? The ancient Loremaster Vardeghul recruits you to get to the bottom of it all.
sd: A Legends of Barsaive Adventure. An artifact has gone missing and everyone is interested.

ds: A competitive NC17 scenario. !!!Content Warning: Violence, Violence Against Women, Hallucinations, Murder, Loud Noises, and Confinement.!!!
sd: An unlikely collection of characters are brought together on one dark and stormy night, competing for their survival and sanity against each other as well as the secrets held inside the house.

ds: During Gen Con 2026, 6 players will be given the opportunity to play in this exclusive game. Just play in other R. Talsorian games - we are always watching. If we hand you a Golden Ticket, you are invited!
sd: Will you be the one to survive Mike Pondsmith's most dangerous game?

t: I Don't Think I Can Handle This
ds: The group hires a third party to investigate the matter, scales, talons, and all. The payday has perfect timing - a member of your crew needs to pay for therapy, badly. Play with designer James Hutt in this special one-shot event!
sd: A extinct species research facility in Utah has failed to submit data for a crucial quarterly earnings report. A group of Biotechnica activist investors smells a coverup.

ds: Your crew is contacted by Fixer Samantha Willis, better known as Reaping Willow in the Elflines Online community. Samantha just received word that Segotari and Puddleforge Games are auctioning off a case of rare, serialized Elflines Online TCG cards at this year's SegoCon. The owners of The Hollow, an Elflines Online themed bar, don't have enough eddies to bid against the wealthy collectors and scalpers, but they have enough to afford something better: your crew of experienced edgerunners with the skills and tools to pull of the nerdiest heist of the century. So grab your elf ears, guns, and tools; it's time to score big, or die trying! Join GM Diamond Dust in this Cyberpunk heist in the Time of the Red!
sd: Word is a rare box of trading cards is going up for auction at a gaming convention. Your job is getting it for free.

ds: Woodchipper, nomad contact for the Night City area, has set your crew up with a gig to help a local Thelas nomad named Maré salvage an old cargo ship that has been seen just off the coast of the city. However, the pay is suspiciously good, and anything that seems too good to be true in this city usually is. Join GM Emmerron and discover a terrifying remnant of the 4th Corporate War in this horror-themed Cyberpunk gig.
sd: One cargo wreck, an exec, and the deep Pacific come together in this horror-themed Cyberpunk gig that takes you to the depths of Night City Bay.

ds:
Adventure awaits! A bold reimagining of the world's second ever role playing game. In this hands-on demo with the new ruleset you'll, create your quirky character, learn the easy D6-based dice pool rules, and dive into an exciting encounter deep into the treacherous caves beneath Market Tharnley.
 
 Centuries ago, the sun disappeared and the Trolls awoke. Their colossal stone bodies destroyed the land, toppled mountains, and crushed villages underfoot. All the treasures, knowledge, and magicks of the age were lost. Heroes are needed more than ever, so grab your sword and your friends, and head down into the dark. Treasures await, but beware, don't wake the Trolls...
 
 Explore the Trollmark's deepest tunnels, face a mighty stone Troll, and try new mechanics like stunting rules and threat counters that add cinematic action and strategy to every roll.
sd: After uncovering a Troll cave beneath Market Tharnley, talk in the Rusty Bucket turns to glittering veins of rare Quartz deep in the cavern. Fortune may lie below for those brave enough to seek it.

ds:
POTENTIAL STORMLIGHT SPOILERS CONTAINED WITHIN ADVENTURE:
 At the height of the war for Roshar, Dalinar Kholin dispatches a party of radiants to investigate a disturbance tied to the storms themselves. The Stormfather has shown him a vision of a battle which occurred prior to the breaking. There is concern the fused have discovered a weapon they might be able to use to their advantage. What begins as simple reconnaissance mission quickly escalates into more than meets the eye. Will you succeed in preventing a calamity larger than anyone could imagine?
sd: You are assigned a mission from Dalinar Kholin himself to protect Roshar! The knights radiant and your people are counting on you!

ds: The Devil has tasked you to collect the souls of the dead and now awaits the story. Work with your pack on the details of your tale. Your mission is already complete; the only question is how.

ds: A classic fantasy tabletop role-playing game full of magic, mystery, and adventure. It is designed from the ground up to facilitate fast, furious play, with minimal prep time and adventures that are a breeze to run. Dragonbane is a game with room for laughs at the table, while still offering brutal challenges for the adventurers.
sd: A one-shot that the players will need to work together to solve puzzles, win battles, and find valuable treasure – all in just two hours!

ds:
Adventure awaits! A bold reimagining of the world's second ever role playing game. In this hands-on demo with the new ruleset you'll, create your quirky character, learn the easy D6-based dice pool rules, and dive into an exciting encounter deep into the treacherous caves beneath Market Tharnley.
 
 Centuries ago, the sun disappeared and the Trolls awoke. Their colossal stone bodies destroyed the land, toppled mountains, and crushed villages underfoot. All the treasures, knowledge, and magicks of the age were lost. Heroes are needed more than ever, so grab your sword and your friends, and head down into the dark. Treasures await, but beware, don't wake the Trolls...
 
 Explore the Trollmark's deepest tunnels, face a mighty stone Troll, and try new mechanics like stunting rules and threat counters that add cinematic action and strategy to every roll.
sd: After uncovering a Troll cave beneath Market Tharnley, talk in the Rusty Bucket turns to glittering veins of rare Quartz deep in the cavern. Fortune may lie below for those brave enough to seek it.

ds: An introductory adventure for the TTRPG of the upcoming sci-fi action-adventure RPG.
sd: Take your first steps in the galaxy. When a dying colony calls out for aid, will you find death or salvation on a centuries-old abandoned ship?

ds: Players will participate in the first few scenes from the longer scenario so that they can get their first taste of Daggerheart. The adventure features six pre-generated characters, including Marlowe Fairwind (Loreborne Elf Sorcerer), Barnacle (Underborne Ribbet Rogue), Garrick Reed (Highborne Human Warrior), Khari Nix (Ridgeborne Giant Guardian), and Tegan Saphire (Slyborne Faerie Bard). The adventure provides opportunities for players to interact with the world and contribute to its narrative by diving into collaborative storytelling, exploration, combat, and social interaction.

Time is of the essence in situations like these, and Caitlyn believes there’s foul play involved because she found Rosa’s diary in a strange place with bloodstained pages. She’s worried her sister is newly cursed or has fallen prey to a predatory Accursed. The crew must work together to investigate, eventually finding Rosa or confronting the person responsible for her disappearance.
 
 This is a game about being unapologetic monsters in a world where being monstrous is the least of your worries. You play as Accursed, descendants of monstrous lineages lurking in a modern world that closely resembles our own. You rebel against the ancient feuds between these entwined families, as well as against the web of curses that binds you.
 TRIGGER WARNING: Some of the events of what happened to Rosa in this adventure focus around a loss of control and a violent assault.
sd: An introductory adventure that follows an investigation into the disappearance of Rosa Rivers, the younger stepsister to Izzy’s contact, Caitlyn.

Players must then navigate the perilous tunnels back to their home settlement of Telver’s Hearth, potentially with monsters in pursuit. Each step of the journey allows the characters and their players to discover something new about the World Below. While threats haunt every crack and shadow, wonders sparkle alongside them.
 
 In The World Below, you explore, you map, you discover, you fight, and with fortune on your side, you might even survive. The Templars preach that “The World Below provides.” Perhaps it does, but only to those who earn it. You play inhabitants of the World Below, who band together to form habitats and parties. Together, you carve out a safe space in a hostile environment, procure resources to allow you to flourish, and find treasures to pass on to the next generation.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: In the Western Wastes, the Explorer's Guild has begun the arduous task of mapping the newly discovered Moontooth mountain range. However, efforts have been hampered by attacks by creatures that, by all rights, have no business being there. Despite this, recent expeditions have discovered the source of the misplaced monsters - an strange shifting, maze-like dungeon has appeared deep in the heart of the mountains. As duly deputized representatives of both the Adventure League and the Explorer's Guild, it is up to your party to ferret out the truth. An Adventure League compatible adventure for levels 5-7. Pre-generated character sheets will be available, or players can bring their own AL compatible characters.
sd: In the Moontooth Mountains, the Explorer's Guild has discovered a bizarre, dreamlike dungeon. Who created it, and what lurks within? 5th level pre-gens provided or bring your own AL-legal character.

t: Do You Know Where Your Children Are?
lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: It’s the 50th anniversary of the Halloween Howl, the annual Trick or Treat ball hosted by the Village of Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin for its children and families, and wonderful events are planned: a corn maze, a rockin’ rolling trick or treat, and a haunted hay ride all culminating in a magic show by the spectacular Carswell the Great! Little do the revelers of the bucolic village know that Carswell has made a deal with the Darkness and intends to sacrifice the town’s children to his fell patron! As chaos and terror reign and the witching hour approaches, can you answer the question striking horror in the hearts of Mount Pleasant’s parents: Do You Know Where Your Children Are?
sd: In Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin, something dark waits for The Halloween Ball to begin. Do you know where YOUR children are? 0-Level nodern.

lo: Stadium Field : Conspiracy of Gamers HQ
ds: In Pokerole, cards are not used, as every single check is tabulated by the amounts of "successes" you get on all of your d6's (any roll of 4 or higher). During scenarios players deal with a problem, similar to the Pokemon anime. Players deal with the problems as they see fit, whether with violence or other skills. Use your Will Points wisely over all three rounds, and claim tactical victory over your adversaries! Players may use any Pokemon that have acquired from previous Pokerole games. Players should bring 4 Pokemon into the tournament, but only 3 are used during each battle. Anyone without a full team of 4 Pokemon will draft from the pregenerated extra sheets provided by the Gamemaster. This is a swiss-style tournament, with prizes guaranteed for all participants! Winners also receive an invite to the quarterfinal round.
sd: Welcome to the Andwine Mettle Tournament! Here, trainers from all over the region gather to show the power of their bonds! Will you become the next Amateur Champion of Andwine?

t: Neon Odyssey: Galactic Bounty - Asteroid Duet

s: Three Raccoons in a Trench Coat
lo: ICC Hall C : Steve Jackson HQ
ds: What do you get when you combine a triplicate of trash pandas and one long coat? It’s up to you to find out. Join editor Irene Zielinski for a hilarious one-shot in which you play one of three procyon lotor masquerading as one homo sapien. Can you successfully fool the humans around you and complete your objective . . . or will chaos ensue?
sd: Three raccoons. One trench coat. 70,000 peeples at Gen Con Indy. What could possibly go wrong? This is a frenetic zine game.

lo: ICC Hall C : Steve Jackson HQ
ds: Six cartoon characters hired to build a vacation house. All the dangerous tools in the world. Three grumpy locals who don't want anything built. One monster in the lake. And no plans. Have a nice day!
sd: Six cartoon characters hired to build a vacation house. All the dangerous tools in the world. Three grumpy locals who don't want anything built. One monster in the lake. And no plans. Have a nice day!

t: A Tragedy for a Doomed Quartet
lo: ICC Hall C : Steve Jackson HQ
ds: In this exhilarating TTRPG, you and your friends will take on the roles of these messy bandmates in a high-stakes dice game of bluffing, secrets, and betrayal. You'll build your quartet, tell the story of their rise and inevitable fall, and reflect together on all the choices you made that led you down this sorry path.
sd: Thirteen years ago, four musicians struck a deal with the Devil for fame, riches, and stardom. The Devil has now come to collect his due, and they must attempt to flee their cursed contract.

t: Take a Look, and Find a Book
lo: ICC Hall C : Steve Jackson HQ
ds: Welcome to the Central Branch! As an Apprentice, you’ll need to work hard to prove that you have the skills to care for and safeguard an infinite number of magical tomes. As part of these duties, you will need to work together with other acolytes to locate and recover overdue books. Are you up to the challenge? Find out in this game of magic spells and mysterious volumes.
sd: This is a GM-less story game of magical research - a treat for library lovers and occultists alike. You and your fellow Apprentices will prepare spells to track down overdue magical volumes.

sd: A group of trainers are caught in the middle of a rivalry between Volbeats and Illumises!

lo: ICC Hall B : Horrible Guild HQ
ds:
In Wilderfeast, players assume the role of “wilders”: monster hunters / chefs who wield gargantuan kitchen implements and gain powerful mutations from each monster they eat. lo: JW White River Ballroom E HQ
ds:
The job was routine, the money fair. Then the damn company diverted you to answer a distress call from a ship that disappeared almost 80 years ago—a derelict carrying something bizarre, twisted, and alien. What the ship’s frozen crew brought back with them was bad enough—what they themselves were turning into was a bloody nightmare. Add to that an annoying sensor ghost shadowing you in the void, and your stress level is shot.
 It’s all a bit much.
 You don’t get paid enough to deal with monsters. But hold your breath, count to three, and play your cards right with this one, and you just might walk away very rich. Oh, who am I kidding?

ds: Rojo is an adventure for the Terror Target Gemini RPG based on Kurosawa's film Yojimbo. The story is set in a remote town in the Maju desert that is at the mercy of two rival crime gangs. On one side is the Rojo family, who control the liquor trade in the region and recently robbed an imperial convoy, stealing a dangerous weapon. On the other side is the Mengusu clan, who are seeking the support of other criminal families to crush the Rojo family. Alongside these gangs, there are also former bandits, deadly killers, secret agents and wannabe movie stars. It won't be easy for the Runners to avoid becoming involved in this war to control the village.

ds: At 04:33 on day 48 of the seventh month, the Eye systems detected a sudden instability in the Breach. Its frequencies shifted violently beyond the Higgs threshold, producing incomplete but significant data. By comparing past records, a new Paradox (catalogued as 220918) was identified with a small margin of error. Warden Kirst initiated the contact protocol, lifting the seals as sirens echoed through Bastion, and Operation Firefly began. The watchers were assigned to make contact with an alien entity from the Paradox.

ds: In 1348, Florence is ravaged by the Black Death, which turns the dead into ravenous Revenants. Ten young Florentines flee the city and seek refuge in a villa in the countryside, hoping to escape the horror. At first, the villa seems safe, but death soon follows them inside. People die, vanish or return as monsters, and the villa becomes a place of fear and mystery. The nearby abbey calls upon the Ordo Mortis to investigate and eradicate the contagion.

People die, vanish or return as monsters, and the villa becomes a place of fear and mystery. The nearby abbey calls upon the Ordo Mortis to investigate and eradicate the contagion.

lo: JW White River Ballroom E HQ
ds: When you come into possession of an Atlantean artifact, it promised a way out. Finding a buryer proved difficult and now it's been confiscated. Is the person in possession behind the strange events?
sd: When you come into possession of an Atlantean artifact, it promised a way out. Finding a buryer proved difficult and now it's been confiscated. Is the person in possession behind the strange events?

ds: Your Suyata team has been trying to break apart a cult that focuses on The Black, thinking our world is not the real one. The leader of the cultists has started a ritual to break down the barrier between Earth and the Black, threatening the structure of the universe. Bring together the talents and items your team has gathered to stop their plan!
sd: A cultist threatens to collapse the fabric of the universe centered in the Free States capital of Cahokia and your Suyata team may be the only thing that can stop them.

ds: [SPOILERS for Brandon Sanderson's Stormlight Archive books hinted at] Your team of Knights Radiant is escorting a group of humans and singers off planet via Shadesmar after the events of Wind and Truth. Survive both the pursuers and the environment with limited remaining stormlight.
sd: Help a group of civilians escape imminent death by travelling through Shadesmar.

ds: The Fanewick is older than any road, older than any map. It is a place where flowers bloom in the shape of faces, where bees hum in mourning tones, and where paths shift when no one is watching. You did not come here by accident. Each of you was summoned—by coin, by promise, by rumor, or by desperation—to the edge of the Fanewick, where a small frontier settlement has gone quiet. Couriers vanish. Hunters return changed. And something in the deep woods has begun to bloom when it should not. The locals say the forest is waking up. They say it has an Avatar now. You are offered a simple contract: enter the Fanewick, follow the signs, and stop whatever is spreading before the forest decides to spread into the world beyond it. The trail is open. The flowers are watching. What could possibly go wrong?
sd: What do you do when the forest comes alive and has it's own agenda?

ds: Uh oh, you accepted a boon from an arch fey and now they’re calling to collect. Suddenly transported to the Feywild, you must complete the quest or face their wrath. A one-shot filled with puzzles, encounters, and creative opportunities!
sd: A zany quest through the Feywild.

ds: Whoville in the Feywild is alive with Pride—music in the streets, magic in the air, and a celebration where everyone can shine. Visitors from across the planes have gathered for a festival of joy, color, and a little bit of delightful chaos. But when a strange contraption starts draining the very spirit of the celebration, things quickly go from festive… to frantic. Magic flickers and somewhere above it all, a certain grumpy troublemaker is pulling the strings. Grab your courage (and maybe some glitter), embrace the chaos, and help save Pride in this whimsical, beginner-friendly adventure. LGBTQ+ friendly. Level 4, beginner-friendly. Silly, chaotic fun with a heroic twist!
sd: Pride in Whoville is under attack! The Grinch is draining joy with a bizarre machine—race up his mountain, battle icy spider bots, and save the festival in this fun, beginner-friendly one-shot!

t: The Baker's Doesn't: A Queer Candy Confection Quest!
ds: Something has gone terribly wrong at a quiet village candy confectionary—and it’s not just some burnt sugar. Upon arriving in a small village, tired after your most recent quest, you and your fellow adventurers find a candy shop set ablaze! Will you help save the confectionary before it melts to the ground and uncover the truth of who is behind this candy coated arson?! Expect lighthearted roleplay, clever (but approachable) puzzles, and a dash of danger as things quickly spiral out of control. Designed for beginners but packed with enough flavor for seasoned players, this adventure is equal parts mystery, mischief, and mayhem. No baking experience required—just a sense of humor and a willingness to get your hands a little dirty. LGBTQIA+ and ally friendly, pre-gen characters and minis will be provided but feel free to bring any of your own items like dice or notebooks.
sd: A fiery mishap sparks a candy-coated quest! Explore a candy cottage, outwit a hag, and rescue a gold wyrmling in this fun, sugar filled pride adventure.

ds: This adventure is designed to give a taste of the system using the quick start adventure recently funded on Kickstarter. If you have a blast and want to keep playing, you can keep the rewards from this adventure when you join in the ongoing campaign. The system is fast, tactical and approachable for fans of old school D&D and newer players alike. Get in, get the goods, get home in time for supper.
sd: Brave mice venture out to recover the key to their society's safety. Premade characters provided. Earn a unique pin if you survive.

t: Brilliant Summer Magic (Play with the Designer)
ds: Welcome to the Queer Coven, a place to build community, make friends, find the meaning of love and family, and learn just who you were meant to be. Here, you are a queer witch (used gender-neutrally!) learning about your identity, your magic, and yourself. You and the other members of your Coven keep discovering strange magics in your safe haven. Is this the work of another Witch? Natural magic gone astray? Or something more nefarious? Band together, explore the world, and protect your Coven! Play with the designer and experience the game as it was meant to be played.
sd: A coven of young witches discovers new magic, identity, and chosen family during a brilliant summer, until strange forces begin to disrupt their safe haven.

ds: You are a Horde Hunter. Sick of being afraid, you take the fight to the zombies. This time, you’ve decided the best plan of attack is a truck full of explosives and absolute, reckless tenacity.

ds: New Quest: Children of the Lost. THIS IS A GROUP QUEST. Your party has been designated Host of this Group Quest. This is a pass or fail quest. Failure has consequences. A secret cult in this lovely village has been kidnapping villagers and crawlers to feed their twisted obsession, and they are preparing a ritual that will wipe the village off the map. You have two hours to identify the cult, find the ritual site, and stop it. Oh, and the village is in a bubble, so you cannot leave, you cannot abandon the quest, and you cannot do that thing where you “come back later” because you are feeling cautious. If the ritual completes, the village dies, and since you are trapped inside, you die with it. Reward: You will receive a Legendary Quest Box. Failure: You will be dead. Probably painfully. Definitely painfully. Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: Welcome to the 5th level! New Quest: Children of the Lost. This cult will erase this village in 4 hours! Find the cult, stop the ritual. DON'T try to ditch the quest and skip town!

lo: JW White River Ballroom C--D HQ
ds: Mayor Igor Leonid has constructed a distillery outside Rybalka. The characters are hired to help and discretion is advised. However, when the characters arrive at the distillery they find something has gone horribly wrong as there have been some unexpected results from use of the hel-tainted varoot from Dark Wood. The clock is ticking and the party must hurry in order to save the future of Dark Redwood Distillery. Pre-generated characters are provided to jump right into the action.
sd: Help the mayor of Rybalka before an inspector from Mohkba, capital of the Klavek Empire, is scheduled to arrive to inspect the distillery.

t: Traveller: Cold Trail in Kethara Reach
ds: Sometimes a complicated extraction beats no extraction at all. You crossed the border twenty-three days ago. Lakamsal is a forgotten Imperial frontier world one parsec inside the Solomani border, and your SolSec remote operations cell has nearly finished what it came to do — running surveillance drones over a Naval Intelligence relay that has been bleeding Confederation fleet secrets for over a year. Extraction is seventy-two hours away. Then the thermal spoofing unit starts failing. Then Imperial sensor drones arrive on a sweep pattern nobody planned for. Then something very large finds your heat signature in the dark. Your cell are experts at directing drones and autonomous systems against targets on enemy soil. Those skills were not designed for this. Can you hold the station long enough to get the data out? Or will SolSec simply have to deny you were ever there?
sd: Five SolSec agents. One failing thermal unit. Imperial Marines in orbit. And the megafauna don't care whose side you're on.

t: Legends of Greyhawk - Highfolk #4 - Wrath of the Blighted Wood
ds: Corruption spreads through the Vesve Forest, and magical wards must be planted to slow the blight’s advance. But the tainted woods are not so easily tamed, and agents of Iuz and an entity only known as the Walking Green stand in your way. Can you sort friend from foe, and salvation from corruption, before the forest is lost - and your lives with it? A Legends of Greyhawk adventure for level 1-4 characters. Interested in playing earlier parts of this story before the show? Head over to www.legendsofgreyhawk.com for in-person and online events, FAQs, and an amazing community ready to help you make the most of your Gen Con.

Can you uncover the truth before it leads to catastrophe? A Legends of Greyhawk multi-table special for level 5–10. Interested in playing earlier parts of this story before the show? Head over to www.legendsofgreyhawk.com for in-person and online events, FAQs, and an amazing community ready to help you make the most of your Gen Con.

t: Legends of Greyhawk - Champions of the Crawl
ds: A competition at Castle Greyhawk draws adventurers seeking fame and glory. Delve into a newly discovered dungeon and race to explore its chambers and uncover its secrets. Will you rise to the challenge and claim victory, or falter before the dungeon's trials? A Legends of Greyhawk adventure for level 5-10.

ds: Come join us for the first ever Trading Post for the Legends of Greyhawk campaign. This ticket guarantees you a spot during this time frame for up to two transactions. Browse a selection of items for trade or purchase, some cool unique things, as well as the ability to turn an un-certed magic item into a physical cert. All proceeds from the Trading Post will benefit charity.

t: Grim Hollow 2-1: Requiem for the Living
ds: The streets of Liesech whisper of a gathering at the Froth Church’s decaying ruin amidst a plague-riddled slum. Meanwhile, a father has gone missing. His children fear the old man’s faith is leading him to his doom and beg for his return before he joins the rotting congregation. This 3-hour adventure is part of Grim Hollow Organized Play – Season 2. It is playable by 5.5e player characters of levels 5 to 7. Org Play rules can be found online at https://ghostfiregaming.com/resources/ Pregens will be available.

t: Grim Hollow 2-2: Worse than the Disease
ds: The Morbus Doctore privately conduct eldritch experiments in their mandate to cure (and control) the Weeping Pox. One such test subject has escaped. The organization prizes their secrets and rewards anyone capable of hunting and destroying their mislaid property. This 3-hour adventure is part of Grim Hollow Organized Play – Season 2. It is playable by 5.5e player characters of levels 5 to 7. Org Play rules can be found online at https://ghostfiregaming.com/resources/ Pregens will be available.

t: Grim Hollow 3-2: A Coin for your Silence
ds: The Silent Citadel has become an eyesore to Simona Calcien. The dark tower rises from the center of her prosperous town like a rotting monolith that looms over its idyllic surroundings. Simona has brought great wealth to her city. But the priests inside the Silent Citadel refuse her generosity, and therefore her influence. The priests are dedicated to the Arch Seraph Solyma, the Great Judge. Her worshippers kneel in reverent silence until they hear the Arch Seraph speak to them, which is a vigil that lasts an entire lifetime. Will you accept the coin of House Calcien to banish these priests, or try hearing the words of Solyma for yourself? This 3-hour adventure is part of Grim Hollow Organized Play – Season 3. It is playable by 5.5e player characters of levels 8 to 10. Org Play rules can be found online at https://ghostfiregaming.com/resources/ Pregens will be available.

t: Grim Hollow 3-2: A Coin for your Silence
ds: The Silent Citadel has become an eyesore to Simona Calcien. The dark tower rises from the center of her prosperous town like a rotting monolith that looms over its idyllic surroundings. Simona has brought great wealth to her city. But the priests inside the Silent Citadel refuse her generosity, and therefore her influence. The priests are dedicated to the Arch Seraph Solyma, the Great Judge. Her worshippers kneel in reverent silence until they hear the Arch Seraph speak to them, which is a vigil that lasts an entire lifetime. Will you accept the coin of House Calcien to banish these priests, or try hearing the words of Solyma for yourself? This 3-hour adventure is part of Grim Hollow Organized Play – Season 3. It is playable by 5.5e player characters of levels 8 to 10. Org Play rules can be found online at https://ghostfiregaming.com/resources/ Pregens will be available.

t: Grim Hollow 3-3: Fires which Seek the Garden of Plenty
ds: Rumors persist that a sanctuary for the cursed, the mage, and the magically corrupted is hidden away in the coauntryside of Sante Viegre. It’s said to be shrine to the Arch Seraph Aphaeleon. Through tranquil meditation and contemplation, a person can repent their sins and be healed of their afflictions. Nevertheless, the Arcanist Inquisition pursues the scent of heresy towards this refuge. Will you join their crusade to destroy these apostates, or rush to warn those sheltering in the Garden of Plenty that the fires of the Inquisition spread towards them? This 3-hour adventure is part of Grim Hollow Organized Play – Season 3. It is playable by 5.5e player characters of levels 8 to 10. Org Play rules can be found online at https://ghostfiregaming.com/resources/ Pregens will be available.

t: A Tragedy for a Doomed Quartet
lo: ICC Hall C : Steve Jackson HQ
ds: In this exhilarating TTRPG, you and your friends will take on the roles of these messy bandmates in a high-stakes dice game of bluffing, secrets, and betrayal. You'll build your quartet, tell the story of their rise and inevitable fall, and reflect together on all the choices you made that led you down this sorry path.
sd: Thirteen years ago, four musicians struck a deal with the Devil for fame, riches, and stardom. The Devil has now come to collect his due, and they must attempt to flee their cursed contract.

t: Take a Look, and Find a Book
lo: ICC Hall C : Steve Jackson HQ
ds: Welcome to the Central Branch! As an Apprentice, you’ll need to work hard to prove that you have the skills to care for and safeguard an infinite number of magical tomes. As part of these duties, you will need to work together with other acolytes to locate and recover overdue books. Are you up to the challenge? Find out in this game of magic spells and mysterious volumes.
sd: This is a GM-less story game of magical research - a treat for library lovers and occultists alike. You and your fellow Apprentices will prepare spells to track down overdue magical volumes.

s: Three Raccoons in a Trench Coat
lo: ICC Hall C : Steve Jackson HQ
ds: What do you get when you combine a triplicate of trash pandas and one long coat? It’s up to you to find out. Join editor Irene Zielinski for a hilarious one-shot in which you play one of three procyon lotor masquerading as one homo sapien. Can you successfully fool the humans around you and complete your objective . . . or will chaos ensue?
sd: Three raccoons. One trench coat. 70,000 peeples at Gen Con Indy. What could possibly go wrong? This is a frenetic zine game.

ds: Miniatures will be proved for table along with character sheets & pencils.

ds: Throwing a party at the last minute is not easy, especially if it is critical that it go well! You've just received word that Madame Anthemia, the locally famous spiritualist is visiting town, and you need to throw her a welcoming party. What are your plans? How will the spooky bat respond? What could go wrong? Grab your tea and get cozy as we settle in for a 4-hour RiverBank event! Pre-generated characters will be provided. An Adult must accompany all minors. Please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page that is linked within the event for more general information.
sd: You and your posh Animal friends host an elegant soiree where absolutely nothing goes wrong. Spoiler: Everything goes wrong. Can you salvage the evening?!

t: Tales of the Valiant: Runes of the World Tree
ds: Yggdrasil, the World-Tree. Within its sacred boughs are nestled entire planes of existence, making it a rare fixed-point within the twists and turns of the Labyrinth. Held especially sacred by the people of the Northlands, an unthinkable act of destruction against the World-Tree will send your party on the trail of a brutal mercenary band in search of the Hexrage Axe, crafted from Yggdrasil itself. This adventure is for 3rd-level pre-generated characters using new ToV Player's Guide 2 classes and features. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: Travel the Labyrinth to the farthest reaches of the Northlands, find the Ironsworn company, and resist the fury within the Hexrage Axe or fall victim to its curse. Let the skalds sing of your victory!

ds: You must hunt down Finulf One-hand and retrieve Uror's Shears. If you succeed, you save the world and become epic heroes! If you fail, Ragnarok starts early and the world is doomed. No pressure. You'll need all your wits to handle the puzzles and traps of the barrow, and all your battle skills to defeat the cultists bent on kicking off Ragnarok. Will you answer the call? This adventure is for 1st-level 5E 2024 characters. Pre-generated characters using new Northlands subclasses and features will be provided. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: Loki has given you a path to become a hero of legend: retrieve a magical artifact and capture a thief. Sounds simple, right? Nothing's ever simple when the god of mischief is involved.

t: Tales of the Valiant: Progeny of Blood
ds: Become a Night Hunter and unravel the mystery that haunts the village of Thrushdale. What you learn will determine the fate of a young boy and blur the lines between monster and man. Will you overcome the darkness, or be consumed by it? This adventure is for 3rd-level Tales of the Valiant characters, and features horror and dark fantasy content. Pre-generated characters will be provided. An adult must accompany all minors. For more general information, please refer to the FAQ on our Organized Play page, which is linked in the event.
sd: A troubled teenage boy vanishes from an isolated village. When the party investigates, they uncover a web of occult secrets, forbidden magic, vampirism, and a shadow war between two factions.

ds:
Drifmeyer has three factions that form the ruling council. They have reached out to your party for aid in cleansing the corruption from the sewers. But they each have a different approach, some more ghastly than others. Which choice will you make? How will that choice affect you and will it give the desired outcome?
 The Unbound Odyssey is a ttrpg game system where players have control over every aspect of their character. You can create your own class. You can create your own spells. You can wear whatever you want and wield whatever weapons you want. In this gaming system you are not restricted like most other systems.
 Sewers of Drifmeyer is an RPG that plays like a ttrpg, board game and skirmish wargame all in one with a deep story arch built in with a questline filled with player choice.
sd: The murdered elf maiden Aedra’s corpse is missing from her tomb. Since then the corruption in the sewers has grown, people are missing, and it must be cleaned out. How is up to you!

ds:
Detroit, 2026. A unity festival promises to bridge the gap between mutants and humans — but something sinister stirs beneath the streets.
 Your team of mutant heroes descends into the sewers to investigate strange disturbances and discovers a conspiracy far bigger than anyone expected. The Rat King plots to expand his domain. A ruthless Enforcer guards dark secrets. And behind it all, The Overlord races to activate an ancient Stargate that could give him absolute power over the city.
 Across three acts, you'll forge alliances, battle dangerous foes, and make choices that shape the outcome. When The Overlord's forces assault the festival in a climactic showdown at Hart Plaza, everything you've done — every ally gained, every secret uncovered — determines whether Detroit survives or falls.
 Action. Exploration. Tough moral calls. Detroit's future is yours to decide.
sd: Mutant heroes investigate sewer disturbances threatening Detroit's unity festival — and uncover a villain's plot to activate an ancient relic that could doom the city. Your choices shape its fate.

ds: For a group of rookie mercenaries, this looked to be an easy job. All they needed to do was watch a small town in remote New Mexico while their benefactor is out of town, and they get to stay at their benefactor’s cushy estate! Little do the adventurers realize that their cushy job is anything but as their benefactor has an agenda of their own, and the town itself has some serious problems! The town’s Body Doc has gone missing, and the mercenaries are tasked with finding him.
sd: It is 105 P.A. A group of mercs are hired to defend a small town in remote New Mexico, easy right? Turns out it’s anything but easy; you’re called in to investigate the disappearance of the town doc.

ds: The vault the Kingsdale map had led them to is now secured, and what valuables it contains is now secure in the Vault Hunters’ vehicle. All that remains is to get it to their buyer in the Chicago Network for their big payday…who is right in the middle of the Chi-Town ‘Burbs! Aside from negotiating with the Black Market and dodging the CS, there’s another party with eyes on the Vault Hunters’ prize
sd: The loot secured, the Vault Hunters need to get their loot to the buyer in the Chi-Town ‘Burbs, right under the CS noses. The CS aside, someone else is eyeing their Pre-Rifts loot.

lo: JW White River Ballroom E HQ
ds: You are a Blade Runner tasked with hunting rogue synthetics. Nexus-9 replicants are ready for public launch, except one turned up dead and another is missing. You need to figure out what happened. Pre-generated characters are provided. Trigger Warnings: Human prejudice, death, mental trauma
sd: You are a Blade Runner tasked with hunting rogue synthetics. Nexus-9 replicants are ready for public launch, except one turned up dead and another is missing. You need to figure out what happened.

ds:
The Fated have been tasked with investigating a rash of undead attacks in the heart of downtown Malifaux. Can they search the labrynthine sewers below the city and destroy whatever is causing the outbreaks without winding up a part of the next wave? 
 Players may use one of the provided pregenerated characters, or bring a character from our character creation sessions, for this card-based steampunk weird west rpg. Will you accept the whims of Fate or Cheat your way to your own goals?
sd: The Fated have been tasked with investigating undead attacks in the heart of downtown Malifaux. Can they destroy whatever is causing the outbreaks without winding up a part of the next wave?

ds: Six cartoon characters hired to build a vacation house. All the dangerous tools in the world. Three grumpy locals who don't want anything built. One monster in the lake. And no plans. Have a nice day!
