t: Learn to Play: Out of Gas
gm: Dannielle Hasty, Erik Norris, Sari Ballard
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds:
New Players welcome! Create your own character and learn the rules. No experience needed. You haven’t seen your best friends from school in at least five years. After graduation you all went your separate ways. But now, at long last, the stars (and your calendars) have aligned, and it’s time for a vacation! What could go wrong?
 
 New Players welcome! In the first hour players may create their own character and learn the rules. No experience needed.
sd: You haven't seen your school friends in five years, but the stars have finally aligned for a long-awaited reunion vacation. What could possibly go wrong?

ds:
Step into an exclusive Gooey Cube experience hosted in a private suite and personally run by master storyteller, Alphinius Goo. Play on a stunning Dwarven Forge dungeon as you dive into a richly immersive adventure—and take home a signed copy of A Trouble with Rats (a $60 value) and enjoy this game with libations in hand—drinks will be provided.
 
 A Trouble With Rats was co-authored with Ed Greenwood and is a classic dungeon crawling and investigation with a twist—where uncovering the truth may be more perilous than the threat itself. 
 
 First level Pre-Gens will be provided, or feel free to build your own.
sd: What starts as rats in a cellar reveals a conspiracy beneath Etholmm. Explore hidden tunnels, uncover dark magic, and face a rising threat—GM'd by Gooey Cube’s Alphinius Goo.

t: Rio Dorado - Action in the Weird Old West
ds: Small cattle rancher is being bullied by a larger spread for its water rights. You arrive in the town of Rio Dorado at the wrong time or is the just the right time to do some good. What is that foul stench? It smells like death.
sd: Cattle ranch wars with a small dose of undead thrown in to spice things up.

ds:
This Level 3 adventure blends haunted wilderness exploration with tense investigation and dangerous combat. Navigate twisting woodland paths, uncover the truth behind the tower’s return, and confront the darkness spreading through the Hollows before it takes root for good.
 
 Experience this event in a private suite with 3-6 players and the author of The Witch's Wrath as your GM.
sd: An ancient evil stirs in Mistwood Hollows. Caravans vanish and a forgotten tower awakens. Dare the cursed woods and uncover the secret rising from the dark.

ds:
Experience this event in a private suite with a hand-selected GM to give your party an amazing experience.
 
 The Deepest Fear is a 3rd-level roleplay and investigation-driven adventure designed for players who enjoy tension, mystery, and meaningful character interaction. The adventure builds steadily toward a dramatic grand finale where everything the party has uncovered comes to bear in a climactic confrontation that tests both resolve and judgment. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Unearth the secrets lurking beneath the city of Darkenhaven. Brave the grime-filled alleys where the nefarious halfling Noggleboffin’s gang has a dark mission in service of an even darker master.

ds:
Experience this event in a private suite with a hand-selected GM to give your party an amazing experience.
 
 Brand new at Gen Con 2026. Prime Rib is a level 3 chaotic combat-heavy romp through the back woods, where the adventurers encounter a house full of unpleasant individuals fond of moonshine and loaded crossbows. Sent to rescue a number of hapless guardsmen, the party must figure out how to find and free them while navigating the many foul Butcher family members that infest the dwelling. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Venture into moonshiner territory at the Butcher Farm, where deadly traps and a murderous clan lurk, ready to protect their bootlegging operation. Survive the carnage and end their reign of terror.

ds:
Experience this event in a private suite with a hand-selected GM to give your party an amazing experience.
 
 The Truth Lies Cold is a 3rd-level adventure that blends tense cave exploration, layered investigation, and chilling supernatural encounters. Designed for players who enjoy uncovering secrets as much as drawing steel, this scenario challenges both mind and mettle. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: The Steel Dagger vanished in the Mournwood. Hired by a shadowy figure, your party must brave Crovendown Cave to recover a lost amulet—while something unseen watches from below.

ds:
Experience this event in a private suite with a hand-selected GM to give your party an amazing experience.
 
 Brand new at Gen Con 2026. The Silence of the Grave is a Level 6 adventure featuring gothic-horror elements, which leans heavily on investigation and roleplay. It has an open, lead-driven structure which takes the party through multiple locations, where they interact with NPCs and uncover clues. It concludes in a dungeon crawl with eerie exploration and high-stakes combat. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: Drawn into the Gloomport’s seedy streets, your party uncovers a fiend’s twisted mirror feeding on fear. To stop a deadly Beacon of Discord, they must survive gangs, cults, and rising chaos.

ds:
Experience this event in a private suite with a hand-selected GM to give your party an amazing experience.
 
 Shades of Loss is a roleplay-heavy, exploration-focused adventure that challenges players to navigate a corrupted wilderness where the land itself seems alive with malice. Twisting paths, unsettling encounters, and shifting terrain create a constant sense of unease as the party pieces together what truly happened.
 
 Combat is present, sharp, and dangerous—but the greater challenge lies in haunting exploration, tense roleplay, and memorable encounters. Parties will be made up of 3-6 players per table.
sd: In the Mournwood, something has taken a child—and the forest does not easily give back what it claims. Your party must brave shifting woods and lurking horrors to stop a creature of despair.

gm: Erik Norris, Dannielle Hasty, Jonsi Donnelly
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds:
New Players welcome! Rules taught, pregen heroes available or bring your EGO character. It’s the final scorching day of the Nacho Haüs international Fusion Festival and temperatures, tempers, and tensions are high. Now, REDEMPTION has intel of threats to the concert and its $200,000 prize money. Walt DeWalt, aloft in the dirigible Piñachtung, calls in the heroes and an old hand from his past to provide extra security...just in time. 
 
 This scenario is a part of Everyday Heroes Organized Play, with character progression and scenario tracked.
sd: Bring your EGO character or pregen. It's the final day of the Nacho Haus Fusion Festival. REDEMPTION has intel on threats to the concert and its $200k prize. Walt DeWalt calls you in for security.

gm: Erik Norris, Dannielle Hasty, Jonsi Donnelly
lo: Crowne Plaza Illinois Street Ballroom HQ
ds:
New Players welcome! Rules taught, pregen heroes available or bring your EGO character. Still recovering from last season's attack by M.O.M., REDEMPTION receives an unusual bequest: a junkyard in New Mexico. The heroes are brought in by Walt DeWalt to investigate. What they all discover beneath the rubble will change the history of REDEMPTION forever and send them on a season of interdimensional adventures chasing down the traitorous Director, before it is too late.
 
 This scenario is a part of EGO Organized Play with player and character progression tracked for the scenario.
sd: Bring your EGO character or pregen. After M.O.M.'s attack, REDEMPTION inherits a New Mexico junkyard. Investigate the rubble to uncover a secret that launches an interdimensional hunt for a traitor.

sd: There might be a bit more than Zenner cards being played in this session. It might involve a good horror story.

t: Legends of Greyhawk - Author Special - Whispers from the Well of Wishes
ds: The old elven map shows the way to the Well of Wishes, an ancient ruin in the Kron Hills from the time before humans walked the Flanaess. Is it a treasure map as the dwarves archeologist proclaims or is it an invitation to ruin as the Knights of Luna warn? Or maybe it’s both? There’s only one way to know for sure. A Legends of Greyhawk Author Only adventure for level 1-4.
sd: The old elven map shows the way to the Well of Wishes, an ancient ruin in the Kron Hills from the time before humans walked the Flanaess. Level 1-4.

ds: "Won't you take that ride on heavy metal?" Plunge into the far out worlds of Heavy Metal. Become Taarna, Den, Barbarella and Harry Canyon, to name a few. Seek out the source of the Loc-Nar and end its evil for all time. Adventure across space and time, battle the forces of Uhluhtc as you soar the skies of Neverwhere. With all the feel of a midnight movie we dive into the pages of the magazine. This adventure is not for the timid. Rated R for Violence, Horror, Sexual Situations and Humor.
sd: Plunge into the far out worlds of Heavy Metal magazine. Seek out the source of the Loc-Nar and ends its evil for all time. Den, Tarrna, and many more. Not for the timid, Rated R. Wanna take a ride?

ds:
The invasion of the Wreck of the Returned continues as a team of Starfinders enters the magical heart of the Wreck, a metaphysical liminal space occupied by Elovai’s mind. But can a foe as dangerous and powerful as a First One be defeated in a realm under her control? Battle your way through the heart of the Wreck to take down Elovai in a final showdown over the fate of Akiton! 
 
 Starfinder Society is a worldwide science-fantasy roleplaying campaign using the Starfinder roleplaying game ruleset. The Society travels the galaxy in search of lost knowledge and technologies, bringing what they learn back to share with the Pact Worlds.
sd: 5th-6th level characters. Navigate a magical demiplane to confront and destroy the master of the Wreck of the Returned in this finale to Invasion's Edge!

ds: Formed in secret six months ago, this loose-knit organization of vampires, walking corpses, morally grey wizards and one heck of an administrative staff are the Allies’ last chance at victory. As Hitler prepares to reveal a new breed of fascist lycanthropes, you and your fellow F.A.N.G. commandos launch their final mission: to crash-land in occupied Paris and fatally destabilize the Nazi war machine. We will be playing a one-shot session of ‘Eat the Reich,’ a fast-paced, supernaturally blood-spattered romp through Paris where our ultimate goal is to have fun and punch/eviscerate fascists. While the game is necessarily hyperviolent, the vibes are less grimdark horror and more ‘What We Do in the Shadows.’
sd: The year is 1943. Europe is in flames. You are a crack unit of vampire commandos with a single goal: drink Hitler's blood and topple the Nazi regime.

ds: WELCOME, CRAWLERS! Your sleepy New England town is known for its Gothic architecture, haunted happenings, and fall foliage. Not much else happens here in Mountainville, New Hampshire - so the apocalypse is definitely new. When life comes to a grinding halt, will you and your friends descend the mysterious staircase that has appeared in Old North Cemetery? Fight your way to the Tutorial Guild and encounter your first Neighborhood Boss in this adventure designed to teach you how to play Dungeon Crawler Carl, the TTRPG. Avoid Zombie Puritans, Resurrected Ghosts, and worst of all, Leaf Peepers and Townies, as you navigate Floor 1! Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: Not much happens in your small New England town, so the apocalypse is definitely new. Do you have what it takes to descend and survive the Dungeon? Better hope so, remember, avoid the leaf peepers!

ds: Welcome crawlers! Because that's what you are now: crawlers! Don't know what that means? Well, you just entered a weird doorway after the entire world flattened and likely killed everyone you know. What a glorious day to be alive, am I right? The Tutorial Guild is right ahead of you, so go ahead and try your best to keep surviving! It’s a new season and a new dungeon, and you are the star attraction! Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
sd: You've entered the dungeon after the world flattened and everyone you know is likely dead. But not you! Now head into the tutorial guild and try to keep surviving!

Hey, is that a glowing book in the llamas saddle bag? Good luck, crawlers! Now get out there and kill, kill, kill!
